name: Floodlight Cam Plus Wired
bestFor: Hardwired outdoor floodlight security with dual 2000 lumen LED lights

reviews.body:
Just had the Ring Floodlight Cam Wired Plus installed by electrician. Works great Only have the one at this stage. cost after 30 trial $49.95 per annum a reasonable price. Easy to operate. Will purchase another camera soon at a cost of $149.95 per annum this cost ensures you can have multiple cameras still a very reasonable price in my view.
During the trial period you have limited access to change modes. After you subscribe you have access to further fine tune the camera, makes obvious sense.
Those negative feedbacks regarding prices etc like all products you need to do your homework. It's obvious that any security camera or tech. will cost something. In saying my research showed Ring offered a very competitive pricing in comparison to other similar home security cams.
I gave 4 stars based on price, product style & service from Ring. I generally do not give 5 stars unless it is
an exceptional product.
reviews.title: I Think It's Good Value
reviews.author: Steve

reviews.body: This is our home's first security camera which we bought for the intention of monitoring our puppy whenever she is left at home alone. The setup of the camera was very easy and it has some great functions. The wide angle lens captures the majority of our deck and garden. The microphone is very sensitive but eliminates most background noise. The floodlight is VERY bright but can be dimmed in the app. The Ring app itself is enhances the functionality of the camera, allowing you to set some adjustments to suit your needs, like floodlight sensitivity and Geo-fencing. I like the auto-capture function, where an image is taken at a set frequency and the video recording when there is motion detected. I am current on a 30 day free trial of the Ring Protect Plan so I don't know if I will lose the video-recording when this expires. My kids loved the 2-way talk function but I don't think I will use it much for the back garden. I will probably invest in another unit for the front of the house in the near future.The only things that would improve this unit is a motorized camera (allowing you to move the camera in-app). As above, I'm not sure if I will lose any functions when the trial subscription expires. This may determine whether or not I sign up for the Ring Protect Plan.
reviews.title: Excellent Video and Sound Quality
reviews.author: anonymous

reviews.body: I was given the Ring Floodlight Camera Wired Plus to try and review. Overall it is a very good product! The setup was really easy and straightforward using the Ring app on my phone after it was installed by a licensed electrician. The video quality is outstanding be it in daytime or nighttime. Also, I can see whats happening in our front yard wherever I am thanks to the Ring app and it works well with the product no glitch so far! The floodlights are really bright and can be turn on and off using the app as well. Compact and looks great in our front area. Definitely worth it and highly recommended!
reviews.title: A product that actually WORKS!
reviews.author: Lady

reviews.body:
The kit is good. Easy install, the resolution is good and the os is pretty intuitive.
It does require a monthly service fee to store and retrieve footage, which I hadn't realised on purchase. There are also a range of super-duper-delux packages etc which is a bit annoying.

The Ring Floodlight Cam Wired Plus sends real time notifications and floodlights are activated when motion is detected. It has colour night vision for clearer images. Two way talk is also a feature allowing communication with anyone on your property. It also features a built in siren for added protection. Every feature can be controlled via the Ring app on your phone.
reviews.title: Ring Floodlight Cam Wired Plus
reviews.author: anonymous

reviews.body: Deceptively, at point of sale we are not told that a subscription is needed to see our own data. There are much cheaper systems that let you see and store your own video. Considering that you will be charged over $50 each year to use each camera it is surprising they're not giving them away. Since we have already paid to have these wired in it would be expensive to return them.

reviews.body: Great coverage and high resolution camera. Does everything it’s says it will do, easy to use settings to make changes where needed. Not sure why you would need the more expensive model, this does a great job and floodlights are a bonus. The intercom is clear and the alarm wasn’t over the top too loud but enough to hear it from inside.

reviews.author: Saachi B

reviews.body:
I have been using this for about a year and a half and it has been fantastic. We got it as we could not add a smart chime to our home given the location of the entry so we opted to replace our driveway floodlight with this one and we've not regretted it one bit!

Taking into consideration it is 1080HD and not 4k it does a descent job to show you who or what is on your driveway or coming to your door. I have been able to accept packages that needed signing by using the intercom and this alone has saved me travel and nuisance of having to go to the post office to pick things up.

The membership is useful (and not too expensive), it really makes it worthwhile if you have 2 or more camera areas you want to keep an eye on (e.g. front and backyards)

I recommend it and works great

reviews.author: Serge

reviews.body: Good camera overall, video quality is good and has 2-way talk and alarm funtions. Simple installation by electrician - needs power only, connects via WiFi. Lights work well and human motion detection seems accurate. App features are good but if you want to be able to record and replay motion activation events then thats a yearly subscription. Basic free features are motion notification and live view only so if you don't check immediately you will have no idea who set off the notification. No option to record 24/7 to the cloud or locally. You need good WiFi connection. Good choice if you want to swap out an existing floodlight. Would be more stars without subscription model.

reviews.body: Great product easy to install and set up. Hubby managed to do it himself by replacing the previously installed flood light. Our wifi router is on the other end of the house (about 70meters away) and no problems with connecting to the internet at all. You do have to pay $50 per year to be able to replay footage but happy to do so for a great app and clear footage.

The live and recorded views are excellent. I have a ring video 3 plus doorbell, two battery security cams and one wired security cam, and an indoor cam and a battery cam.

reviews.author: anonymous

reviews.body: Great electronic qualities but not the best for real world. To replace the batteries you must use 2 hands because the battery cover screws on (very tightly). You must use 2 hands or you will move the camera and then have to reposition it. picture up on top of a 10 foot ladder and having to use 2 hands to do this. FYI, their other non-pro cameras have hinged covers and only need one hand to open and replace the batteries. Plus, when you are up on that 10 foot ladder planning on replacing 2 batteries, when you use your 2 hands to remove the battery cover you will have to plan on where to have the 2 replacement batteries ready, then how you will also hold the loose battery cover (which is slippery and surprisingly heavy), and how you will do that plus remove and hold the 2 old dead batteries along with everything else. PLUS if you drop that battery cover from the top of the ladder and want to replace it, you can't get it as a spare part. Let's also say that down the road if/when your pro is out of warranty and you simply need to get that battery cover/speaker as a replacement spare part. You can't. Ring should either attach the cover to the unit using a slim metal tether, or bring back the much safer and easier hinged design. If they keep this design they should at least offer that cover as a spare part. If you look at the photo of the lady replacing the battery, notice she is using 2 hands. Imagine that picture with her doing that while up on top of a 10 foot ladder. I have also purchased the Ring optional indoor/outdoor plug-in trickle charging wire. This is the exact wire that comes with their plug-in model (plug-in, not hard-wired). This will help cut down on having to get up on that dangerous ladder to replace batteries. Suggestion.... buy the plug-in model which will come with the charging wire and buy 2 batteries. Most of the people who have given 5 star reviews probably have not experienced replacing the batteries while up on a ladder. Not a safe project.

If the camera wasnt over 1,000 miles away i could come and fix it, but either way I shouldn’t have to because a single battery should run it for that long let alone double batteries and a constant power supply. Not happy with this $200 brick. I would NOT recommend this model to anyone. reviews.body:
There are a few positives worth mentioning. The video quality is clear, and the spotlight is bright enough to cover a decent area. It’s easy to set up, easy to install, and the app has a clean, intuitive interface that makes it simple to use and manage settings. If you use two batteries, the battery life is fairly respectable — better than expected for a wireless setup.

That said, this camera has its flaws — some of them major. Motion detection is inconsistent. In most cases, it will register motion, but if someone is moving quickly, they’ll already be out of frame by the time it actually records and sends you an image. If you don't have a subscription you cannot watch that part. That delay defeats the purpose of having a security camera in the first place. The subscription part defeats the purpose of buying a premium wireless camera.

But what really gets under my skin is the pricing model. You pay for a premium camera, only to find out that basic features like person and vehicle alerts require a monthly subscription. It's ridiculous. I’ll admit I’m a little biased — I had a wired system that includes these features without any extra cost. But this whole tech-bro model of locking features behind a subscription just feels like a cash grab. It's built to extract ongoing fees for something that should be standard out of the box.

Bottom line: I’m switching back to a wired system that gives me more functionality without nickel-and-diming me every month. If you're serious about home security, I don’t see how this camera qualifies as a reliable solution.

reviews.author: JonCard

reviews.body:
I had the Google Nest outdoor cameras, and they always had problems dropping off and not recording for huge blocks of time (which doesn't help when it's a SECURITY camera!). I would constantly have to reconnect them to my router, turn them off and on to try to get them reconnect, and despite having 2 Nest signal boosters, I was finally fed-up and replaced all 4 of my outside cameras with the Ring system.

The Ring cameras have so far been flawless. I've had them several months now, and they have never dropped off my router or not recorded every second of every day. The night vision goes at least twice as far out as the Nest (a long, long way) and the range of video capture from side-to-side is much greater, allowing me to have no blind spots with the same 4 cameras. I purchased the wired version with a plug, and each camera has a battery for backup should the power go out (we have a whole house backup generator anyway, so they would only be without power for 30 seconds before the generator restored power).

The LED light is very bright and even penetrates well into our heavily wooded yard. It's great that the sirens can be linked to my new Ring security system (that arrives today) so that all my outdoor cameras as well as the indoor siren will go off if our house is broken into. The motion detection is amazing--the front camera picks up cars passing down our street that is over 200 feet away and is mostly blocked by trees and brush--I couldn't believe that it could detect that motion--and that's with the motion sensitivity set to only 75% out of 100%. So far, this has been a far superior to the Nest, which is all I can compare it to. I install my Ring security system today, so I'll submit a review of it as soon as I've had it a couple of months at least.

My final comment is get Ring for all your camera and security needs, don't ever purchase a Google Nest product. Once Nest sold-out to Google, they stopped updating it, and now their products can't compete with Ring. Trust me, I've had a lot of Nest products, and they're terrible.

reviews.body: Ring Stick Up Cam Plug-InThe Ring Stick Up Cam is a versatile, indoor/outdoor security camera known for its clear video and audio quality, ease of use, and real-time notifications. It offers both battery-powered and plug-in options, allowing for flexible placement. However, some users find the motion detection can be triggered by non-threatening events like spiders or insects. A subscription is needed for full access to features like cloud storage and advanced analytics
reviews.title: Best security investment
reviews.author: Habiba B

reviews.body: Ring stick up battery cam has saved me countless times of anxiety over the protection of my home. Not only does it provide high quality video surveillance, but the price is just right so I know I can protect my family at all costs. Installation was quick and easy with step-by-step instructions provided by Ring, and the app is so helpful for me to monitor and make changes as needed. Setup was simple, and I will continue to use my Ring devices to make sure my family and I feel at ease at all times.
reviews.title: My Peace of Mind!

reviews.body: It has a nice Bill to it, installation was very easy it's not mounted I use it on my shelf to catch my front door. It was mounted in my last place but it's not mounted in my new place. Notifications they work excellent sometimes you get too many so you'll have to tone that down. The night vision on it it's pretty good you don't have to worry about seeing at night however I use mine on the inside of my home. It's durable, nice color, and easy to maintain.
reviews.title: Love it
reviews.author: Donna T

reviews.body:
In order to set up MOTION ZONES you are now required to enable ADVANCED MOTION DETECTION which merely gives them more access but cuts down recording time. If someone walks past and you have 120 seconds record length it stops shortly after the person vanishes so you cannot listen to hear if they are trying to get to a blind spot or it activates again and again if they walk back and forth instead of simply staying on as was set up to do.

Weak detection and fails to update category, if a dog walks by it classes it as MOTION even if a person or vehicle comes into view seconds later. It should be smart enough to change classification to the most important feature.

Will be replacing them all next year with something which serves my needs and not their data hoarding
reviews.title: Gets worse with every update
reviews.author: Myname

reviews.body: I love my Ring stick up cam. Installation is really easy with the instructions and templates that they provide. There is really no maintenance you have to do except charging the battery about every 1 -2 months depending on settings you have. WiFi set up is a breeze. You can literally customize so many different settings and it also will link up with other Rings cameras and products you have. It’s a nice low end cost to provide security for your home and loved ones.
reviews.title: High Quality/ Low Cost Security 📸
reviews.author: Chris S

reviews.body:
Fantastic devices! I started with a Ring Doorbell Camera and was so impressed that we now have a network of Rings Cameras covering the outside of our house. The Ring devices are so simple to set-up and the Ring App is full of great features and is super easy to use.
Why do I love Ring Cameras?
1. It’s modular. I just use battery devices for outdoors so it means, no awkward wiring (and the batteries last a long time between charging). No wiring means it’s easy to move devices to adopt to changes in the outside environment.
2. No hub\DVR\NVR required on premise. Just use the reasonable subscription for remote control and viewing and storing or video history.
3. The dollar value is great (particularly if you look out for sale times). The quality is great, the cost is acceptable, and you can grow your set-up over time. I started off with a doorbell camera and have added 4 more cameras to cover the outside of my home.
4. The App is fantastic, the ability to view remotely what is happening at home, to remotely activate an alarm, the 2 way talk function through the doorbell, the historical viewing, the Modes and Mode Scheduling, love it! The App has a good amount of complexity but is still very intuitive, just by exploring the functionality you can understand how to use all of the things it can do.

Do I recommend Ring Cameras and Doorbells? Absolutely!
Addressing other reviewer’s comments :
The Subscription:
A number of reviewers comment on having to pay a subscription to get the full functionality from the Ring devices.
1. The subscription isn’t a huge cost (and it’s cheaper if you pay by the year rather than by the month). I’m one of the most stingy people that you will ever meet, so that coming from me is saying something,
2. The Ring App (and Browser access) is amazingly feature rich. The control of individual devices, the remote viewing, the Modes and Mode scheduling… this is not a static device list but a comprehensive management tool for your set-up. You just don’t get these sort of features in something that’s free.
3. And what is free? Yep, things that are loaded with paid advertising. There’s none of that in the Ring App, just a nice clean, clever interface.
Image Quality:
1. Seems great to me, even with the cheaper cameras. not sure why a small minority of users have issue with it.
2. If you really need to seem fine detail you can review recorded bites, which generally have higher resolution than the live view
Connection Drop-out:
1. When people comment on lapse of connection, I suspect that it is more to do with router performance that the Ring devices. I have 5 devices around the outside of my home and have no issues with connectivity… but I do have a good router (just ask your internet provider, my provider has been happy to routinely upgrade my router.. just have to ask).
Interesting Observations:
1. I’ve looked at Ring Devices on E-Bay, Facebook Marketplace, etc. but it’s really hard to find a bargin price on Ring devices. What does this mean? It means that there are a lot of people who love the product and are happy to pay good prices even for used Ring devices.
2. Beware, building up your system can get addictive, one more camera here, another there, now a spotlight camera, a pan tilt camera to watch the pets, another for the driveway, maybe one to watch for when mail arrives… 😊 If you like Tech you’ll love setting up this sort of system.
reviews.title: Fantastic quality and functionality!
reviews.author: MattTZ

reviews.body: I have a much better security camera system for my home's exterior but thought I might try one of these cams indoors since I have the Ring alarm system and a Ring Doorbell already. I made the silly mistake, I guess, of assuming there would be some kind of integration with other Ring products - there isn't, None. Not a single thing.. I can connect to the Ring camera live view in less than 2 seconds. The setup was easy, no sync modules, just put the camera up and connect it. The Ring app is great. I purchased the Ring plug in cameras. They have long and even really long cords included. The camera mounts are nice too. So glad we went with Ring. AWESOME. I highly recommend this product.
reviews.title: Easy to use, quality, battery life..
reviews.author: Ivy V

reviews.body: After installation, I really like this camera because it looks very modern and minimizes the living room space. I decided to install it because I wanted to watch my little dog more when I was out. The camera is high quality and the image is clear, along with clear, realistic sound, motion detection. The battery is removable and can be easily charged with a USB cable very quickly. Connecting to the Ring app and installing the camera was quick and easy. This is a high quality, easy to set up camera that I highly recommend.
reviews.title: Easy to connect
reviews.author: Jennie K

reviews.body: Love my ring cameras! I have 5. Love the outdoor ones because you can buy a solar adapter. Picks up even the smallest motion. Great picture even at night. I have one way out by my garage and it still has wifi. Setup takes about 2 mins. Subscription plans are also very affordable!
reviews.title: Great camera
reviews.author: Melissa S

reviews.body:
Bought this prior to Christmas as an extra for my current security system (hardwired 240V) to fill a blind spot.

Camera quality is great and on par with my ~ $600 units.

Battery life is great, just tune your settings and don't be stupid and sit on Live View for 30 minutes at a time, it's not designed for that.

In 1 month I have used 10% battery power with multiple events per day (watching front yard and front door) so packages and people are common every couple hours.

Easy to setup and comes with some self tappers and anchors for brick too. 5 minute install.

If you're planning on mounting to a roof you will need a separate mount which you can order from ring/Amazon for cheap.

All in all, great unit for the price even though they were on special over Christmas at much better prices elsewhere. Still, happy with our purchase.

Don't know why the other reviews are whinging.
reviews.title: Great Camera, Zero Issues
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.body: This camera is absolutely perfect for in home security. It is also great to use for checking on pets when gone from the home. Alerts can be customized depending on needs. After connected to wifi the first time, I never have issues with connectivity going in and out. The camera itself is also very durable and can be dropped with breaking. There also aren’t annoying updates every week only on occasion.
reviews.title: Home Security Must Have
reviews.author: Makayla D

reviews.body: This camera is amazing! I have it placed in my backyard and it picks up everything! The video quality is great! It doesn’t have a light but it has night vision that is just as effective. I can talk and listen through it which I love! It lasts a long time without having to recharge it.
reviews.title: The best on the market!
reviews.author: Cassandra D

reviews.body: I love this camera so much I use it to watch my puppies around the house when I have to leave. It’s so perfect has great quality and the installation was so quick and easy . I haven’t had not one problem since buying this product I truly do love this product so much. If you need a quick and easy camera this one it’s great for you.
reviews.title: The best quality camera
reviews.author: Julie M

reviews.body: This camera has great motion detection and responsiveness. We have it showing our driveway and it’s been reliable so far on alerting us when people are at our home. The night vision is also very good on this camera and provides a clear image.
reviews.title: Good, reliable camera for home security and peace of mind.
reviews.author: Kim S

reviews.body: I recently purchased two of these cameras as I already have two Ring devices a doorbell and floodlight. They work fine because they are both hardwired. These two cameras are battery powered, because of where I needed to place them. The cameras are offline during the day and are on from 10pm-4am. The batteries do not last a month. I bought 2 replacement batteries so that I would always have them charged to be able to swap them out. Not worth the time, money and aggravation. Buy something else, or purchase cameras that are hardwired. And unable to return as I have had them for 2 months. And have now replaces batteries x4.
reviews.title: Battery lasts less than a month off-line
reviews.author: della

reviews.body: Perfect for wire-free security! The 1080p video is nice, and the color night vision is a gamechanger for backyard monitoring. Setup took minutes, and the battery lasts long. I love the two-way talk for greeting delivery drivers. Only downside is needing a subscription for video history
reviews.title: great for wire-free security!
reviews.author: Mohamed K

reviews.body: These cameras and the ring app are worth the money. Super easy to set up. Blazing hot summer and now bitter cold single digits and below for days and they just keep going giving sharp video and alerts. I have them everywhere and they stay connected to the wifi.
reviews.title: Great product
reviews.author: Lam N

reviews.body: I started by installing three Ring cameras to allow me to keep an eye on my dogs in our fenced backyards. The 2-way talk feature allowed me to encourage them to stop barking without going outside. This worked so well that I expanded the network to cover my driveway, doors, and mailbox. The night vision features work well. The battery life is reduced a little by very cold winter temperatures, but it is easy to recharge the batteries. Adding a solar panel can extend the battery life some (but not as much when there is only 5 hours of sunlight). The Alexa app or use on a PC allows a panel display of all cameras or a focus on a single camera.
reviews.author: RobinSnowbird

reviews.body: I purchased a couple of these Ring cameras as they were such a great deal. Kohl’s passes these off like they are selling you brand new however 2 of the cameras I ordered were very used. Both had grime and dirt on them. One did not work at all. The other was still attached to someone else’s account so I could not connect. I returned them and told them why. Clearly, Kohls has zero QA when it comes to these returns so buyer beware: you could be buying someone else’s used, broken Ring cameras.
reviews.title: Kohl’s sells you used Ring cameras
reviews.author: Jenn

reviews.body: I bought 3 of these a couple of months ago. After reviewing, the camera quality isn't good for today's standard. You can't identify anyone past 4 metres or 15ft. Also you can't set the alarm on the camera to go off automatically if it detects a person, you have to do this Manually which is not good. I suggest shopping around first and going with a minimum 2-4k quality camera. This one you couldn't identify someone 5 metres away from it in our kitchen due to grainy quality. The camera is 7 metres from out router in a clear path.
reviews.title: Poor Video Quality
reviews.author: Mick

reviews.body: Ring Stick Up Cam Battery (White) features a clean, versatile design and reliable motion detection. Its nware runs smoothly, charging is convenient, and notifications arrive quickly and accurately, making it a lid choice for flexible home monitoring.
reviews.title: Best choice
reviews.author: Uyen P

reviews.body: This product is working out perfectly for us. We worry less about when CJ is ready to eat or come inside because now we get an alert as soon as she returns home. It’s been about 2 weeks now and we have zero complaints. This is ideal for cats that are allowed outdoors without a pet door. I still check the camera sometimes if it’s been a while since we’ve seen her to ensure it’s still connected and charged up.
reviews.title: Perfect for our cat
reviews.author: Joy

reviews.body: I’ve enjoyed having this inside I can use to watch our animals while away on a clear quality video. The camera is very well built very durable and has a great motion detection. Battery life is awesome and no installation if you’re just setting it on a shelf or something similar like I did.
reviews.title: Nice video surveillance for inside
reviews.author: Kevin L

reviews.body: The installation and setup was relatively easy. However, the camera doesn't do what it's supposed to do; namely, send an alert when people are on the property and not alert when cars drive by the house. At times I had to practically walk up to the camera before it alarms that a person is present. Then the alarm goes off all night telling me a person is in front of the house when a car's headlights shine into the camera lens. The customer person was nice, but could not resolve the problem.
reviews.title: Doesn't do what it's supposed to do
reviews.author: Johnjoseph

reviews.body: We put in a pool this summer and I was very concerned about making sure it was safe. But, due to a challenging location we couldn’t put in a wired camera. This Ring Stick Up camera was the perfect solution. We bought the optional solar panel attachment so we wouldn’t have to change the rechargeable battery. It works like a dream. It has a very wide range of visibility and also has sound and speaker features. It synced up effortlessly with the Ring app and other devices we have. The only reason I couldn’t rate it 5 star is because the speaker is very quiet and is not adjustable on it so people outside can barely hear you. Other than that, this is a brilliant solution for home safety and security.
reviews.title: Such a great safety tool
reviews.author: Jennifer C

reviews.body: The Ring Stick Up Cam Battery is a sleek, wire-free security camera that delivers crisp 1080p HD video and clear two-way audio—perfect for both indoor and outdoor use. Its rechargeable battery lasts up to six months on a single charge, and customizable motion zones help you focus on what matters most.
reviews.title: Compact, Reliable, and Easy to Use
reviews.author: Tuan T

reviews.body: I had a package stolen off my porch and my video doorbell didn't pick it up. So I bought this camera for extra security. It was easy to install myself and it connected to the Ring App easily. It's compact and has a nice clear view. It also has an optional Siren feature
reviews.title: Highly recommend this camera
reviews.author: Angelina7577

reviews.body:
I have given 3 stars as after 3-4 days use one really can’t say anything. I don’t know how good its battery proves. How good its recording intervals work etc etc. Anyways, its setting up was easy, results seem to be much better than my Blink, with which I replaced it due to their poor performance.
I will definitely write another review after few months to cover more areas and give genuine stars.

reviews.body:
The Ring wired video doorbell pro was exactly what I was looking for. Once installed and tested, the video image is so clear, the ability to draw the alert zone is a great feature. The ability to talk to the visitor is a plus, and the sound is clear to the person at the door. The night view is also very clear. From the Ring mobile app by turning your phone from a portrait to landscape view gives the image a much better, wider view of the entrance as well as the road in the background. The notification's received when someone is at the door is prompt, it gives you the ability to greet whomever quickly.

The fact that you can respond from anywhere as long as you have an internet connection i.e., when you're home with your WIFI or out when using mobile data is a real bonus. The box also came with a 30' degree mount that tilts the camera if needed, as not all doorways will give you a good view of those approaching the door.

Don't be afraid to buy an open box from PB Tech, I was able to inspect the contents prior to buying, which I think is a bonus, as with a new sealed box item you don't get that opportunity and it was nearly $70 cheaper than new. It also comes with the like new warranty. All in all it's a great product, very happy with the purchase from PB Tech.
reviews.author: RaymondY16

reviews.body:
Having access to a doorbell that you don’t have to have an electrician install is one of the key factors for choosing this door bell.

We just moved into a house that has a wired doorbell but it is buried in the wall and would cost a lot to install the wired version of the ring.

This Ring fits our needs. It is perfect for mounting anywhere we want, being battery powered, and are not forced to place it in the old doorbell location. (Which would not offer any clear videos of the front of our house. I found the best location for video and still be accessible for those that can use our wired doorbell or the ring. The app that comes with the ring is one of the better and far more user friendly ones that I have come across. I have our set to sensitive and was able to choose the area that activates the camera. I love that the app basically lets you tweak out the setting for about anyone’s needs. If you have a need for a certain setting it is in the app!!

It allows me to see the whole body of the individual on our door step, coming and going. As well as package drops, late night walkers like our neighbor Havalinas. The resolution is very good, perfect for our needs.

It is nice that the ring will store up to 180 days’ worth of video with the ring plan. They offer multiple plans. I intend on purchasing a few more outdoor cameras and adding them to my plan to ensure I have my whole property covered. I will use the solar powered cameras, so no wiring is needed.

Setting up couldn’t have been easier. You download the app, create an account….Everything you need to install the Ring is in the box. Including the security screw/screwdriver for access to the battery

Should you need to add a little angle to you Ring, a plastic wedge is included for that.

The internal battery is good for about four to six weeks with my settings and busy activity on my street. With less camera use or activity this will only lengthen the time in between your charges..

Should you not want to worry about charging the battery a solar add on option is available and fits around the base of the ring. Making charging the battery a thing of the past.

I am very happy with everything and would recommend this to family and friends.
reviews.title: Great Video DoorBell
reviews.author: Fordman

reviews.body: I really appreciate this doorbell because it comes with an AU wall socket, making installation incredibly simple. It's one of the most reliable versions of doorbells since it doesn't rely on batteries, eliminating any concerns about battery swelling. It supports both 2.4GHz and 5GHz Wi-Fi bands and delivers app alerts promptly. Setting up and using the app is quick and effortless. Personally, I prefer cloud recording and subscription services because local recordings may not be useful in the event of a security incident.
reviews.title: Best doorbell in the series.

reviews.body: I got this as a testing product and so far, It is very helpful. Sometimes I don't know my sister's work schedule and I know that If I text her, she won't reply until hours later. With the ring, I get a notification when someone leaves the house as well as when someone gets there. So instead of ne texting her, I can just look at the time on the ring app and know that she is at work and won't reply until 8 hours later. I also like those neighbor notifications; they tell you where a light or water outage might have occurred or even If you lost a dog. Last time, I had the UPS call me through the ring because he needed a signature. Thanks to it, I was able to get my package delivered; otherwise, I would of have to pick it up myself
reviews.title: Nice tracker!
reviews.author: Fleriflo

reviews.body: Decent video quality and easy set up. The issue I have is the long delay before notification when it senses motion. If someone or something is on your porch, they'll be gone before your notified. I was under the impression from the ad that you get notified in real time
reviews.title: Its ok
reviews.author: Tammy

reviews.body: It's been three weeks since I installed our Ring Battery Doorbell Pro. First off, the battery really lasts, drops about 10% a week. Second, I really like that I can look at the live feed and the replays and zoom in. And lastly it will pick up someone approaching at about 35 feet away, which is about where my vehicles are. Personally, I like that.
reviews.title: So far Great!
reviews.author: GLK1

reviews.body: We really love this doorbell. We had a Ring Doorbell 2 (2017), which lasted us several years before I wanted to replace it (still works, but the video quality has started declining given it sits in full sun 365 days a year). It's a little more expensive than its competitors, but we're used to the interface and ecosystem. These products hold up exceptionally well if you don't take a screwdriver to them, but even if you do, Ring is still nice enough to offer you a discount on a new one.
reviews.title: Great Doorbell
reviews.author: Dimmi

reviews.body: The video quality by comparison with the Ring Doorbell 3 is simply superb. The vision is a bit fish eyed. The increased angle of view both horizontally and vertically is great. Can now see parcels being put on the porch below the doorbell. Excellent product, although not connectable to our old doorbell. Rings through our mobile phone / iPad etc.
reviews.title: Ring Video Doorbell Pro 2
reviews.author: kjenko

reviews.body: I was curious to see the actual benefits from this device. I can honestly say we are still getting shocked with more benefits almost every day with even more added benefits from the device. Also the battery powered one the install was seamless.
reviews.title: Great product

reviews.body: This is worth the money. We never miss anyone at the door. From the post package drop off to our friends and family visiting. So handy if youre not home or busy working, the notification pops up on the phone app and allows you to speak to people live. Love it! This has been life changing!
reviews.title: Best video door bell ever!
reviews.author: anonymous

reviews.body: We've had the same Ring video doorbell for 3 years and also transferred it to a new home. Never had an issue and its always worked perfectly. Really wish they'd support HomeKit and its annoying you need to pay a yearly subscription to have all the video functionality.
reviews.title: Reliable & problem free
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.body: If we can get the thing working correctly, and the software to record the entire events that would be a plus. Our unit is on a gate entrance and the wifi signal is poor at 100 feet away so keep that in mind if you want to put it anywhere but touching your home or router.
reviews.title: Ours broke within several days.
reviews.author: MeThePeople

reviews.body: i feel this would be a great purchase/product for our office but this is wired use. so we have had to purchase another ring doorbell through click and collect. and this one will be returned today when we arrive to pick up the new doorbell wireless.
reviews.title: Wrong purchase
reviews.author: YAC

reviews.body: Only lasted 2.5 years before deteriorating. Ring customer service is a joke no service or backup. Resolution to fix this problem is buy a new one with a small discount. Cracking products is a well known problem with ring. Stay away is best advice
reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.author: Darren

reviews.body: I had to purchase my own horizontal wedge. While the faceplate screw goes in easily [all the way in] when the faceplate is left off, when I put the faceplate in place, the screw doesn't go in all the way. Tried several times.
reviews.title: Much improved with a few problems
reviews.author: JimSeis

reviews.body:
I appreciated the detailed installation instructions, both in the included booklet and in the app, and easy set-up.

The Ring Pro 2 video doorbell has some nice features. I like that I could talk to and/or listen to whoever is at the door. I like that I can snooze alerts after being notified. (This is helpful for me when my spouse comes back from running and stretches outside.)

There is a way to adjust the motion sensitivity, but there seems to be only four settings to choose. I don’t have a need for it with my doorbell location but you can set up motion zones. It’s great that the video shows what happens just prior to motion being detected. I also like that the videos are encrypted and that I can control how long they are stored via a browser.

There are other features that I don’t need to use, like Alexa Greetings.

I didn’t notice any colors in the night vision.

I wish that the history feature in the app had a filter or another way to choose the date and time instead of having to scroll through numerous events. We use the front door a lot so there are many events during the day. I like that I can filter by type of event, favorite videos and download videos.

If I login via the website on a PC I can filter by date but still not by time. If I view the video full screen I can’t stop or pause it. I also can’t zoom in via the browser. I can download videos via the website.

I need to be able to filter events that occur during specified time periods, like overnight or while I am away. Without this feature it takes forever to find specific events. I hope that Ring adds this feature soon.

The live video quality could be pixelated. Apparently this is by design in order to get the video to us ASAP. I expected the videos I access from history to be better quality but it is mixed - some are good, some aren’t. The device health portion of the app doesn’t really help - it only tells you what to do if you get a poor signal notification without really telling you what the signal quality number means, although it is displayed in color (mine is green). Apparently the closer the number is to zero the better the signal quality is.
reviews.title: Nice but Missing date & time filter
reviews.author: Tofu9

reviews.body: I replaced my standard doorbell with the Ring doorbell pro 2 and couldn't be happier. Installation was simple even without having electrical knowledge. The Ring app walked me through installation. It's fully compatible with my existing doorbell wiring and included the part to chime inside my home. This model is hardwired so you don't have to remember to charge the batteries. The video quality is amazing and it does a great job at detecting people and objects if you choose that option in the app. This particular model has the head to toe feature which is nice because it allows you to see close up areas at your door. The built-in Alexa Greeting is fancy! I'm always asked how does your doorbell do that?! Alexa will even let delivery drivers know where to leave my packages. Notifications come through to my phone instantly even when I'm not home. I love being able to answer the door without having to be home using the two way talking feature. The neighbors community that's built into the app is nice way to alert neighbors of suspicious activity. I've had ring service for two years and it's worth every penny. I'm very satisfied and highly recommend it to everyone!
reviews.title: Peephole for my door 24/7
reviews.author: Diyer440

reviews.body: This Ring Doorbell Pro 2 is very easy to set up and to use. It can be easily set up with our existing doorbell and has a high-definition camera with two-way talk that will let you see and chat with visitors from your smartphone or other devices wherever you are. You will receive notifications from the 3D motions sensors when someone passes by, knocks on your door or presses the doorbell. It can also be set up with Alexa Greetings so that Alexa can speak to visitors and can accept deliveries. I love the easy set up and installation. The instructions of all the steps for installation are very easy to follow. The camera offers clear imaging. Even when it is on night vision mode the images are still bright and clear and it is easy to recognize visitors. Overall, this camera is a great solution for our family to see who is at the door even when you are not near the door and to add more security for the front door with this easy to use camera and app. Highly recommend it!
reviews.title: Easy to use
reviews.author: Hendrika

reviews.body:
We recently "upgraded" to this Ring Video Doorbell Pro 2 and we are AMAZED!

We loved our initial Ring and were really anticipating our upgrade! Initially we noticed that the width was slightly less (we love this) and it remains super streamlined with a very clean presenting faceplate!

The picture quality is stellar and the audio clear and crisp! The 3D motion detector really is amazing!

Installation was quite easy (we hardwired ours) and was easily completed by 1 person. Kudos to the set up guide, scan feature to assist and the easy to follow instructions!

One tip we found is that there is a reset button on the side, and you may have to press this to pair your device. Our area is quite "tight" so if this is the case for you, it may help to do this before "tightening down" the unit.

This really is a "must have" Doorbell! We also pair to our Alexa Show!
reviews.title: The best yet!
reviews.author: Allyrio

reviews.body: The Ring Video Doorbell Pro 2 is one of the best additions we've made to the home lately. I love that it gives head to toe video and the picture quality is great. The fact that I can have Alexa great the guest or delivery driver is fantastic. It is hardwired in which makes it that much more secure. It easily hooked up to our wifi after installed. We were able to use our existing wiring from the doorbell that was there which made the installation easier. It provides a sense of security because it has the function to record video. I can be anywhere in my home and know what is going on in the front of my house. 3d motion sensing makes is easy to see anyone approaching. It gives an easy mind set especially with having kids at home. I love greeting my amazon delivery person and i know my packages are safe.
reviews.title: GREAT FEATURES
reviews.author: JC440

reviews.body:
This is great! We have other ring products & they all are a great comfort for our home.

I love this Doorbell Pro 2 with the advanced 3D motion detection, head to toe video, high definition audio, & you can place wherever is best for you. This all connects to your phone with the app. Literally everything comes through your phone no matter how far away from home.

1536 HD video, two way talk, live view, color night vision, dual band Wifi, weather resistant, & so much more. Easy to hang & put together. App is just as easy as all the other ring products & is amazing! If your doorbell is stolen ~ they replace it. So you have nothing to loose & everything to gain by protecting your families & home. We love them all here!
reviews.title: Ring Doorbell Pro 2
reviews.author: michellelittle60

reviews.body:
First off, I feel that Ring should make it clear that the doorbell might not be compatible with all existing household doorbells. I think most people would assume that their old wired doorbells would have the 16V-24V that is required to power this video doorbell, and I found out that because I have an old house that my doorbell only powered up to 10V. I figured out that I needed a new transformer and the doorbell works great now, but Ring should definitely make that clear.

Now onto the doorbell itself. I love the Ring Pro 2. It was super easy to install and set up. It works exactly as it is described to. The video is high quality. I love that it lets me know whenever anyone is at my door. There is a few seconds delay between when motion is detected and when I am alerted but that's to be expected. I also love that you can now talk to people outside through the doorbell and not have to come to the door. It's fantastic. I definitely recommend this video doorbell, just make sure you have the right voltage first.
reviews.title: Excellent Video Doorbell
reviews.author: Cydni

reviews.body: I’ve been wanting a ring doorbell for many years now. I’ve always heard great things about them and I can say for myself that I agree with all the positive reviews. It was easy to install. The quality of the picture is great. Night quality isn’t as good but still doable. I initially got this so I could keep track of packages that are dropped off. With all the thieves out there now a days, especially around the holidays, it makes me feel safer when a package is dropped off when I’m not home. This detects and notifies me as soon as someone comes to the door. Overall, I’m very happy with this product.
reviews.title: Very happy with this product
reviews.author: Krink040

reviews.body: Got this amazing Ring door bell camera install and it only took like half an hour to install . Everything was in the box that came with the door bell camera. The video quality is too notch and it has night vision!!! You can see anything in the dark as clear as day. It has clear sound quality as well. Is so worth it to have this on a crazy time as this I need to feel protected and secure in my home. And the best part that I love is the neighbor hood watch feature where people type “ my cat is lost “ or “female with pink hair removing item from porch” is good to be aware and I am glad that I am experience the ring door bell and you should too.
reviews.title: I am amaze about this ring door bell
reviews.author: Majesticname

reviews.body: We didn't encounter any problems with installation, quick & simple. The angles and viewing areas are better than I expected and the clarity of view is excellent. HD audio sound is terrific. Night time viewing also exceeded our expectations. So with excellent video quality, sound quality, seeing full view images and great night vision we're very pleased with the Pro 2. Also happy to say that the motion detectors haven't set off any notifications that are in error yet so the accuracy is quite good. Great, high quality device.
reviews.title: High Quality Viewing
reviews.author: peachy

reviews.body: The Ring doorbell pro 2 has been amazing. You can definitely tell it is the newest in technology. Installation was so easy I just removed my old regular doorbell and mounted this new one. Setting up the app was so easy to navigate. It really does give me a peace of mind especially knowing when I'm not home when my packages get delivered and to make sure they stay there. You can even record a message letting a delivery driver know where to exactly leave the packages. The 30 ft covers my whole front yard so I'm alerted whenever someone comes on my property. If you are looking for the newest and best video doorbell definitely give this a try and you won't be disappointed.
reviews.title: Love it
reviews.author: Jessica H

reviews.body: We installed the Ring, and the next morning I already had a notification in the Neighbors feed about a man trying to get into cars that were parked on the street. Eek! It was a mile away, but still nice to know what to watch out for, especially as we have had to park our cars on the street during construction being done at our house. Installation was fairly easy, and the app is a breeze to use! I also like that my teenagers can download the app, and instead of answering the door, they can look at the app to see who is at the door before they answer(even though they are told not to answer when we are not at home ha). The camera covers a big area around our house, which I love!
reviews.title: Makes me feel more at ease
reviews.author: aelinab5

reviews.body: Installation of this video doorbell was insanely easy! I had the entire process done in about 15 minutes. The video clarity is AMAZING! Hooking up the app, was super simple and easy. Even my low tech wife had zero issues using the app and doorbell. It's already come in handy twice to see who ding dong ditched us last week lol. Motion detection works perfectly and two way audio is crystal clear. l. I intend to purchase another for my garage and back doors.
reviews.title: Security at its finest!
reviews.author: Jsotam76

reviews.body: So my husband and I were debating if we needed a home security system or not. We ended up meeting in the middle with this doorbell as there is a camera and we don’t have to install a whole system. The doorbell didn’t take too long to hook up and install where our old doorbell was. The Ring app was very easy to download and customize the settings as well. This doorbell has motion sensors and you can actually talk through it as well. I often can’t hear the doorbell when I am downstairs and this works great because I get notified and can see when someone is at my door. The picture quality of the doorbell is fantastic. Overall I am very happy with this doorbell.
reviews.title: Great resolution!
reviews.author: AngieY

reviews.body: I’ve had Ring just about a month. I’m still learning a lot about it, but I’ve enjoyed the product and it does make me feel better about security of my home.
reviews.title: New to ring
reviews.author: Justin69

description: The Ring Video Doorbell Pro 2 enhances your home's security and convenience with smart features that keep you connected. See, hear and speak to anyone at your door from anywhere with crisp 1080p HD video and two-way talk. The 3D Motion Detection with Bird's Eye View provides intelligent motion detection that minimizes false alerts, while the built-in microphone and noise cancellation ensures clear audio. Dual-band Wi-Fi connectivity and hardwired or plug-in power options provide flexible installation. With night vision, customizable privacy settings and dual-band Wi-Fi connectivity, the Ring Video Doorbell Pro 2 is an easy way to upgrade your home's security. The satin nickel finish seamlessly blends into your home's exterior. Receive notifications and customize motion settings right from the Ring app. This smart security upgrade monitors your home's entry point with intelligent alerts and crystal clear video. The manufacturer's part number for this product is 8VRBPZ-0AU0. Consider the Ring Video Doorbell Pro 2 to enhance your home's security today.

name: Battery Doorbell Plus
bestFor: Extended battery life with 1536p HD video and package detection

reviews.body: The Ring Battery Doorbell Plus has been a great upgrade for home security. The installation was simple and the battery power means I didn’t have to worry about wiring. The video quality is sharp, and I really like the wide field of view that lets me see packages left at the door as well as visitors. The Ring app makes it easy to get alerts and check in from anywhere. It gives me peace of mind knowing I can always see who’s at my door.
reviews.title: Easy-to-Use Doorbell with Clear Video Quality
reviews.author: Kat R

reviews.body: Our last doorbell was hung low because it was attached to the old doorbell wires which are fixed in place. Unfortunately, with the old bell, once callers were at the door, we couldn't see their faces. Also, we couldn't see much of the floor area. So, if parcels were left on the doorstep, we often didn't know. But with the RING DOORBELL PLUS (battery model) we can see people from head to toe even when they are close to the door. And we see the floor area clearly and now know if parcels are waiting there. And, what's really nice: we didn't have to change the position of the doorbell on the doorpost to get the full view. So, the installation looks pristine.
reviews.title: Head to Toe View is Great
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.body:
I think I actually really hate this thing. For one, I bought it but it won’t do almost anything unless I pay a monthly subscription. If I want it to alert me to people outside, or record anything, I have to pay them even more money. But besides that, those features barely work even with the free trial you get. The motion alert has missed loads of people. I tried adjusting the settings, but these are people that walked well within five feet of the ring camera. Once I was inside and heard someone on my front porch messing with my mailbox, Ring didn’t get any of that. The camera is next to my mailbox for crying out loud. Then on the chance that it does detect someone, it records for around 10-15 seconds, and that’s it. Even if the person lingers for ages, it still won’t record them more than that time frame.
Honestly, for me, the only thing it’s good for is as an actual doorbell, without the subscription (and even with it a lot of the time,) the person would have to ring the button for me to know they’re there. But even then because of social media I’m not sure it’d really work as a doorbell either! People, like me, would just assume it’s recording and speak directly to it or something without ringing the bell. Only one person in the three months I’ve had it, has actually rung the bell, who knows how many attempted to speak to it.
If I hadn’t damaged the outer casing cover thing, I’d definitely return it.
They say we’re living in an era where people are buying things but owning nothing, like that the next generation of kids will never own anything, it’s all subscriptions and paying for the right to be able to use the thing you should rightfully own. That is a sad bleak future we’re already starting to live in.
Anyway, I hate that I ‘bought’ this expensive ring camera and they expect me to keep paying for it for the rest of my life, and also it just doesn’t really work either. Pretty useless across the board.
reviews.title: Basically worthless
reviews.author: Cameron

reviews.body: The RING battery doorbell plus was super easy to install and provides full image HD plus video, motion detection alerts and two-way talk. I’m able to see and talk to anyone at my door and I feel much safer with the RING cameras on my doors! The unit has a quick release battery pack that easily recharges with long lasting life. Anotherr cool feature is that it works with Alexa. For the safety and protection this provides it’s proved phenomenally well!
reviews.title: High quality camera great price
reviews.author: Lindsey R

reviews.body: Had I know buying this from Costco would have given me 6 months of service before having to pay for getting simple notifications, I would have got it there. Same price! (If you have a membership, get it over there) I'm also disappointed in having to pay at all. I had looked it up, Ring makes it sound like you don't have to pay a subscription. If you want a notification when someone is at the door...you do have to pay. The camera itself works pretty well, unless its dark out. Someone came up on my porch, grabbed a snow shovel, and we did not get a notification on that.
reviews.title: Ring
reviews.author: MzBev

reviews.body: I purchased this ring video doorbell from target a couple of weeks ago and it's been nothing but problems first of all it arrived with the box unsealed no indication that it was brand new red flag secondly the battery is dead without two weeks of me purchasing it and thirdly it is sold by a third party seller and not a target item which I was unaware of so that explains everything it's probably a refurbished piece of junk and target need to make it clear on this website rather the items purchased from their website is being sold by target or a third party seller and rather the items are brand new or refurbished....
reviews.author: lealea

reviews.body: Chose the Ring doorbell after reading the reviews left by other customers. Loved that it was so easy to install! Attached it to my old doorbell system so it still sounds inside my home and notifies on the phone. The pictures from my porch are very clear and make me feel safer. I have plans to put one on my back door too.
reviews.author: Snowman

reviews.body: I live in a four-storey condo. Our unit is at the end of a hallway. We often do not hear someone knocking at the door if we are at the other end of the condo or on our balcony. We also wanted to be able to screen persons at the door and have a record of visitors (welcome or otherwise) and deliveries. I had some very good reviews [not from this site] so I decided to get a unit to solve the issues. The doorbell came with a mounting bracket (for attachment to a wall with drywall anchors or wood screws - supplied), adhesive strips for non-screw mounting, teeny tiny flathead screws to attach the doorbell to the mounting bracket, a USB-C charging cable and a very basic multi-lingual exploded view illustration leaflet of how it is to be mounted. I decided initially to use the adhesive strips and they worked fine to attach the bracket to one side of our doorframe. One thing I did not count on was that the recessed entrance door meant that the doorbell camera was blocked by part of the frame. I am sure in a normal residential setting this would not be an issue but it was for me. The most frustrating part of the installation was trying to get the teeny tiny screws through the camera body and into the mounting bracket. Coupled with this issue was trying to find a small Philips screwdriver; I really needed four arms and hands to do this. Setting up the doorbell was relatively straightforward with creating a RING account and customizing the features. I wanted to share the doorbell access with my spouse and it was a convoluted exercise in having her get her own RING account [why?] and then briefing her on what the doorbell is doing when it notifies her that someone is at the door - the issue here is that she cannot see who is at the door, only be notified that someone is there - what is the point of her having her own account? The doorbell battery did not fully charge using the supplied cable and soon ran down, forcing me to remove it (I learned later that it takes several hours to charge). I ended up purchasing another charger and spare battery (something RING alays reminds you to do). The doorbell works and does provide useful information on visitors . Just be prepared for a tricky installation. I ended up purchasing a RING angle mounting bracket to position the camera more towards the centre of the doorway. This was also challenging getting it installed.
reviews.title: A very good video doorbell but there were issues
reviews.author: cruisinbill

reviews.body:
Our daughter recently gave us a ring doorbell for our home so we could monitor and see who was at our door. We were hesitant at first to install it because we weren’t sure we really needed a doorbell that allowed us to see who was at our door. One day my husband decided to install it and I am so glad he did.

This allows us to see who is ringing our doorbell, to talk directly to them if we want to and gives us a feeling of taking control of who we want to talk to or answer the door for.

I highly recommend this for seniors especially since you will no longer have to run to open your door to a stranger or solicitor.
reviews.title: Every Senior Needs to Have One to Provide Security
reviews.author: Darlene

reviews.body: The install of this camera is ridiculous. It gives you no indication what screws you would be using to mount the camera. It's almost impossible to take off the cover to charge the battery. I had to use a kitchen knife. The camera itself is fine but the set up is negative stars. I would buy a different version of this camera. Whoever designed this camera should be fired.
reviews.title: Ridiculous
reviews.author: Chanin

reviews.body:
I replaced Doorbell 2 with doorbell plus. It does what it is said. I can see a person from head to toe in front of my door. It literally shows everywhere in my porch. I am very satisfied with the wide view angles, horizontal and vertical. The image has also become sharp and crisp.

The issue: Whenever a car/truck passes by in a sunny day, it seems to reflect the sunlight into my porch and white out the image for a second. It did not happen in my previous ring doorbell. It would be a big issue when someone parks his/her car in front of my house and walks toward the door. The camera cannot detect the motion in time as the reflection whites out the image. Because the image looks like a fisheye view, I suspect the algorithm needs to adjust the brightness of the center area of the image.

Three images are attached. They were taken at 10:23am, 1:57pm and 2:45pm respectively. In the third image a mail person walking toward the door cannot be seen. So this issue basically affect the camera for 6-8 hours everyday..
reviews.title: Big improvement with a glaring issue
reviews.author: royalvr

reviews.body: Easy to install and setup. Worked great. This was installed in a house that was built in 1900. Somewhere along the line, previous owners had disconnected the chimes and removed them. The transformer was nowhere to be found so the existing doorbell didn't work. This battery doorbell is a must have in this situation.
reviews.title: What Wires?
reviews.author: Dave

reviews.body: I've had this camera for a year now and so far it's done a good job recording and capturing things, however the battery dies WAY TOO FAST. I have to charge it at least once every two weeks. I have the settings set the same as my Ring 1080p Wireless Video Doorbell and this one dies so much faster than my other one which is also cheaper and does the same job. This camera could use improvement on battery life. I would say that's the only flaw.
reviews.title: Good but bad
reviews.author: Good

reviews.body: The product is very well made with camera images of high quality. I like the features of the camera and software options as well. However, the charging cable was faulty and unable to charge the battery. In addition, the screw driver only had the star feature for the lock screw but no Phillips head option to secure the camera to the mount. I was very surprised by these shortcomings and the reason for the three stars.
reviews.author: HomeDepotCustomer

reviews.body: Bought this a year or so ago. Would give negative stars if I could. Was fine until free subscription period ends. The packaging does not highlight the fact that you'll need to pay a subscription for viewing past videos. Very misleading. Once free monitoring period ends, product malfunctions all the time, dropping out from wifi, losing login details, failing to communicate with phones. Go look at other reviews, this is very common for those people who refuse to pay for the subscription service. Very poor form by Ring. Do yourself a favour, go to Bunnings and buy any of the other brands that clearly state they are subscription service free. I bought a Eufy version to replace my RING unit that refused to work anymore. The Eufy door bell unit is absolutely perfect and no subscription.
reviews.title: DO NOT BUY RING. Does not work if you don't pay subscription

reviews.body: The ring Doorbell plus was easy to install and is a very clear picture of everyone who approaches the front door entry. I love how I can talk to the person at the door. This is the second one I have purchased. I highly recommend this purchase.

Ring has made these newer models worse in every way. Outdated 2.4 wi-fi, motion sensitivity is to low even when set to Max, picture quality is worse than the older 1080p models. Horrible design in almost every way.
reviews.title: Older models were better
reviews.author: RonW

reviews.body: This give a very good picture and image. It covers a large area of my property. It was installed three days ago. It totally meets my expectations! The Ring Battery Doorbell Plus for back my deck, that shows the entire deck and stairs.
reviews.author: DMA

reviews.body:
I bought this Ring about three wks ago,, thought it would be better than my last video camera. It isn't. At least my last camera, which was not a Ring, would record when we're not home plus at night. I purchased this ring to see what's going on during the night and when not at home. The video is clearer.
When received the ring package the mount ing bracket wasn't included, have to purchase it separately.
reviews.title: Okay product
reviews.author: kw50

reviews.body: This is a really good video door bell and the battery last long. The reason for 4 star is that on the description, it doesn’t indicate that after 3 months you have to subscribe to get access to video alerts and a simple door ring. Mine is currently useless since I haven’t subscribed.
reviews.author: Nthabiseng

reviews.body: I am having multiple issues with motion detection and motion zones but thats not the worst thing about this device. I get constant flickering in my video. It happens in live view and recordings. Ring insists it's just an issue with my WiFi (I work in IT. It's not the WiFi). I have searched the web and found many other people having the same issue with no resolution from ring. The video flickering makes this product unusable and since ring won't replace it as a warranty issue, I'm going to have no better option then to throw this thing in the trash (electronics recycling) and go with a different brand.
reviews.title: Ring Won't acknowledge problems
reviews.author: Frustrated

reviews.body: I purchased 2 of these doorbell-cameras several weeks and had them installed in minutes. The shipping and installation went flawlessly. The instructions to physically install as well as systemically install the software were clear and easy to follow and implement. Previously we had no doorbells and often could not hear guests knocking at our doors. Now as long as we have our cell phone near we hear the "someone at your door" chime and can answer the door or we can ask questions via the talk option, or let them know we are on our way. Best of all while away from home we can do the same, which provides significantly more security and piece of mind than we previously had. It is also nice to be able to see what the weather is like and how much snow we may have received. Lastly, we also purchased and installed 2 motion wired security lights and cameras which work great with the doorbells. I will review them separately.
reviews.author: San Juan Mountain Man

reviews.body: I recently purchased this product to replace my Ring Doorbell II. I am giving it an average rating because it really doesn't appear to be any better than the Doorbell II as far as I am concerned. It was easy to install and works fine for the purpose. I don't think the extra wide field of view is worth the extra money I paid for the doorbell. As with my other Ring products audio recording is sketchy at most. Most of the time it doesn't record any sound at all. I like my Ring products but honestly for the price I can get as good quality from much cheaper devices.
reviews.title: Ring Battery Doorbell Plus
reviews.author: Pat B

reviews.body: This was an upgrade from 1st gen Ring battery doorbell, which malfunctioned after 10 years in service. It has color night vision capability and removable battery design. These are very good useful features. Plus the availability of purchasing additional battery. Very convenient! Body of the doorbell felt very flimsy as I screwed in on a piece of soft wood. I had to be extra careful and hand tie screws with a screw driver. Normally, I use power drill with very low torque. I hope I don't have to remove the device for any reason. This doorbell may not last 10 years I'm afraid but time will tell.
reviews.author: HomeDepotCustomer

reviews.body: The ease of use and installation is really good! Being somewhat of a gadget novice, I was apprehensive, but I'm glad I purchased them. The range and clarity on these devices are excellent. A fantastic value for something that's definitely worth having!
reviews.title: Yes, EYE get the picture
reviews.author: saltnpep54

reviews.body: Great product. I've only had to replace this due to a hurricane/flooding. My only complaint is that there is a tiny delay when an event occurs and it notifies me, but it's very small. The app is easy to use and it's fairly easy to install. I had someone else do it for me due to my condition.
reviews.title: Great product.
reviews.author: Veronica

reviews.body: Big mistake buying this. Do NOT buy this unless you want a big headache and like wasting your money and time. It has never worked I had friends try numerous times it’s more steps than I ever imagined. I have taken it at this point and it’s all in a garbage bag in my closet next step is the dumpster where it belongs
reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.author: Verarema

reviews.body: I’m 71 and all things technological can be baffling for me. I know many older folks who take to it like water-but not me! Once the battery was fully charged (mine took hours), the install, setup, connection to the phone, adding my husband’s phone and connecting the pro-chime was very straightforward. I love the features, the clarity of the pics and recordings, and the feeling of security it gives us. Would highly recommend.
reviews.title: Easy to install, even for this old geezer!
reviews.author: UpstateSandyman

reviews.body: Works fine as advertised. I saw my sister's and decided it was time. What I disliked was the Ring products were all over the store. Couldn't find the ones I originally saw online so bought a few different cameras. Then there was another pile of Ring products in the front of the store I found after I already bought substitutes. I also had a pick ticket for the Ring Flood Lights which an employee could not find. While I am very happy with the products my local store could be doing a better job of locating the products.
reviews.title: Comb the store looking for whatever they want.
reviews.author: Ron only 3 letters

reviews.body: The doorbell was easy to install and has excellent video quality. The removable battery is a major improvement over the old model. The battery has never lived up to the promise of how long it will last. This new battery was installed 3 weeks ago is is already down to 58% charge.
reviews.author: KATHRYN

description: Stay in the know from head to toe with Ring Battery Doorbell Plus. This battery-powered smart doorbell delivers ultra-clear HD+ (1536x1536) video with a taller Head-to-Toe field of view for better porch coverage. Receive important alerts with Package Alerts (Ring Protect subscription required, not included) when packages are detected within a designated zone. Quick Replies let you guide visitors to leave a message when you’re busy. Compatible with Android and Alexa, it connects via Wi‐Fi, records video and audio to the cloud (subscription optional), and supports 2‐way talk and mobile notifications. Battery-powered with USB charging, easy surface installation, and a Satin Nickel finish. Weather-ready from -5°F to 122°F, with 30 ft motion detection and 15 ft night vision. Model B09WZBPX7K.

name: Video Doorbell (2nd Gen)
bestFor: Budget-friendly 1080p smart video doorbell for Australian homes

reviews.body: This was a replacement bc Lowe’s let someone return an open one and when I tried to install it said already registered to someone else ! Got this 1 and it got stuck in update mode . Ring sent me a replacement same issue .. was told it was this model they sent me an upgrade and it works fine . This model do not buy !!
reviews.title: Horrible model do not buy !
reviews.author: slsalapn

reviews.body:
The video doorbell was the easiest installation among all the Ring devices (we have a few) and other systems. We got the wireless version. The packaging was minimal. There were no extra plastics or cardboard to dig through to get to the product. Yet, everything came neatly and securely packed. I have to note that the lack of plastic was impressive and environmentally responsible. The USB-C charging port came with a tiny plastic protective insert. That is such a smart addition for outdoor devices. A charger is not included, but since it uses a standard USB charger, that is not an issue. It arrived around 60% charged and went down to 28% in one week. The device will likely need to be charged once every two or three weeks, depending on the weather.

Installation was simpler than expected. The last time I installed a Ring device, the QR code was too small for my phone camera to scan. That was a frustrating experience. They made the QR code bigger this time, thankfully. The software is super easy and user-friendly. It took a few minutes to update and was easily added to the existing app. I love the option of connecting it with Alexa or an existing Ring Chime. I opted to receive alerts on my phone. It is super helpful to receive personalized alerts for each device.

Installation was super easy. The doorbell comes with a lever for easy dismounting. I like it better than the sharp tool I need to dismount my other doorbell. The lever is more user-friendly and age-friendly than expecting users to locate a tiny hole underneath the doorbell and insert a pin in the correct place. Also, the lever is bright orange. If left in a drawer with a pile of items, I can imagine that the little bright orange lever would be easy to locate. I am grateful to the designers for thinking about senior users.

The area covered by the camera is not as large as that of a mounted camera, but it is large enough to serve the purpose of a doorbell. Once mounted, the device can be adjusted at several angles to get the exact coverage according to the user’s preference. My house is 20 feet away from a busy state highway with heavy traffic. The moving cars are not setting off the activity warnings. Only human movement about 15 feet away seems to trigger motion detection. I was surprised to see that my 12-year-old daughter was identified as a “child” and adults were identified as “person.” The event descriptions are amazingly accurate. For example: “person walking on the pathway with a dog on a leash” and “person standing on the doormat.”

The app is excellent, with snooze, event history, and other useful options. The alerts and notifications can be shared with other family members very easily, without extra downloads, which is very helpful. The best part is being able to connect it with other devices and control everything easily through the app.

The gray-and-black design is attractive and not overly conspicuous. There is a slight lag in the video, which could be improved. The communication feature is sharp and clear. Night vision is sharp as well.

Overall, The Ring wireless video doorbell is easy to install, user-friendly, and offers clear video, sharp audio, accurate motion detection, and useful app features. Its thoughtful design, environmentally conscious packaging, and seamless integration with other Ring devices make it a practical and reliable choice, though the video occasionally experiences slight lag.
reviews.title: Best Buy
reviews.author: Magneto

reviews.body:
We recently purchased a new home and I left my old video doorbell at the old house. Darn the luck, time for new technology!!!

Ring is the original video door bell and has been around for over a decade. I wanted a doorbell that was completely wireless. We're planning some home renovations and I didn't want to worry about where the doorbell would be positioned or be stuck to where ever the wires were currently.

I was shocked at the weight of the doorbell. I assume most of this weight is due to the size of the battery, which is said to last between 2-6 months depending on conditions. Mine has been online for a week and is still at 97%. Overall construction was top notch and fit and finish is what you'd expect from the leader in video door bells.

The initial charge took a few hours when hooked up to my 65W laptop charger.

Setup was a breeze and I didn't experience any issues connecting to my IoT wireless network. I can't say that's been the same for other smart home products I've used before.

Video quality is great and even in low light conditions it is able to capture high quality video. One nice feature is being able to setup different zones.
