reviews.author: Naughty_Dog

reviews.body:
Researched outside cameras. Didn't want batteries to change and wiring. Bought this camera from Argos.
Its very well made. The set up was relativity easy. I can not find any negatives. It has sound both ways. It has a switchable light. Day and night picture quality very good. Can adjust length of recordings. Fine tuning to enable set up operation. Solar panel has been charging well in January wet weather.
I will add a friend bought one on my advice and could not set up the App bar code scanning. It appears this can be a problem, which can be overcome?
Argos had this camera on a great offer. Overall its a great bit of kit
reviews.title: Great camera.
reviews.author: GC

reviews.body: A great camera that is very easy to connect to your network. The field of view is much wider than the last camera we had and the quality of the picture is excellent as is the audio, you can clearly hear conversations five metres away. The night vision is as clear as the day vision, except that it's in black and white, unless you allow the very bright spotlight activate, and then it's in colour. The camera follows the subject for a while before returning to its original position. You can pan the camera 360 degrees manually from your phone. Overall this camera is amazing and well worth the money.
reviews.title: Amazing camera
reviews.author: AlanT58

reviews.body:
Dear Neil, just because the camera dropped in price does not mean you have to rate it at one star you complete tool! You know full well this camera is absolutely amazing. For the actual review The Eufy SoloCam S340 is a game-changer in home security, offering top-tier features with no monthly fees—making it an unbeatable value. This camera delivers 3K resolution, giving you crisp, detailed footage that far exceeds traditional 1080p cameras. The dual-lens system allows for wide coverage and depth, capturing more of your surroundings with incredible clarity. Even more impressive, its 360° coverage ensures that no angle is left unmonitored, meaning you get complete peace of mind.

What truly sets the Eufy SoloCam S340 apart is its solar panel, which means it's powered by the sun, virtually eliminating the need for frequent recharging or battery replacements. This is especially perfect for long-term use in outdoor areas. It’s also incredibly simple to install and operate, with wireless connectivity and seamless integration into your smart home ecosystem.

Plus, the no monthly fee model means that once you’ve bought the camera, you’re done with recurring costs—a rare benefit in a market full of subscription-based competitors. The build quality is solid, and its weather-resistant design ensures year-round performance, no matter the conditions.

In short, if you want an advanced security camera that’s eco-friendly, cost-effective, and packed with premium features, the Eufy SoloCam S340 is a no-brainer. It’s the ultimate security solution for anyone looking to secure their home without breaking the bank.
reviews.title: Neil is a prat
reviews.author: Kingdaniel630

reviews.body: Our S340 SoloCam more often than not goes offline.  There is so much delay when using the camera.  You are not able to view objects as they move due to this delay, they are out of frame by the time the camera adjusts. Eufy's standard answer reconnect the camera. Guess I should just stand on a ladder 24/7 to continuously reset the camera. Goofy at best. We have multiple interior bullet cameras that consistently send false alarms "someone has been spotted". Advised Eufy tech the same interior bullet cameras have different app versions.  Eufy ignored us.  Regarding false alarms were told it was because it was seeing a mirror in background, but never addressed why our other cameras were sending false alarms.  The tech dept is essentially worthless along with the product.  Do not recommend whatsoever.
reviews.title: Would Never Buy Eufy Cameras Again
reviews.author: Stephen Stout

reviews.body: Put the camera up yesterday, simple to install and connect to WiFi to see recordings on my phone. Picture is clear and the target tracking is smooth with good coverage (3x zoom) for a large back garden. For £125 (with the recent 30% discount) it’s a quality item. Bought two, may get another. Couldn’t justify another £150 for the S4 model which was not discounted, 3K quality is sufficient to see what balaclava any would be thief is wearing!
reviews.title: Solid security camera for the money.
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.body: Very pleased with purchase. Camera was easy to fit over garage door- fortunately I did not have to mount the solar panel separately, so less installation time. Used my house wifi to connect camera via app. Once up and running it is easy to adjust the camera to just cover area required. Day and night images are good.
reviews.title: Works well
reviews.author: Duncan

reviews.body: This camera is perfect for those who don't wish to run power to an outdoor camera. Easy to setup and install, excellent image quality and app options such as preset view areas, alert area zones etc. The battery has yet to go below 95% and charges up with ease in overcast or clear skies. Highly recommend this camera.
reviews.title: Excellent Solar Camera
reviews.author: CFGBR95

reviews.body: I reviewed the features of the camera and it had all that I needed. It's a self solar charging, 360 ptz, colour with option to add light when night motion is detected for colour recording, it can track and trace. It has a number of presets that can be added and many other features. My only concern initially was the location of the cam due to its solar charging however all year around there is a window of time where the solar can receive light and so I went ahead and purchased. From charging it fully as first recommended via a mains, It was fully installed within 10mins and is working lovely, charging lovely and serving its purpose as intended. I ramped up the sensitivity and have caught the local wildlife too 👌🏽
reviews.title: Great features and veru easy to install
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.body: Brilliant device. Very clear images from a camera which tracks round following whatever is moving. Great for spotting nocturnal wildlife ( and trespassers ). Works independently of mains supply. Plenty of storage capacity and very low power consumption backed up by a solar panel.
reviews.title: Does everything it says on the tin
reviews.author: G and G

reviews.body:
Bought camera on recommendations from friends, can't fault it, easy to install and setup, picture quality is excellent and solar panel keeps it charged up.
Camera notifies me by text within a couple of seconds of any movement detected and the App is easy to use.
reviews.title: Works straight out of the box
reviews.author: Tuvver

reviews.body:
Very easy camera to set up. Works well even in adverse weather conditions.
Only negative comment is the screws to attach the solar panel to the camera are very short and they initially did not stay tight. I had to take the camera down and refit the solar panel using a drop of thread lock.
It's been fine since.
reviews.title: Review of EUFY SoloCam S340 3K WiFi Security Camera with Solar Panel - 8 GB
reviews.author: Reviewed by Currys customer

reviews.body: My husband & I aren't great with all this technology stuff, but this is a simple little camera to get set up. The picture is lovely & and clear, it's pretty easy to use. The only thing that takes a bit of getting used to is that you can't talk to someone & hear them at the same time (like my ring doorbell), you have to press on the microphone to speak, then let go to hear them, hence 4 stars. Apart from that it's great.
reviews.title: Great little camera
reviews.author: Karen

reviews.body: I bought this a weeks ago to replace an old wired system. This was so easy to set up and has some great features. Having two cameras in one unit is great - wide angle and close up in one screen. The tracking feature is also useful. I had this set up and displaying on my phone within minutes of charging it up. Once charged the solar panel keeps it topped up. The picture quality is fabulous. I would definitely recommend this security camera.
reviews.title: Great security camera and easy to set up.
reviews.author: Alrob

reviews.body: Easy to assemble and connect to App and WiFi. It needs a strong WiFi signal at the mounting point so insure close enough to Router or budget on buying range extenders or Repeaters. It works well and records all motion promptly and accurately. Notifications are quite quick (10-30 seconds) and reviewing recorded video is simple through smartphone or computer. It takes several seconds to download videos but dual lens is amazingly clear. Solar panel keeps camera charged in normal weather conditions and battery is large enough to cover those days without any sun. Overall excellent security camera.
reviews.title: Great Features Needs Strong WiFi Signal
reviews.author: Expatman

reviews.body:
Great camera for the price. Excellent comprehensive features and functions.

Easy to set up & programme. Brilliantly clear images and videos day or night.

Love the solar panel charger. Install and no forget about replacing batteries etc.
reviews.title: Fantastic Security Camera
reviews.author: Stu

reviews.body: Excellent, clear and concise images of guests and intruders alike. You can set the field of view to the edge of your land and it pops up on your phone. The only downside is the lag on opening the images live sometimes, but you can still view after
reviews.title: Great product ! That good I bought another
reviews.author: Roon

reviews.body: Do not buy from Eufy!  This company does not stand behind its products. My s340 died after two weeks of use and Eufy customer service is giving me the run around and refusing to send a replacement.  The cameras are difficult to get working, don't stay charged and on top of all that, Eufy will not send a replacement for their defective camera. I deeply regret purchasing Eufy products as the manufacturer has horrible customer service and defective cameras.
reviews.title: S340 Battery died after 2 weeks, Eufy will not warranty
reviews.author: Scott Bieluch

reviews.body:
Excellent piece of kit, works straight out of the box (after you've charged it).
Very easy to set up and operate.
I will be buying the Eufy homebase and another camera for the rear of the property.
reviews.title: Review of EUFY SoloCam S340 3K WiFi Security Camera with Solar Panel - 8 GB
reviews.author: Reviewed by Currys customer

reviews.body:
Was dubious of the solar option in UK but after the initial plugged charge it works like dream
Very easy to set up via QR code and no connections issues that plagued our previous NEST cameras
Bought on offer and then bought another as so pleased with it - 100% recommend
reviews.title: Great Camera
reviews.author: Russ

reviews.body: Excellent piece of kit. Works well and very solid. Excellent feature of the solar power as I am fed up charging my Ring one. The main feature behind that is that there is no subscription so it pays for itself over a number of months in terms of the savings. Excellent lens and AI feature that recognises people who come to the door. Much better choice that my other ones.
reviews.title: Eufy S340 Camera
reviews.author: Jack

reviews.body: I bought 2 of these to add to my eufy homebase. Features are fantastic, AI recognition, tracking, speak to intruder from your phone or sound an alarm/flashing lights. Records clear audio. Crystal clear footage & solar charging so put it anywhere. No fees no workmen. Eufy are leading the way. Recommended
reviews.title: Premium Security camera
reviews.author: KMC

reviews.body: I have had this a few weeks and I do like it a lot. But it does have a few bad points. The good points are that the picture quality is really good and the set up was easy. The only bad point I found it can take a wile sometimes to get on and view the camera.
reviews.title: Solar camera
reviews.author: Neil

reviews.body: Purchased recently after good experience of another Eufy camera. This one is even better. Solar panel moveable and charges quicker. Tracks vehicle and/or human motion and follows them so you can see all the action. Microphone very good so you can hear clearly. Best security camera I've purchased with dual cameras for close up and wide angle. Very impressed!
reviews.title: Amazing Security Camera
reviews.author: Jay

reviews.body: Excellent piece of kit. Good quality video images and tracking of persons in view. Easy install and controls simple to use.
reviews.title: Review of EUFY SoloCam S340 3K WiFi Security Camera with Solar Panel - 8 GB
reviews.author: Reviewed by Currys customer

reviews.body: I could say I love to use Eufy verity product, it is easy to setup and use with it. It can record the best quality video, and always send me the notice with the video. Especially this 360 degree cam is really the best item I choose. When you record by Eufy, you will track by it.
reviews.title: Great outdoor camera
reviews.author: Yvonne

reviews.body:
The delivery was prompt and good but the Camera we received was not holding well to its clamp. Consequently I am waiting for the day when it falls of the clamp and shatters to pieces.
I am in touch with Eufy to get this resolved since last month but no respite yet apart from some really empathetic mails. Still hopeful that they will help me before this cam takes a plunge.
reviews.title: Eufy S340 Solocam Dual Lens 2k Pan and Tilt and Zoom 2K Camera with Solar Panel - White | T81703W1
reviews.author: Bhaskar S

reviews.body:
Excellent camera. It detects people and vehicles and wiith the secind lens, I can zoom in remotely. Picture quality is very good.
After much research, paradigit offered the best price and deluvery was super quick and hassle free

This is my first security camera and it’s been excellent so far. It was easy to install and works great. I particularly like the dual lenses and AI face recognition, which follows around the movement, leaving no blind spots. I also like the 2-Year warranty by Argos. I would definitely recommend it to anyone!
reviews.title: Great product
reviews.author: JK

reviews.body: Replaced my old PTZ camera that couldn’t hold a charge for one night without the sun (just above the s340). The s340 works like a dream and I haven’t had to worry about power for it ever since. I’ve basically stopped monitoring the power dashboard at this point cuz I simply can’t get the battery to drain.

description: The Eufy Solo. Cam S340 from Anker Group is a versatile and durable surveillance solution designed for various environments. With its weatherproof protection, this camera can operate in temperatures ranging from -20°C to 50°C, ensuring reliable performance year-round. Bundled with a solar panel, it offers an eco-friendly power source, allowing for continuous monitoring without the need for constant battery changes. Equipped with a vibrant color lens and capable of 3K video quality, it delivers impressive image resolution, while the pan-and-tilt mechanical design provides a complete 360-degree view and 70-degree vertical tilt. Moreover, the Eufy Solo. Cam S340 integrates seamlessly with popular intelligent assistants like Google Assistant and Alexa, enhancing user convenience and control. With features such as two-way audio capability, motion detection, and infrared night vision up to 8 meters, it ensures comprehensive surveillance of your property. The inclusion of an 8 GB flash memory allows for ample recording storage, making it a smart choice for anyone seeking to enhance their home or business security.

name: Smart Lock C220 with Wi-Fi
bestFor: Fingerprint smart door lock with built-in Wi-Fi and keypad

specifications.name: Operation Type
specifications.value: Voice control via Google Voice Assistant or Alexa, Automatic locking when the door is closed

specifications.name: Durability
specifications.value: BHMA Grade 3 Certified (after being locked and unlocked more than 100,000 times)

reviews.body:
Let me start with, I already have 4 cameras & the home base, so I’m familiar with eufy’s lineup. I had a keypad lock on the front door and wanted WiFi access so eufy’s smart lock was of interest. I did my internet & YouTube research to understand pros/cons of many smart lock brands.
I bought the 220 direct from eufy (my money, no special discount), although lock was available through Amazon at the same price. Purchase & shipping were straightforward and delivery was a few days, maybe a week. This was directly in the holiday season when so many items were being shipped; no issue.
Installation was simple. The most confusing parts for me were finding the right QR code and finding the right location in the app to add a device. Once connected, everything just worked. I added codes & fingerprints and…that’s it. It VERY simple, easy, straightforward.
I like that I can add a code for a specific amount of time/days for visiting family. I like knowing whose code is used to lock/unlock the door. I like knowing if the door is locked or unlocked just by looking at app. Lastly, I like being able to lock or unlock the door from wherever I am using the app. All are features not available with the original keypad lock (b/c it wasn’t WiFi). I could go on but you get the picture; I do like the lock & the app and they are integrated very well with the eufy system of devices.
So, this lock is certainly an upgrade for my family. Installation was 12/23/24 so longevity has not yet been tested (for me). Hopefully, it provides years of service.
Now I’m interested in adding the 230 to the front door & moving the 220 to the garage. Just need to convince one family member 🤔 😂
reviews.title: Great lock, great app

reviews.body:
In general, I like the lock, but be warned that it is not possible to re-key it to match any other key. It requires some unique pick-proof pins that locksmiths do not carry and are not even allowed to purchase, unless they join the Eufy Affiliate Program. Now, I am stuck with my front door using a different key from my back door.

The other drawback is that the 8-month battery life is probably going to get old pretty quickly. Other smart locks I have used in the past had a 2-year battery life.
reviews.title: Cannot Be Rekeyed
reviews.author: Eric in Colorado

reviews.body: I purchased this lock after two different Kwikset’s corroded from the inside. I’ve been a loyal buyer of Kwikset for 10+ years. But after these last two locks I had lasted less than a year, I decided to look at other brands and this one from eufy is wonderful. Easy to install, connects well with Wi-Fi, looks great, easy to use, and even the fingerprint feature was easy to set up. I highly recommend this if you’re wanting something modern, fairly priced, well made and of high-quality, easy to install, and works exactly as described.
reviews.title: Great alternative to Kwikset
reviews.author: Bluestyle18

reviews.body: The battery lasts for a year, and it's rechargeable. The auto door lock feature is adjustable from 5 seconds to 60 minutes....or you can turn this feature off. It can store/use over 20 fingerprints, because my wife and I stored each finger. It also stores/uses a bunch of security codes, we only stored five. It also comes with two keys, and it works flawlessly with our existing Eufy app. Don't hesitate to buy one!
reviews.title: Great Product!
reviews.author: Skip

reviews.body: I've owned the C220 lock for a month and have found it to work really well. It took about 10 minutes to install and no modifications to my door were needed. The lock is well constructed and is heavy. The management app is well done and easy to navigate.Things to note:1. Some older people can have hard to read fingerprints. This is not specific to Eufy. Use a code number for them instead if this is a problem.2. The battery life on my lock has been great as my wifi is close by. The further away the lock is from your WIFI access point, the more demand there is on the batteries. This is why some people report great battery life while others complain it's terrible. I believe it took 8 batteries.. it should last a long time.3. No more smart hub!! Good riddance. Adding and removing codes or fingerprints is FINALLY easy! This might be the biggest difference.4. The touch keypad CAN be seen in direct sunlight5. I did not try the geofencing but it has the capability, provided everyone in the family has the app on their phone. It could auto-lock and auto unlock if configured to do so.6. I did not test doorbell or camera integration - but it has that feature.Gripes: These are small but need to be noted1. For renters: temporary/scheduled access codes work fine but there is no integration with text messaging (or email) to create the code and send it in a single process. Heck, the app is already managed on your mobile - why not do this? Now I have to separately send a text with all the details when this could have been easier.2. When using a number codes, you have to press the keypad once to wake it up, enter the code, and then press the enter key on the bottom right of the panel. Why do I need to press enter? Why not open the lock after a second if no additional keys are pressed and the code is correct? Now you have to tell potential renters of this requirement to press the enter key. My point is: the enter key is not be obvious to people unfamiliar with the lock.3. On the app, the battery life is shown as a tiny battery picture with lines filled in for battery life remaining. Would it have killed them to put a percentage number next to it?Overall, this is the best lock that I have tried and I have tried about 6 others to date. I hope you found this review useful.
reviews.title: Works great and no more Smart hub needed !

reviews.body: Eufy has some amazing products and they just did it again with this door lock. I had ultraloq before buying this door lock system and this was one reigns supreme. There are multiple ways to unlock door, it has an auto lock timer on it, installation was easy and was not hard to set up. Would definitely recommend. Will purchase another.
reviews.author: ATTALIA

reviews.body: Easy Installation!! Our door already had a smart lock but after 6 years it began jamming and nothing but headaches, I was already in the market for a new smart lock and this eufy hasn t disappointed me in any aspect.I took off my old deadbolt smart lock and told my husband have it to install the new eufy lock. He had the lock on the door in about 10 minutes, it did require a little effort on the door frame as the jam plate was a little larger than our previous one so he needed to chisel a little out to make it fit well. The app was a breeze, connecting, calibration and setup were all very simple!Adding a code for each user was mandatory which isn t my favorite thing. I was more aimed to the fingerprint as it s not something my kids or husband can lose easily lol!! Adding was pretty simple but for some of them it took longer to add.. overall like 2 minute job and ready to go. I LOVE the fact we can add multiple prints per person!!So far this lock has been amazing and working beautifully. I am a little worried that it s only been a few days so far and the batteries are already down to 3 bars when it shows 4 would be full. I will let that slide though as they are the factory sent batteries and my prior lock basically required 4 AA lithium batteries to even function for more than a week, this one requires 8 so it ll be more pricey to maintain but should make it last much longer before needing to be replaced.
reviews.title: Smooth and very easy to operate!!!

reviews.body: I absolutely love my eufy Security Smart Lock C220. It Comes with Fingerprint Keyless Entry Door Lock, Built-in Wi-Fi, App Remote Control, Front door Smart lock Deadbolt The battery lasts 8 months, reliable power, waterproof and more. As soon as my smart door lock came in the mail, I installed it. It comes with step by-step instructions, but the installation was so easy I did not need them. After I installed my door lock, I downloaded an app on my iPhone (eufy Security) and took full control of locking and unlocking my door. The app allows you to unlock or lock from anywhere. I went to Tennessee for the weekend and my son needed into the house and it was locked ... I simply got on my security app and unlocked my door for him to get in. Not only that, but I was also able to set up a fingerprint profile for my husband and my son. We are able to unlock the door multiple ways with this device. We set up a profile for each of us so we can lock or unlock our door using the app, fingerprints, or 4 digit code. When setting up fingerprint best to use your thumb. Another function I love is that I have total control of anyone who has access. I can deny access to any profile at anytime. This security lock has AI Chip built in. I love the appearance and intuitive of this lock. It is very easy to install and operate. The only downside to purchasing this smart lock is it does not allow me to merge it into my ring system. Maybe in the future or I just don't know. With that being said, it does integrate with my Alexa. It is very affordable.
reviews.title: eufy Security Smart lock C220 Fingerprint Keyless entry

reviews.body:
I just purchased this smart lock over the weekend and recieved it within 24hrs (via Amazon prime).
I have been wavering upgrading my front door lock with a smart lock for sometime now. I wanted convenience, easy to operate, easy to install, not too pricey, and looks nice/pretty/better than a standard lock.
This smart lock gave me all the above. I'm also familiar with the brand as I own one of their robovacs and it has been fantastic!
I like that the app is not limited to only one user in the home controlling the smart lock via the app. Anyone else in the home can be logged in at the same time as me and control the lock via the app.
Installation is really quick and easy - 15-20 mins max.
I have used the physical key, the passcode, the fingerprint, and app options to both lock and unlock the door and have experienced zero issues.
I did opt to use my thumb as my fingerprint option since my index finger was not being picked up. Perhaps i had lotion residue on it as this was not an issue for my mother who has the same sized hand and fingers.
I love being able to allow access and then revoke if needed or limit to whenever needed (such as a dog walker or someone house sitting).
I also like that you can turn on the auto lock option -- this is off by default, you need to go into the app and activate this option. This has also worked great.
Granted this is just 2 days of operating the new smart lock, but so far it is working as advertised.
I do carry the physical key with me in the event the lock malfunctions or stops working and then I'm locked out. I know, it defeats the purpose of having a smart lock, but i would rather be ready in the event this does happen than lamenting I should have carried the physical key just in case.
I do wish there was option to come in nickel instead of just black. My door handle is nickel as was the old lock - I prefer the set to match, but it doesn't look hideous, just not matchy like I prefer. Having said that, even if the coloring doesn't match, this smart lock looks FANTASTIC on my door.
reviews.title: Easy peasy
reviews.author: Liz M.

reviews.body: Works very well and super easy to register fingerprints. Who needs keys when your fingers are your keys. This lock also opens up with the app you can use the app to open it or your fingerprints either way works. App is very intuitive it shows you how much battery is left whether you need to change them or not. They last a long time about a year if you open and close the lock 10x per day if you do it less it'll last longer. AA batteries easy to replace. There's really nothing bad that can be said about the lock. It's secure and deadbolt is solid with solid core. Don't believe you can hack this lock either it's very well made. So far I have 2 of these one on my front and one on the rear doors on my house. I love that now I leave the house and not worry about taking keys with me. As long as my fingers are attached to my body I'll be able to get inside lol. Get with the times and get this lock. There's a newer version with Li-Ion battery it's a little more expensive you can go with that one as well but overall very satisfied customer here. Nothing but nothing but right
reviews.title: Absolutely love this deadbolt lock

reviews.body: We use this on an Airbnb suite. This locks works much better than the cheaper one I replaced. Can be tricky to get the program right, but once you have it down it works well. Forgot to tell our first guests that you have to touch it first on the outside for it to activate.
reviews.title: Dependance remote lock
reviews.author: ROGER

reviews.body:
We love this lock. The reasons for the four stars is 1) we have never had a lock with such a sensitive bolt. If everything is not exactly inline it won't lock and, in some cases, won't unlock. Was almost locked out one night. 2) finger print reader initially worked for the second person on the primary account but then stopped. Even after deleting and reconfiguring it would never recognize the thumb print. Finally had to create a separate amount. Weird and ought not be necessary.
Otherwise we love the capability. Even had an occasion where a contractor showed up after we left and we were able to unlock the door remotely. Very cool
reviews.title: Great lock!
reviews.author: Chazman

reviews.body: Let's just say we had another brand of door lock and it died after 8 months. The lock wouldn't turn. The motor burned up, and the stupid wifi gateway that we had to order for it didn't do anything to help the connection. This one was a BREEZE to install. It took me about 15 minutes and then setting up the fingerprint was so easy. I ran an errand, came home and sat my thumb on that fingerprint reader and the door opened so much faster than putting a key up to the lock. It's impressive. This is THE door lock that everyone needs. It has an app and it connects through wi-fi. It also comes with 2 keys for you. I'm loving how sleek it looks and I am super impressed with even the stickers that eufy sends you to show that you have eufy security. If you're debating door locks. This one is THE ONE!!!!!!!
reviews.title: I installed this today and had to run to leave a review

reviews.body: So, I have a big desire to make my house as "smart house" as possible. I have a lot of smart devices, but Eufy goes above and beyond on their items to make things as easy and as user friendly as possible.I bought a similar deadbolt without the fingerprint for my office, and love the ease of use.So when I decided I was tired of fumbling with my keys to get in my house, while carrying 2 kids, and more, I decided to try this lock out.The greatest thing about this over some of the other similar Eufy deadbolts, is this one has built in wifi. There is no need for a HUB or anything like that. Once you get it installed and set up, it connects easily to your wifi.The fingerprint scanner gives me issues sometimes, but like I said, I have my hands full a lot of the time. So if I went in and did a few variations of the same fingerprint I shouldn't have any issues with it.I love the ability to have it auto-lock after a set amount of time, so whether I'm leaving or coming home, I don't have to try to remember if I locked the door. And if I want extra verification I can just check the Eufy Security app on my phone and it will tell me if it is locked or unlocked!Amazing product and a great price for everything you get!
reviews.title: Easy to install and use, might have to get fingerprint just right sometimes.

reviews.body:
I ve installed a few smart locks over the years and they are all pretty much the same method to install. The app makes setup a cinch. Wifi reaches my basement which is great. This lock doesn t need a gateway as it has wifi. This one takes 8 AA batteries(included) which allegedly will allow it to function for longer. The fingerprint detection is good but not perfect. It has more to do with user consistency than the technology. Touch control is solid and intuitive. Keys for backup work great. There is a backup usb power port for when the power runs out. Scramble mode is handy for being able to protect your code.
One of the best deadbolts I ve used so far.
reviews.title: Brand has a history and features are solid.

reviews.body: The most important characteristics for this user:1. Easy installation. I’m not kidding around here, completely installed this lock in five minutes. Use the quick start booklet.2. User friendly. As soon as I connected the cable to the Smart lock, and entered my Wi-Fi password the lock started booting up. After that you simply follow the prompts in your app to add your device and your up and running.3. Adding finger print and or password. Simple, use the app again for this.4. Adding another person to have lock access. This is also very easy using the app.5. Linking Alexa to your smart lock. Go on the app & live chat. Eufy will send you a link to add this function.Notes:1. When using finger print mode, make sure your finger/thumb is not dusty or dirty and place it flat on the sensor.2. Make sure after you’ve installed the new lock that the dead bolt in/out movement is very smooth with “no” binding.
reviews.title: Awesome WiFi Smart Lock!

reviews.body: Works perfectly. Extremely well made and very easy to install and set up with wireless.The lock also works with Alexa but needs to be set up as it's disabled by default.You can set it up with the app to receive notifications when the door is locked or unlocked.Fingerprint is easy to set up and has worked every time. You can program numerous prints of your own or for use with others.I like that the number pad is not visible until you touch it, then it lights up.Quality product, excellent packaging, performs as advertised, quick and easy to set up and looks great.No more fumbling for a key.Highly recommend.
reviews.title: Quality product

reviews.body: Very happy with this lock so far, the previous model I purchased was just inconsistent with the auto-lock and lack of built in Wi-Fi connect just made it insufficient for what I needed. Other model would require for me to buy an additional part to sync the Bluetooth with Wi-Fi. The Eufy comes built in Wi-Fi and cost less (with prime discount) than the other brand. The packaging of the lock also was in some apple level packaging, which also had me impressed. Installing was a breeze and the app is beyond simple!! Only wish the app would allow for multiple people in the household to have same access to the app. Right now they would have to install the app and log in with my account to get the level of acces I have. Other than that it s been flawless Wi-Fi reaction is almost instance, auto-lock and finger print works flawlessly so far.
reviews.title: Very easy to install and setup

reviews.body:
Pros: Easy install; looks good; app functions well; automatic lock works as expected

cons; Can not get fingerprint reader to program or function. Tried to contact customer support online and they provide no help without copies of serial/receipt PDFs/photos of issue etc

I am disappointed as I replaced a kwickset lock with this because I have a eufy security cameras. I also purchased two C210 locks that work correctly and went with this one for front door. It just does not work. Bought on sale and the price has gone up and want it replaced at same price
reviews.title: Finger Print issue
reviews.author: KZee

reviews.body: I have had it for a while now and it works great. I have several items from Eufy brand and I am very pleased with each one of them.This lock is not the exception. It works well, battery life is good, simple to mount and simple to setup.I am not a fan of having my face recognized or fingerprints on databases so I only tried with one finger and it worked but I removed my fingerprint and don’t use that function altogether.Love the 18 month support that they give you with this, and again, the eufy ecosystem has worked well for me (no cloud storage or fees).
reviews.title: Excellent Smart Lock

reviews.body: The lock works well once installed. The only issue that I had was with calibration. Evidently, the hole in the door frame isn’t as deep as the calibration requires. When doing the installation using the app, the setup always failed with a calibration error even though the lock seemed to be locking and unlocking correctly. I eventually tried calibration with door open and was able to complete the installation. After closing the door, the software reported that locking failed even though it worked perfectly. After a few cycles, the lock stopped returning the error and works fine now. Since the errors stopped, I am very happy with the function of this lock. The physical installation was easy. The calibration function was not.
reviews.title: Great Smart Lock

reviews.body: For those who don't know, eufy is a division of Anker, who has been selling chargers and power banks for years. They are a very respected brand. I ordered the very first eufy outdoor security camera that was sold intially on Kickstarter over 4 years ago, and I'm still using that camera today. I currently have 5 eufy outdoor cameras, 6 eufy indoor cameras, and an eufy video doorbell. This smart lock will complete my collection of eufy security products for my home. It's nice because I can use the same app for everything. I had previously used a Wyze smart lock, but I had a lot of issues with it. Sometimes it wouldn't open at all. Other times there would be a huge delay between the time I tried to unlock my door with the app and when it would actually unlock. So I finally gave up on it and ordered this new model from eufy. It is so much better! Not only can I control it with the same eufy app that I use to monitor my cameras, but it is much more responsive than my old Wyze lock. Plus the fingerprint sensor built into the keypad works great, so I don't even need to have my phone with me to unlock the door. Whether you already own several eufy products like I do or this is your first, I highly recommend this smart lock.
reviews.title: A nice addition to your eufy security system

reviews.body: This lock is made from premium materials, with metal outside case (plastic inside case), good rubber to contact your door, electronics are coated. The instructions made it super easy to swap out my existing manual deadbolt in about 15 minutes. The app requires the creation of an account which requires email verification, 2 factor phone verification, etc. it seemed like a lot of back and forth before I could add the new device. But better to be safe than sorry. When adding the device you can scan the QR code on top of the inside case then connect using Bluetooth. You give it your wifi password and pick where the lock is installed (e.g. garage) and then set the PIN code. The last step was to add my fingerprint which is very familiar if you have a smart phone. I love being able to see the state of the lock from the app and remotely lock it at the end of the day. I m very impressed with this lock. I think I might have to replace my other smart locks with this brand. The only negative is that it takes 8 batteries and I don t know how long they last. They do include premium batteries.
reviews.title: Premium quality, super responsive, phone notifications

reviews.body: eufy products are well known for delivering quality performance at reasonable price points. My previous experience with them had been with their excellent security cameras. I love anything that automates routine household chores and that includes locks. This isn't the fanciest or most feature packed smart lock but it does the job and does it well. There's a variety of ways to open the lock--fingerprint, keypad, physical key, smartphone app, voice assistant and Apple watch. Installation was simple--I just took out the old deadbolt and installed this one. First rate product at a very solid value price. Highly recommended!
reviews.title: Nice lock for a reasonable price point

reviews.body: Installation was fairly simple, did have to slightly enlarge the hole to make the deadbolt portion fit at the back, but was easy enough. The Deadbolt has multiple positions that will fit just about any standard hole. Installation took all of 10 minutes. Configuration through the app is easy. Fingerprint registration is a little tricky for some users I've found. Recognition of fingerprints seems very good and the code functionality works pretty well. Integration with Google works okay for locking, but unlocking requires you verbally say a PIN that *MUST* be 6 digits which is just awkward. I wish there was a way to override that feature.
reviews.title: Great Lock, loaded with features

reviews.body: Had to replace my current Smart lock & found this Eufy Brand with Fingerprint access. This unit has 4 options for entry, Basic Manual Key, passcode, Fingerprint and/or Phone App.The install was very easy, and I thought the set up was going to be challenging but it actually wasn t. The app walks you through step by step and if you mess up it will let you know. After the set up, you may have to do a firmware update, which was fairly quick. After that your all good to go!Overall so far so good for the 1st day! Fingers-crossed no issues will arise  Ultimately if this product performs as it should, I then 100% recommend it, especially for the low cost.
reviews.title: Very Nice

reviews.body: Pros:Look very nice on door. Very easy to install. Fingerprint works well so far. Has a power backup port outside to power the lock in case out of batteryCons:Must connect to wifi. Otherwise, can only use key to openHold ok button 5s to lock. I wish the duration can be adjusted on app. I think 1-2s to lock is more reasonableToo many notifications. The app only allows to select notifications when lock/unlock, but cannot customize the lock/unlock method. I don’t need the notifications when I manually lock/unlock
reviews.title: Beautiful lock

reviews.body: Upgraded from Wyze smart lock, which died after just a year. This device is awesome. Fingerprint reader is brilliant, app is good and does not spam us with ads, like Wyze does. Works great with Alexa. Installed rather easily after drilling a slightly large hold in frame for deadbolt. Lock feels solid and well made. Battery power from 8 AA seems decent but would prefer a rechargeable type. Overall, recommend! Thank you.
reviews.title: Love this lock!

reviews.body:
I have been a dedicated user of the old S230 lock for quite some time now. It's been reliable on my door since day one. But I've recently heard about the new version came out and seriously considering making an upgrade!
here's what really caught my attention: the new model got a super long battery life. The S230 has been good to me, but the idea of not having to worry about recharging the batteries for almost a entire year is incredibly appealing. It's a convenience that's hard to pass up.
reviews.title: Recommendation from an old user

reviews.body: I think this is a very good lock at the price with what it was offered. It takes only 2 AA battery and it lasts almost as long as those that uses 4 batteries, that's pretty impressive. The finger print reading time is, a little slow, but it's accurate. What I like about it is it doesn't require bridge to connect to wifi, for most lock at this price, they requires some kind of bridges. The app is easy to use. There are some small flaws, but it's mostly good overall.
reviews.title: easy to install, great feature, and good value

name: Pro 5 2K Wireless Security Camera
bestFor: 2K HDR video quality with dual-band 2.4/5GHz Wi-Fi connectivity

reviews.body: Recording is great. Very clear video. Does lag when I first click to watch. It just had a small lag of maybe one to two seconds. Super easy to set up, connect to wifi, and mount. Motion detection is awesome it remembers similar faces and pets. You can set up emergency alert to alert police or call some you have saved on app to call in case of an emergency. Notifications work great. Really is a great security camera. Only give it 3 stars because the battery does not last long. I think a full charge last me 3 MAYBE 4 days.
reviews.author: cheyenne.k

reviews.body: You only get what is pictured. This is missing the mount and the security key. I was unable to find just the missing part of the mount so a complete new mount will be needed if you want to attach it to a flat surface. Bypassing the missing security key needed to open the camera for pairing or battery replacement was relatively simple but it irreparably damages the hole for it. Simply use a right size hex wrench and twist hard to break the set screw loose. The camera can then be removed from the housing by pushing a paper clip down the resulting hole and the camera will pop free of the housing. Otherwise, the camera looks brand new and works fine.
reviews.title: Missing key parts.
reviews.author: tambourine--man

reviews.body: I reviewed this a few months after I bought it last summer, well for an outdoor camera it is garbage. It’s delayed by about 30 seconds, a lot can happen in 30 seconds when kids are playing, and after one winter the camera now has a cloudy film over the centre of the picture. So it leaked and the water remains inside so now it’s in the garbage. And you need a subscription which I can’t afford. Don’t buy.
reviews.title: Not good
reviews.author: Nikki

reviews.body: The set up is very easy and after downloading the app it walks you right through the whole process. The videos are very clean and crisp. I have an issue with the sensitivity. My house is in the middle of two acres and it alerts me every time a car goes down the road. I have it angled to get the sidewalk and our front porch. The light is so very bright and comes on in the day also. I wish it wouldn’t as it brings attention to the camera. I don’t necessarily want everyone knowing there is one.
reviews.author: barrie.w

reviews.body: This came at such a perfect time. I had left some sunflowers on my deck to dry. Every morning I would wake up to a ton of seed shells right in front of my door. I couldn’t imagine what it would be because there’s four cats on this property and my deck is two stories up. I was so surprised to see this little guy on the camera! Anyways about the camera, it works great! Great battery life, easy to use, and the picture quality is great. The app is easy to use and navigate. I haven’t tried any of the fancy stuff it can do but I do plan on it. Definitely a great item to have as a security camera or a mouse cam lol.
reviews.author: alison.p

reviews.body: I’ve had security cameras from local security company for about a year. They are mediocre at best and cost $400 each and only cover half of the perimeter of the exterior of my home. So, I knew that this arlo could help cover some of the area not currently visible. I definitely had some hiccups in setting up and getting it mounted in a good location to capture my deck and door area. Likely more user error! But I like how sleek this is and that it doesn’t have a million flashing red lights like my other cameras do. The images the arlo captures are way sharper than my current cameras and I like that’s it super sensitive as I don’t feel my others are sensitive enough. Definitely considering swapping my other cameras for more arlos!
reviews.author: jo.c

reviews.body: This Arlo Pro 5S 2K Wire-Free Spotlight Security Camera is amazing! I love how it easy it is to set up it only took me about 10 mins. I love that it is wire free so you can install it anywhere. The video quality is amazingly clear. It works with a app so I can view my camera from anywhere. It even has color night vision. If your looking for a new security camera this one is the one to get!
reviews.author: michael.s

reviews.body: Very Disappointed! Very slow to detect and record an image. Also, the batteries are expensive and don't last very long. If you mount it in a hard to reach place, you will have to be servicing this camera soon. This is a real pain!!
reviews.title: Way Overpriced for a mediocre product
reviews.author: Fred

reviews.body: This was one of the nicest things I have received from influencer! This camera is excellent! Crystal clean recording and excellent night vision. Definitely recommend if you are looking for home security cameras. Don’t waste your time with ADT that costs an arm and a leg! Also very easy to setup and install.
reviews.author: ryan.s

reviews.body: Wowwwww, how cool is this. So we decided to put this wireless camera on our property next to our deer feeder so we can see whats coming in at night/early mornings and boy was it cool to watch. We caught bucks, does, cows and bear all grazing at the feeder. And all the pictures/video was clear as can be. Highly recommend this if youre in the market for a high quality security camera.
reviews.author: kanoe.g

reviews.body: I am livid about these cameras. They work great, but after your one month trial is done, they are literally useless unless you buy the $200 a year subscription. Coincidentally, this is also when the return period is up. They literally become useless. It will tell you if there is a motion detection, but when you try to load the camera it won’t load, as well as it won’t record or save anything from you. You literally can’t use them without a subscription. When bought, I was told that the subscription was not necessary and that you would still be able to see recorded videos. I would rate this 0 stars if i could.
reviews.title: DO NOT BUY- useless without the $200 a year sub
reviews.author: Amber

reviews.body: I really liked this camera and the sense of security it provides. The video picture is not bad, but could be clearer especially in lower light situations. Connecting to the app and setting up was a little bit of a challenge. The two way talk audio is not very loud or clear.
reviews.author: zi.b

reviews.body: This camera is ideal to have out front of my home. I worry some about safety and theft due to issues I’ve had happen in the past so the system gives me more confidence. I love that it has a light. This feature is great because it really lights up the porch and acts as a deterrent to anyone wanting to take anything. I like that I can use my WiFi for the camera. You really need to get the subscription to get the best use out of the product. It’s my first time with a security camera and I felt like this sleek design is exactly what I hoped for. It stands out and I like the modern look.
reviews.author: elizabeth .l

reviews.body: I wasnt expecting too much out of this camera due to the size. But boy was I wrong. The camera quality is great. I love the motion alerts I get on the app from the camera and all the features it has. The only complaint I would say I have is the camera footage is a little delayed from camera to phone. But overall an awesome camera and I absolutely love it.
reviews.author: alexis.p

reviews.body: Wi-Fi picks up long range which is very important for me. The picture quality is absolutely great. The only negative thing about this is the screws were poor quality. I had to get some different screws. Overall I would definitely recommend this product.

I have friends that use Arlo and they are durable, great image quality, day and night and I was stoked to get mine. I docked one star because of the WiFi connection being 2.5 or whatever and that makes it a bit finicky to setup, otherwise, looks nice, works great. I recommend
reviews.author: abby .c

reviews.body: The Arlo Pro 5S 2K Spotlight Camera is such a great upgrade from the cameras without the spotlight. The sound quality is awesome as is the image quality. I already have 3 cameras on the Arlo system - this camera is a great addition for home security!
reviews.author: amanda.s

reviews.body: This camera is great! It is extremely easy to install (1 did it myself). Just needed a drill, ladder, and wif! Works amazingly and great view. The only thing I would change is a stronger spotlight. Overall, it is amazing!
reviews.author: jessie.b

reviews.body: This camera is great! It is extremely easy to install ( I did it myself ). Just needed a drill, ladder, and wifi! Works amazingly and great view. The only thing I would change is a stronger spotlight. Overall, it is amazing!
reviews.author: jessie.b

reviews.body: Pro S5 2K Spotlight Camera is the BEST security camera Ive ever owned. The picture quality is excellent. The light on the camera is bright so you can see everything day and night. I highly recommend this camera.
reviews.author: lynne.a

reviews.body: I bought this to replace an older Pro 4 that was damaged in a wind storm. The Pro 5s was easier to setup, has a more sturdy mount system, and uses the same batteries. I'm very happy with the purchase.
reviews.title: Excellent and easy to set up
reviews.author: iguy

reviews.body: We don't have wifi, just a mobile hotspot. We can't use it cause it has to connect to wifi for setup and then later can connect to a faster connection. So, can't even set it up. Will probably have to gift it. Nice gift for someone, since I got it free fro.com Influenster!
reviews.author: cindy.b

reviews.body: I really enjoyed trying this product. It was easy to set up, and easy to follow. I found that the quality is excellent as well! I know that I feel much safer from using this product!
reviews.author: bethany.c

reviews.body: I have been a long time user and fan of Arlo products. This new camera is exactly what you need. The video quality is excellent and probably the clearest recordings out of all security cameras. I really like the look of this camera and I especially like the built in light it has. I highly recommend this camera!
reviews.author: kevin .g

reviews.body: This camera is great! Its easy to set up and has an app. The video quality is amazing! I wish it had the ability to acess videi whenever you want though. Set it up outside to watch our horses.
reviews.author: jessica.s

reviews.body: Love the product. It does require a subscription, however the price is not bad. I don't like that my phone will just randomly play the audio from the camera site. It was difficult at first to figure out live view and set up. All in all a great product
reviews.author: summer.f

reviews.body: Nice camera for the view and the app is pretty user friendly. Comparing to the blink cameras I have it seems to be less finicky but being rechargeable is a pain if you have to plan around battery. But you never have to replace batteries like in the blink.
reviews.author: gina.b

reviews.body: The cameras (and the app) are easy to set up and work much better than I had hoped for. The notifications are easy to configure and the video quality is superb.
reviews.author: jenna.l

reviews.body: This arlo camera works great . Great quality videos and picks up sound with Bo issues. I love all the features and I would recommend this camera for your home!
reviews.author: nichole.t

reviews.body: The camera is excellent its Very easy to set up takes less then 10 minutes, love that it has an app to control everything, the video quality is great, highly recommend this one!
reviews.author: katherine.f

description: Leave your worries at the door with cutting-edge clarity and powerful protection with the Arlo Pro 5S 2K. Installation is easier than ever with a wire-free setup. Plus, the camera's smart Wi-Fi with dual-band connection automatically connects to either the 2.4 or 5 GHz network, whichever is stronger, for faster video loading and less buffering. See details that matter with 2K HDR video thats twice the resolution of HD cameras, 12x zoom to make out details like faces or license plates, and a wide 160 field of view to see the bigger picture. Never miss a detail with clearer video, even at night, with color night vision and enhanced low light video with an advanced image sensor. You can also spend less time charging and more time protecting with additional rechargeable batteries and a dual battery charging station. Your cameras will also always stay secured with the included anti-theft mounts, and you can send a message that youre protected with the included yard sign. The Pro 5S 2K is also built to work with the Arlo Home Security System, providing enhanced battery life, a more robust connection with Arlo SecureLink, and image verification when power or Wi-Fi is down.

name: Ultra 2 4K Spotlight Camera
bestFor: Ultra HD 4K video resolution with ultra-wide 180-degree diagonal view
description: Receive instant alerts on your phone when motion is detected and take quick action. Capture a clearer picture of every detail with 4K HDR. See in the dark with colour night vision. Works with most voice activated assistant. 1 camera pack.

name: Essential Wireless Video Doorbell 2K
bestFor: 1:1 square aspect ratio video doorbell to view packages on doorstep

reviews.body:
This video doorbell has fairly good quality video, but that's where it ends. The quality of the intercom for communication is very poor and unusable.

There does not seem to be an option for viewing in color at night time . Just black and white.

Not sure if this device has an built-in alarm but wondering if it's as bad an alarm as on the Arlo cameras.

The battery life is not satisfactory and I am wondering if this mob has a solar panel available specifically for the Arlo video doorbell.

Without a solar panel it requires frequent recharging.

Overall its just ok . Score from 1 to 10 for the price I'd give a 4 .
reviews.title: Just passable
reviews.author: Ck 1212

reviews.body: I purchased this doorbell camera approx 1 month ago, there is a bit of foot traffic past it and I have had to recharge in past few days. Overall I am happy with the quality and the picture quality of this product. I also have 2 x ultra cameras and an essential camera all running from the same hub. 2 of them have solar panels which work great.
reviews.title: Works well, clear at night also
reviews.author: Ben S

reviews.body: Bought the Arlo video doorbell late last year and have loved it. Gives me a greater sense of security knowing who’s at the door. The app is super easy to set up and use. I do wish there was some greater customisation with the settings on the app for notifications. But aside from that no major issues or anything. Will be looking at purchasing more cameras soon!
reviews.title: Solid Product
reviews.author: Todd V

reviews.body: Couldn’t set up as the app thought my wifi network password was incorrect. 2 chatbot disasters later, they just told me to restore factory settings and try again, then left the chat after 2 minutes, the time it was taking me to do this….. very frustrating and time consuming. I then did all the usual suspects myself, rebooted the modem, reinstalled the app, sat next to my modem during set up. If there is a logical reason, their support is not doing them any favours. Back to the shop this goes.
reviews.title: Doesn’t recognise my wifi
reviews.author: Barbara

reviews.body: Arlo Doorbell 2K captures surprisingly clear and sharp images even in low-light. The 2 second delay after pressing the button and the bell ring could be improved (shorten to under 1 second). Don’t know how robust the wall frame is (from wear & tear) when I have to keep removing the doorbell for recharging once a week. Wide angle of view. Elegant design. Phone app can do with an ease of use improvement.
reviews.title: 2K Doorbell Compliments my Arlo Ultra2
reviews.author: AC/DC

reviews.body:
I give it one star (that star is for the impressive battery life).
Expect to pay $120 min yearly for cloud service. The camera to phone warning time is useless and you have no playback option, not even for one instance if you don't subscribe $10 a month after the trial. Waste of time and money with too much lag. I recommend spending an extra hundred or so and go with reolink unless you have other arlo cams linked to a hub.
reviews.title: Don't buy it unless you have a hub
reviews.author: TF

reviews.body: We set up our new video doorbell a couple of weeks ago and it is absolutely brilliant! Swift notifications, brilliant colour and image quality and a great asset to our busy household. We appreciate it even more than we thought we would! The extra features from the app subscription (e.g. package recognition, person recognition) seem like they will be worth paying for (we are currently on the one month free trial). Highly recommended!
reviews.title: Awesome doorbell camera
reviews.author: Kirsty C

reviews.body: Bought the 2K doorbell a month ago. Have loved it ever since. Packed full of features you’d want including clear video both day and night, timely and detailed alerts and the ability to speak to people who ring the doorbell. Battery hasn’t needed a recharge yet and it’s in a busy block of units where it gets a lot of use so that’s been a surprising bonus. It’s been great for parcel delivery as well. Great value so highly recommend if you were thinking of converting from a traditional doorbell to a video doorbell
reviews.title: It does everything you’d want!
reviews.author: AdrianS88

reviews.body: I highly recommend this product. I had an Aqara doorbell before which relied on AA batteries to power it. This was not great because you had to by rechargeable AA batteries which took a whole day to charge and went flat every 2-3 weeks. The Arlo has stood the test of time still holding 50% battery after 4 weeks and is USB C rechargeable. Great user friendly interface and works with my Arlo cameras. When doorbell is rung is calls your phone directly to all you to immediately answer the video and audio feed. It offers a voicemail option after 20sec of not answering and connects to Alexa so we don’t need a chime with it
reviews.author: MorganD439

reviews.body: bought to replace existing Blink doorbell. I have 4 pros also. As usual it is a solid unit with excellent features, like the cameras. Problem is it is too sensitive, even at its lowest sensitivity setting, for a device that points at the street - it catches every car, all day, and the battery runs low too fast. Also, the release function used to take it off its bracket is too easy for anyone to do - its just a standard sim pin. considering the cost of replacement, I think you should consider a more secure design. too easy to steal.
reviews.title: solid but sensitive and vulnerable
reviews.author: KevGme

reviews.body: Wire free video doorbell with easy set-up on the home wi-fi network. Was pleasantly surprised to get such good features in this small package. The movement detection and categorisation ( Person, Animal, Package,etc) is excellent. 2-way communication possible through the doorbell even when we are miles away thru internet. 2K video quality is clear even in the night mode. Overall happy with our purchase.
reviews.title: Front door Video bell -Arlo
reviews.author: Nitin

reviews.body:
I bought this arlo camera for our new house and it was great for the first month, i was a touch disappointed the battery lasts about 2 weeks before you have to take it down and recharge it. but thats where my disappointment started. after the first month we notice the camera just stopped working all together and we couldn't figure out why......the subscription service had expired, so after the first month you are wrestled into paying an extra $20pm thats $220 annually for a camera we paid $89, I DISLIKE HAVING TO PAY A SUB SERVICE FOR A PRODUCT I BOUGHT OUTRIGHT. THATS 2.5x THE COST OF THAT PRODUCT.

2/10 - Like the camera quality itself is reasonable, i dont think the cost of the sub service in reasonable, i do think its a bit scammy, and it should say on the box it requires a sub service to work after 30 days.
reviews.title: The annual cost of subscription is 2.5X the cost of the camera (RED FLAG)
reviews.author: Arron

reviews.body: I bought this a month ago now, and honestly I had my doubts. Not so much in the product, but I'm not technically inclined. But I figured I'd give it a go. The charging and set up was easier than I thought they'd be. The app is truly user friendly. I must say that I'm sure I'm not using all the product features, but it gives me a great view of my yard, the sound and picture quality are great and I'm very pleased with its doorbell function. So, for the technophobes out there who can operate basic apps - if I can work it out, I'm sure you can too!
reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.author: KaySea

reviews.body: The doorbell is a bit hit and miss, occasionally stop detecting and needs to have the battery removed to reset, I have had missed detections when it was working (the postie riding right up to the doorbell on his bike) and you can't change the phone interface, which is extremely annoying, when im at home, i don't need the chime and the phone going off when someone rings the doorbell, but if you can change it I can't work out how
reviews.title: Fairly Ordinary
reviews.author: Tony695

reviews.body: I am happy with the sensitivity of the cam and the general quality. But, and it is one big but, the material at the lower front section is made of a plastic that scratches very easily. Even just with your fingernail. For a door bell that is terrible. It is not a cheap item and you would not expect it to scratch do badly. Makes it look crappy on your front door. Forget about any help from Arlo about it. Look up other online complaints about the same issue.
reviews.title: Needs work
reviews.author: DSP Tas

reviews.body: Doorbell looks discrete and sophisticated. name: Tapo C220 2K Pan/Tilt Security Camera
bestFor: Affordable 2K indoor pan & tilt security camera with smart AI detection

reviews.body:
This is now my 7th WiFi camera from Tapo and the quality seems to go from strength to strength!
This camera is destined to be fitted in my carport/garage, it will be my second as i already have an older C210 model that is virtually the same only lower image resolution. Although these cameras are intended for indoor use, my original has been working fine in my unheated and slightly damp carport for over 14 months without any issues what so ever, fingers crossed this stays the same? Don't let its size fool you, the image quality is fantastic especially when you take into account its cost! The built in microphone works well and is quite sensitive, as for the speaker the playback sound quality isn't so great but what do you expect from such a small speaker in such a small unit, that said speech is clear enough to be understood. The IR night vision is just enough to illuminate a standard size garage end to end, similar to an average size living room for which it is really intended.
The AI recognition at this price level is about what you'd expect, but if you intend to add more cameras or sensors to your set up the H500 Hub adds the next level of AI to this camera giving it the same features as Tapo's much higher level cameras. Set up is very easy once you understand that during setup you have to connect your phone/tablet to the cameras own WiFi and not you own home's WiFi, this caught me out and catches alot of people out i understand, the apps instructions are very good but not clear on this one point which should be expressed better. I purchased one of these for a relative who takes it on holiday with her just so she can keep an eye on her dog when they go out, poor thing feet's!
It's a good camera at £25 but Argos often have them on a deal so can be picked up even cheaper, this was one of those deals. It is worth paying the extra few pounds for the C220 over the other similar, cheaper models, these are basically the same camera but the much higher image quality is what your paying the extra for.
Add an SD card to your camera and record your own footage without the need of a paid 3rd party back-up service. Tapo do offer such a service that I belive is about £30 per year, personally this is why I purchased Tapo's H500 Hub so I have my own back-up without any additional cost, it's worth reading up on Tapo's website just what you can do with a Hub! The whole thing integrates perfectly with Amazon's Alex Echo Show units, this is when you can really start getting carried away with the other possibility of Tapo's kit.
More than happy to recommend this camera.

Absolutely packed full of features in the app, no subscription, no ads etc. The night vision works well just with ambient street light. Loads of options for detection. Can zoom across the road and still read number plates. Audio is sensitive enough I can hear noises through the window they're behind and around the house. The ability to tune the different detection modes is very useful. I have a 64gb card in them and it lasts about a 9-12 days before looping back to the beginning. Just make sure you use a branded high endurance SD card like a SanDisk high endurance because the standard ones aren't designed for continual re-writing. The range seems to be further than what I would typically want, but this is managed quite easily with the in-app settings. Resolution on output seems to be the main varying factor among cameras, but I have not quite gotten a chance to see any benefits from the higher resolution due to the visibility of the unit acting as a deterrent. reviews.title: Tapo Link C200C
reviews.author: Flowers

reviews.body:
Tapo C220
There are so many features to this camera when connected to the Tapo app.

I like that you can schedule continuous recording at certain times. There is also an option to detect if someone walks past a set line.

I also like the privacy feature.

The image quality is good, depending on what you plan to use the camera for. Zooming in with the app can distort the image.

If the wifi goes off, the camera will still record footage to the sd card. The red LED will flash, and the camera will automatically connect to the network again when it comes back on.

If the power to the camera goes off, then the camera will automatically connect to the wifi when the power comes back on again.

Motion detection is not as sensitive as other cameras I have used. If you move slowly, then detection is not picked up, even on the highest sensitivity, but motion detection in general is very impressive and is perfect for general use.

If a light is on and is then switched off, it takes a while for the camera to respond to night vision when it is in auto mode. (A few seconds)

At first, talking through the camera was not really possible as the voice couldn't be heard. Going to advanced settings and changing voice call mode from standard mode to compatibility mode fixed this.

I would highly recommend this camera to anyone as it has passed all of my expectations.

Just a couple of suggestions for future development, to improve on the instruction manual or guide and to have an option to detect any sound for some recording scenarios where there is no motion detected, but there is sound.

Update: The sound recording quality has been a bit hit and miss. After using the camera for a couple of days, it has been noted that the sound can be a bit distorted or not heard very clearly at times, even with the microphone set at the default setting.

Also, if you use dual broadband it is still possible to use the app, but some functions, like cut or download playback video, will not work unless connected to the same network. I found that messing around a few times with my vpn settings actually fixed this. There is a way to record the playback video in the app anyway so that isn't too much of an issue.

I thought that I should also mention that a vpn needs to be switched off or paused when first setting up the camera. After the camera is set up then the vpn can be activated again and the camera works very well.

Tapo C120
As I liked the C220 so much, I purchased a waterproof camera for outside too.

The C120 is very flexible, providing you have power nearby. I prefer solar powered cameras, with long battery life, but this camera is very good.

I have the camera placed up against a window at the moment, for testing, but it is best to have it set up properly, with no restrictions. Night vision cannot be used through windows. (Use day mode and motion sensor lights). Night vision is very good.

The motion sensitivity of this camera is amazing.

Image quality is similar to the C220. People further away may be blurry or may not be able to be recognised and zooming in with the application doesn't really help. If you have a large area to cover then you might want to look for a better camera. 4k or something.

The sound is good when set up correctly. I have to change it to compatibility mode for it to work at it's best. Loud and clear, when talking through the app to the camera. The microphone is very sensitive on the camera and it can pick up sound from a fair distance.

It is really nice to be able to see and control both cameras in the same application.

Support get back to you fairly quickly and are very helpful.

Night Vision:Not that great so we keep a light on.
Video Quality:Excellent

So rather than try to sell it I decided to just mount it near a window. The microphone and talk functions aren't really needed as we can hear if someone comes. The video quality is excellent. reviews.author: Stolenlights

reviews.body:
Purchased to replace a prior tapo indoor camera that died after 5 years.

This item is a huge leap forward in tech, compared to the previous version.

Not too big, easy to install. Plug in, use your phone to locate device, and then configure. All very smooth, no issues or complexity. Will also be registered by Alexa.

Software is intuitive, assuming you have used a tapo previously, with very few differences compared with prior version.

The recording sensitivity can be adjusted. Plenty of additional configuration available.

The camera will rotate to track motion. You will hear the motor, but it is fairly quiet. If you install an SD card, will record to local as.

Or you can pay for online storage.

Playback software very simple to use.

Recording quality excellent.

You can also view the footage remotely, assuming you have a data plan in your phone.

Will see how long the device lasts. Manufacturer does advise that use of tracking will impact the lifetime of the motor , hardly a surprise.

So far, so good.

This really is a very good security camera for the money. Having the option to turn off night vision is a big benefit when the camera is set up to monitor outside through a window and there is sufficient illumination from other sources like a street light for example. The detection features are numerous and you can easily create your own customized zones. Recordings are saved to an SD card (not supplied) or you can pay for online subscription recordings. The Tapo App is definitely one of the better App's for interacting with the camera and so far No advertisements.

reviews.body: I bought this camera so I could keep an eye on our two cats while we went on holiday to Spain and I'm so glad we did. We have cameras in other rooms from other brands but none of them even close in comparison to the TP Link Tapo cam. We have our lights through Tapo so we were familiar with this brand and it was incredibly easy to set it. The full rotation and height adjustment is the reason we chose this one as the cats like to move around the room and it can be hard to get good coverage from stationary cams. The price as well for the quality is amazing! We will be buying more of the TP-link Tapo cameras to replace the other cameras around the house for sure.
reviews.title: Great quality camera for pet watch
reviews.author: Anna7

reviews.body:
Blimey, things have certainly advanced over the years!

Connecting an remote network camera used to be the domain of real coding wizards with having to open router ports etc to allow the remote access to function - but not any more with the Tapo Pan and Tilt Wifi camera.

Installation is really simple and easy - install the Tapo app onto your phone, set up an account and select your camera model. Plug the camera into the supplied power adapter and select it from the app (temporarily using the camera's broadcast Wifi network). Installation done!

The camera can be accessed from the app, remotely moved 360 degrees horizontally and moved up and down within a limited range (114 degrees), the image quality is excellent - I'm a photographer and have used all sorts of cameras over the years, but the Tado 2K QHD produces some really nice footage - you can certainly read car number plates and clearly see faces with no issue at all.
Zooming on the 220 model is digital, but still very good quality and far better than expected.
The night vision is ok but I set the infrared emitters to be off in the app, as they reflect really badly from the internal glass window behind which I've positioned my camera. The night video is still fine but at a slower frame rate than the stock 15FPS during the day. (this FPS can be increased with the app - but remember that higher FPS will result in your home broadband slowing down as the camera uploads the footage at a higher framerate/larger file size every time something triggers it to record)

Really good camera, the price is amazing and the connectivity is spot on. Absolutely worth every penny and wholeheartedly recommend this product.

name: Tapo D230S1 Smart Video Doorbell
bestFor: 2K 5MP battery video doorbell with hub and color night vision

reviews.body:
Bought the Tapo D230S1 in late December 2025. After 40 days of normal use, the battery dropped to 20% despite low wake-up sensitivity (3-4), tightened activity zones, and vehicle/pet/package detection turned off. Advertised 180 days is misleading—real-world drain is much faster, requiring frequent recharges that leave the camera offline.
Live view lags 2–5 seconds every time—not real-time as claimed.
Activity zones and detection toggles make zero difference—no reduction in alerts or events regardless of settings. Wake-up adjustments are useless here.
Contacted TP-Link support: they apologized for an insulting “was it dropped?” question but offered no real fix, just repeated requests for screenshots I can’t provide post-recharge and blamed “usage patterns” despite my optimizations.
Solid hardware when it works, but the battery, lag, and ineffective zones make it unreliable for the price. Very disappointed—would not recommend.

Reolink is fast becoming a great part of the video ssurveillance market and particularly for those who use the Smart Home platform Home Assistant!

The battery perforance is quite poor! My Tuya Video door bell would go 5 or 6 months between charges, the reolink lasted only a month! Otherwise, this is a great Smart doorbell, fisheye lens takes getting used to but being able to see both packages and faces in one setup is great! :-)

Great device. Better picture that the Google Nest doorbell it was replacing. It does not sound the mechanical chime like the one that it was replacing, but it comes with a wireless chime that you can put anywhere. It was a drop-in replacement for me.
