reviews.author: DC246

reviews.body:
I’ve had various Swann systems over many years. While I’ve been initially impressed with some of them, a recurring issue has been their ability to establish and/or maintain a stable wireless connection. Unfortunately, after a few days of being delighted and very impressed, my new Max Ranger system has reverted to Swann form.

The initial set up went relatively well, and my 72 hours of testing at various locations was very impressive. Excellent to medium signal levels and solid high quality video from all parts of my property - something no other wireless video system has ever been capable of. Given the 900Mhz signal, I was hoping that would be the case, and the system initially exceeded my expectations. A few days later, I mounted the cameras in very sunny locations with strong signals and tested again. Excellent to good signal, excellent video and detection at the beginning. I have some quibbles about the detection sensitivity of the cameras and their PIR sensors, but that’s trivial at the moment.

Unfortunately, less than 18 hours after mounting, the links between the base and the cameras deteriorated to the point where neither of the cameras would connect manually, and no detections. Nothing had changed in the interior environment, and the cameras had been mostly outside for the previous 3 days already. Carrying the base out to under the cameras resulted (finally) in detections, but showed fewer bars than the interior remote installation 100 feet away had previously. Both cameras show well over 95% battery, so it’s not a power issue.

I have no idea why Swann WiFi and now dedicated 900Mhz link cameras cannot seem to maintain a strong, stable RF connection. I have had four generations of Swann wireless WiFi, and this has been true since the second generation. (The first generation cameras were impressive for their day, and the last stable ones Swann has ever produced). Others also have some issues, but none are as consistently unstable and unreliable as Swann.

Given previous experience with Swann’s customer service, I don’t expect any resolution. I’ll be happy to update, if I’m wrong. I expect that I’ll be doing what I’ve had to do with one of the previous three systems I’ve purchased, and send it back.
reviews.title: Disappointed, yet again
reviews.author: co.gringo

reviews.body:
Had the Maxranger only about a week. 2 camera's are in full sun. I can't use the 4th camera as I need 1 on charge at all times as the charge runs out daily. I'm busy charging and changing over the camera's everyday with the heat waves we have been having and 2 of the camera's in FULL SUN you would think that the camera's solar panels would be keeping full charge.

Please don't respond with things I can do is FULL SUN as the answer has been for everyone else who has said the cameras are in full sun.
Or take down the settings as they are needed to be high to do there job. I still don't like just how close you need to be to trigger camera's sensor's.
Sometimes the sensors go off when there is nothing there or so delayed what ever it was is gone. Other times the sensors do not pick up cars the same distance as it picks up other times.
Can not make out number plates.
Can see down the street but hard to make out what things are so not really long view.
Basically I sit as security watching the screen all night as our street has had a lot of incidents most nights (some nights multiple incidents) and if I fall asleep chance are the camera might miss the event as I did the other morning out the front of a neighbours house though I do not think the camera would have got a clear recording anyway if I had pressed record manually as it just does not reach that far 44 metres clearly.
if I am sitting watching I can press the recored button but I don't always find my full recording in "recordings" It's all very time consuming.
To set up the camera's and app I had to agree to a subscription. Yet to look into that as Swann advertises that you don't need to pay subscription fee's.
Need clear footage for the police.
reviews.title: Solar does not work

reviews.body: Got a lemon, tech support next to useless, not in AU. One camera of two works ok, the second camera is next to useless, slow reaction time, subject needs to be on top of the camera before it actually activates, if it activates. Not sure if it is the base unit or camera, but awaiting a warranty claim, and as the camera works intermittently, I foresee dramas, as the tech team couldn’t help, and only offered a warranty after I insisted, I think I will be going to consumer affairs, as the camera is clearly not able to do what it is supposed too. I have two cameras set up along a fence line, if people walk from one camera to the next it should record them walking along the track, but this has never happened. Yet the dodgy camera only records if you are on top of it, within a metre, or a bird sitting on the fence. Very disappointed in this purchase.
reviews.title: Buyer Beware read the warranty fine print. Reaction time very slow despite full battery full bars for camera wifi. Not sure if this base unit can actually record more than camera at a time, as it never has with the one I got.
reviews.author: Marienoz

reviews.body: Purchased these cameras about 6 weeks ago and was a bit dubious about their effectiveness. After using them, I can happily say I am greatly impressed. We have the two camera, one router system (will by more.add ons when finances allow) one of these cameras faces the sun all day and has 100% charge since 10 May, it is the 15 June now. The other camera is on the opposite side of the house completely covered by the roof with no direct sun at all and after the same time, sits at 50% charge. Picture quality is awesome and ease of playback is good too. It doesn't offer continuous recording, for obvious reasons (battery drain) but tec9rds any events with ease. If you want something that rec9rds continuously, then go for wired. If I could give more than 5 stars I would
reviews.title: Excellent system
reviews.author: BradRen

reviews.body:
Great system

Swann product I bought so far is great.Well packed, shipped intact and complete.Installing and integrating the system was simple.The quality of the components are solid.Included was everything including hardware for multiple installation .Putting the pieces together..it just felt machined and precisely made.The camera quality is superior to all my past cameras.Everything works as it should and has added security for my home.The app is great.I have had zero issues with the max rangers and whole heartedly recommend these to the world
reviews.title: Great so far
reviews.author: Adam 12

reviews.body: The solar panels are inefficient and you have to pull the cameras down and recharge them every two weeks and that is over summer. They will not charge on cloudy days so winter will be a nightmare, within six weeks senior light on one dies not work, sensitivity settings are inconsistent, one day everything is being recorded next day nothing. My experiences are reflective of other customers, so it’s not a faulty unit that I purchased. I have had other Swann products in the past that performed stay away from this model.
reviews.title: Very poor product stay away from this model.
reviews.author: Stig

reviews.body:
I was lucky enough to win a 2 camera Max Ranger system in a Swann promotion. I already have a Swann wired system which has been in operation for around 3.5 years. My existing system had several blind spots, so I took the opportunity to cover these areas with the new Max Ranger cameras. Not only were the new cameras super easy to install, but the vision is crisp, colour is amazing, and night vision is super impressive. As per instructions provided, I charged the units prior to installation, and the solar panels have taken over from this point with the cameras running without further charge since I installed them two weeks ago. The backup battery in the base unit is also a great feature, enabling the system to continue to operate in the event that power is cut.

As I have an existing system, I was pleasantly surprised at how seamlessly the Max Ranger units connect into the Swann Security App, with all cameras visible concurrently, across both systems. The lack of requirement to switch between systems is a great feature in my view.

As I’m on a suburban block, range is not really an issue for me, but I can certainly say I have had no issues with the Wi-Fi signal.

I did find aligning the camera brackets a little trickier than it was with my wired system due to the mechanism design, but once set, the camera brackets were solid and support the cameras well.

Overall though, a super impressive system. I’d definitely recommend.
reviews.title: Impressive!
reviews.author: RichardC

reviews.body:
Swann MaxRanger 4K.

I was recommended these cameras by a friend and ended up buying a pair.

I live on a 10-acre country property and wanted something that could have a long-range connectivity, as well as a clear sharp image. Well, these cameras don’t disappoint, I am amazed at the 4K resolution even at a 400m plus distance. I have one of them set up approx 250m down my driveway so as we can see who is coming onto our property in advance. The image is extremely sharp and the connection to the base station has full bars, the NVR base station also has a backup battery that will keep you connected for up to 5 hours, should your power go down. Another upside is that the solar panel is integrated in the unit with the camera, so, there is no problem with having to deal with 2 separate things. Apparently, the Lithium-ion battery in the cameras is made by Tesla and can withstand lower temperatures and hold their charge longer than the average WI-FI external security camera. Other quality features for these cameras are the quality Sony sensors, siren and spotlights, colour day and night vision and 2-way audio. The Swann MaxRanger 4K security cameras are a real game changer and I would highly recommend them for your security needs which are also ideal for average home, office, business and people with larger properties as its expandable up to 8 cameras. Well done Swann!!!!
reviews.title: Swann MazRanger 4K security cameras, amazing long range connectivity with high resolution!!!
reviews.author: Living the dream

reviews.body:
I was one of the recipients of the "Meet Max" drawing. The excitement was over the top and continues today as I'm getting excellent video from two areas around my house that has been lacking. Since I installed my Swann system several years ago my two side yards were left out. The reason being, the access to get the cable to the cameras is nasty. I was pumped to see the ad for the MaxRanger and it being a wifi camera system. It sounded exactly like the answer to the side yards.

When the camera system arrived a couple weeks ago I was really impressed how well it was packaged. I unboxed everything and setup the cameras for charging. Read the easy to understand instructions and got the hub powered and connected to my network and a TV for monitoring. I did find it funny, once I powered the hub it immediately connected to the two charging cameras so I looked at a bookcase for the night.

The next morning armed with my screwgun and a ladder I headed to the two locations I had picked out for the install. Both had good security coverage and ample sunlight for changing. The hub/cameras were configured on Swann Security before I went out the door. The mounting brackets were simple to screw into my fascia board, cameras clinked right in, a little adjustment and they were done! They have worked flawlessly since I put them up.

I'm still working on the right adjustments for monitoring but have been totally pleased with the system. Now I'm exploring what other locations around the house that work for a couple more of these great cameras. Ample sunshine in my biggest problem in the front of the house (northside). Rumors of some rain gutter clips may be the answer.

The Five Star rating is a 100%, in my opinion!
reviews.title: MaxRanger4K Solar Surprise
reviews.author: Skysho

reviews.body:
Having recently moved into a multi-storey townhouse, I had to consider options for security and CCTV coverage. The building is mostly concrete, leaving no option for a hard-wired system, and camera location would make it difficult to continually remove for charging.

I reviewed the various options on the market and was pointed towards Swann camera systems. Being an Australian company and producing a wide range of products, it was an easy decision to build my system around their selection of cameras.

I received their new dual camera Max Ranger 4K kit. The cameras have an integrated solar panel to charge while in use. The kit contains a hub which has onboard 64GB of memory and is expandable via a USB port. The hub provides extended range on the cameras, which is rated out to 600m unobstructed and 200m obstructed. I found this capability handy to provide a consistent connection through concrete walls.

Connection was simple with the cameras preconfigured to the hub, so plug and play. The hub needs to be connected to a monitor to configure your Internet connection; hopefully, in the future, this can be done directly by phone or tablet, but it is not an issue. Having now used the cameras for a couple of weeks, I like the quality of the 4K images and configuration in the app.

Ensure that the cameras receive a few hours of sunlight per day to maintain the charge and minimize high traffic areas to reduce the drain on the batteries.
reviews.title: Swann are staying ahead of the game and providing real-world solutions.
reviews.author: ChrisB123

reviews.body: Works well long range. Wish it did continuous recording. Slow to respond and misses some movement. great resolution and 60 sec clips are nice. Have to add external solar panel to charge. One with built in battery is better for many cloudy days.
reviews.title: Works well long range. Wish it did conti...
reviews.author: apcstore

reviews.body: Great cameras, do a great job, get good high def pics. Only criticism would be that no one seems to sell the hub by itself - hub was damaged in house fire but cameras all intact, but had to buy 2 more with hub. Not a bad thing as now we are covering more aspects of the property, just a nuisance to have to buy more when they weren't needed. Love that they're solar powered, no cables to run.
reviews.title: Mount cameras and you're away laughing

reviews.body:
The good

* Quality of Camera's is fantastic, just make sure to invest in the correct 4k Monitor.
* The range isn't a joke, I am double brick and they have absolutely full signal outside of my house and in my backyard which needs to wrestle with multiple walls, so I am impressed with that.
* The features such as the Spotlights, Siren are good touches, I like that the camera's seem to flash red and blue during the day too, not sure if that's a deterrent feature but still good.

Now the bad

*The Solarpanels are not good, You need direct and I mean DIRECT sunlight, I would be lucky to get half an hour of charge a day from the sun and they are positioned in what I'd consider good spots, above where my house solar panels are. I've noticed they don't feel like solar panels on top, like made of some sort of Polymer? Maybe its not as good quality as actual solar.
* Battery life leaves to be desired, I am on a busy road, and I do get a lot of notifications, I fully suspected it would be the case that it would cause the battery to drain a little faster, but I am getting at best a week before I take them down, charge them, Disappointing to say the least, the average response of turn down the sensitivity defeats the purpose of having the camera's I want them to be able to cast at least 10 metres from my property and being on a main street shows this aren't the correct set up for myself.

Overall, the features they went hard in such as camera quality and camera features are fantastic, but they've cheaped out on the Solar feature, and on the battery life, two parts that I expected to be far better.

Overall, they're good, but they need more R&D in battery life if they aren't going to invest in harder solar energy. I've noticed that I'm not the only one that agrees the Solar is average.
reviews.title: Its has potential but needs work
reviews.author: Fouquesy

reviews.body: I live in the 3rd floor of an apartment building with a garage on the ground floor. I was looking for some cameras to monitor the garage and most wi-fi cameras wouldn't work as I couldn't pick up my network from the garage. Took a gamble on these as they seemed to be the only reasonably priced long range cameras on the market and I'm happy to say they worked out quite well for me! The one downside is that the live playback isn't always perfect and can freeze for a few seconds, but it works well most of the time. Admittedly, the main reason I got these cameras was to be able to check if I left my garage door open or if I accidently hit the clicker from my apartment (yes it does open from up there). Never had any issues connecting to the cameras and steady live playback isn't strictly necessary for checking on the garage or downloading playback from an incident, so I'm happy! Had these cameras a few weeks now and battery charge is still showing full, but that's to be expected considering the cameras turn on only a few times a day when I go in the garage or check on them.
reviews.title: Works well when wi-fi cameras won't cut it
reviews.author: jt55

reviews.body: Installed these cameras facing the street in both directions to catch cars driving past the house. The quality is not good enough to make out the driver or the car license plate. After 30 days had to take down the cameras to recharge the battery because the solar panel wasn’t enough to keep the cameras working.
reviews.author: HaroldY

reviews.body:
I’ve installed a 2 camera system on a house in rural NSW and found the cameras to be ideal.

Having the cameras powered by solar removes the need for costly electrical work to be done, or the need for placing the cameras in less than ideal spots. One camera has been placed on a non powered machinery shed and for the first time the location is now secure from unwanted nighttime visitors.

The ability to run the system with out without internet is also a plus. The NVR can easily be hidden away for more secure recording without the need for a TV or display all the time. With the low data requirements of the NVR to the Swann app when connected to to the internet, it also makes it ideal for connection, via a wifi extender, to a 4 or 5G wifi dongle with a low cost data plan.

These cameras are now providing security for a rural property and have already proved their usefulness.
reviews.title: A great system, ideal for rural and remote locations.
reviews.author: Scott_T

reviews.body: Easy to install and set up. Solar battery works great. Longer range than any other system I have had. The only thing that I dont like is that it takes a minute or so for it to upload the camera's display on the phone app every single time.
reviews.title: Better than most.
reviews.author: Jack

reviews.body: Good system, shame the ring tones are quite out of date given what you can get now, but the range/reach is good, the sound levels easy to adjust and works really well for our needs.
reviews.title: Wireless foorbell
reviews.author: Angie R

reviews.body: I am disappointed in the inability of the solar/charging system's ability to remain charged if there is cloudy days or if there is any shade encountered during the day. This is more so in the winter with shorter days. The alarm and voice volume is poor and overall I expected these cameras to perform better
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.author: Geoff

reviews.body: Works well for what it does, Solar powered is a plus. However if you are looking for a system that provides continuous live feed, you may want to look elsewhere. Swann is not very forthcoming on this information. Discovered this bit of information using Google, as the user guide did not provide it.
reviews.title: Does not provide continuous live video feed.
reviews.author: mpmaloy54

reviews.body: Great piece of kit, easy to set up, excellent images, the only reason I gave a four is I had to return the hub which failed. Customer service was really helpful and I have now received a replacement which works perfectly.
reviews.title: MaxRanger4K™ Solar 2 Camera Security System
reviews.author: IceCreamMan

reviews.body:
few teething issues with making sure the cameras get enough sunlight. the lower the power the poorer the quality i find. and wi fi dropping out. this i found comes back to how chargred the cameras are night is worse than day if battery is low.

using a solar pannel fixs these issue.

all in all well worth every cent.

you carnt put a price on peace of mind.
reviews.title: Swann 4k solar powered security cameras
reviews.author: Greg

reviews.body: The solar charging doesn't suffice unless the camera is exposed to sun all day long, If it's not then it needs charging every 4 weeks with moderate usage. The app is a joke, it takes forever to connect to live feed often timing out. Eufy's interface is much better going by my neighbor's setup, hope their solar charging is also better as they say 2 hr sun is enough to get through, where as Swann doesn't mention it. Clearly disappointed.
reviews.title: Not worth the hype
reviews.author: AndrewSV

reviews.body: Good camera however for the price there are some downfalls, the antenna doesn’t feel well fixed in place and is easily moveable… don’t think it is true 4K, maybe more like 2K. Other than that the motion alerts are on point and it is fast activating. Quality of the camera images and video could be more refined along with the mounting and antenna.
reviews.title: 4 Star Camera setup
reviews.author: Jake33

reviews.body: Incredibly complicated to set up, with TV connections with a mouse, then modem connections. The quoted range is completely false. Direct line of sight of just over 100 metres before the range dropped out. The other cameras are working fine but expected more.
reviews.title: Not great for the money.
reviews.author: James JB

reviews.body: terrible representatives. instantly returning cause they won’t reset my pw on the phone while I’m talking to them asking them to. no it’s not connected to a TV or monitor cause the cable length you give me makes me plug it into a stupid spot.
reviews.title: not good
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.body: do not buy this product. It’s advertised as solar. The solar is absolutely useless. I have to recharge at least once a week. When I called customer service they told me I needed to change my settings, notification settings, absolute waste of money do not buy.
reviews.title: Solar function is useless do not buy
reviews.author: Alan

reviews.body: These were an impulsive purchase. One I'm so glad to have made. The image is crisp and tgey were easy to install.
reviews.title: Great buy
reviews.author: SSmith

description: Rechargeable & Easy Wire-Free cameras with rechargeable batteries make installation easy 4K Ultra HD State-of-the-art video to see faces, license plates, close ups & more Prevent Crime Controllable spotlights & sirens help deter intruders True Detect Heat & motion-sensing for more reliable alerts Night2. Day Color Night Vision Powerful color night vision up to 65ft / 20m with the spotlight Always charged, always secure. The All. Secure650 4K Wireless Security Kit has three 100% wire-free cameras you can set up in minutes. The cameras feature long-lasting rechargeable batteries, spotlights, sirens, 2-way talk and more, all controllable through the Swann Security app. There's also a spare battery that charges in the Power Hub for easy swapping with no downtime and provides backup power to the Hub. Its security made smarter and fee free.

name: Assure Lock SL Key-Free Deadbolt
bestFor: Keyless touchscreen deadbolt compatible with Z-Wave & HomeKit
description: Lose Your Keys. For Good. Introducing the slimmest electronic lock for your home; the Assure Lock SL. This sleek and modern touchscreen deadbolt allows homeowners to enjoy the convenience of 100% key free unlocking while enhancing curb appeal. Unlock your home without the hassle of keys by entering your 4-8 digit entry code on the keypad. Lock the door behind you by simply tapping the keypad.

bestFor: Retrofit deadbolt lock that keeps your existing exterior door keys

specifications.name: Included Hardware
specifications.value: Mounting hardware, DoorSense™ sensor, Lock adapter

reviews.body:
I’ve had August since their inception, one of each generation. The Gen 3 failed after about 5 years. I wish I’d realized the roughness in the turning was a flaw and gotten it replaced during the warranty period. When it failed (got so crunchy it wouldn’t turn) I replaced it with the only thing August offers and that’s this WiFi unit. I’ve since learned it’s a downgrade in many dimensions. First the good.

- It’s smaller and lighter. This new size feels so much closer to an unobtrusive size.

- it uses the same app, so I didn’t have to create any new account or home config.

- In most ways, it operates like the Gen 3 (Auto lock, Auto Unlock, …)

- Action is smooth and reliable.

Now the bad

- When it arrived, it was stuck in a position that the proper adapter wouldn’t mount. Support incorrectly guided me to use the wrong adapter, which sort of worked, but also caused problems later. I was ultimately able to get it to work after hours of troubleshooting and switching to the correct adapter.

- Although the door proximity sensor is supposed to be compatible with the previous generation, the lock is much less sensitive and although we had the sensor installed into the door, we had to have another one installed below the latch in order to function. It took support over half an hour to figure out this discrepancy.

- This lock drops support for ZWave, so this lock no longer integrates with our security system.

- The lock adds WiFi, which is nice in theory, but the feature uses a lot of battery, which is also a very precious resource.

- the Bluetooth range is dramatically reduced. The Gen 3 would work in most places in the house (15-20m). This new unit barely has 3-4m of range. Support indicates that the HomeKit hub needs to be within 10 feet (3m). It’s not very useful to have a bridge if you can’t place the speaker or Apple TV in a useful location in the home.

- The battery capacity is about half. Support says the batteries should last 2-3 months, but with WiFi enabled, the batteries were drained in 47 days.

- When the batteries failed, they failed without warning and left the lock jammed in an immovable position (open). Thankfully, I was home. Replacing the batteries cost $16. At this rate, I’ll pay more for batteries than the list price of the lock before the warranty expires. I’ve disabled WiFi to conserve battery.

- There’s no way to monitor the battery health from the app. Support has access to telemetry, which does track the battery health over time, but be prepared for them to blame you for not using it correctly if you call.

If they made the Gen 3, I’d just buy another one of those. This Gen 4 is riddled with problems and a real disappointment.
reviews.title: A significant downgrade from the Gen 3
reviews.author: jaraco

reviews.body:
I have this lock working on my front door, and it's been pretty solid for a number of years. Works fine through the August app, whether using bluetooth, cell, or wi-fi connection. Apple Home is usually unable to see it. Home Assistant works pretty good - about a 1-second delay in responses to commands. Unfortunately, this model predates Apple's Home Key.

Installation was easy - if you can work a screwdriver and read, it's straightforward.

Only real issue is the low battery notices. We don't really use our front door often, but we start getting daily low-battery emails over a month befre I would consider it "low." For example, I've been getting alerts every day for 21-days, and the Home Assistant integration says the battery level (an estimate, I know) is at 46%! Settings are already pretty sparse. Nothing about when to start sending alerts.
reviews.title: Pretty Decent, but low battery warning...
reviews.author: NotABot3285

reviews.body:
I’ve been using August smart locks for years and have recommended them to family members, but this experience completely changed my opinion.

Our August Wi-Fi Smart Lock unlocked itself in the middle of the night multiple times without logging the event. That is a serious safety issue. We discovered the lock unlocked in the morning while the app still showed it as locked.

I reported the problem within the return window. What followed was weeks of back-and-forth with customer support. I was repeatedly asked for photos, logs, resets, and confirmations, often by different agents, while the lock continued to malfunction. The process dragged on long enough that I was eventually told I was outside the return period, even though the issue had been reported on time.

August eventually agreed to a refund, but only after significant effort and after requiring me to pay out of pocket to ship back a defective product. Paying return shipping for a safety-related defect was extremely disappointing.

A smart lock that unlocks itself without logging is unacceptable. Based on both the product failure and the customer service experience, I cannot recommend this lock.
reviews.title: Unlocked Itself Overnight Without Logging and Support Was Extremely Frustrating
reviews.author: George

reviews.body:
I’ve been an August customer for years and have recommended their locks to multiple family members. This experience completely destroyed my trust in the brand.

Our August Wi-Fi Smart Lock unlocked itself in the middle of the night multiple times without logging the event. That alone is a serious safety issue. I reported the problem within the return window.

What followed was weeks of frustrating back-and-forth with support. I was repeatedly asked for photos, logs, resets, and confirmations, often by different agents, while the lock continued to malfunction. The process dragged on until I was told I was outside the return period, even though the issue had been reported on time.

Eventually they agreed to a refund, but only after I paid out of pocket to ship back a clearly defective product. I spent about $25 just to get my money back.

A smart lock that unlocks itself without logging is unacceptable. A company that responds to a safety issue with delays, policy excuses, and no accountability is worse. I cannot recommend August based on this experience.
reviews.title: Unlocked Itself Overnight and Support Was a Nightmare
reviews.author: Greg Jones

reviews.body:
The lock installation went smoothly. The August software works well and integrates with Apple HomeKit. I ended up deleting the recommended Yale software as it wasn't needed.

For the most part the lock works very well. There was one time that I came home and the auto unlock feature kicked in (as it should). But the whole lock fell off my door. If I hadn't had my physical key handy, I would have been locked out of my house! That was an isolated incident caused, probably, by the clamps built in to the lock being a bit too loose.
reviews.title: Works great but for one thing
reviews.author: Happy Homekit Guy

reviews.body: All the functionalities and perks are great. Had this lock for 4 years now. The huge downside is the battery. In 4 years, I have spent over 200$ on batteries. The lock is worth almost the same. And it works on CR123A photo batteries which are not cheap. About 10$ a pair for a good quality ones. In the winter months the battery life is very short and the lock struggles to close the latch all the way… After all this battery issues I recently decided to change to another lock (not August) that has a rechargeable battery and lasts 3 months before I have to recharge it with a USB C cable. Why can’t August do the same?!
reviews.title: Battery eating lock
reviews.author: alexmania1989

reviews.body: This lock is super easy to install, youtube video under 5 minutes, no drilling. You can open/close from anywhere with internet. The battery life is not very good and brand name batteries are outrageous, buy online at a fraction of the price. Great for emergencies and if you have anyone that you are concerned about that you may need to check on. An added bonus is since you are not changing the lock set this unit can be installed over the deadbolt that is in place thus an apartment superintendent can still use the master key.
reviews.title: Very Covenant
reviews.author: Easyentry

reviews.body:
We’ve been using August locks for a few years now and just love them. From having the door automatically open when we get home, to automatically locking when we forget, to opening when we forget our keys (but of course bring our cellphones), these locks have been great.

My only gripe is that battery drains quick without a bridge/connect, an additional piece of equipment that occasionally loses connection. Also the customer service is really really good, they care and always go above and beyond.
reviews.title: Amazing product. Perfect for the forgetful.
reviews.author: Adrian

reviews.body:
I’ve had this lock for a few years now, and really enjoy overall. Overtime, I’ve changed how I use it though. The “Auto Unlock” feature when you get home seems nifty, but you need to give unlimited access to your location which I don’t love and stopped using. Also, Wifi function is cool, but cuts the battery life down to 3 months. I only use the Bluetooth feature now, and battery can last 9-12 months. I’ve paired it with the Number Pad, which I use most days and easier to give to friends/family. I find most people not interested in downloading an app to open my door, so a code is nice. Now don’t have to hand out as many keys.

I ended up buying a few for family members so now I can unlock their doors with the app.

It would be better with a rechargeable battery or more standard size. That’s the only issue
reviews.title: Great Smart Lock
reviews.author: CJMW

reviews.body:
I've had the lock installed for close to two years, and it works very well, and integrated flawlessly with Alexa for voice commands and routines.

My favourite feature is the auto-unlock. The lock opens when I'm walking up to the door. I don't use the auto-lock feature, however it is available.

The lock installs on the inside of the door, and is 'renter friendly'. I needed only a screwdriver and an extra pair of hands.

I purchased rechargeable batteries, and the app alerts when batteries need to be changed. My lock is on the exterior door of an unheated entryway, in Canada, and rhe lock worked well for the past two winters, (with more frequent battery changes).

I have given custom entry permission to family and a pet sitter. The pet sitter is scheduled to be allowed entry on certain dates during certain times. My son is always allowed entry.
reviews.title: 2 Years Solid Service
reviews.author: DownWithTrees

reviews.body: I bought this very expensive lock for an airBnB situation and it worked at 1st but it quickly drained the batteries. I had to change my wifi password and now it will no longer will hook up on the wifi....after calling in to support they say it only supports 2.4Ghz. My internet has 2.4Ghz, along with the other, newer frequencies, and the app (on my android phone) sees my wifi and lets me step through the entire process until sending info to lock...then it gets an unknown error. Call in support at August was useless!! Hard to understand...had a really thick accent. They said to take it up with my phone manufacturer or internet provider.....wasted $300
reviews.title: Seemed ok at 1st
reviews.author: terrible support

reviews.body:
I have been running this lock for the past year. It’s by far the worst August product I’ve owned. The battery lasts 2-3 weeks at most. Support says this is because the WiFi bridge is integrated into the unit, rather than being external with previous generations. Regardless of the reason, it dies constantly and takes a non-standard battery that needs to be special ordered.

The other night we were sitting in our living room and the lock suddenly opened by itself. There was a purple light flashing on it. Support has dodged the question on why this happened. I’m worried someone might have hacked my account. If I can’t trust my doors to stay locked, then what the heck is a lock good for?

I’ve tried to get support to address both the battery life and random unlocking issues several times over the past year. They always dodge the questions and fail to provide useful advice.

DO YOURSELF A FAVOR: DON’T BUY THIS LOCK

I have two Gen 2 August locks that work great. This Gen 4 is a terrible design. If you value battery life and having your doors stay locked: buy one of them instead!
reviews.title: Terrible battery life and lackluster support
reviews.author: Sfpaul

reviews.body: I had the earlier generations of august lock which were great battery life was 8 months long or longer on AA. When you approached your door it would unlock quickly. I purchased the 4th gen wifi lock thinking it would be the same but better. Smaller size and better tech. 6 years since my first one . Was I wrong. First you have to get these special lithium battery Cr123a that can cost up to 20 bucks for two. The kicker is that you need to replace them every two months of light use. Spoke with August and they said that’s the expected life with this lock. I’m shocked. Spend your $300 and now every two months spend another $20 for quality lithium battery. This info was not on the Best Buy site or on the box when I purchased it. No all of a sudden because of all the complaints it is now on the august site that batteries only last two months. If you want the battery to last longer tech support suggests you spend another $100 to get some August wifi connect device . This allows you to disable the wifi on the lock and use only the Bluetooth to connect to the wifi. This tells me that august made a faulty device and is now trying to cover up their issue. Thing is we have to pay more for to use the lock like it should have been decided like in the first place. Look at something else because this lock will just end up costing you more and more money. Very disappointed.
reviews.title: Regret spending money on this
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.body: Connects with the router okay, but will not unlock with the App the way it's described. When I command it to unlock, it just keep showing it's connecting until it eventually will wear the battery down if you allow it to hang up for hours. I reset it over a half dozen times and thoroughly went over the installation instruction again. Same result, just hangs up and wears the battery down. Try something else out there. This should not be that hard.
reviews.author: HomeDepotCustomer

reviews.body: This is an excellent product. Well made. Easy to install. Phone support was excellent. Bought with set of rechargeable CR123A batteries. One piece of missing information I wish I had known (presumably applicable to all smart locks) is that if your door fits tightly against the door jamb as many do, requiring light pressure against the door to fully engage the deadbolt, you will have to move the strike plate so that no pressure needs to be applied to allow the deadbolt to move to fully locked position. Otherwise the smart lock will not work. Two problems with that: (1) making that change will compromise your air seal; (2) it is extremely difficult to make a sight move of the strike plate due to the existing holes and needed new holes being so closely aligned. With a high security strike plate like mine with four 3+ inch screws secured to the stud you might need to replace the door frame or even the stud to which it is mounted to avoid compromising security. I chose to keep my existing deadbolt and return the smart lock.
reviews.title: Will not work if door tight against jamb
reviews.author: Mortimer 59

reviews.body:
Took awhile to have it installed because the screws on my door bolt were too short. Took me a long time to find the right screws. I wish the screws are included in the package, they are cheap but hard to find. They do sell them on their website but shipping charge is 10 times the cost of a screw. Home hardware stores around my home don’t carry the 60mm, maximum length they carry is 50, I finally found some on Amazon but have to buy a pack of 5!

Installation instructions do not direct you to setup the WiFi connection, you have to go to the settings to set it up otherwise it only works with Bluetooth. It also doesn’t mention anything about installing door sense part, you also need to go to the settings after you installed the lock. I almost returned it because I had to research the information on every step and attempted the installation about 4 times (mostly because of the screws). I’d give a 5 rating if 2 screws (cost $1.50 @) were included.

Once you get everything installed. It works great and very useful.
reviews.title: Works great once installed successfully.
reviews.author: Elisa

reviews.body: Nice lock, works with cellphone. Basically it turns your standard key on the inside of the door but the front of the door looks unchanged and you can continue to use your standard key if needed. You don’t have to change your existing lock or cut your door. Drawback in cold climates the batteries tend to go flat quickly although this hasn’t been a problem for us. You can share access via cellphone, although it did not work with foreign phone. Technophobes don’t do real well with the sharing they have to get the app.
reviews.title: Nice solution not too complicated
reviews.author: Chrisalbany

reviews.body: If you don’t have one of these, you need to invest… It never fails… Unlocks right when you walk up to it… It’s so easy to send people a keypad code if they need to get in your house. Tells you who’s bc coming and going! If your hands are full of groceries, you don’t have to worry about getting your keys out and unlocking the door. Plus it locks automatically if you set it up to do so after three minutes… So I just leave the house without worrying about locking it. I love it so much.
reviews.title: This whole system is the best
reviews.author: Aokf17

reviews.body: Works well and I would say the only two issues are with the auto door unlock. It's a great feature and it syncs to your telephone so when you come back home your door will unlock. The issue is, if you have a front door and a back door and you generally come in the back door and you have the lock on your front door, it will unlock even though you don't want it to. Another thing, if you just go out for a walk around the block it may not unlock the door because you have not gone far enough away from the house. But overall, it's worth the price
reviews.title: Works great
reviews.author: SlimPD

reviews.body:
I bought this 2.5-3 years ago. Simply put it’s exactly what a promises. I used it on my second to last apartment when I got it, but when I moved into my previous apartment, it already had smart locks. I kept this in a box along with a couple of batteries and now that I’m in a townhouse, it’s back working perfect as the day I got it. Just make sure that you have a lock that works. I would say probably about 70% of you do. I also have the keypad additional accessory and stuff, but I haven’t really utilized that. works well don’t get me wrong but the smart lock works perfectly with Google home and it senses when I get back in my driveway and unlocked so I don’t have to usually ever even open the app.

* Also since I’m kind of forgetful sometimes the autolock feature is fantastic. It’ll lock your door, even if you forget to and for those who have kids or disabilities it’s a cylindrical round lockimg mechanism so even manually twisting it which is really neat, that it’s just a circular motion of turning the thing, in a will unlock your door for those with disabilities like hand issues might enjoy having this bigger knob.
reviews.title: Enjoy this luxury and with no subscription! thanks
reviews.author: JP1111

reviews.body: Every 3-4 weeks I get notified my August Smart Lock batteries need to be replaced, despite the fact it’s installed on a door literally 20 ft away from my wifi router and it hasn’t been electronically locked or unlocked since the last battery change. Too much of a hassle and costly to keep replacing the batteries. The lock was expensive so I put up with it for 2 years, but I’m done.
reviews.title: Batteries Drain Way Too Fast
reviews.author: jmchob

reviews.body: [Employee of august] You have a pretty fancy door that’s got multiple pins that go into the door frame and it’s not like a normal door… but around the house, we have battery powered Yale locks that work fine. This door however, needed to look the same, not different so we left the exterior key install this deadbolt, only actuator, loaded the app, connected the bridge, and it’s been flawless ever since….
reviews.title: All I wanted was a wireless deadbolt…
reviews.author: therealminamu

reviews.body: [Employee of august] The August Wi-Fi Smart Lock is simple, nearly perfect, and very convenient for remote access and smart home use. It’s sleek, easy to install, and works with major voice assistants. Battery life could be better, and the app’s UI could be more futuristic with added features, leaving room for improvement.
reviews.title: Great
reviews.author: Satwinder

reviews.body:
I have been using four 1st generation August Smart Locks for about 10 years and they continue to perform exceptionally well. I use these locks in three different houses. These locks easily allow me to add and remove access for guests while I am remote. I am sure the latest models match the performance as the original with functional and physical improvements like reduced size. I highly recommend this product and I am sure I will update my locks at some point.

I also have four August Wi-Fi Bridge Connects. I am not as impressed with these units. When they work they do a fantastic job but the often loose signal, disconnect, and I have to periodically reset them. All of them are located in close proximity of a Wi-Fi signal and the door lock so I don't understand why their performance fluctuates so much. I still highly endorse the August Locks so don't let my comments about the August Connect deter you from considering the lock. My 5 star rating is for the August Lock.
reviews.title: Excellent Smart Locks
reviews.author: JoMar

reviews.body:
I started buying August locks probably 10 years ago. I’ve used them for my house, my Airbnb, my mother’s house, everywhere I can so I can avoid carrying a key on a ring. They have gotten better and better. This is my first August with built in WiFi-a huge improvement. My 83 year old mother, 99% of my Airbnb guests, and friends and family are able to operate them without incident.

I have used the app, key pads and WiFi bridges. My only criticism is the key pads go through batteries quickly.

The first photo is my new lock, the last photo is my original August lock and the middle one is a version in between.
reviews.title: My fourth new August Lock- keeps getting better

reviews.body:
Good lock and works well but battery life is ridiculously short even when not using the open/close function often.

Apparently this is a known problem for years and the company does not address it assuming they can.

Surprised the rating received is as good as shown but in my view they are better alternatives than this lock
reviews.title: Battery Life is terrible
reviews.author: KevinL

reviews.body: Love this lock until it quits working. I had gen 1 and it failed just over 2 years old (out of warranty, it was around 300.00 back then), bought a newer (smaller version built in bridge) guess what it failed 2 1/2 years they are saying bluetooth chip has a problem....so here we are a little over 5 years over 500.00 in 2 locks and no help from manufacturer other than saying sorry....going to go online research remote lock and find one that isn't associated with August and buy it. I really loved this lock but not for 500.00 every 5 years...i will research remote locks and buy one as soon as I validate they have no connection to the August lock. Really wish they stood behind their product, saying the bluetooth chip failed in it. I do i break that, mistreat or abuse it....
reviews.title: 2 locks 5 years both failed
reviews.author: Davejr423

reviews.body:
August smart lock poses a safety risk to me and family. I purchased my home one year ago which came with an August smart lock. Despite offering to provide proof of purchase and residency, August refuses to allow me to register the lock in my name. Therefore allowing anyone who has had previous access to our August lock able to unlock our home and come in without our consent or knowledge.

I contacted customer support, their fix was to “just remove the batteries”. Essentially making our smart home/lock non-operational.

They would not allow me to speak to anyone above an entry level position in order to get this resolved.

The company does not care about you or your families safety, which is unfortunate coming from a company that is supposedly selling, just that, safety.
reviews.title: Safety Risk
reviews.author: Concerned Home Owner

reviews.body: I bought this a few months ago when we were getting ready to have company and needed to share a house key. It has turned out to be the best purchase I ever made! It has made sharing house keys with anyone that I need to share a key with super easy. It is easy to use because it works with my phone app and I can make sure my door is locked even when away from home. I especially love that it automatically locks after a certain length of time so that when people are coming and going, I never have to worry about them leaving the door unlocked. Highly recommended!

reviews.body: Well it says in the instructions 5 min if you're familiar with the lock & 10 min if you're not but lol OMG as it turns out that's far from accurate - it took hours to understand it all - the instructions weren't very clear at all so with the help of the 24/7 August tech phone support I was able to install it myself - it was quite stressful & frustrating at times but now that it's installed & I figured out how to use it w/the August phone support i love it!

description: Welcome home to an even smarter home. Upgrade your deadbolt with the all-new August Wi-Fi Smart Lock, a lock so smart, it simplifies your daily life and the way your family lives. And with built-in WiFi, our lock requires no additional bridge to connect. Together with the August app, it’s now even easier to securely control and manage your home. Remotely lock or unlock the door, check door status, grant virtual guest keys, and see who’s coming and going. Our smart lock is easy to install and attaches to your existing deadbolt on the inside of your door so you can keep your original keys.

reviews.body:

App is easy to use but only retains scheduled on/off if the app can continue to run in the background. The strip lights work with Echo Dot/Alexa, and this will save you buying a Bridge for $80 if you were looking to do more sophisticated automation like voice activation or bringing lights up incrementally every evening.

Having said this, I love the strip light and it looks beautiful lighting up my bookshelf.

The backing tape and adhesive are about 15 cm long, about 6 strips per metre. All sounds good so far? Try removing the backing tape without removing the adhesive strip, I spent 20 mins and was able to remove 5 or 6, I then gave up I decided to go put pins in my eyes to stop the boredom and frustration.

reviews.body:
The Phillips hue lightstrip are a great addition to any smart home setup. They are bright, colourful, easy to install and compatible with HomeKit.
Unfortunately, Phillips have recently upgraded their lightstrips to a new “Bluetooth compatible” version, which, while this is great on its own, the new design is not compatible with the original lightstrip extensions as they have adjusted the internal connection size.

name: Smart Dimmer Switch V2
bestFor: Wireless wall switch for controlling Hue lights without opening the phone app

reviews.body: My switch plate was uneven given where it's positioned, so the product didn't initially stay attached. I removed the plate and was able to adjust the screws holding the switches. Once leveled out, the product worked perfectly. A lot of the other options here are bulky or very obviously 3D printed/low quality. This option is excellent quality, looks OEM, and arrived within a few days of ordering. Money well spent!
reviews.author: Patrick

reviews.body:
Nothing much to say except I received two switches which had minor defects.

The first switch had an very small extra piece of plastic on the slot that covers the small battery, which made it easy to open up but impossible to close, as this piece of plastic would not fit into the small slot in the back. After spending nearly 45 mins of aligning up the cover and attempting to force it in, I decided to use a bit of sandpaper to smooth out this plastic nub to close up the battery cover.

The second switch had an issue with the 3M adhesive; my walls are pretty flat, and I've had no issues with mounting the rest of my hue switches, but I've noticed that on one of the hue switches the 3M adhesive didn't adhere well to the wall and kept falling off the wall. My solution for this was to just visit Landi and buy some 3M adhesive and apply it to the back of the dimmer switch as a fix.

Overall, the switches work well with Hue but the quality of these new models - compared to the previous generation - has fallen short of my expectations.
reviews.title: Works well, but quality has gone downhill!

reviews.body: I put these up and lived with them for about a week before reviewing. I have to say the design and finish on these are kind of poor for something that is being sold. Something simple like a bevel or chamfered edge. Or, just smooth out the 3D printed layer lines. Don't take folks money and send them something with unfinished surfaces. I hate to leave 2/5 stars but these will get replaced with a better quality option ASAP.
reviews.author: Kyle

reviews.body:
If you have the Philips Hue lights as your main lights in the room this is very useful accessory. Rather than having to go and find the app on your phone, this allows you to turn the lights on with one click.

Has three sections. One a simply on/off function. Second allows you to brighten/dim the lights. Third allows you to save 5 different settings that you can cycle through. In effect you can have 5 preset colour combinations that you can adjust via the App. Means you can change the mood in the room very easily without having to go into the app.

The switch sits in a casing with a magnetic feature, so you could attach this to the wall if you so wished. We haven't done that, as not sure about the aesthetic of it as a wall attached switch, but that's likely a personal style preference.

Feels well built in your hand, like they've really considered the 'look and feel' of it as a device, as well as functionally what is useful. We are very happy we bought it and would definitely buy again.
reviews.title: Makes the Hue lights easier to use
reviews.author: Owen

reviews.body: When I moved into my new apartment, I wanted to go for an 100% hue setup, but was disappointed to find that Hue didn't provide any easy way to replace the light switches you already have with hue switches. I was super excited to find a solution for this when I came across Jon's Etsy shop. These switch covers work exactly as described and look great too! Additionally, Jon provided excellent customer service and even helped me get my package replaced when it got lost in the mail. Highly recommend these switch covers!
reviews.author: Camden P.

reviews.body: If you've got Philips Hue, this makes controlling your lights much easier when you walk into a room. You can then carry the switch around with you as it fits to the backplate magnetically so can easily be removed or refitted. Easily configurable within the app for all sorts of scenes, brightnesses and now even to start times or go to sleep routines.
reviews.title: Great accessory for Philips Hue
reviews.author: thepieman

reviews.body: This is the 3rd of these switches we have bought which is a sign of how much we like them! Easy to use and install on phone. The fact you can take it off the base and walk it around the room with you is something we like for some rooms. Good value for money. Will probably buy more for more rooms!
reviews.title: 3rd one we've bought
reviews.author: KBR73

reviews.body: I bought this about a month ago, specifically to control my LifX smart lights via Apple Home app. It works pretty well - Apple Home does not support the full range of features that you would get if you were controlling Philips Hue bulbs directly vie the Hue app, but it allows you to have 4 buttons, each controlling a different scene. If you do try this, the Apple Home app alas does not support on/off functionality for a scene on each switch, so you will need to allocate a button to turn a scene on, and another to turn things off (but you can do this if you are using Hue bulbs and app directly I think, and I suspect Apple may add this feature later). Physical build quality of the switch is good, and it looks nice enough.
reviews.title: Handy physical switch for smart lights
reviews.author: mat

reviews.body: Brilliant switch. I have these for all my lights. Easy set up once you know how. Just make sure you set each setting to the lights. Each of the four buttons has its on setting on the ap. So you have to assign the lights to each setting. And save it. And chose your scene or colour.
reviews.title: Love these remotes
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.body: We are so used to controlling the lights in the house with our voice, but it’s not practical when guests stay over. This switch makes it easy for them to switch the guest lights on and off without using the main controller, you can have it right next to the bed.
reviews.title: Very handy

reviews.body: Great experience, and this 3d printed product fills a real need. Why Philips decided to never release an ACTUAL wall plate is beyond me - but thanks to makers like this we have a product that works and it looks great! You'd have to be very observant to realize it isn't one of our normal screwless wall plates that our other switches use. Thanks!
reviews.author: Ian

reviews.body:
Have got 3 of these and they all work well with the light fittings and spotlights

POSITIVES

You can use take the switch to where you are sitting and use it to dim the lights or change the colours

Fairly simple to use it to replace a standard light fitting if you have some basic electrical knowledge

The HUE app works quite seamlessly with the switch once you have figured out out how it works with it

NEGATIVES

The first is that once you link a ceiling with the Hue Colour GU10 spotlights the switch doesn't allow you to zone areas. You have to use the app to do this

The second is that the size of the backplate is slightly narrower than a standard switch so if you use this to replace a standard switch you will need to decorate the bit either side that wasn't covered originally
reviews.title: Switch works well and is easy to use once set up
reviews.author: mahtsl

reviews.body: Works a lot more efficiently than older version, whose battery needed replaced frequently. It’s less intuitive to set up as almost too many options via the via. The old version’s default Off button is not a default now and you need to program one or other button to do this. Also, the cycling of light options on repeat clicks needs to be thought through if you use one setting more frequently than others. Generally very good.
reviews.title: Marked improvement in efficiency but a bit fiddly to program - not for those that want simple settings
reviews.author: Ruthvenst

reviews.body: I got this controller as my echo device keeps not listening. So to be able to change bedroom light was easy to use. It was easy to set-up with the light I wanted it connected to
reviews.title: Simply set up
reviews.author: Stephen

reviews.body: I have had this version (v2) only a few days now but as with most HUE products for me it works great. Easy to connect to the HUE app and select the lights/room to control and done. My only issue is the on/off button on v1 are separate buttons but on V2 the share the top button which can get confusing when controlling different lights/rooms.
reviews.title: Another for the collection
reviews.author: buster2006

reviews.body:
The original product did not fully clear my switches, but the seller revised the design and shipped me a new product which fits correctly.

I would personally prefer a design which allows for all 4 mounting holes of the factory plate to be used, however it holds fine with 2. I also find the included screws to be too short, which causes them to strip easy, but this was easily fixed by using a different screw.

Overall it is a good product, and and easy to install if you do not want to remove or replace the original switch.
reviews.author: Jacob T.

reviews.body: Fits well and does the job. It’s a lot more attractive than having the hue controller stuck next to your standard light switches. However, the magnet is not super strong. It’s good enough that it will hold the controller, but it doesn’t feel quite as secure as the Hue standard wall plate. You can tell it’s 3d printed from the finish, but I suppose nobody ever really stares down a light switch hard enough for that to be an issue. I’m pretty satisfied with it
reviews.author: Alex K.

reviews.body: Product arrived on time and matched the pictures exactly. It comes with some screws for mounting it (important if your old screws are stripped or weird) and generally doesn't look bad. Note that it's a matte finish (because it's 3D printed) so it will look out of place next to a bunch of glossy white face plates. Compared to a lot of the cheap face plates out there, this is definitely more expensive but I've yet to crack one yet from overtightening it.
reviews.author: Kevin

reviews.body: The plate looks great, functions as advertised, and aligns with the existing screw holes perfectly. I love that this is a true white color and not an odd off-white. Some have mentioned the slight texture, but it really isn't obvious and I am very picky about details. I was able to use the existing plate screws as well, but additional screws are included just in case yours don't work. Jon knows what he's doing and creates quality products.
reviews.author: amccarron9

reviews.body: This is my second time ordering from the shop. Just like the first time he built the product and shipped it very very quickly. The quality of the product is stellar and it’s functionality is exactly what I needed. I use Phillips Hue throughout my smart Home, and it is very helpful to have these custom switch plates allowing me to integrate the Hue switches. The last time I ordered, I needed a custom switch plate for one of my rooms and he was able to custom build exactly what I needed. I highly recommend these products.
reviews.author: Danny

reviews.body: More solid and better quality than expected. Pulled out a switch, capped the wires, added this cover and it looks so much better. It does NOT match the previous cover style (matte not smooth, sharpish edges not curved) but as long as another cover isn't next to it, this looks really good. In the future I might like to get one in a different color.
reviews.author: Landis B.

reviews.body: I use several of these Hue dimmer switches with my Philips Hue lights and they work well. You could mount them next to an existing switch but I would recommend getting a 3rd party adapter plate designed to fit this Hue Dimmer switch over your existing light switch - this results in a much neater solution and ensures your lights are always receiving power and will respond. The default dimmer set up options within the Hue app are sensible and flexible enough for most users but it is easy to extend the options by installing some Hue recipes (accessible through the Hue app). If this is not enough then with a little effort all the Hue devices and many others from other manufacturers can be integrated into third party apps such as Home Assistant.
reviews.title: One of the better Philips Hue accessories
reviews.author: Dan

reviews.body:
Having something that looks like a light switch to control your Hue lights is a great idea. It's stylish and the fact that you can remove the central section to carry with you to control the lights is inspired.
Programming it is not so simple. The app really needs a major update to ensure that this product fulfills its potential.
reviews.title: Great Idea
reviews.author: Tony

reviews.body: These are a fantastic unit, so simple to install but sadly limited to just Phillips bulbs. If they control other makes this would be so much better. I tend to purchase a mount to go straight over my normal switch and the fascia clips straight on. A really tidy unit. Dim your lights or select colour scenes.

reviews.body:
These really transform how you use Hue lighting. No more hunting for your phone every time you enter a room.
Solid build quality and the adhesive tape works surprisingly well on painted walls. Easy to setup. The only problem is I have to buy more for the rooms that don't have one...

reviews.body: Looks clean. Tightened in perfectly, no warping (didn't over tighten). I would be interested in a gloss version, not sure if that is possible. This has texture but it is not noticeable unless you mount it right next to a glossy cover plate.

reviews.body: Fits well, magnets are decently powerful. It does slip around a little bit, but nothing major. It does have some "creases" on the side, from 3d printing, but they look quite ok. Just don't expect it to be perfectly smooth.

reviews.body: The quality of the spacer is great. It sits flush with the wall and the dimmer switch. It matched the description and photos exactly, and it totally met my expectations. I bought two for my home, and they're both high quality and made very well. I got two extra screws for each spacer (so four total per spacer) to make them even more flush, and it turned out great. Thank you!

description: Create the perfect atmosphere with dimmable Philips Hue lights. Energy-efficient, remotely controllable lighting that helps you craft the ideal light settings to match your preferences, activities, or mood. Basic remote control Dimmer for Hue bulbs, allowing smooth, convenient and wireless dimming. Use the dimmer to control all Hue lights and bulbs. It also functions as a standard wall switch and dimmer, and thanks to the screws or the adhesive strip on the back you can mount it almost anywhere. You can preset 4 light scenes on the power button for individual bulbs or groups using the mobile app. Control up to 10 bulbs with a signal range of 12 meters. The controller is powered by a single CR2032 battery (included). Compatible with Amazon Alexa and Apple Home. Kit systems. Find more information about the Hue system in our article. bestFor: Weatherproof low-voltage garden landscape lighting kit

reviews.body:
Very easy to set up - I unboxed and connected most of it indoors initially, as it was freezing outside.

The Hue app discovered each light very quickly and the colour and brightness was easily set.

The build quality is excellent.

The lights come out of the box with a round metal footplate attached. There is a little screw holding this in place. I used a small screwdriver (from a set designed for watch maintenance) to remove this so that I could use the spike attachment, but if you have strong fingers you may manage without.
reviews.title: Fabulous lights
reviews.author: 112411W

reviews.body:
Am heavily in to Philips Hue lighting throughout the house. Seem to be reliable overall.
Have always wanted these for the garden and after an extension build, we made sure we had an armoured cable and power socket installed in the garden flowerbed, which meant plug and play with this set.
Comes with everything you need. We already have the Philips Hue Hub so once plugged in you just connect these via wi-fi to link it with your app etc.
Gives off a really lovely light and of course you have a choice of thousands of colours. However these are fairly bright, more like accent lighting, and certainly not flood lighting but allows you to pick out and light up features or bushes in your garden at night. Ours came on pre-set with different colours from the get go -yellow,blue and red and we have left it like that!
And the connections and cables are very sturdy as are the actual light fittings. I just hope they last many winters and summers without issue.
You can add plenty of further Lily lights to this set, money allowing!
reviews.title: Lovely lighting effect. A touch expensive for what they are.
reviews.author: MarkMz

reviews.body: Really well made lights and easy to set up with the Hue bridge, with a nice range of colours to light up the garden. On the less positive side is the brightness of the lights. They are ok to spotlight plants and trees but are not bright enough for wider lighting of the garden and given the overall price of them, I have to say that I am a little underwhelmed.
reviews.title: Phillips Hue Lily LED Smart Outdoor lighting
reviews.author: SM6022

reviews.body:
I am obsessed with these lights. We have installed them on our balcony which struggles with getting any light as soon as the sun goes down as we're covered by trees. They are such high quality and we're really easy to install. The cables are strong the matte finish to the lamps make them feel really premium.
We've also set them up to test as mood lighting for occasions inside and they look fabulous too. I'm so impressed.

reviews.author: Mel M.

reviews.body:
My first impression when opening the box was how sturdy and well built the lights are. The cables are a good length and the connectors all fit together seamlessly. I've had other cheaper garden lights in the past and and now I can see why you would pay more for these. It can be a little confusing with all the lengths of cable though, so I would suggest you have a plan in mind before you start to assemble!
Setting the lights up was relatively simple and the instructions were thorough so I was confident I could get them working quickly. Connecting the lights to the Philips Hue bridge is really worth doing as it gives you a wealth of different colours and moods.
Once it was dark I could really appreciate how effective these lights are. For the size of the lights they give off more light than I was expecting - see photos attached, and the 3 lights feel plenty to light a reasonably sized patio/ decking area. We (my children and I) had great fun playing with all the different colour combinations and I love how the lights can be switched on/off and dimmed all from my phone.
Overall these lights are a good investment - I feel they've totally transformed the decking area in my garden. I would definitely recommend this product.
reviews.title: Perfect for lighting up your garden!
reviews.author: AMB

reviews.body: As many other reeviews have said for this product, a high quality product, easy to set up, and easy to use. I was afraid that maybe they would not reach the w-fi hub, but they do just fine, and apparently, one light passes the signal onto the next, so only the nearest one needs to reach the hub. They are easy and pleasurable to control using the Philips Hue app. The is 5m cable between the power supply and the first light, and 1st to 2nd light, and 2nd to 3rd light so plenty of wriggle room, making it felxible. As others have said, you can use either spikes that go into the soil, or brackets that screw onto things (such as fences). I have used the spikes for now, and will probably leave it that way because it works well in our garden. I have moved them slightly to make them point up at trees and they look great. It's spring now, so they come into their own at dusk and when fully dark, but I am also looking forward to having them on in winter on those dark days, and when it gets dark earlier. I think they will also look great is there is a scattering or snow or frost. I actually bought 2 sets of these while they had 20% off in the sale. Only set up one of the sets so far, but will add the other set to the garden soon. Really happy with them so far. No issues and like the Hue app. I used to use LIFX lights and app before and they are very similar to each other.
reviews.title: Great quality product - easy to set up
reviews.author: JasonKaye

reviews.body:
This is my first Hue product so I am completely new to the set up, however it was very simple and everything was up and running within 15 minutes. As well as the lights package you need the Hue bridge, which connects to your router. Everything just plugs in, download the app to phone/tablet, sync it up and away you go.

Without the bridge, the lights simply turn on or off, but once you're connected via the bridge you can adjust each light to any colour and brightness or dimness. There are some pre-set 'scenes' on the app, or you can create and save your own. Each light can be any colour or brightness. It's really fun to play around and experiment with. There are timer options too, which I'm sure I'll make use of when away.

The spotlights don't light up the garden in the same way a lamp would, so it's not actually light you would see by. They are best positioned to illuminate features, like a tree, tall plant or fence/wall etc. You can either screw a bracket to the decking or wall, or use a stake on grass or soil. Each bulb has a 5m cable so they can be well spaced apart, and the length from plug to first cable is about 3.5m.

Overall, I'm very impressed with these lights and the technology that accompanies them. As an outdoor lighting solution they are great to add ambience, in addition to a main outdoor light.
reviews.title: Great effect and easy to set up & use
reviews.author: Alster123

reviews.body:
We had been on the hunt for some outdoor lighting for a while and I came across these at the perfect time.

We already use Philips Hue lightbulbs at home (paired with the app) which have been life-changing (as you don't need to get out of bed to turn the lights off) so when I found out that there were Philips Hue products for outdoors, I was extremely excited to try them.

Set up is extremely straightforward and once you have it paired with the app (Hue Bridge needs to be purchased separately but is worth every penny), you are set to go. Through the use of the bridge and the app, you are able to change the lights to any dimness/brightness and any colour making it very fun to play with. Worth noting that these lights are more functional as ambience setters/illuminating specific features within the garden rather than a floodlight.

The lights themselves are super sleek looking and would prove to be a great addition to any garden.

You will probably need to work out the placement of the lights prior to set up to ensure that the cable reaches.
reviews.title: Just what I was looking for!
reviews.author: TReviews

reviews.body:
I found these lights really easy to install they just need plugging in and they were detected straight away by the bridge. They come with an option to either fit them to a wall which has a little pin so you can fix the arm of the bracket to your preferred angle if you prefer you can put them on the spike. I found they look best when either uplighting or downlighting a certain area of focus.

Within the hue app you can set the lights can be set to come on/off at a certain time of day, set each light to its own brightness and colour which they remember. I also found controlling them via voice using a smart assistant simple to setup and easy to use

Overall I am enjoying the extra lighting in the garden and as each base unit can power up to 40w worth of lights I likely will expand it further as each light only uses 8w each.

reviews.body:
The build qulaity is amazing. Powder coated, connector fit tight, good length of cable, very easy to setup.
Yes they are pricey but I have had others in the past and all fail after a couple of years (rust, water getting in, bulb failing etc).
What I like. These Philips Hue lights connected to Hue Bridge make all the difference.
My bridge is approx 15-17 meters away from garden tucked away in my garage. The range is really good. Connecting lights to Bridge was a doddle.
The colours you can play with are amazing.
I have not finished my Koi Pond Project yet but I provide a photo to show the effect. Note that the themes are amazing. Different colours and light intensity.

reviews.author: WhoKickMyDog

reviews.body:
There are our first hue products and we are really impressed. We spent some time planning out where we would like the lights to go and ensuring that we had the correct length in the cables to enable this.

I think the planning was worthwhile as if we hadn't done this we wouldn't have had enough cable to reach where we wanted the final light and that was the most important to us to light up our wisteria.

The system was really easy to set up, you just need an external power source to plug them in to. We easily linked them to the required Philips 'bridge' and enjoyed playing around with the different features.

The lights can be set to millions of different colour combinations and they add ambience to your outside space. We have used them as accent lighting to light up features in our garden.

As well as able to turn these on and off as required, we really like the ability to be able to set a schedule for the lights. They can be set to come on at a certain time of day or set to come on at sunset and go off at sunrise.

Overall, we are really impressed with the lights and the flexibility they offer.

reviews.body:
Firstly, you'll need the Philips Hue Lighting Bridge to make this set up work properly. Once out of the box, you'll need to figure out where your light will need to go, so best to layout everything before connecting the various cables.

The cables are a simple slot in and tighten / screw situation, but it can get confusing trying to figure what connects to what at first.

Once set up and connect to the Lighting Bridge, it really is a doddle to use via the app. Great different choices in moods and hues, with a gallery selection of you can't be bothered to fiddle with all the different colour combinations.

Light is dimmable, so you can choose your light strength to your liking. And all light can be clicked off with one button on the app.

Would look amazing connected to more spotlights around a big garden, but it did wonders for our small balcony during family dinners.

Overall, a great bit of tech that's a little bit fiddly at first.

The best thing is the Hue bulb goes into any light fitting and transforms it into a high tech fitting. I bought the Hue Bridge with 2 bulbs as a kit and put the bulbs in our front door coach lights. You need the Bridge with the spotlights - the Bridge plugs into your router.
