Even a novice can set these up, I'm almost looking forward to darker nights when they will provide a dash of colour in the winter months.

name: Tapo P110 Smart Plug with Energy Monitoring
bestFor: Tracking power consumption (kWh) of appliances to beat Australian electricity tariffs

reviews.body:
Be aware that this device *will* fail in the next 3 years, some reports that it doesn't even last half a year. It apparently uses an underspec capacitor which will eventually explode inside it. If you're unlucky, this can short, which means fire.
After it fails, this device will rapidly switch power on and off rapidly multiple times a second, some electronics can't handle that kind of abuse, especially the expensive stuff.
I was horrified though, because I was using this for li-ion battery charging. Playing with electricity and li-ion batteries is how you get a house fire.

You can google this if you're unsure, "P110M Failure"
TP-Link has known about their plugs having issues for a while now, and they've been silent. They will however blame the consumer, regardless of how it was used.
My plug was running warm despite nothing being plugged in, I don't think that's a good sign. Which is where I stumbled into this rabbit hole.
I think it's probably an issue with their design and not just the capacitor, as it doesn't seem to matter if you're using a small load, still fails.

This also apparently isn't rated for inductive loads, which they neglect to say. I didn't even know it mattered until reading them blame the consumer.
It's not too relevant as this will fail regardless of what's plugged in, just at different times.

So other than that, this device is meant to be online only, no offline mode. You could previously use it offline with some complicated workarounds, they've fixed that.
I don't have any other plugs to recommend, because they all suck. I'm getting an electrician to hook me up with something safer.

TL;DR
Dangerous to use, should be recalled. Don't use it on anything you're not prepared to lose. Always fails.
reviews.author: AndrewH1391

reviews.body:
We had the older version which wasn't Matter compatible before and these are much faster to set up, directly in Apple Home I added them, just make sure you're phone is using the wifi network you want them to use before you start (we have a 2.4ghz network set up for all our smart devices and a 5ghz for everything else). Press the plus in apple home and it's only a few steps. You can then change back to your 5ghz network on your phone and it'll still control them flawlessly. Much faster and less buggy than the previous ones. A month in and we haven't had a single one fail even once. I use siri to turn our lamps and oil burners on and I schedule them all off at certain times. Even got some fairy lights for the garage that I can voice command on as I walk in carrying things. BEST.

I hope Bunnings gets bulk packs soon so they're a little cheaper, and the power board version too!

Very easy to set up the app and use continuous monitoring - you can enter in a $/KwH cost and it will estimate your monthly expenses for the device/powerpoint. Also great ability to remotely toggle power on and off.

I immediately tested it out on every appliance in the house, and now have a great idea about which one of them are energy vampires...

I've had a few different brands of 'smart plugs' over the years and this brand are the ONLY ones I've never had to replace.

As the others die I'm replacing them with the TP Link brand plugs, slightly dearer upfront but not having to replace them every 12-18 months works out a lot cheaper.

You also don't have to worry about redoing your schedules and automations every time you have to buy a new plug!!

Their App is better than the others but it still could be a lot more intuitive, it seems that all the different companies apps are made by highly skilled programmers who failed to give it to their mum to test before releasing it!!

reviews.body: Very good quality smart power board made for Australia/NZ. What we like: 1) can turn on/off each power socket using the app or Google Home. 2) Small form factor so it fits neatly in a D-line cable tidy box. 3) one of the only smart device brands that works with Asus router 2.4ghz band (most other brands will not connect). reviews.author: Nigel

reviews.body:
Unreliable, which is not what you want from a power board.
At least once a week the board "freezes" and stops delivering power. When this happens, pressing physical buttons on the board doesn't work but you can still control the ports via the app.
Only the power outlets are controllable, and not the USB ports so you can't remotely power-cycle any USB devices. No energy monitoring like the P110M. I can live with the lack of features, but when you have an aquarium filter and heater on the board and they stop receiving power without any indications, it becomes a showstopper. It's a common problem reported in the forums, which I wish I'd read before I bought several of these boards.

En av väldigt få zWave pluggar (enda för invändigt bruk) jag testat som rapporterar strömförbruktning till Telldus Live. Det tog nån dag innan den började visa förbrukad ström så jag trodde inte den fungerade. Men nu visar den både watt och kwh.

Telldus hittade den direkt vid parning vilket inte alltid är fallet med zWave.

Bra med en knapp på enheten för fysisk av/på.

Op de hub staat de status op "dead" en er valt niets meer te bedienen. De stekker werkt handmatig nog, want als je het fysieke knopje indrukt dan gaat het gewoon aan en uit, maar daar koop je zo'n stekker niet voor. I’ve had several different brands (they cost way more than SwitchBot) and they’re incredibly pain in the butt to pair to HomeKit. After 30th attempts it’ll finally pair. But then doesn’t stay online with HomeKit if no activity for several hours.

This one took one try! It’s been online and consistent since day 1.

I was shocked to see how this is the cheapest one I’ve seen and proven to be reliable AND provide cool feature with energy monitoring! For those expensive brands I’ve had in the past literally has no features like this.

reviews.body: Great little plug. Provides lots of energy use info such as: Energy output in kWh, Power On Duration, Power used in Watts, Current output in Amps, and Voltage output in Volts. It also gives you the option to export usage history into an excel .csv file. It also integrates into Samsung SmartThings ecosystem where you can turn it on and off and view energy consumption (and integrate it into automations) but you do not get info from the power meter function as you do in the SwitchBot app. I have it connected to my home theater system to have automations happen when the TV is on based on energy consumption values. Overall, product features, functionality and construction are solid.

De Shelly Pro4PM in een behuizing (Toolstation, Merk Elettrocanali, Productcode: 53721 Waterdicht uitbreidingskast Ip65 4 modules) gezet. Kast heeft al een din-rail, kwestie van de Shelly erop klikken, aansluiten, netwerk erop en in Home Assistant aanmelden (https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/shelly/ ). Vanuit Home Assistant kun je nu de 4 schakelaars van de Shelly bedienen, automatiseren enz. Ik gebruik de Shelly om de tuinverlichting en gevel verlichting te schakelen, dan hoeft deze niet de hele nacht te blijven branden zoals eerder door een schemerschakelaar geregeld werd. Nedoporučuji toho prodejce!!!

Het is net een Shelly Plus Plug S maar dan 4 stuks in één kastje en het werkt met MQTT ook hetzelfde, wat ook de reden is dat ik dit heb aangeschaft. Voor bezorgde mensen over crashes door back lash EM zoals TL balken en apparaten met spoelen zoals ventilatoren of wasmachines kan ik zeggen dat ik voor de zekerheid 4 snubbers heb mee besteld en tussen de fase en output 1,2,3,4 heb geplaatst om spanningspieken en dalen als het ware te filteren en er is nog niet één keer een crash geweest. Vanwege de energietransitie wordt het stroomnet regelmatig een dagje uitgezet en ik wilde daar ook iets voor de groepen hebben staan, wat de groepen pas na een aantal seconden weer last-state inschakelt mocht de netbeheerder toch spanningspieken veroorzaken. De eerste klappen worden dus opgevangen door de Shelly Pro 4 en de rest van het huis blijft gespaard, wanneer het net weer wordt ingeschakeld. Geweldig om de 4 groepen afzonderlijk te kunnen verbruiksmonitoren en schakelen. Heb er al wat sluipverbruikers mee opgespoord die me al een besparing van €100 / jaar opleveren en dus de aanschaf van de Shelly Pro 4 er binnen een jaar weer uit heb :)

reviews.body:
Ich darf keine Sterne abziehen, weil ich genau wusste, dass das Gerät eine gemeinsame Phase hat und es unfair wäre, vorauswissend dies zu tun. Man muss halt schon von vornherein abklären für was man ein Gerät einsetzten möchte und für meinen Einsatz verdient das Gerät eindeutig fünf Sterne.

Ich freue mich auch auf die vier Pro-Komponenten für den Verteilerkasten, die vor ein paar Monaten vorgestellt wurden aber die Preise und Verfügbarkeit noch nicht feststeht. Darunter hat es auch einer mit zwei getrennten Phasen. Zwei davon montiert, benötigen gleichviel Platz wie dieser 4PM hier, dies für jene die nicht mit zusätzlichen Relais das Problem der gemeinsamen Phase lösen möchten.

An die Freunde die wegen Bluetooth fragen, wo der Sinn ist. Sofern ich mich noch korrekt an eine Produkte-Vorstellung erinnere, hiess es, dass es noch eine eingeschränkte Funktion ist und vorerst nur zum Einrichten von Wi-Fi-Anmeldeinformationen verwendet werden kann. Bis Ende des Jahres könne aber Bluetooth verwendet werden, um andere Geräte wie Fernbedienungen und Sensoren zu verbinden.

Das tollste an allen diesen Geräten und auch am 4PM, ist der LAN-Anschluss und so einen sehr stabilen Einsatz gewährleistet wird ohne viele Wi-Fi respektive WLAN-Repeater einsetzten zu müssen, wie bei meinem Fall bei grösserem Umfeld und viel Beton, es sonst sehr mühsam wurde.

Auch die Anbindung an Sprachassistenten ist sehr einfach und wer auf Solches und auch auf eine Cloud Anbindung verzichten will, der kann es auch nur im lokalen Netz nutzten, was andere Hersteller sehr oft nicht anbieten oder nur mit einer alternativen Firmware von Dritten. Nebenbei auch die Shellys erlauben die Firmware zu ändern.

Ein bisschen stört mir das Gefühl, ein billiges Plastikteil in der Hand zu haben. Irgendwoher muss es kommen, dass es so günstig angeboten werden kann. Das alleine kann mich nicht abhalten es ein sehr gutes Produkt zu nennen, da die Vorteile und die viele Möglichkeiten bei diesem Preis, was das Gerät zulässt, schon sehr erfreulich sind.

Εγώ δεν θα χρησιμοποιήσω καλωδιακό έλεγχο από μπουτόν αλλά θα το συνδυάσω με ένα Shelly plus I4 που μέσω δικτύου θα ελέγχει κάθε κανάλι ξεχωριστά από τον SW4 4-πλό διακόπτη της shelly .

Πολλές επιλογές στην εφαρμογή. Περισσότερες ίσως από ότι θα έπρεπε.

Η τιμή του είναι πάρα πολύ καλή, αν φανταστεί κανείς πως 4 αθόρυβα ρελέ καστάνιας (απλά) έχουν περίπου το ίδιο κόστος.
Εδώ παίρνεις και smart έλεγχο, πλήρη συνδεσιμότητα με το home assistant, Rest API, HTTPs και πολλά πολλά άλλα.

Update: 24/10/2024.

Έχει βγει νέα version του ρελέ με διαφορετικές κλεμμες εισόδου.

Σε δεύτερη εγκατάσταση οικίας πλέον έχω 4 τέτοια τεμάχια.
Άψογη η συμπεριφορά τους και εδώ.
Το καλό είναι πως η shelly με πολλαπλές ενημερώσεις firmware έχει προσθέσει πολλές νέες λειτουργίες.

Α) Μπορείς να παντρέψεις τα ρελέ με αισθητήρες Bluetooth (κίνησης, φωτεινότητας, θερμοκρασίας, υγρασίας, τοπικά μπουτόν Bluetooth μπαταρίας) , κατευθείαν επάνω στο ρελέ χωρίς να απαιτείται internet ή cloud, για απλούς αυτοματισμούς !!!
Πχ. Έστω πως δεν έχεις σε ένα σημείο καλωδίωση για διακόπτη. Τοποθετείς το Shelly BLU Wall Switch με πλαίσιο ίδιο με τους διακόπτες που έχεις, το παντρεύεις με το ρελέ που θες να ελέγξεις και έτοιμο ακόμα και αν χαθεί το internet!
Ή έστω πως θες να ελέγχεις την έξοδο του ρελέ αν υπάρχει κίνηση στον χώρο. Συνδυάζεις το ρελέ με έναν αισθητήρα Bluetooth Shelly BLU Motion Sensor.

Β) Υποστηρίζει πλέον KNX NET IP που στην περίπτωσή μου που θα βάλω KNX Fan Coil ρελέ, θα παντρευτούν μαζί σε κοινό δίκτυο.

Γ) Η Shelly με την παρουσίαση πολλαπλών νέων συσκευών Dimmer phase-cut ράγας, dimmers 0/1-10v ράγας και κυτίου, dali dimmer κυτίου, σου δίνει ολοκληρωμένη πρόταση οικιακού και όχι μόνο αυτοματισμού !

Επισυνάπτονται και νέες φωτογραφίες.

20/10 το ρελέ για αυτά που προσφέρει. Δεν έχω βρει στην αγορά κάτι καλύτερο και πιστέψτε με, έχω δοκιμάσει πολλά ...

Produs excelent.
- 4 ieșiri on-off.
- Măsurarea consumului pe cele 4 ieșiri separat.
- Conexiune stabilă cu cablu Ethernet, deși suportă și Wifi.
- Suport Bluetooth pentru conexiunea inițială cu aplicația.
- Silențios.
- Ecran de afișare pentru a arăta măsurătorile și a controla dispozitivul.
- Control local fie de la un buton, fie de la un întrerupător pentru fiecare canal separat.

Nu voi folosi controlul cablat de la un buton, ci îl voi combina cu un Shelly plus I4 care va controla fiecare canal separat de la întrerupătorul Shelly SW4 cu 4 căi prin rețea.

Multe opțiuni în aplicație. Mai multe decât poate ar trebui să aibă.

Prețul său este foarte bun, având în vedere că 4 întrerupătoare de releu silențioase (simple) costă cam la fel.
Aici obții control inteligent, conectivitate completă cu asistentul de acasă, Rest API, HTTPs și multe, multe altele.

Actualizare: 24/10/2024.

A fost lansată o nouă versiune a releului cu terminale de intrare diferite.

Într-o a doua instalare acasă, acum am 4 astfel de unități.
Performanța lor este impecabilă și aici.
Partea bună este că Shelly, cu multiple actualizări de firmware, a adăugat multe caracteristici noi.

A) Poți asocia releele cu senzori Bluetooth (mișcare, luminozitate, temperatură, umiditate, butoane Bluetooth cu baterie locală), direct pe releu fără a necesita internet sau cloud, pentru automatizări simple!!!
De exemplu, să presupunem că nu ai cabluri pentru un întrerupător într-un anumit punct. Plasezi Shelly BLU Wall Switch cu un cadru identic cu întrerupătoarele pe care le ai, îl asociezi cu releul pe care vrei să-l controlezi și este gata chiar dacă internetul este pierdut!
Sau să presupunem că vrei să controlezi ieșirea releului dacă există mișcare în zonă. Combină releul cu un senzor de mișcare Bluetooth Shelly BLU.

B) Acum suportă KNX NET IP care, în cazul meu, unde voi instala relee KNX Fan Coil, se va asocia împreună pe o rețea comună.

C) Shelly, cu introducerea mai multor dispozitive noi precum Dimmer phase-cut rail, dimmers 0/1-10v rail și box, cutie dimmer DALI, îți oferă o propunere completă pentru automatizarea casei și nu numai!

Sunt atașate și fotografii noi.

10/20 pentru releu pentru ceea ce oferă. Nu am găsit nimic mai bun pe piață și crede-mă, am încercat multe...

Ich hoffe der neue Pro 4 PM reiht sich in die gleiche Stabilität der anderen Shelly Produkte ein.
Es sind 4 kompakte Relais mit Display für die Hutschiene. Von Vorteil ist der Ethernet Anschluss und der WLAN Anschluss bzw. Hotspot als Ergänzung. Was die Bluetooth Funktion bringt weiss ich nicht.
Die Anschlüsse sind genug gross für 1,5mm2 Drähte. 2,5mm2 Drähte mit Aderendhülsen für eine 16A Last bringt man hinein mit etwas Kraft.
Die Schraubterminals sind gut abgedeckt. man kann entweder die Abdeckung durchstechen, oder abder die Deckel abnehmen, siehe Fotos.
Als erstes muss zwingend ein Firmware Update aufgespielt werden um einige Bugs zu beheben.
Die Firmware ist noch nicht ganz ausgereift und auch an der Version 0.9 ersichtlich. Shelly-üblich wird dies wohl in den nächsten Wochen behoben werden.
Alles in allem eine sinnvolle Ergänzung der Shelly Produkt Reihe.
Ich hätte allerdings lieber 4 getrennte Relais als 4 Relais mit gemeinsamer Phase, deshalb nur 4 statt 5 Sterne.

Onbelast schakelt het ding vrolijk aan/uit, maar blij het herhaaldelijk shakelen van 'probleemlasten' zoals TL-buizen, LED verlichting, contactor coils, e.d. gaat dit toestelletje in 'safe' mode en moet het ge-reboot worden. De kans bestaat dan ook dat als je dit regelmatig doet, de levensduur beperkt is.
Dit probleem doet zich meestal voor als er kort na elkaar geschakeld wordt, ook op verschillende kanalen.
Oplossing hiervoor is een zogeheten 'RC snubber' in lijn met de belasting te plaatsen. Deze neemt dan de spanningspieken tijdens het schakelen van deze probleemlasten voor zijn rekening, waardoor de 4PM module gespaard blijft.
Deze RC snubbers kosten enkele EUR en het zou handig zijn moesten deze ook in het aanbod van ROBB zitten.
Voor de rest, bijzonder handig toestelletje.

description: The Shelly Pro 4PM Wi-Fi & Bluetooth Relay Module is a 1-phase, 4-channel dry contact relay module that mounts inside your breaker box to add Wi-Fi, LAN, & Bluetooth remote control and energy monitoring for up to four electrical loads in your home or business. The Pro 4PM supports up to 40A for a single load or up to 16A from all four connected loads. Three press buttons on the front plate enable users to scroll and navigate the device's menus with press and press and hold inputs. The LCD screen has a short status info bar at the top that displays the live status of inputs and outputs with color coded indicators. Use the Shelly Smart Control app to help you control your connected devices remotely and receive alerts directly from your smart device. A Shelly Smart Control App user account is required to access, include, and control Shelly devices through the Shelly Smart Control app and include your Shelly devices to 3rd party home automation or voice assistant platforms.

bestFor: Ultra-fast 58-minute wall recharging & 1800W continuous output

reviews.body:
I had one question when I was researching power stations, which brand has great quality for the price and can I use one of their power stations as a UPS for my computer systems.
The manufacturer of my power supply unit (PSU) in my custom-built desktop computer highly recommends clean 'pure sine wave' power, battery or not. My uninterrupted power supply (UPS) unit from a well-known company has been going on the fritz shortly after the 3-year warranty expired, randomly turning off and cutting power to my computer systems while they are running. Abruptly cutting power to such computer systems can lead to things like lost data and/or corrupt file system(s) that can be a pain to remedy. Said UPS has fast transfer switching (4ms to go from loss of input power to battery power output) which make them more desirable (and sometimes necessary) but are generally made up of lead acid batteries; very heavy, very inefficient systems that require replacing batteries every 3 years. They are meant to provide power long enough to shut a system down gracefully to avoid issues mentioned earlier. 'Pure sine wave' UPS units are very expensive on top of all that I already mentioned. My computer system can draw up to 850 watts of power and would require a UPS that produces 'pure sine wave' at 850 watts or higher costs about $399 USD and more. I researched online hoping I could find out if one can use a power station like the C1000 as an effective UPS without issue (e.g. fast enough transfer switching times, sensitive enough to correct bad fluctuations in voltage to not trip out a PSU, etc.) but wasn't getting good enough answers so wanted to write a thorough review of my findings in hopes it helps others.
I know that power stations have lithium derived batteries which are much more efficient than lead acid. The Anker C1000 as of 2024 has a 'transfer switch time' of <20ms. The PSU in my desktop computer has an 'extended time up' of 30ms (how long will the system sustain power when loss of power has occurred on input). That means that if the C1000 switches to battery at ~20ms and my PSU can tolerate ~30ms at the time of no power in input, the C1000 SHOULD be able to keep my systems up and running. It was an expensive experiment I wanted to find out.
After hooking up the C1000, I can say that my desktop computer and monitor don't appear to be phased when I pull the AC power plug from the wall; verified by the display between battery draw or not. I also loaded up playing a graphic intense game so the power draw would be higher, around 650 watts. I pulled the AC power cord from the wall and again, system was still up and running. I haven't tested this, but the C1000 indicated that based on power draw I could continue gaming for about an hour.
I'm extremely happy with the results. After a major price discount on the C1000, it still was a little more expensive than a 1500VA UPS lead acid battery with 'pure sine wave' output but completely makes the C1000 worth it from an investment perspective; not only do I have a high quality, higher warranty, higher/longer sustained power output that can reliably act as a UPS, but I can unplug and use it anywhere to power devices. Very worth the investment. Hope this helps folks.
reviews.title: Works great as a UPS for my desktop system

reviews.body: Update:Returned home after a 30 day trip back in May 2024, traveling from NC to upstate NY in our northstar SC 650,. We used this the Solix C1000 with the expansion battery everyday. Although It won't power our rooftop AC, it powered everything else. Came in super handy during quiet hours when we wanted to use our microwave, or keurig coffee maker and so on. We do carry a generator on board so at the end of everyday around 4-6 pm, we would start our generator and backcharge our entire system. Our onboard solar system would charge our "house battery" but the generator would top off the anker system in about 1-1.5 hours depending on how much power was drawn off the system. We keep the system in our camper and backpower through the shore power hookup. It worked flawlessly for the entire trip. It's pretty handy given the weight, I put the main system where we want it and then stack the auxiliary battery and hook them together with the provided cord.No regrets on this purchase to date.The C1000 and BP 1000 work well for our specific needs and physically handling the system wrt weight is just right!Hope this update helps someone out who is looking for a similar system for a similar application.After purchasing the solix C1000 and then partnering it with the BP1000, I have doubled the output watts I desire to power my northstar sc650 truck camper over a longer offgrid experience.Although I've not tested it on a multi day trip yet, but testing over several hours and running the things I normally would on shore power, I am extremely happy with what it can now power over extended periods of time.Literally running multiple items from our microwave, furnace, hot water heater, and more, when plugged into the surge pad socket with a 15 amp cord I am essentially runningeverything I need when I need it.The BP1000 discharges first and then will consume power from the C1000 and Vice-versa when charging the system back up.I believe that the system is setup this way so that the user will always have control over power charging and dischargingThe system does not have a pass through charge function but rather works like a UPS system in the sense that when plugged into shore power and backcharging, if power is needed to run something, the system will stop charging and immediately switch into ups mode and power what you need in the moment.Our plan is to use this system in campgrounds during quiet hours when gas generators cannot be used.Based on our particular wants & needs, I Would highly recommend.I wanted something small but that packed a high watt output when I need it.So far, so good. Boondocking in my northstar truck camper I am able to backpower the entire camper with the Solix C1000 for about a 24 hour period.This depends of course on what I am running. Occasional microwave oven use, my fridge on propane setting, lights, water pump, even the hot water heater and hot air furnace, again, limited high use items.Only used so far on 2 overnight trips.Next morning I use an 1800-2200 watt generator to power the anker back to full from about 15% only drawing a set watt charge of about 750. The generators rpm only increase a little bit and the anker is charged in about 1 hour and 30 minutes.I could increase my charge watts to 1000 and be done inside of 50 minutes or less but I want to break the unit in several charge cycles first and I like running my generator on eco mode.The anker is not heavy at only 28 lbs and I can set it up on my campers kitchen counter or just about anyplace else inside my rig.I bought it for $650 from amazon, anker Direct, and it shipped to my house in under 5 days and came in just under $700 total, a great buy in my opinion.I am looking to eventually buy the expansion battery to give more power in depth but am in no rush at this point.I am 100% satisfied with this small yet powerful unit. It definitely lives up to what it says it can do, also, the app is simply incredible.Great job to the folks at anker.Highly recommended, just do your homework on what you plan to use it for.I've been a goal zero fan for years but it's the older led acid yeti 400 and 1250 units.Great products and they still work great, I also have the ego nexus system and run 7.5 amp batteries on it, again, great units all around but this anker system takes the cake.Size, weight, power output, and charge times is what sold me!!Happy shopping.

reviews.author: D.S.

reviews.body: After using this for dispersed camping in our small overlanding camper I have to say I'm impressed. This was our first try wirh electric powerbank and the beauty is having quiet power all night long.For context our camper is a 2023 Coleman Rubicon 1200rk. It handles the little demand it has very well and we were able to run our fridge, Lights, charge phones, and the water pump for the sink all night and in the morning had around 30% left. Pretty satisfied with that.The solar panels were the most impressive to me. I got up to a s over the wattage rating at some points of the day coming in and it charges the power bank quickly for being free!The UI is great, app is great , simple and elegant design. All around great powerbank and Anker had been my favorite for smaller powebanks forever which is why I tried them out.Weekend camper or need some extra power for get together, this is it.Overall I'd say 9/10.
reviews.title: Great combo package
reviews.author: T.C.

reviews.body: Received this Anker Solix C1000 today. I immediately plugged it in to my office and it began charging from 90%. While it's charging there is a louder hum than I expected. This hum would be distracting for a quiet room. Thankfully, the fans went to silent once the Solix reached about 95% state of charge.I'm not sure I would recommend this unit in a home office or quiet space if you plan to load it up to the extent where it will kick on fans or constantly be charging. I did notice that in the Bluetooth app you can set the AC charging rate (max 1000W) — perhaps setting it to charge up slower would prevent the fans kicking in but I'm unsure.The unit is much smaller and lighter than pictures suggested. Another nice bonus is that you can manage this from only bluetooth using the Anker app without creating any sort of account or sharing location.
reviews.title: Louder than expected when charging
reviews.author: J.

reviews.body: After hurricane helene, family member needed to borrow due to power outage. This product allowed them to charge phones, laptop, batteries for power tools, etc. They charged it back up using the car charger which worked well (as the solar panels were in transit). Subsequent to them returning to me, I used the solar panel (100w) to recharge as it arrived. Went from 76% to 100% in 4 hours (keeping in mind, I placed out in the morning and the sun was not at its peak, I repositioned into direct sun after an hour, and the charge rate went up quickly. Overall, I would recommend. Those concerned with size, it’s about twice the size of a men’s size 13 boot (eg it does not take up a lot of space), and is fairly easy to lift with the handles.
reviews.title: Great product
reviews.author: A.

reviews.body: Keep in mind while reading this review that it's my personal opinion and review and may not represent the reviews of others ... BUT ... After looking into the price of having the entire home powered up by even a generator ... I stumbled upon this item ... For a quick power loss emergence ... This product and price (when on sale) ... Has been a great item to have on hand ... While there's many other brands to choose from ... I chose Anker ... I trust them for any and all my backups and power sources for other items ... Such as our Cell Phones ... So why this one besides price ... Portability ... Not at all that heavy ... BUT ... Additionally ... Another top selling point is the number of 3-phong plugin ports (Hubs) ... Six (6) right across the front ... Fast charging also ... And so many other features ... (Read their AD for details) ... So many of our kitchen products are 3-prong ... We've ran our Coffee Maker and Microwave simultaneously ... Don't forget that it also charges and runs via their solar input item ... I'm serious thinking of getting a second one when it's at a great sale price just to run the Refrigerator Separately ... Their always having a sale ... BUT ... I'm waiting until the sale is around or below $450 ... We've had times ... Not that many ... When we had just finished grocery shopping ... Filled the fridge ... Especially the freezer ... And within a day or a few days ... The power goes out ... Even if it's only for 3-4 hours ... Having this item sure was comforting ... So read up on it ... AND ... Once again ... Keep in mind that this is my personal experience and review of the Anker C1000 ... Thanks for reading ...
reviews.title: A MUST for a QUICK Emergence Power Fix
reviews.author: A.

reviews.body: I use the unit for emergency backup for my i/2 size 100W 1.5 Amp freezer. It ran off the station for 12 hours and still had 35% charge left. I then connected it to three 100w solar panels and it charges one % every 4 minutes. Very robust for its size. I have yet to try it on my main refrigerator/freezer. It is small and light, with handles to make it easy to carry around and store in your RV, Car, or in your house. It does not connect to the standard RV solar panel connectors, so you will need to order an adaptor cable to plug into the XT60 station connection. I wanted something that would run all night without running out of juice. This works for me.
reviews.title: AnkerSOLEX C1000 1600W Solar Power Station
reviews.author: D.P.R.

reviews.body: 1kWh of capacity is the perfect size for running a 12v fridge/freezer for the weekend (2-3 days easily). Not too heavy or big to carry around (only around 25lb) but enough power to run air fryer or electric grill as well. The 600w XT60 port can charge at high speed with a 560w car alternator charger (sold elsewhere). Rated to -4C in discharge mode is also very nice. Of all portable power stations on the market I would recommend this one first. It’s perfect. One note, in high output/input AC mode (above 600w) the fans sounds like a space heater, but the fan profile is smooth (no spiking on and off) so it’s more white noise.
reviews.title: Perfect size for car, camping, and 12v fridges
reviews.author: K.C.

reviews.body: Received this product and used it for the first time at my off-grid cottage this weekend and I must say that I wish I would have purchased this unit from the start. Seems like a great compact package with a nice display and easy to use App. I did have to by an adapter to hook up my already installed 400W solar panels, but it was cheap and easy to install. I run a dual compartment 12V fridge and LED lights throughout my cottage, phone charging and a radio all day and into the evening and only used 65% of the first battery which I was pleasantly surprised about. it was raining most of the time and i only seen a high of 40ish watts of power being generated by my solar panels so little to no charging during this period of use.

reviews.body: Looks and feels like a high quality product. It charged up pretty fast, no issues. It ran my 43" Roku TV (pulling about 30W) for 2 movies and still had over 85% charge left. I also had the light on and charged my laptop a little. The light is a soft, warm light, which is good. It has three settings: low, medium, and high. I can't speak to long term results but first impressions are very good.

reviews.author: sb98neon

reviews.body:
The purchase transaction was quick and smooth. However, it has been a week now and no product arrived yet. The Anker tracking info page has no tracking progress. CANPAR site shows the item sitting in the same location for the last 4 days. I will update this review once i receive the unit and get to test it.
Update: Apr.15, 2025. CS escalated the matter with CANPAR and now i have the units on hand. First impression is good. Compared to competition, charging at around 600w is almost silent and no fan is heard. You can choose to charge at a higher rate but it is not good for the health of the batteries.. unit looks well built and robust. Will see how it will hold against time and when i do actually perform efficiency test.
Update: 2. Apr.15, 2025. Took off one start for app features it lack off i should say. There is no option to choose how high you want to charge the unit and how low you want it to go before cutting off. The competition allows for that in addition to specifying the percentage you want done with AC and then the rest will be charged using solar only. Also, when both AC and Solar are connected together, the unit seems to default to AC instead of using solar to save you money.
