name: Era 100 Smart Speaker
bestFor: Stereo acoustic architecture with AirPlay 2, Bluetooth and Sonos Voice

reviews.body:
This has genuinely changed my enjoyment of my house. We stayed in a hotel recently that had the original Sonos speakers (the Play ones?) all around. I was incredibly impressed by the bass response and general balance, particularly given the small size.

I had been missing a good sound setup at home so decided to purchase one of these. I should have done this a long time ago! The sound is extraordinary and I find myself listening to it most evenings rather than turning on the TV.

Don't hesitate like I did!
reviews.title: Why did I wait so long?
reviews.author: Ryan

reviews.body: I don't consider myself tech savvy but I think I might be above average in technology setup. It was very easy to set up. Packaging was beautiful - great presentation and first impression matters! The speaker itself is also beautiful and fit the aesthetics of my small apartment well. The sound is absolutely amazing, which I expected no less from Sonos. Pairing to my MacBook, iPad, iPhone, and smart TV were all very easy to do. I appreciate the great sound.
reviews.title: Great buy for my small apartment
reviews.author: August

reviews.body:
Day one with the Era 100s has been quite the journey. My initial plan was to use the Era 100s in a pair in the office, then add a subwoofer, and eventually, a Beam 2 when I move the setup to the lounge. My first impression? The WiFi setup left something to be desired.

Given that my office is in a remote part of the house with no Ethernet ports, I'm relying solely on WiFi. This setup has posed some challenges. Although I've had no issues adding devices elsewhere in the office, I struggled with setting up the speakers. I took care to set them up one at a time to ensure a trouble-free process.

Updating the first speaker took a few attempts, but once it was done, I was pleasantly surprised by the sound quality. The second speaker encountered the same WiFi update issues. I walked from the office with my iPhone to the router and back several times before it finally connected.

Despite my initial frustrations with the setup process-likely due to WiFi limitations-the stereo mode setup was smooth and sounded fantastic. I tested it with music from my iPhone and movies on my iPad, and everything worked beautifully until the right speaker stopped due to a WiFi dropout. A quick unplug and replug resolved the issue.

I connected my Apple TV to the monitor and was impressed with the AirPlay performance. The audio synced perfectly during movies, and both dialogue and action scenes sounded great.

Here's how I'd rate the experience so far:

Setup Process: 3/5 - A bit challenging, possibly due to WiFi issues.
App Performance: 2/5 - The app was quite slow.
Sound Quality: 4.5/5 - Much better than I expected, though there's room for improvement as I'm still on day two and concerned about sync issues.
The original plan was to use these as an entry point to a wireless system, eventually adding a sub and a soundbar. Despite the WiFi sync problems, I'm impressed with the Era 100s. They're about a third of the size of the speakers I replaced but deliver exceptional sound. I'm intrigued by the potential of investing further in this setup.
reviews.title: Let's talk Wi-Fi
reviews.author: Cheeky Monkey

reviews.body: The speaker was very easy to set up and to add to an existing Sonos system. The instructions were simple and precise - the software did all the work, even down to "tuning" the speaker to the room's acoustic. The sound is clear, but not overly bright, and the bass is agile and well-defined for a speaker of this size. Overall, I am very pleased with the overall musicality of the speaker. It also performs very well on spoken word content (e.g., podcasts and radio broadcasts), with a very natural sound.
reviews.title: Excellent sound and easy to set up
reviews.author: Joe

reviews.body: My first setup was in the bedroom with two Era 100 as a stereo pair, - excellent sound with deep Bass good Midrange and Treble. Even if this setup was very satisfying, I bought the Sub Mini which added an additional dimension to the sound and I couldn't be happier. But ... I was missing not having music in the living room and decided to get another Era 100, very happy with that choice too. I'm pretty sure there will be more Sonos products in my home in the future
reviews.title: I just added another Sonos speaker to my previous setup.
reviews.author: Newtops

reviews.body: I bought one of these to replace a different wireless speaker that didn't sound all that great and had occasional issues with dropping the connection to Spotify. I had this one set up and working in about 5 minutes, and I'm happy with the audio performance and problem-free connectivity. I installed the Sonos app on my phone, but I don't really use it; I stream directly from Spotify, and it works well.
reviews.title: Great sounding speaker, simple setup
reviews.author: Audio geek

reviews.body: Great little speakers, plus work even better as a pair to get great stereo sound from any source. Excellent product for a small to medium sized room with sound that fills your space with brilliant music reproduction easily connected from any source & works great as a full house setup connecting with all your other rooms creating one single sound throughout your entire house. Easily recommended speaker with simple setup & great sound for its size
reviews.title: Good little Speaker
reviews.author: Goofy

reviews.body: I have a number of Sonos products at home and wanted to add another small wired Sonos. I like the era 100 since the quality is slightly better than the One - but comes slightly larger. However it does allow WiFi and Bluetooth connections which is great when your friends want to connect to the device. Overall easy to set up and the controls are intuitive. Would be happy to add another if there was a need.
reviews.title: Nice improvement on the Sonos One, Bluetooth and WiFi ready
reviews.author: Xtraz82

reviews.body: Great sound overall, being able to control it from my iPhone enjoy that, I didn't like the fact that you couldn't hook it directly up to your TV without another Sonos product, especially when it's Bluetooth as well. I bought this at Costco on a promo and still haven't received whatever Sonos is offering big challenge there. I don't think consumer should ever have to challenge, especially when the companies initiating something not the biggest deal, but you wanna know I'm a consumer that enjoys these type of products if it wasn't easy to use, I probably wouldn't or would have taken them back because of the baiting switch I thought I was given.
reviews.title: Great product
reviews.author: Bear

reviews.body: I have just replaced an old early generation alexa which was connected to an old JVC iPod speaker. This a a nice sleek unit with a great sound. The only downside is that the microphones don't seem to be quite as good as on the old Alexa meaning she often seems a bit deaf and I have to shout her name a few times before she responds. I was hoping the voice feature would be an improvement on the old tech but sadly not.
reviews.title: Great sound but a bit deaf
reviews.author: Keebab

reviews.body: I am using this product as a speaker at my desk. I like the way it sounds but there are a lot of things about using this Sonos speaker that I wish were better. Firstly, it is not compatible to set up surround sound with older products (ie. Sonos playbase). I have no idea why this is the case. It should be as simple as setting up the phone application to direct which sounds go to which speakers. This should be easy to do in 2024... I want to have the flexibility to add a lot more Sonos products to my home stereo, but I feel Sonos is making it difficult for me to do so. Second, the speaker is not very customizable. The EQ options for the speaker are very limited, allowing only a discrete slider for Bass and Treble with little option to change more of the sound wave form. Again, in 2024, this should be easy to set up and modify. Lastly, I found that the application on the phone is quite difficult to use. For example, I had trouble figuring out how to synchronize the speakers in different rooms to play the same sound. I also had difficulty in figuring out where to specify what the input should be for each speaker in my home system. I think the App is very disorganized at the moment, but it should be easy to fix with an App update. Overall, I think the hardware is great, but the software around it that Sonos provides needs some serious updates to use the product to its full potential. Given the expensive price, I expected the experience to be better.
reviews.title: I this but I wish surround system is more flexible
reviews.author: Kyle

reviews.body: This replaced a Bose. Not only does it look better, but has great sound for a small foot.print and is easier to operate. I talk to my Sonos and it obeys. One happy customer with this purchase, and probably I will purchase more for other rooms in my house. The embedded radio stations are good too. Though there is some advertising it is discrete.
reviews.title: So happy with my Era 100
reviews.author: ViviS

reviews.body: Right out of the box these speakers impressed. Quality materials and solid construction, super easy to set up the whole system with the Sonos app. I bought 2 pair of the Era 100 and Mini sub for my open floor plan home. Full range sound that doesn't distort even at max volume. The bass out of these speakers is perfect. The Alexa interface is nice, and you really only need to set it up on one speaker if you have multiple locations. Added control of your music subscriptions through the app is pretty great too. I have a pair in my family room set up as stereo with the mini sub added there, wow! Unbelievable listening experience. I have already recommended these to several friends who also enjoy music. Great job Sonos
reviews.title: Blown away by this speaker
reviews.author: Drbll

reviews.body: Love the sound quality and the flexibility of this product and system. It's the ability to move my speakers anywhere and customize my home's sound environment on the fly that got me to purchase Sonos in the first place. Unfortunately, the 'performance' has been erratic. It can work great for 2 or 3 days - beautiful sound throughout my house - and then suddenly "poof!", there's the silent void, 'no content available' ( or something like that ), and none of the devices are detectable, or just one ad none of the others, etc. It can be so extremely frustrating. I keep thinking it's something I'm doing wrong - but then I see other people online complaining about the same thing, so it's apparently not just me. It's such a great concept - I don't even care if I have to buy a dedicated tablet just for the controls of this system - I just don't want to have to keep connecting it and reconnecting it, over and over and over. It takes so much of the joy out of this otherwise awesome product and system.
reviews.title: Great product - yes, I'd recommend - with some caveats
reviews.author: marlene

reviews.body: I love these speakers. I'm able to stream music from my phone. I use YouTube music primarily and it's a seamless operation via Apple Airplay or Bluetooth. The speakers couldn't be easier to set up. I'm enjoying them so much that I'm considering expanding my system to include tos Sonos soundbar and bass module. In addition I'm thinking of buying more speakers to expand to other rooms.
reviews.title: Great product, I want more of the Sonos line
reviews.author: Joey

reviews.body:
Main use case is playing the same music in multiple rooms for parties and such and it works perfectly. The sound is great. Easy to use and setup.

My only negative is that the Sonos music stations are a little limited. And it seems like they might be Playlists instead of stations (seems like they start on the same song every time). But we usually use Spotify anyway and I imagine most others will. Integration is seamless. And it doesn't need Bluetooth so you can run it from your phone without having all phone sounds come through the speaker.
reviews.title: Happy with the purchase
reviews.author: Josh

reviews.body: The sound quality of the speaker is great and the wireless connectivity is easy to use. The limitation is with the Line-In connection which unless your device has a usb-c output you will need the sonos adapter to connect a device with a 3.5mm audio cable. No other adapters seem to work as the digital to analog on most other connectors is apparently the wrong direction.
reviews.title: Good Sound, Line In connectivity limited
reviews.author: Peter

reviews.body: These are great. Fantastic sound bass is spot on we love em in a large living room not a bad thing to say and they look cool too . Good weight to these too get them. It's 360deg sound I've not had any better surround sound speakers ever. I've had a few Sony Samsung lg the normal brands these are top notch premium purchase we are not looking back enjoy .
reviews.title: Quality sound
reviews.author: Davor

reviews.body: We set this up in our dining room, and the difference in sound quality between this and the old unit we had is unbelievable. Deep base and smooth highs, vs the tinny sound the old, non-Sonos unit I had. Generally, just stream Pandora from my phone to it and could not be more pleased with how well it works. Simple set-up and high-quality output.
reviews.title: One of my best purchases EVER!
reviews.author: Mountain Man

reviews.body: Great sound quality for its size, with clear vocals and solid bass. Setup is quick and painless through the Sonos app. Connectivity is flexible with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and AirPlay support. The controls are simple and it fits easily into a multi-room setup. A reliable, no-fuss speaker that delivers exactly what you expect from Sonos.
reviews.title: Big Sound, Simple Setup
reviews.author: Colli84

reviews.body: I have a single Era 100 in my small office and use it to stream music while I work (using Apple Music and an iPhone) and group it with my Beam that is in my living room for multi-room music listening while I'm walking around the house. Being able to easily group and ungroup the speakers is magic - you can do it directly in Airplay controls on an iPhone just by checking and unchecking your speakers - love it! The sound of the single Era 100 in the office is incredible, the bass is nice and punchy and it has nice stereo sound for being just a single speaker. The speaker really punches above its weight - it is LOUD! This is my second Sonos speaker and the sound quality and build quality of their products is worth the cost, they sound and look amazing.
reviews.title: Great sounding speaker on it's own
reviews.author: Nealien

reviews.body: The pair are the perfect and discreet addition to complement our renovated living room. The speakers defy their size and amply fill the room, faithfully reproducing the strains of jazz, blues and other genres of music. The ranges and subtleties are not lost in the ERA 100.....audio equipment has come a long in reducing speaker size and improving sound quality and this Sonos product does not disappoint. I haven't any other reference to compare the sound quality but I know enough to know what is good and these are impressive.
reviews.title: First time Sonos buyer with no regrets!
reviews.author: RDG

reviews.body:
I have Sonos speakers in most of my rooms and enjoy their flexibility in choosing different music choices in each room or the same choice in all rooms.
The quality of sound is excellent and the ease of use is a must for me.
The App is easy to navigate even for me as a non technical person.
Overall very happy with the system I have and often get asked about them when I have any visitors.
reviews.title: Great speakers
reviews.author: Jim

reviews.body: system is outstanding-clear, balanced sound that fills the room without distortion. Setup is effortless through the app, and multi-room syncing works flawlessly. The design is sleek and blends into any space. Whether streaming music, TV, or podcasts, it delivers premium quality every time. A true upgrade for home audio!
reviews.title: Sounds amazing and simple install
reviews.author: Les

reviews.body:
I generally like the design & sound that comes with owning an Era 100. Love that I can use it along with my other AirPlay speakers in any config I feel like in the moment.

Have to admit that, as I used it more, I became slightly less satisfied with the low-mid representation with my test playlist (some details becoming nearly unnoticeable compared to my work setup (Volt 1 + DT990 Pro)). Oddly enough, vocals seem to be artificially prominant...but to its benefit. The best thing going for it is the "Loudness" option in the EQ (does wonders for late-night quiet listening). Bass is well represented & sub-bass is certainly there. The "kick" component of bass overshadows "hum" a bit much for my taste.

Good overall & definitely accomplishes its goals...but I want my multi-band EQ lol.
reviews.title: Great speaker to start building a home system with
reviews.author: Q

reviews.body: I've recently upgraded my surround sound system with a Sonos Arc Ultra, Sub 4 and two Era 300s. Beyond blown away by the packaging. Set up, placement, auto tuning, and using the app could not be easier or simpler. Love everything so much that I also purchased an Era 100 for my kitchen and a Roam 2 for my main bathroom. The fact that I can just say 'Hey Sonos connect to living room' and immediately get the same sound of what's on in my living room in my kitchen, bathroom and wherever I want to take the Roam with me is AMAZING. I could not be happier with my purchases from Sonos. And their customer service... right after I purchased the Era 100 and Roam 2, I got an email about them being on sale.. I chatted with Customer Service and they were able to refund me 100 bucks back to account for the new lower price difference. Sonos has a customer for life!
reviews.title: LOVE my new Sonos system
reviews.author: CatMom

reviews.body:
I have bought a pair of ERA 100. This upgraded my home listening in a crazy way. I can walk around my appartment and have a great sound. I create a stereo pair when I want to listen with attention to music, or when I want to watch movie. The initial set up was absolutely simple.
Cons - I can not connect to Alexa, because of location :-(
reviews.title: Love at first sight (song)
reviews.author: Peter

reviews.body: These speakers have superior sound and it's so nice to go from room to room listening to my favorite music as I do stuff around the house. I first heard these speakers in a friend's house and decided to buy 1 to see how I liked it. I liked it so much I immediately bought 3 more while they were on sale. Wait for the sale...it's a big discount.
reviews.title: I now own 4 of these speakers! They are wonderful!
reviews.author: Jimmy K

reviews.body:
I had high expectations for the sound quality, it's good but I wasn't blown away by it. Perhaps I would appreciate it more if I had a pair of these devices, maybe I'll get another one.
Very easy to set up, great that Alexa is built in, I don't miss the Echo Show it replaced. It's helpful that it looks great too. I may gradually replace all my Echo devices with more of these.
reviews.title: Very good
reviews.author: Sonicscot

reviews.body: Grandpa wanted the best of both random internet radio and his own music sources. The Bose Soundtouch , in a small room, was perfect for that, for years. Sonos era of course has better sound, but in the most important ways for me, phone - app dependent. Fine, if you live through your phone. For this user, less user- friendly than the old Soundtouch. But beautiful sound that could fill a room twice as large as the one I have my stereo pair in.
reviews.title: It depends
reviews.author: Grandpa

description: With its sleek black design, the Sonos Era 100 wireless speaker will fill any room in your home with rich, immersive sound. This Bluetooth and Wi-Fi enabled speaker effortlessly streams all your favorite music, podcasts and more from services like Spotify, Apple Music, and Amazon Music. Controlled completely through the Sonos app, the Sonos Era 100 allows you to listen to different songs in different rooms or group multiple speakers together for a multi-room listening experience. The speaker's capacitive touch controls let you easily play, pause or skip tracks right on the device. Designed to withstand humidity, this durable speaker can be used in the bathroom or outdoors. And with built-in Amazon Alexa and Apple Air. Play 2 compatibility, you can use your voice to operate the speaker hands-free. So whether you're hosting a dinner party or just relaxing at home, the Sonos Era 100 speaker delivers bold, balanced audio and seamless wireless connectivity. Let this sleek smart speaker fill your home with music you'll love. The manufacturer's part number for this product is E10G1AU1BLK. Bring home rich, immersive sound with the Sonos Era 100 today.

name: Era 300 Spatial Audio Speaker
bestFor: Dolby Atmos spatial audio with 6 directional drivers
description: Step into superior sound with the Sonos Era 300. This sleek wireless speaker pumps out room-filling audio in true Sonos style, blending modern aesthetics with smart connectivity for fuss-free streaming. With Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on board, you can jam to your favourite playlists from any device. Control is a breeze with the Sonos app, Air. Play 2 and built-in voice control with Amazon Alexa. Touch controls let you skip tracks or adjust volume right on the speaker. Slim and subtle, the Era 300 makes an elegant statement on any shelf or tabletop thanks to its matte black finish and compact footprint measuring just 160mm high x 260mm wide x 185mm deep. The durable polycarbonate housing shrugs off moisture so you can enjoy stellar sound in the kitchen or bathroom worry-free. Inside you'll find custom-designed drivers and advanced processing that delivers clear, balanced audio with plenty of detail and depth. This wireless speaker is optimised to fill rooms with immersive, faithful sound that brings music, movies and more to life. With modern styling and smart streaming in a durable, compact form, the Sonos Era 300 makes it easier than ever to enjoy brilliant sound anywhere at home. The manufacturer's part number for this product is E30G1AU1BLK. Learn more about the Sonos Era 300 online today.

name: Move 2 Portable Smart Speaker
bestFor: Weatherproof outdoor speaker with 24-hour battery life & stereo sound

specifications.name: Output Level (SPL)
specifications.value: Plays about 25% louder than the Sonos One, Able to go louder than the One, Doesn't play as loud as the Sonos Play:5

reviews.body:
The speaker is wonderful! Love the sound, it looks great, and being able to move it around the house, because it's battery powered, is the way of the future.

The app, however, could be smoother. It took me 4 tries to create a 'system' with my first one (but adding a 2nd and 3rd worked perfectly)

Adding speakers to 'rooms' seems outdated now that the speakers get moved around at will. Makes sense to rethink that for the future.

Little things like charging/battery status are available but not prominent- they could be displayed without so much tapping on UI elements. Low battery or charging status is not shown on the speaker at all - use of the LED on the front would make sense.

Being able to name a room, but not the speakers in it, is an oversight - especially if you have multiple of the same speaker model in a room. Choosing them would be guesswork.

I do love the Spotify integration, though now that the speakers show up also in AirPlay it's confusing because popup windows that try to help you, don't say which method of connection they are part of.

That's all I've noticed so far
reviews.title: Wonderful speaker, quirky app
reviews.author: Rob

reviews.body: This WAS the absolute best portable speaker on the market, crisp highs, excellent low range for it's size. It learns based on it's location and creates better sound. However, after less than a year of use, the speaker will not connect anymore. I spent over 2 hours on the phone with support. They said (reset after reset) I'm out of luck and they would send me a voucher for 30% off a replacement only AFTER I send this speaker back in. For something of this price I hoped for better customer service. I'm glad I have a full Sonos suite of products because I love them. But I'll look elsewhere when it comes time to replace my system. Sad.
reviews.title: I LOVED this speaker
reviews.author: Donny McCurdy

reviews.body: I have wanted one of these speakers for a very long time and finally ordered it, I couldn't be happier, the sound quality is fantastic, its quite a large speaker and I didn't realise it would be this big. Easy enough to carry around the house/outside. It's expensive but a worthwhile investment. This is my first Sonos purchase and I will definitely be buying more.
reviews.title: Wonderful Speaker
reviews.author: Raj007

reviews.body:
My wife wanted a high quality portable stereo to work without wires around the house.
We bought two Sonos moves.
Sound quality is great. App seems hard to work with and needs to be more step by step - for different things you can/need to do for the speakers. Still have't been able to get our WiFi compatible CD player to work with them.
reviews.title: Sound is brilliant but app seems hard to work with
reviews.author: Sizzy M

reviews.body: Bought a used Move on ebay so I could expand my S1 Sonos system into my master bathroom. Also wanted to be able to listen to programming on my phone via the Bluetooth option. Had to reset the speaker from Sonos 2 to Sonos 1 in order for it to operate on my older system. Suggest turning off when not in use, the battery tends to run low quickly when on for prolonged periods of time. Happy with the sound, functionality, and convenience.
reviews.title: Happy with Purchase
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.body:
It's weighty but feels incredibly well built and sturdy out of the box, plus it looks great!
I wasn't after a speaker to go travelling with, but to move around the house and into the garden with.
It connects really easy to the app and links with other sonos speakers in the house which was one of the main reasons i brought this.
It sounds great, clear clarity and a deep bass, gave me goosebumps when i turned it up.
Extremely happy with it
reviews.title: Solid sounding speaker that packs a punch
reviews.author: DomJW

reviews.body:
I bought this a week ago & my Grandson offered to help set it up. I'm pretty good with things like that but didn't want to put him off. I shouldn't have worried; setting it up was a doddle. We experimented with the sound in different rooms & both agreed how powerful it was, it could entertain in a large hall without sound distortion or softly as desired. I wanted a system with a good bass but not one that would swallow the other sounds; perfect. The bass is strong, as advertised and something I wanted. I wasn't expecting the sound to be so rich. To have this small portable object, to be able to meet everything I wanted is amazing. Much is written about it being heavy, but I don't think it is and I would have noticed if it was very heavy as I've had major spinal surgery and may be shortly having more. I liked that the charger is a ring the Move sits on. It charges up well & lasts for ages. It's been thoughtfully designed so it's nice to look at and the smooth surfaces are nice to touch. I've used it both as WiFi & Bluetooth with no problems at all. As yet, I haven't experienced everything the Move can do, but so far I'm delighted. Well worth the money.

As for the order - very simple & extremely quick delivery. Well done.
reviews.title: Sonos Move - A great move as it turns out
reviews.author: Amante

reviews.body:
First what I love: 1) Great sound quality - all ranges and volumes. This was my #1 priority. 2) The adjustable EQ settings in the app is a great feature - it's nice to be able to adjust for different times of day, room size or volume level. Also appreciate the compression level settings. 3) AirPlay mode is nice for sound quality. The unavoidable drawback being that it burns through speaker and phone power more quickly than BT mode. 4) Looks great. Simple and clean design, yet not boring. 5) Easy to move and fits pretty much anywhere I want to set it. 5) Moisture and dust resistance. 6) Ability to control volume, play/pause and track skipping from the speaker.

Complaints: 1) Don't like the "sleep" mode - it will turn back on randomly, sometimes when I don't want to broadcast what I'm currently listening to/watching on my phone, or just sits turned on, burning battery life for hours before I notice. 2) Turning off takes too long (5sec hold). Should just be 1sec on/off (with no sleep mode). 3) When using AirPlay, takes a long time to reconnect to the network after being turned on, during which time you're unable to change it to BT mode. 4) When turned off in BT mode, it will often try connecting to the network/AirPlay rather than resuming in BT mode. 5) No Aux/headphone jack 6) App (minor) - the only settings I really use are the EQ and being able to check the battery level. Only wish the EQ settings were quicker to access in the app menus, and it would be nice if they were accessible during BT play (only available during AirPlay/network mode). Some of the other settings are necessary and nice, however I only have one speaker so I haven't had to pair with another for speaker (although this seems like a cool feature), and I do not use either the voice assistants or any of the media/content controls through the app, so I cannot speak to those. It'd be nice to have a slightly cheaper version that excludes the voice assistant & microphone.

Overall: Great speaker - highly recommended (I might buy another in the future to pair with it). A tad expensive (got it on sale for $330), but still feels worth every dollar, assuming it lasts (I've had it for about 3 months at the time of this review). I am still very satisfied with this purchase despite my knit-picky gripes. It would be extra super awesome if it had a small, FULLY adjustable LED band between the base and the grill that wrapped around same length as the grill. Also a aux jack and a dust cover for it and the usb jack. Thanks SONOS for a great product!
reviews.title: Fantastic Speaker
reviews.author: Devin the Dude

reviews.body:
I own 12 Sonos speakers at home. I recently installed an outdoor Sonance system powered by a Sonos amp, and mounted the speakers over my deck.

It's great, but I needed to get the sound out to the pool area, and when they introduced the Move I figured it'd be perfect. A recent sale caught my eye, and I pulled the trigger.

Boy, am I thrilled! This little wonder is phenomenal. It syncs perfectly with my home/outdoor system and sounds incredible!

I'm currently on vacation renting a house at the beach and this speaker goes with me everywhere - from the beach on Bluetooth to any room in the house on Wi-Fi. It connects so easily and sounds amazing. All my friends came over and remarked how good the bass response is on the beach and how clean the music is. The functionality is 100% the same as any Sonos speaker. I love that it's weatherproof and the battery life so far is 8-10 hours! Amazing!

This is a gem, and my son wants one for his room, as does my daughter. I'm gonna need to upgrade the Wi-Fi we have so many of these speakers!

Greatest invention of the 21st century for music, IMHO.

Thanks, Sonos! Get one - you will love it.
reviews.title: Wonderful, wireless incredible Sonos sound!
reviews.author: JimmyM

reviews.body: I am very pleased with having purchased the SONOS move 2. Although I am in the SONOS ecosystem with A Beam Gen 2 and mini Sub - this speaker is a great addition to my set up. As i intend to use this around the house and in the garden - i consider that it is portable and the weight does give it that premium quality build feel. It may be a little heavy for carrying around on trips out - so a smaller speaker would probably be more suitable. The first thing to say is that the sound quality on this speaker is super - It is very impressive on its own. Adding it to a Beam Gen 2 and mini sub it also compliaments the home set up in my lounge - bringing real depth to when i watch my music concerts. The battery life is reported as being very good and the battery is eventually replaceable. i cannot comment on the voice activation features - as it doesn't use Siri, however i don't use these on my other SONOS devices, which is something which is available to use - but not a killer feature for me. Although the SONOS move 2 is at the top of the price range for such a product at full rrp price - however you do get what you pay for and if you manage to get any discount / use JL rewards - this is definitely worth considering. I do not regret getting this speaker and as there is the possibility to add another Move 2 to create a stereo pair in the future - if the need / desire arises. However that may be more of a luxury. SONOS APP is very reliable and great for apple music and grouping your Sonos devices with individual flexibility. I always buy good equipment. Am very pleased.
reviews.title: SONOS MOVE 2 NO REGRETS
reviews.author: Jono

reviews.body:
We've been using a 1st Gen Echo ever since it came out. I found a charging base for it, which made it portable for our outdoor patio, but over the years, the sound has diminished greatly (and in reality, the sound was never something I applauded). I have 2 other Echo speakers with screens, which I enjoy, but they are not portable and have to be plugged in at all times.

It got to a point where I began researching new options, realizing we needed something new, and definitely something portable.

It really came down to a BOSE unit and the SONOS Move. When I saw them both side by side, I was a little surprised how small the BOSE speaker was. When I compared the sound, the choice was pretty clear for me - SONOS Move was going to be my new baby, and purchased it, wrapped it up, put it under the tree, and addressed it to "the house", from Santa.

My wife was not initially very happy, even though she was the one who continuously said we needed something new for music. Even when I unboxed it, she was mostly concerned with how much "Santa" spent on it.

Well, let's just say that once I played some tunes, her thoughts changed, and the more we play it, the more she's impressed.

For me, it's nothing short of awesome. I haven't had a sound system in the last 15 years (other than sound bars for the TV's) and I must have forgotten how good music can sound. The deep, rich bass, the solid mid range, and of course, the high end treble.

But it's much more, really, as I now pick up things I haven't heard in so many years. Different instruments, sounds, clarity. Overall richness. It's just great.

I love the simple yet oh so effective charging system. So easy to pick it up and bring it outside, then drop it back down on the charging ring. Absolutely love it.

The Move is obviously a little big and heavy to bring on trips that require a flight, but when we drive somewhere, it's coming along for the ride. Love the fact that I have both wifi and Bluetooth.

Very impressed.
reviews.title: Awesome...just simply AWESOME!
reviews.author: Kid Bush

reviews.body: I replaced an older Klipsch battery powered Bluetooth speaker that I gave our son with this Sonos unit. The sound is great and it is very simple to charge in the house on a windowsill. While I won't treat this like an all weather speaker, I do like having the option to move it outside to our standalone garage, or to my shed/workshop, or even near our garden, with it on a tractor. The Bluetooth connection is very strong and overall, I am very happy with the purchase.
reviews.title: Great product and weighty.
reviews.author: BIGCRCIII

reviews.body:
I have had several Amazon Echos and bought several battery bases to allow them to be fully portable.

None lasted very long mainly a problem with the battery bases. Although the speakers were "adequate" they are simply not very responsive.

Clearly these speakers including the cost of the battery bases were much cheaper than the Move however depending on how long it lasts it might well prove cheaper in the long run.

The Sonos Move is portable although a little too large to take it backpacking it's great for the garden and taking to outside events. It works well with my Android tablet and phone on blue tooth and wifi... It also works well with Alexa..with a very easy setup.

I've really not had it long enough to determine how long the battery lasts after a full charge or how far from my wireless router it will actually work... Although it seem OK in the detached garage and shed... Both are 30 metres from the house and router... Not tried it in a really damp environment yet although it is ip56 so should meet my needs...

Overall very pleased with the product...
reviews.title: Fantastic Speaker That does exactly what I needed

reviews.body:
I purchased the Move as a companion to Sonos Port and Sonos Amp. The Port feeds into my stereo receiver which powers two pairs of indoor speakers and two pairs of patio speakers. The Amp powers my outdoor kitchen speakers and takes the outdoor TV input (thanks HDMI ARC). The Move is the "free safety" that can move around the backyard and help keep the music evenly distributed without having to crank the other speakers.

First, the pros: The Move sounds great. Great companion speaker for my home office. Great by the pool,
when everything is working. My overall plan is working as designed and I'm happy with the overall Sonos experience.

The cons: The Move is "fickle", meaning it has a hard time connecting to the Sonos system and picking up what's playing in my zones. This could be related to my WiFi, but there's nothing to indicate whether it's connected or not. Where's the sound to alert me to a connectivity problem? There doesn't seem to be a sound when I power it on, just when I power it off, so I'm never sure if it's really on and trying to connect. Finally, when it does connect, the sound can be spotty for a few minutes. I usually have to fight with turning it on/off a few times to get everything working right. What's worse is that my teenagers and wife have a hard time getting it to work, too, so it takes away from the overall experience of Sonos. Overall, it feels like it's missing some usability features that would help me better diagnose product state/errors/etc.

Also, considering that the Move is splash resistant, where is the rubber cover for the USB-C port? It's already corroded after two months of indoor/outdoor use. I'd like to use that port as a second charging option (i think that's supported...) but I can't do that until I clean the corrosion off. Seems like a shortcut that should be reconsidered.

Overall I have a hard time recommending this specific Sonos product, it's doesn't quite deliver on the "Move" promise...
reviews.title: Great sound, sketchy performance and features
reviews.author: David

reviews.body:
I purchased this speaker to take with me on vacations. The sound is great and it does not have any issues with connections.

This is very frustrating to have this happen in the first week of a multi-month trip, leaving me to buy another speaker to use and then incur additional charges at the airport for luggage.

The problem seems that once this speaker drains all the way down to 0%, there is no way to charge it up without the dock. Now, I know what you are going to say: "Not enough watts/amps on your cable/charger bro", "Faulty USB-C cable". But no, neither.

I work from remote locations for months at a time and bring 3-100w USB-C cables with me as well as 2 - 100w and a 90w GaN power charger.

I tried them all. None worked. I took the same cable that charged my 16' Macbook Pro and left it plugged in all night multiple times. This speaker just blinks red for a couple of seconds then stays solid red... then NOTHING.

Upon returning home this time, I set the speaker on it's charging dock and a couple minutes later, it came back to life. I then verified that the most recent firmware is installed. After that, I unplug it from the dock and using the same USB-C cables and power brick as before, I see that it is charging fine in the app. It seems that this issue ONLY occurs if you let the battery drain down to 0%.

I have 3 Sonos speakers, 3 Bose speakers (all portable), and 5 Apple Home Pods in total. It's a hard one because I really like the sound vs portability of this Sonos speaker but I can not recommend this brand at all as they are the only ones that have given me problems on multiple occasions.
reviews.title: Great sound but with major flaws to the battery
reviews.author: GeoChristof

reviews.body:
Overall amazed with the sound quality. Good battery life and the handle is just perfect. Easy to setup and use. I'd never try another sound system again :) Only gonna get more and more separate speakers from SONOS!

- But since I care, I gotta mention some bugs or negative sides that I've encountered.

1. There's somekinda bug where the sound volume randomly drops by around 30%. It's very rare but I did have two of them in an hour recently.

2. Sometimes the speaker doesn't know to shut off/power save by itself. So if the speaker wasn't manually turned off then sometimes it just ran out of the whole battery while I didn't use it at all. And all that in one night or so.

3. It's nice to see how developed the SONOS app is but I still HAVE TO use it because using airplay through my music app (Tidal) I get annoying latency/delay and the phone sometimes doesn't recognize that the song is even playing so I lose the ability to change the sound volume.

Despite all that - thank you for everything!
reviews.title: So so worth the price!
reviews.author: Richy

reviews.body:
I own two Sonos Ones, a Move and a Boost.

The Sonos Move is designed to be a standalone speaker. It is battery powered and Bluetooth compatible. Since it has a battery and does not require Wi-Fi, it is very portable. Sound quality is good and battery life is great. You can take this portable speaker anywhere you have Bluetooth.
The Sonos Move is NOT compatible with the Boost (SONOS) network. I was very disappointed this fact is NOT mentioned in the sales information, documentation or online help.
The Move seemed finicky on my Wi-Fi EERO mesh network. Reinstallation with the incompatible Boost required extensive research of Sonos documentation, help and user forums. I eventually uninstalled both the iOS and Windows apps and performed several factory resets before the Move worked on the EERO mesh network. Because most of the documents does not mention the Move is NOT compatible with the Sonos network installation was not straight forward. Adding the Boost using the iOS app did not work as documented. The Sonos documentation and help were no help. The user forums sent me down a couple wrong paths but eventually provided the answers I needed.
reviews.title: Good Portable Speaker
reviews.author: Bill White Hair

reviews.body: This is my fifth Sonos speaker - my first Sonos Move. Like all their products, the sound is incredible and the device is easy to use. The setup, however, was an ordeal. My other four speakers were easy to set up, but there has been an update to the app, and you now need an 8-digit pin in order to complete the setup. The PIN is supposed to be on the back of the speaker. Well there is, if you have a microscope handy. On the upper edge of the rubber base, there is a PIN. It is embossed black on black, and is less than a millimetre in height. The only way I could get this was by using my phone camera to photograph it in strong light, then zooming in as far as the phone would allow and then deciphering the blurry image. Sonos somehow seems to think that customers can read this! Moreover, they seem to have introduced an extra step into the setup process the sole purpose of which is to make their products unusable for anyone who does not have advanced optical technology to hand. This is a major negative, and I hope Sonos will rethink it. I had to check my calendar to make sure it wasn't April fools' day.
reviews.title: Have your microscope ready
reviews.author: Woodbridge1965

reviews.body:
Bought myself this as a birthday present in May. Very simple to set up and even to pair with other Alexa devices. Sound is great and I adore being able to grab it off its base and move it around the garden with me. now that summer is over my boys have started to pinch it and use it in their bathrooms during bath time- again great as no plugs required and it easily fits up in top of bathroom cabinets to keep it out of the splash zone of small children (even though it is water resistant).
It does everything I had hoped it would, is light enough to be easily moveable in one hand without problems and a large comfy carrying slot in the back so even with gardening gloves on it isn't fiddly at all. Small enough to be unobtrusive when placed on a garden table whilst eating, but also powerful enough to be placed further away and provide great background music.
reviews.title: So simp[le and effective
reviews.author: Belleoftheball

reviews.body: I was introduced to this speaker when I rented a vacation home for a week back in October. I was so impressed with this speaker that my wife and I decided to treat each other to one for Christmas. I already have plenty of experience with portable speakers, but they're all bluetooth only. Being able to connect by Wifi makes all the difference, not to mention that the Move offers far superior sound to any bluetooth speaker that I've used. The speaker sits in the charging cradle the vast majority of the time in the center of my home, but it is really nice to be able to move it into another room or out onto my back porch as needed. We find that it works best if it is located against a wall in an adjoining room as a source of background music. You can then turn it up to get a fuller sound and not be overwhelmed by having the speaker sitting right on top of you. To sum it up, although the Move is expensive for a portable speaker, it is definitely a step up from a bluetooth speaker making it worth the money. We are very happy with our purchase.
reviews.title: A great-sounding well-built portable speaker
reviews.author: Music lover

reviews.body:
I use this as a second speaker in my kitchen, and also as my way into Alexa in that room. But I take it into the garden for BBQs etc. It is great to have the music in the garden and house in sync. The sound is surprisingly good for such a small unit, especially the bass. There is no issue getting good volume outdoors. The battery lasts for a very long time - about 9 hours.

Just to be clear, the charging stand is very discrete and there's no issue with using this in a fixed position in door on a semi-permanent basis.

Sonos customer service is also excellent. After about nine months, I dropped the Move outdoors and cracked it. It worked but looked awful and would clearly no longer be water resistant. So I rang Sonos to ask about paying for a repair, which they don't do. But they just replaced it, for free. In this day and age, that seems extraordinary.
reviews.title: Excellent product and excellent customer service
reviews.author: Robin

reviews.body:
So..... I have been, or was, a Bose customer for 35 years. I recently replaced our entire Bose system that included the Lifestyle Soundtouch 535 series III, 3 Bose Soundtouch 20's, 1 Soundtouch 30 and one 10. We replaced it with 6 Sonos one's, 2 Sonos Five's, 1 Move, 2 Arc's and one Sub. Every aspect of the new Sonos system is substantially better than the Bose products that we had. First, the sound is MUCH better. The home theater is amazing, we are hearing sounds that we never heard before. We play music all day and the sound throughout the house is absolutely awesome! The App is excellent, much better than Bose Soundtouch and with a ton more features, like an alarm that we can set to wake the entire house. And technical support is a 10! The build quality is outstanding and the unboxing experience is pretty darn awesome. Setup is so simple. I never was able to set up any of the Bose Lifestyle systems, and I've had 5 over the years, without calling support. I also love the history of Sonos.

Let me add, this portable speak is truly amazing!!!!!
reviews.title: Just buy it, you WILL love it!!!
reviews.author: Porsche Phil

reviews.body: The Sonos Move is a great product. It is Easy to set up, easy to use, and most important to me, a voice enabled, hands-free, high-quality music source. We use this in our backyard where we have a pool, so having a system that is loud enough is important. In addition, we love the fact that we can change music channels, sources, and volume without getting out of the pool to touch the device. This can also get the device wet, so the voice enabled hands-free option is paramount.
reviews.title: Dynamite Sound
reviews.author: Dee

reviews.body:
I've had quite a few speakers and this one is far more superior,
The sound is amazing inside outside in a small room in a big room.
Only downside I had was trying to set up the app on my phone was an absolute nightmare and I found out whilst trying to do that. It's a known problem.
But once you get past this, it's toasty worth it. It's an amazing speaker. I would highly recommend it to people.
reviews.title: I most definitely would buy this speaker again
reviews.author: Tinker

reviews.body:
This has to be one of my all time favorite purchases. I take my Roam everywhere with us. To the beach by the ocean it's loud and punchy enough to be heard over the waves.

It comes to the pool, or to the lake house - out by the water, on the boat, on the deck at night. Doesn't matter where or when because the battery lasts 10 hours in the sun. Leave it by the dock and don't care if the kids or dogs splash water around it - just wipe it off and it just keeps pumping out music.

Even when we're out of WiFi range just sync Pandora or Apple Music to the phone and switch to Bluetooth and it doesn't miss a beat.

The SVV being local and easy to use lowers the barrier to using to to less tech savvy people, and no worries about creepy big tech companies listening in.

The sound has to be the best out of any portable battery powered speaker. I've turned more people on to Sonos with this thing than the other $3k with I have around the house.
reviews.title: Must have travel/leisure companion
reviews.author: NuclearXP

reviews.body: I have multiple Sonos speakers in many rooms of my house. I absolutely love the sound that comes out of the Move and its ability to play loudly outside. I also have a Roam and a couple of One SLs. Also love their sound. However, I have to reset some of them from time to time due to connectivity issues and them disappearing from my internet system. And switching between Blue Tooth and WiFi is not seamless with my Moves and Roam. In fact it is often very frustrating. I also hate the fact that I can't easily connect my Move speakers to a friends Sonos system without resetting mine all together. You would think you could have a temporary connectivity setting so that you didn't have to reset things all together. Also, if someone else is trying to connect to my speaker to play their music, it is very difficult to do. I often have to turn my phone completely off for this to happen. Connectivity is my biggest complaint with Sonos. These are expensive, high-quality speakers, so it would be nice to have them be a little more user friendly.
reviews.title: The sound is great, but...
reviews.author: Constant Listener

reviews.body: My wife and I listen to music differently. When I want to enjoy music on a good sound system I head to Guyland in my basement and select from source choices for input and Big, Old, Heavy three-way speaker systems in furniture-like ported, floor standing cabinets - playable in combinations with a surround sound system. This is my heritage music system with many components dating back to the mid-1970s. My wife likes songs, sometimes. To her tastes, quiet is usually the best noise. Songs can play from internet streaming on a puck-like device that can also answer verbal questions. NOW, current best practices have caught up with us. Our children gave us a Sonos Move for Christmas. As I easily move the Move from Family Room to Living Room to Dinning Room and use my iPhone or iPad to control Spotify playlists or albums, my wife is definitely getting onboard the Better Sound train! She is even talking about adding other Sonos devices around the house! Sound is no longer noisy songs. We are enjoying a Rich Range of well engineered Sound that makes the music listening much more enjoyable! Wow, what a revelation.
reviews.title: We are Moving to Better Sound
reviews.author: Sailor Pat

reviews.body:
I have been very impressed since "getting my Move on" 3 weeks ago. Setting this device up was very simple. Streaming YouTube Music is a breeze; Apple Music is also easy but the voice control with Apple Music is not up to par as compared to YouTube (minor issue). The sound quality is very good (nice bass but not overwhelming like some speakers which act like they have something to prove) and volume is more than enough for even a large room. This is my first Sonos device I've had, so I can't comment yet on pairing with other devices (I'm looking forward to it though). It is easy to take from room to room and outside. Some reviewers have been concerned about the weight of the Move. I haven't found it to be an issue - but probably wouldn't take it along on a long hike. I'm looking forward to having it by the pool when it warms up.

Overall I am very pleased!
reviews.title: Simply wow!
reviews.author: FollyDad

reviews.body: I'd like to add another sound bar to my collection, but am concerned about my hearing. I can already really crank up the tunes to a deafinyng sound level in our house & I so often do! Since we were kicked out of the gym at the beginning of COVID, I started exercising in my basement and have 4 SL One & now just added MOVE to my listening arsenal; the tunes can get pretty loud in the house. MOVE is awesome as it travels with me outside on the deck when the weather is nice enough to exercise outdoors. At a company dinner in January another fellow i work with ( who is also in his 60's ) were discussing SONOS, how great the sound is and the simplicity of initial set up and how versatile it is to add more speakers in more rooms throughout the house & into the garage ( as there's very point to restricting great sound to indoor use only ) It's a fabulous audio system; I absolutely love it!
reviews.title: Awesome sound. I have a sound bar, 6 SL One's, ROAM & MOVE.
reviews.author: Squashcheeks

reviews.body: Mrs Clause was kind enough to put a pair of the Sonos Move speakers under the tree for me this year and they are great! They sound great, look great and perform well but not without issues. Setup was easy but I did have issues at first with pairing them together for stereo sound. I think the issue was with my ATT modem so I cant slam Sonos for this. The problem that I have is that each time I use them as a stereo I have to unpair then re-pair them otherwise they get out of sink or one just does not work at all. The Sonos tech said is was a channel issue with my modem and that ATT could fix the issue. Personally I would rather just unpair and repair each time rather than sitting on the phone with ATT tech support so for now thats what it is. The other poor issue is that you cant pair two of the Move speakers together in Bluetooth mode, this should be a simple programming issue that has long been known and not fixed. Both speaker show up on my phones bluetooth but only one will play at a time. Both of my ear buds show up just the same and they both play just fine so come on Sonos, fix the issue so we can enjoy stereo sound outside of the wifi connection.
reviews.title: They sound great but there are some issues.
reviews.author: Matt

description: Stream with Wi. Fi and Bluetooth Built-in Handle Ultra-wide soundstage with deep base Tunes itself like magic Effortless charging The Sonos Move is a durable, battery powered smart speaker which is perfect for both outdoor and indoor listening. The Sonos Move delivers impressive sound anywhere you go and for peace of mind is not only weatherproof but also drop-resistant too. You can control your new speaker with your voice, the Sonos app and also Apple Air. Play 2 whilst at home. When your Wi. Fi connection isn't available you can easily stream your favourite tunes via Bluetooth. The Move offers surprisingly deep bass for a small speaker, a wide soundscape and automatic Trueplay tuning which all perfectly balances the sound for where you are and what you are listening to. Thanks to built-in Google Assistant and Amazon Alexa, when you are connected to Wi. Fi you can play all of your favourite music, check the latest news, set alarms, get questions answered and much more, all hands free. Stream over Wi. Fi and connect Move to the rest of your Sonos system at home and switch to Bluetooth when you're away and offline. With an IP56 rating, Move stands up to rain, snow, dust, salt spray, UV rays, and extreme heat and cold. Move fits seamlessly into the included charging base and features an ergonomic handle, making it easy to pick up and carry. Read our independent product review on the Sonos Move here!

name: Beam (Gen 2) Compact Smart Soundbar
bestFor: Dolby Atmos TV soundbar with crystal clear speech enhancement

reviews.body: Quite an impressive soundstage from this system. Set-up was straight forward with the exception of the sub-woofer which needed to 'connect' with my iphone via Bluetooth seperately / in addition to utilising the Sonos app. Early days, but I'm happy with my purchase. Recommended for anyone with a moderate sized living room or flat. Please note - this is a complete 5.0.1 home threatre system which cannot accommodate any additional surround speakers but which does allow for one additional sub-woofer!
reviews.title: Sonos Beam + Sub Mini + 2 x Sonos ERA 100
reviews.author: Donald

reviews.body: Sonos equipment is on unimpeachable quality and the installation is a breeze. This setup provides high quality audio for home cinema and music and it is in latter that Sonos scores over competitors like Samsung who may give a greater bang for your buck but lack a little in style and refinement particularly in the bass performance. There is almost no boom with this system which audiophiles will appreciate. Modest in scale perhaps but balanced and engaging.
reviews.title: Sonos Beam + Sub Mini + 2 x Sonos ERA 100
reviews.author: Adrian

reviews.body:
I've had a Beam Gen 2 for a few months now and loving it. But wanted more for a new room, so decided to go for it and get all 3 sections - Front, Surrounds & Sub and I wasnt dissapointed. They were surprisingly easy to set-up and use too. Just plug in, they pop up on the Sonos S2 App, you do a software update, add them to your system and thats it.
After listening to lots of music, it sounds amazing, especially some of the Spatial Music with the surrounds. Then of course I watched Top Gun: Maverick - Incredible. It sounded amazing and the planes & missles literaly flew past you. I can't wait to re-watch all my favourite films again.
reviews.title: Sonos Beam + Sub Mini + 2 x Sonos ERA 100
reviews.author: Robert

reviews.body: Some good and bad - good is the purchase and delivery cycle from the supplier, ease of setup and use. Bad is the lack of specifics about power and volume of the kit and suitability for room. I have a lounge area of 7x3m and standard height and this system is of a very low output for the room, for almost £1,200 I think this is a bit poor. It would probably suit a room a third of half the size. Bad is also the Sonos app, worked at first but at some point update and lost the system and evereything now needs to be factory reset and done again - really poor QA but tbh the app setup is a poor idea anyway imho. The last two issues outweigh the good points, so best avoided and 3 stars is generous.
reviews.title: Sonos Beam + Sub Mini + 2 x Sonos ERA 100
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.body: Well worth the money, how do they get that sound from such small enclosures, must be dark magic. Blew my old AV amp and B&W sub and sats out the water. Technology moves on .
reviews.title: No regrets
reviews.author: peterbridge

reviews.body: Great sound as you’d expect and the fact that I can connect to the other Sonos speakers I have is brilliant. Love the vocal focus ability of the Beam too
reviews.title: Sonos Beam + Sub Mini + 2 x Sonos ERA 100
reviews.author: Simon C

description: Experience surround sound for home cinema and music with this compact smart soundbar and subwoofer plus rear speakers. Beam (Gen 2) immerses you in films, shows, and games with Dolby Atmos while Sub Mini balances the bass for clearer, richer sound. The Era 100 stereo pair brings every detail to life. Quickly set up and connect your system over Wi. Fi using the Sonos app, and enjoy easy control with your TV remote or voice.

name: Arc Premium Smart Soundbar
bestFor: 11 high-performance drivers for cinematic cinema sound in Australia

specifications.name: Connectivity

name: Sub Mini Wireless Subwoofer
