reviews.body: I've had this EcoBee Smart Thermostat Premium for a couple months and absolutely love it! It looks great on my wall, has many features and the App is super easy to use. Installation was easy and both sensors work perfect. At one point, I called the help line and uploaded photos into the App so they saw what I saw. The best, absolutely the best I have experienced! This EcoBee shows 4 days of weather, chance of rain, air quality, 3 time/temp settings for morning, day, night that I can change at any time from my phone or wall unit. It works with other Smart devices as well. I highly recommend EcoBee!
reviews.title: EcoBee - Great informative thermostat !
reviews.author: DianaB

reviews.body: This thermostat is just great. It has made a huge difference in our ability to regulate temperature in a very simple way - cooler at night and warmer during the day. Many thermostats can do that, but some are so complicated and so difficult to read because of dim screens and complex programming. I know this one can do more complex things than the competitors, but sometimes simpler is easier. And importantly, it is very bright and easy to see either day or night. My wife hates complex technology and she is in charge of home temperature regulation - remarkably, even she likes this thermostat. I was so happy to place the old, still working well thermostat, in the trash. As always, the staff at Lowes were just great help finding this thing and help me check out. Many thanks.
reviews.title: This is a great thermostat-easy to install and use
reviews.author: Latastia

reviews.body: Easy to install once you have the correct wiring. Ours was 1 four wire run, split half way into 2 two wire runs, then those were wire split into a 1 five wire. Wasn't sure how to use the adapter or running it straight. Ended up just running a completely new 5 wire from thermostat to HVAC and hooked it up directly, no adapter. Setup of the unit didn't go right the first time, but I did a reset and set it up correctly the second time. Just missed a step the first time. Once setup, it has been keeping our home nice and comfy. Love the time frames for when to change to a lower temp, no more forgetting and needing to go back downstairs at night. Set it and forget it. Love the Heat/Cool (Auto) so the thermostat knows when to turn the heat and/or cool on based on current temperature.
reviews.title: Excellent Thermostat
reviews.author: MichaelS

reviews.body: I purchased the Ecobee Premium last week to replace my Nest Generation 2. I'm happy with the purchase overall. Installation was very easy. The thing I really like are "Comfort Settings." You set a home, away, sleep (or anything you want) comfort setting and then apply that to a day/time of the week. So, if you want to change your sleep temperature, you only need to change the "sleep comfort setting." No need to modify the schedule for every day of the week. What I love is the air quality sensor and real-time data. One example: one chart shows the trend of inside, outside, and set temperature. It's actionable data to decide to keep the system on or turn off the system and open the windows. I also like that it runs the fan for a few minutes after shutting down the AC. My Nest Gen2 did not do that. What I'm not happy with, which may or may not be an issue for you, is automatic home/away based on phone location. This worked flawlessly and independently with Nest on iPhone and Android. If you have an iPhone, you need a "HomeKit" setup (HomePod or HomePod mini or 4th generation Apple TV). iPad may work but is no longer recommended. Without one of these devices, Ecobee will not automatically go into away mode when your phone leaves the house or return to home mode when you return. This is frustrating because I wasn't expecting to have to buy other devices. If you use Android, you cannot set the Ecobee into away mode when the phone leaves the home. You also cannot create automation routines in Goole Home to change the Ecobee comfort setting (the great feature I mentioned above). You can set temperature or set it to cool, heat, or off. For example, you cannot set a routine of saying "Time for bed" and it triggers your Ecobee "sleep comfort setting." You need to set the temperature in your routine, which defeats the purpose of the one stop "comfort setting." I spent hours figuring these things out, because it didn't seem logical for them not to work. That being said, I am happy with the purchase overall. Granted, I may become annoyed over time with having to set an expensive "smart thermostat" into home/away mode only schedule or manually. I'm hoping the ability to automatically go into home/away mode based on phone location and the ability to set up Android automation with "comfort settings" comes without other device requirements.
reviews.title: Nest to Ecobee Convert
reviews.author: jerryr73

reviews.body: After having used Google Nest thermostats for years, I decided to switch to this brand. The setup was fairly straight forward, only difference in Nest is the Rh wire placement for Ecobee. The WiFi connection works perfectly. Adjusting the schedule takes some time so be patient, it is worth the effort. Using average temps between selected sensors at different times of day along with the presence sensing capabilities far exceed the whole house balanced cooling ability of the Google product. In contrast, Google can only read from one sensor at a time on a limited schedule. Ecobee can be programmed which sensors to average. This thermostat has much more flexible configuration than the Google. Added bonus here is Alexa Echo built in. If you want to use voice control, talk to the thermostat. I have extensive electronics training and experience along with past HVAC electrical and electronic experience so the only issue I had was learning the app. Some might find it a challenge. Your old school HVAC person will be ready to run screaming from your house. Regardless, our level of comfort is far superior to anything we’ve had before and our energy provider offers an enormous rebate. This is a professional level precision device that monitors temps effectively.
reviews.title: Excellent Product and Replacement for Google
reviews.author: Jo986

reviews.body:
I had a nest 1st and 2nd gen thermostats in my house, and google was ending support for them this year, so I decided to replace 1 with an ecobee (I didn't replace the other because I didn't use that thermostat much, so I could just create a schedule before support ended and let it go after).

My nest wasn't perfect, but calling this ecobee "smart" or "premium" is FALSE ADVERTISING!

My nest could detect when I left the house, and it would put my thermostat in away mode. Not right away, but if I was gone more than an hour or 2, it would kick in, and I never had to worry about it while on vacation.

I was just gone for 3 weeks over the holidays, and my ecobee was heating my house for most of the time I was gone. I asked on reddit, and apparently "smart home/away" only kicks on temporarily, and if you have a schedule set up (they call this "comfort settings"), it'll turn off on the next scheduled change.

Also, my nest would try to learn my heating and cooling habits and make changes to the schedule based on that. My ecobee says it will do that too, but it hasn't yet, and most of the people I've talked to say theirs hasn't either. I asked on reddit what "smart" features the ecobee smart premium has, and the consensus was "none really."

With my nest, setting a schedule was simple - they give you a 7 day calendar and you can set the temp to whatever you want on whatever day you want, at whatever time you want (multiples of :15), so if you want the heat to turn on at 6:45 AM on Wednesday only, you can do that. My ecobee has "comfort settings," like home, away, and sleep, and you set what you want the temp to be during these times, and then set which comfort setting is active during which time on which day. Convoluted to say the least.

Beyond functionality, the device itself is frustrating. The menu system is awful, with some menus being hidden completely unless you enable/disable certain features. there are multiple main menus, meaning you could search through every item in 1 menu and not find what you want, and then go to a completely different set of menu options and find it. And the screen is smudged when you get it, and any time you touch it you'll make it dirtier.

One thing I was looking forward to was controlling my ecobee with Siri, but, unlike google and alexa, the siri commands are not remotely intuitive. I had to ask on reddit how to do it, and luckily I found ONE PERSON who knew who and told me what the magic words were.

Do I regret buying this thermostat?

Yes. 1000% yes. If I could give it back to Duke in exchange for store credit towards buying a new nest, I absolutely would.
reviews.title: I miss my nest
reviews.author: unami218

reviews.body:
Purchased the ecobee Premium thermostat thru the Consumers Energy program. First one received was installed and did not work at all, ecobee tech on phone did all he could only to end in a nonfunctioning thermostat. Replacement installation was quite easy again. Just follow exactly what to do as shown on your phone installation guide. Everything worked and is easy to set, revise, etc. Only thing I wish it would also do is to monitor the time the filter is installed and recommend a filter change reminder on screen. Maybe that would be a great software update, please???

But all in all, pretty easy install and easy to use and modify as you wish either from the display or the app on the phone. Thanks Consumers Energy and ecobee.
reviews.title: Great Thermostat!
reviews.author: comfy in Michigan

reviews.body: Do not purchase if you need to control multiple zones in your house (i.e., if you have more than one thermostat but only one cooling/heating unit). Our Nest thermostats needed to be upgraded as they were losing smart functionality. After researching, we replaced them with Ecobee (3 zones in the house). The entire house is now either too cold or too hot all day and night. The room temperature never reaches the temperature we set it to be at. To get the upstairs to cool, the main floor and basement temperature must be set at much cooler than desired. We never had this issue with our old Nest thermostats which accurately heated/cooled to set temperatures. Additionally, we purchased Ecobee premium for the sensors but to try to regulate multiple zones, we had to turn off the sensors as any unoccupied room caused heating/cooling to stop working in the other zones. In a prior house (single thermostat without zones), the Ecobee worked great which is why we purchased. Unfortunately, Ecobee does not regulate temperature well if you have more than one thermostat zone in your house. We wish we had not spent a significant amount for three Ecobee premium thermostats that we will soon be replacing with something else.
reviews.title: Does not work with multiple zones
reviews.author: anonymous

reviews.body: Bought this few months back replacing Honeywell unit. Big mistake! It does look good on the wall, thus two stars, but functionality sucks. From day one it didn't work properly, always way off on when it should start or stop. Over night it fell well below set threshold and heat wouldn't kick in for hours. Then, finally 5 hours later heat kicked in and now we're boiling because it wouldn't stop. Currently I have it turned off, but the furnace is still going. Need to open doors and windows to cool the house down. Not happy with it at all. Will put Honeywell back on the wall and throw this junk in garbage.
reviews.title: Wouldn't recommend it
reviews.author: Zoran

reviews.body:
For all the talk about its intelligence this thing is too dumb to adapt to the real world changes that happen all the time. It only runs checks, it seems, based on the set point and current data and turns equipment on and off solely on that data. If the outdoor temperature changes across your head pump's operating threshold tis pile of garbage doesn't care about that, it just keeps doing what it decided to do an hour ago regales of the change in circumstances. I have to touch this thermostat at least once a day to maintain a comfortable temperature in the house which is not worth $260.

I tried three times to explain this to their tech support but they don't speak English well enough to understand the issue and provide any solution.

I'm sorry I spent the money on this thing and the time to run new wire to enable all the supposed smart features. Overall it's no better than the dumb thermostat I replaced it with.
reviews.title: remarkably bad at being a thermostat
reviews.author: Grjj

reviews.body: I am completely pleased with this thermostat and so glad that I bought and installed it. The packaging is very well designed, and the pieces are easy to identify. This thermostat replaced a simple digital thermostat in my home, so the wiring was in place for the exchange. The instructions were easy for me to follow. There is an app that walks step by step, including taking pictures of the relevant steps anticipating that the photos will be needed for reference moving through the process. There are lots of wire colors and naming references, which can be confusing, but easily managed by attaching little stickers from the kit to the wires. This thermostat can be purchased with our without the additional room sensor. I purchased the package with an extra sensor that provides temperature monitoring in a different room. I only have whole house heating (one exchange), but I like having the extra sensor in the office so that heat/cool would kick in if the temperature is different than the main thermostat. There is an air quality sensor for "volatile organic compounds" and carbon dioxide. it will send notifications for air quality/CO2 events, but I am sure what that looks like. It really brings peace of mind living in a city with air quality issues. It is very easy to set a weekly schedule, and very easy to change the max/min settings anytime during the day. The display is large (great for old eyes), and the touch screen is super easy to use, sliding the numbers up and down to change the temps rather than pushing buttons. The "on the fly changes" change for the set period, i.e., day or night settings, and then return to the schedule. Also very easy to turn on the fan only with preset times easily set. I set up and used Alexa for a short time, but it started responding in place of my Alexa Echo, and I didn't like the sound of the thermostat speaker. I subsequently changed the setup to Siri (Apple Home) which does not use the thermostat speaker and makes me happier. There is an additional app that allows for setting/changing the temperature remotely. It also offers reports on heat/cool/fan use and savings, notifications, etc. Apparently there are other ecobee security products that one can connect, but I have not followed up on those.
reviews.title: Sleek, convenient, smart to use
reviews.author: nice2visit

reviews.body: I purchased a refurbished premium thermostat. I called support before I placed the order for compatibility and they said it would work. I’m not super handy or a DIY person. Set up went well but blowing cold air. Went thru the screens but sensed up with support. Went thru a couple configurations. Seemed ok but kept rebooting over the next week. Actually got really bad rebooting nearly every time it called for heat. Back online with CS and went thru the same setup again. Really didn’t seem to resolve the issue and sadly admitted it just want going to work, and planned to return. Oddly it then started to work as described. And has been fine ever since. Wondering if it just needs to update itself over the week. Very happy it’s working. Finger crossed that the AC will just flip over in the settings.
reviews.title: Took a bit, but now it awesome
reviews.author: Dr choco

reviews.body: Last summer got new HVAC system, it came with Ecobee's Premium Thermostat, added three Smart Doorbell Cameras, two are connected to in-door chime, using individual adapters, one wired to ding for the garage door, one wired to ding-dong for the front door, the other not connected to a chime for the back door. With one Smart Sensor for Rooms included added four more Smart Sensors for Rooms to balance the temperature and for motion monitoring. Put Smart Sensor for Doors and Windows on all entry doors and including the Aluminum Garage doors. The Premium Thermostat works great, except when power is out, we get a lot of storms. Wish they include a internal battery, so monitoring and Smart Security was still functional with the power out. I do have a mobil whole house generator, as it is stored when not in use, power is not out for long. Do like the integration with Apple Homekit/Alexa/Google Home can modify temperature, but it can't change comfort settings or scheduling. You can setup a pin to lock down the Thermostat, but you can't lock down the Ecobee App. Would be nice to create permissions or roles. The Ecobee App works well with managing the thermostat, but a lot of functionality is on the device not configurable thru the Ecobee App. Love the integration with Samsung Smart Things for monitoring alerts. I get alerts when the sensors sense presence or motion. Also can use IFTTT, but that is also a paid subscription service. I like the look of the Premium Thermostat on the wall, looks like a premium made device. Made sure to seal the wall and put a thermal sheet behind the surface of the thermostat so it can't get the temperature from the wall. Really great feature, my compressor works well at a certain temperatures, with settings in the thermostat and the weather feature it won't allow my compressor to run if it is too cold outside. Which allows me to leave the thermostat in auto mode all year long to call for heat or cold all depending on the weather, although it would have been nice if they had a actual outdoor temperature sensor. The indoor air quality sensor is nice to have but it only reports, no actions can be taken like to turn on an accessory fan or open or close a damper. But you can configure the fan to run for a certain time an hour. With the built-in humidity sensor, I also have a humidifier attached which during the winter when called for heat if it was too dry it would auto turn on, really loved that. Now the Ecobee integration with all the additional Ecobee devices and Sensors. With the Ecobee light Switch when in Vacation mode I can have it turn on or off a light to simulating someone is home. The Smart Doorbell Cameras, it rings on the thermostat, thru homekit, Alexa and Google, lets me get more info thru integrated services. Integration with the Doorbells is impressive, shows live video, and when someone presses the door bell the feed shows up on the thermostat. Love the integration with the Thermostat and the whole house chime, wish they gave you options to the have distinctive rings, hard to know which doorbell was pushed as they have the same ring sound. Same thing with Smart Sensors for Door and Windows, they can also chime on the thermostat so you know a door or window was opened or closed. But they have the same audio so you have to go to the door or look at the app to figure which door was opened. If they had distinctive audio you would know just from the sound. Wish something was displayed on the Thermostat as to door opened as well. So many possibilities for integration. But the paywall is a hugh negative, don't understand the need to charge for package detection and rich notifications which have nothing to do with cloud services, same for pause when door is open for Smart Sensors for Doors and Windows, or motion sensing is disabled. Would have given 5 stars, these devices are extremely expensive for what you get after free trial is over. Subscription services are good but once that goes away, Trying to save money not transfer money saved to ecobee's greedy pockets. MSRP is a lot for what you get out of box once subscription ends, maybe charge more up front or give an unlock code so we can get full functionality? If they wanted to charge more for the device I would have paid more to keep the non cloud services, but any money saved would go to their subscription. I am hopeful they will ditch the subscription for non cloud services, one day, but until then it works as I need it to.
reviews.title: Great Premium Thermostat with Smart Sensors and Sm
reviews.author: Jdsenter

reviews.body: Easy to program, can regulate temperatures at different times or day or night. App available. Economy link with local provider available. I especially love the Puck that you can put on a different floor - like in the finished basement. With the main thermo on the upper floor, the puck is designed to bring the lower floor up to your setting on the thermo before it shuts off. This way, both floors are the same temperature. Great feature. The thermo also has outside temperature and a four-day forecast feature. Nice unit.
reviews.title: ecobee Smart is a smart buy.
reviews.author: Bcondon

reviews.body: I'm very please with the ecobee thermostat. It's very intuitive. And being wifi enabled makes it so easy to manage & control with the iPhone app; no matter when I'm home or somewhere else. Only problem I haven't solved is when humidity hits a certain level (71%) it turns the AC on no matter what it's set to. So if I set it to 80 at night so I can open windows and skylight to cool the house overnight, if it hits that humidity level the AC comes on with the house opened up!! I'd love to know how to get around that problem!
reviews.title: Great features!
reviews.author: dmader48

reviews.body: Received the two thermostats quickly. Because we had guests I waited a few days to install the units (1 upstairs and 1 downstairs). Easy to install if you take a photo of the existing wires. The thermostat along with the ecobee app on the Iphone made it easy to setup. Both have been operating on HEAT only and temperature and fan controls are excellent. I'm glad that we replaced the two Nest units that were installed by the home builder in 2020.
reviews.title: Smart Thermostat Premium (2 total)
reviews.author: XNuke

reviews.body:
I bought ecobee premium to get more out of my new two-stage furnace. My existing thermostat and old furnace had only single-stage control. The new furnace had an algorithm for using two stages with a single-stage thermostat. It went to the high setting way too fast. The ecobee two-stage control handled this.

The reason this thermostat is only fair is that the Eco+ features are not well thought out.

The first feature that does not work well is smart home & away. The problem is adding custom comfort settings disables it. I added two comfort settings. Each setting was flagged as someone is usually home. I guessed this flag was needed to make the smart home & away work. It didn't. Smart home and away only works with the pre-loaded home, away, and sleep comfort settings.

Geo fencing is not a good option for me. With the old thermostat if I was going to be away, I would just set the old thermostat to off. The problem is sometimes I would forget. Smart home & away is a great idea. It just does not work with custom comfort settings.

Figuring out this smart home & away custom settings interaction was difficult. Only one obscure comment on a forum mentioned this. Sure enough, removing custom comfort settings enabled smart home & away.

The second Eco+ setting that does not work well is time of day. When this was set up, it correctly found the high electric rate time was 3-7PM. It determined this from my electricity provider, DTE.

The way it was set up, it could pre-cool up to 4F and let the temperature increase 2F. All summer when it was very hot and should have been pre-cooling, it never did. All it would do was change the set point from 78F to 80F. Because there was no pre-cooling we would be uncomfortable form 3-7PM and the air conditioner would run during this time. The first time it did pre-cool was in the fall when the outside temperature was only 81F. My house only increased 1 degree during the high rate period. This is just wrong.

I contacted ecobee about TOD. After several phone calls and emails, they were no help fixing this issue. They just said there was an algorithm that controlled this. I knew that. They would not give me a description of the algorithm so I could see if I could force it to pre-cool with the settings.

I used to do the equivalent of pre-cooling with the old programmable thermostat. That worked fine. I was expecting ecobee to be able to do a refined version of this programmable functionality with their TOD algorithm. What I got was worse than a programmable t-stat could do.

Without these Eco+ features I pretty much got the equivalent of a two stage programmable thermostat for three times the price. As a basic programmable thermostat the ecobee works fine.

I will say that having the one remote sensor is nice. My house has a den far from the furnace. Its temperature could be high or low depending on the location of the sun. Putting the remote sensor in the den, has made it much more comfortable without any noticeable increase in heating/cooling costs.

I think ecobee has some good ideas. I think they just need some better algorithms. There is no doubt that smart home & away could be made to work with custom comfort settings. As far as time of day, no pre-cooling in mid summer I don't know what they could be thinking.

The reason I would not recommend this thermostat is because some of the advanced features do not work. Without these features, you could do better and save money with a programmable thermostat.
reviews.title: ECO+ feachers do not work well
reviews.author: Electronnic Engineer

reviews.body: This and I suspect all "smart" thermostats operate very HOT so the AC is on way more than it should be, i.e., normal Ecobee operating temperature is too high and raises the temperature at the thermostat! And the Eco+ function is pathetic since it lowers the AC three or more degrees when electricity is "cheaper" and raises the temperature when more expensive. My electricity varies only one cent, but the house temperature varies too much and makes it feel too warm or too cool. I removed the Ecobee Premium and reinstalled my Honeywell TH8321 thermostat which does not ADD any increased temperature after less than a week of using the Ecobee Premium! AC is now on much less and at a constant temperature, as it was before I installed the Ecobee!
reviews.title: Ecobee Premium Operates Very Hot
reviews.author: charlie-vette

reviews.body:
This is our 2nd ecobee thermostat. I installed one on the 1st floor several years ago and was very please with the results. Last year, I purchased an additional ecobee for use on the 2nd floor but held off on installing it pending replacement of our old 2nd floor HVAC system. After the new 2nd floor system was installed last month, I discovered that the new ecobee, although working, could not be controlled remotely via the ecobee App. I sent a request for help to the ecobee support team who responded very quickly. The support team found an internal communication error in the new unit and had a replacement sent overnight via FedEx. I was pleasantly surprised by both the rapid response and replacement times. Especially since the thermostat had been purchased over a year before it was finally installed. Both the 1st & 2nd floor ecobees are now in service and are saving me $$$ every day. Ecobee's remote sensors know when the 2nd (or 1st) floor is unoccupied and adjust the temperatures accordingly to keep the operating cost as low as possible.

I believe ecobee to be the best thermostat available for both keeping you comfortable and saving you money, an unbeatable combination!
reviews.title: Love My Bee and the ecobee Support Team Too!
reviews.author: Joe Cool

reviews.body: The installation guide has 3 annoying glitches that need to be addressed (if one is not quick enough it sends you back to the beginning so I had to start like 12 times from the beginning/the EPK has 4 wires going into it but 5 coming out. I had to guess so the first guess was wrong, the second guess seems to work/the thing about taking pictures of the wires was a waste of time). Once I got it installed & functioning, I was disappointed with the app. The smart thermostat I had from another brand at my old home was a lot user-friendly, more adaptable to my routines and easier to install. I do not recommend Ecobee.
reviews.title: Not
reviews.author: Ken

reviews.body: Installed with new HVAC system... the phone app works great, and our system has a back-up gas furnace for when it gets too cold (we couldn't go all electric because we have an old house with space constraints). Has kept the house pleasantly warm and we've had some very cold nights... and not very warm days. Only gotten above freezing even during the daytime on 6 of last 21 days.
reviews.title: Great features on app!
reviews.author: Bob24

reviews.body:
I bought this thermostat because it was recommended by the AC contractor for the new AC we had installed.

This is my fifth programmable thermostat and it is by far the worst! Ecobee has no instructions in the box and no instructions online. No troubleshooting guides until you call customer service. Then they'll send a link to you by SMS. What kind of bull crap is that?! You have something to hide. It sure seems like it!

I had to stumble through it. Even the customer service don't know how to use that own product!
I had to create custom comfort setups.
And the scheduling is not easily done and you cannot go back in and easily correct it.

When I had an issue today and called customer service was on hlod for 30 minutes. No one answered. I hung up.

There is no special day or holiday mode. Have to manly change the scheduling and then change it back. What a piece of junk!

If I had to do it over I would ask the contractor what other thermostat!
reviews.title: Smart thermostat that isn't so smart! Avoid buying this!
reviews.author: Single Dad of 5

reviews.body:
I recently had an Ecobee premium installed replacing a ten year old Nest, and I’m so incredibly frustrated and disappointed with it since it lacks quite a few obvious functions that my *ten year old* Nest had. Things it lacks:

- Native geofencing setup for “away”: Ecobee+ has “smart away,” but it only activates after two hours of being away, and seemingly it’s based on the (not especially accurate) occupancy sensors. As someone who often comes and goes throughout the day, it’s frustrating that it will almost never switch to away mode. I have an iPhone and was able to work my way through Google Home Settings for a sort of workaround, but it took quite a bit of trial and error. Why can’t the away function allow more customization, like changing the minimum time away before switching to Away mode?

- No ability to preset fan runtime: in comfort settings you can seemingly either set the fan to “always on” during a timeframe (like, constant running for 10 hours straight) or “auto” where it only runs while the furnace or ac are a to ely running. Nest allows you to run the fan on demand (and it’s easy to find the feature on both the app and the device), OR to set thresholds like “15 minutes per hour.” Why can’t o control this??

- Numerous settings only accessible in device: I can’t even name which ones, but quite a few controls can only be accessed on the device itself. I don’t just mean things like the wiring, but like the fan controls mentioned above— only on the device.

The fact that even the textbox to write this review doesn’t auto fit to a phone screen is a perfect example of the major design flaws from ecobee.

Don’t buy it. Don’t do it, get a Nest instead.
reviews.title: Missing obvious key features
reviews.author: Hatingtheecobee

This state-of-the-art thermostat seamlessly integrates with Siri, Alexa, Apple Home. Kit, and Google Assistant, allowing for effortless control through your voice or smartphone. Its advanced Smart. name: SmartSensor 2-Pack
bestFor: Balancing hot and cold spots across Australian multi-story homes

reviews.body:
I’ve been an Ecobee user since before 2019.

I didn't get to join the pilot program for the Switch+, but I bought one as soon as it was released. Unfortunately, a lightning strike took it out. I replaced it with another one, and once again, after a small lightning spark, it went haywire. I had to remove it from the wall and reinstall it (which the average user probably shouldn't be doing — YouTube helped, and yes, I turned the breaker off). It powered back up and worked for a while... until now. It no longer connects to the thermostat. The motion sensor on it still works, which is nice, but everything else has failed. I won't be buying another Switch+ — next time, I'll just use a motion detector and another smart switch.

I also bought a combo pack of motion and door sensors, thinking I could use them with Apple Home Automations — for example, when a door opens, the light turns on. But they’re too slow to respond for that to work well. I also assumed the door sensors had temperature and motion detection — turns out, not without a subscription? That’s disappointing. You can use the 2 individual occupancy sensors but now I have 2 devices for one purpose. The door sensors are a waste.

From here on out, I’ll be switching to Eve devices — motion sensors and door/window sensors that work with HomeKit without needing a subscription. I can still trigger the Ecobee thermostat through Apple Shortcuts if needed, like turning off the AC when a door opens. But Ecobee requiring a subscription just to get basic motion functionality from a sensor is a bad move. If the motion on the door sensors worked out of the box, I wouldn’t be this frustrated. 120 degree of motion detection, False! never had any motion from my door sensors.

Sorry Ecobee, but you're losing a loyal customer with this approach.

Don't bother reaching out - just improve your approach, I'm already switching.
reviews.title: T-Stat is good and works fine, door sensors ($$$$)
reviews.author: MrNok

reviews.body: Easy setup, major flaw: This 'security' system is useless without internet. If your connection drops (e.g., cut cable, router failure), all features, including the thermostat alarm, fail. Our house was unsecured for 48 hours over Thanksgiving when our internet went down. This critical vulnerability is not disclosed in the product information.
reviews.title: Security features do not work without Internet
reviews.author: Keith B

reviews.body: I installed a few sensors on our exterior doors to satisfy my wife who is gone alone most days. The installation and setup was super fast and super simple. Using the app is probably even more simple. If a door opens we know right away. As an added bonus, if a door is open for a short period of time while the AC is on the system automatically shuts down the AC until the door is closed. Very smart.
reviews.title: Super simple and easy to install and use.
reviews.author: MarkM

reviews.body:
I have lived with my Ecobee thermostat and home security system for a few months. I picked up the Ecobee thermostat after having repeated issues with my Google Nest. The Ecobee thermostat is easy to use, and I have had zero issues with the thermostat so far. I purchased additional sensors, which are easy to install and can be used as a part of your home security system. I spoke with customer service because one sensor was faulty out of the box, and I can't speak highly enough of the experience. Getting a new sensor was quick and easy, and the customer service representative was great.

The system has one big issue (for me) that I hope Ecobee can resolve. The thermostat is perfect, but the security system is completely controlled through your phone. That means arming and disarming all take place through the phone app and cannot be done on the thermostat itself. Phones get lost, batteries die, and a host of other things can happen. Being able to arm and disarm the device through the thermostat, even if you rarely do it, is a necessary addition. Imagine your home is armed, and you lose your phone while out. What do you do?

Additionally, I would like to see an option for when a door or window sensor is triggered, where you can have an alarm ring out after a set amount of time. Currently, a notification is sent to your phone. If you have the professional monitoring enabled, they will call you if the alert isn't disabled, but I would still like to see the ability to choose to have the sound alarm triggered ring out after a countdown. In short, if someone breaks into my house, the alarm going off may let them know that they are caught, and they might leave on their own. If I am away from my phone, I may be unable to trigger the alarm myself. Adding these features would make the thermostat and alarm system perfect in my eyes.
reviews.title: Good as is, Could be GREAT with one addition
reviews.author: Hershequick

reviews.body:
The sensors are ok. They work. The issue is with the camera they came with. I’ve own 3 of them for over 3 years. Key features missing are lack of support for usage outside - you have to put inside on window mode infront of a windoe … the result is an image i would grade at 1/10. The speaker for spotify connect is only usable if you have spotify premium - I Am not be able to play apple music or amazon music on it for my baby cam! The cam integration with apple home is missing the ability to create shortcuts and automation with the built in siren or use of the cameras speaker.

The camera sometimes is in daymode when it should be in nightmode there is no ability to correct this only the vice versa issue. The camera has a wide view but does not really use it to its full capacity, it should offer an ability to track and follow movements within its view something that you would think the smart focus option would do but doesnt. The camera emits a lot of heat. It disconnects between 2 to 5 times a day.

Try changing wifi networks! Ie. Bring the ecobee babycam to another house like grandmas or babysitter, just make sure to set aside 30 minutes as it is a burden. It could be easy, the easiest way ecobee lays it out is to on the camera click forget wifi then in the app connect it to the new wifi network…. This has worked for me twice over an easy dozens of attempts (still takes more time than you woukd want if you ever get it working). In the end the only way to do it is to reset to factory settings, delete from homekit, delete from ecobee, re-add the camera, do the forced update… 30 mins. Then when you go back home, repeat. Awful.

On apple i sometimes cannot pull up the video through homekit with a weird and scary message “ wait until someone else stops viewing the video to see the live image” ….. …
reviews.title: 3 yrs use:Missing key features and camera has bugs
reviews.author: Djjm

reviews.body:
This is my third set of these sensors. They are super simple to setup and their battery life is very good. The sensors connect to your Ecobee thermostat so you must have one of those for these to function. I subscribe to Ecobee's basic security plan and with that you get the added feature of these sensors telling the thermostat that a window/door has been left open and the thermostat will not run the HVAC to save energy until the window/door is closed. Don't worry, this is all configurable with which SmartSensor(s) will trigger the HVAC shutdown.

I would like to add one more small remark. There are many options when shopping for smart home products like the Ecobee smart thermostat and these sensors. The one thing that sets Ecobee apart is the fact that they just work. I've never had to tend to them after we've lost power or the internet goes down. When our service is back online, so is Ecobee. It's refreshing when a company puts as much quality and attention to detail into their software as they do their hardware.

I have nothing but good things to say about Ecobee and their smart devices. It's refreshing when smart devices just work.
reviews.title: Easy, simple setup.
reviews.author: csciguy

reviews.body:
I decided to give this a try because it would be hard wired to the HAVC system control via the C wire to power the unit. No batteries are needed in the unit. That the package comes with a smart room sensor for extra temperature and occupancy monitoring, a door/window contact sensor for security and pausing HAVC running when door/window is a plus. Also getting a free 60 day monitoring is nice.

The installation guide illustrates each step to match the HAVC system is clear to follow. The setup on the unit is self explanatory and connecting to WiFi network is simple to follow. The software is not too difficult to complete the setup for home, geofence and link to HomeKit for Apple iPad or iPhone.

It would be nice to have an occupancy sensor built in the unit. The eco+ is a nice feature for energy saving but it would take at least a month to know how much it saves. So far it fits the bill and meets the need for a single stage heat/cool HAVC system without other accessories attached such as humidifier. The saving would pay itself. It is time to upgrade regardless smart home or not.
reviews.title: Nice ecobee3 lite easy to use

reviews.body: I set up Geofence and set custom temps and settings. It should automatically change setting when we’re out of the house and when we cross the geofence. It asks me for permission! Why do I need to accept “arm away” on alarm every time I leave the house? Just do it automatically, isn’t this why you set up the geofence?! Most of the time it doesn’t change to the away temp when we leave the house. Sometimes it works, other times it doesn’t. I got this system so I wouldn’t need to babysit my settings. Will it ever just work on its own like it should? Now I’m still on my free trial for the alarm, but after all this trouble why would I pay for the subscription? That’s the other problem I have. I get that if I want house monitoring by actual people, I would need to pay for that. But having to pay for alerts from a motion sensor I already bought that just goes to my phone/watch… give me a break. I would take it back, but I’m already past the return time. Counting the days when the thermostat will die so I can have an excuse to purchase a better one.
reviews.title: Does it ever work properly?
reviews.author: RealtorInPA

reviews.body:
I have 2 SmartSensors installed on 2 doors in my home. They were very easy to install and set up. We have the Geofencing option set up on my wife and my phones to arm/disarm the system when we leave/arrive home. The geofencing works consistently (although it seems take some time to notify that there is no one home). When the notification comes up, it gives the option to manually arm the system via the phone app. There is no auto-arm option as there is with some other security systems. Each user's situation is different, so not auto-arming in some cases may be preferred, but having an option to auto-arm would be nice. They system auto-DISarms upon returning flawlessly.

Overall, the system is quite good and works reliably. I would recommend it.
reviews.title: Works consistently well, but does not auto-arm.
reviews.author: BILL_PGH

reviews.body: Had a nest for several years then it went to a new owner who ruined it all, doesn’t work,Google Home is more trouble, and I wouldn’t have it back if it was FREE. WE LUV our Ecobee system easy to install,multi-users too, and it works flawlessly. I would highly recommend anyone to try a great system that really works as advertised.
reviews.title: Glad to see Nest GO
reviews.author: Pferg1024

reviews.body: Very easy to setup and notification work well. I have been using on garage door as it seems it magically opens and 8 need to know if it is open or closed. I had to design and 3d print brackets as the rails and door are not flat.
reviews.title: Door sensors
reviews.author: Ca3d

reviews.body:
The only thing I’d like to see added is the ability to change the sensors refresh time on sensing motion in case you decide to use them for something like smart lights. Right now the sensor will only trip once about every 15 mins which means if you have your lights turn on for 5 mins, then go off and you walk back in that room within those 15 mins but after the light has auto shut off, the lights won’t come back on for 10 more mins unless you manually turn them on.

That is because it’s not there purpose and they are probably trying to extend battery life but adding control for how often it updates to HomeKit would add another selling point for smart Home customers.
reviews.title: The sensors work well
reviews.author: Brian1773

reviews.body: I did a lot of research when replacing my existing non-HomeKit friendly security system with a HomeKit friendly one. It does require an existing ecobee thermostat as a hub, but since I've been using one in my house for years, it was a no-brainer for me. All the sensors only take minutes to install and configure, and they immediately show up as first-order members of your HomeKit environment, ready to take part in automations. ecobee's Smart Security add-on is a worthwhile upgrade, even if you don't go with a fully monitored solution. All-in-all an excellent product, easy to install, easy to use, just what you'd expect ecobee to be like!
reviews.title: Easy to use, excellent Homekit integration
reviews.author: Misky

reviews.body:
Super easy to install. Really nice product! A couple improvements to consider: Issue 1: I have the devices installed at a rental. I bought them so the heat/AC system would shut off if a door or window is kept open for more than 5 minutes. The sensors do in fact secure the system but the thermostat then prompts the tenant that the air has been secured and then allows the tenant to restart the heating/cooling of the space without ever closing the door or window by simply touching the thermostat. (I know you can't fix bad behaviour but...). Maybe you could send a report indicating that the system was restarted and the door/window is still open.

Issue 2: I would like to have the tenant adjust their own temperature within a range that I set. For instance cooling between 70 - 78 degrees. If I "lock" the thermostat, the tenant can't adjust the temperatures within the range I had specified (70 - 78) and they are stuck with whatever SINGLE temperature setting I select (no range allowed). There should be an allowance for the owner to set a range that the tenant can operate within but the owner should be able to lock this range such that the tenant can't change it.

Please allow more lock functionality. Keep Airbnb and landlords in mind.
reviews.title: Please consider improvements

reviews.body:
I have had this SmartSensor setup for a few months now. I installed it on a door about 20 feet away from the thermostat. I am not a fan with the sensors inability to stay connected. I had to retry the setup steps multiple times before it finally connected successfully to my Ecobee thermostat. From then on, it would randomly disconnect from the thermostat. Each time I had to remove the battery from the sensor to attempt to restart/reconnect it. It does not seem to attempt to reconnect on its own, and because this is a measure of security, I find this troubling.

When it works I like it, but it is unreliable.
reviews.title: Randomly Disconnects from Ecobee Thermostat
reviews.author: JordWms

reviews.body: I own a short-term rental in a warm-to-hot climate. It has multiple doors to the balcony that guests tend to leave open when out on the balcony. These sensors now turn off the A/C if any door is left open more than 5 minutes. That saves me money and helps keep the inside humidity level down. AND the guests like it because it is easy to set temperatures. The sensors were NOT as easy to install as the directions made it seem, but work great once synced to the thermostat.
reviews.title: Reasonably priced solution
reviews.author: HalC

reviews.body:
I have five of the door / window sensors in my home. All are on doors, two sliding and three standard. They allow me to use automations with Apple HomeKit and receive notifications.

I did have a slight problem with setting them up on my sliding door. There was an issue with the positioning of the magnet to the sensor. It works on one sliding door and not the other. But that was the only issue I have had.

They are very easy to set up and use. It only took about a minute to complete the setup. Would highly recommend this product.
reviews.title: Great product
reviews.author: Bird

reviews.body: I recently installed these on my doors. Setup and linking to the thermostat was easy. You can check status of the doors in the app, but you need to subscribe to at least the $5/mo plan to get alerts when doors open and close. Initial tests indicate the alerts are timely and accurate. My only complaint is the things are big ugly white blotches on my wooden doors. It would helpful if they were available in a darker color option. Other than that, they meet expectations so far.
reviews.title: Appears to do the job
reviews.author: GeneK

reviews.body:
It would be really nice if there was a feature where the thermostat would chirp if a door or window was opened.

The camera works well but when you are trying to pan and zoom if it sees motion it ignores your commands and moves to the motion. This should be turned off while panning and zooming in.

The camera also goes offline and rarely captures HomeKit people alerts even though it’s following them while they move around.
reviews.title: Great experience with HomeKit. Lackluster security
reviews.author: Nooch

reviews.body: I have had ecobee thermostats for several yeafs now since 2019 I believe. The thermostat has worked well. I’ve had minimal issues and can control it with my phone or Amazon with minimal issues. When it came down to the kits or even the individual cameras, sensors. etc. it’s just another system you have to connect with when you already have a Ring system and probably a blink system it becomes excessive. When you have several different systems to control lightbulbs from Phillips and plugs from Wemo, and also Amazon and the list goes on it gets quite frustrating God for bid you replace your router and use a different name you’re spending week trying to re-configure everything the way it was.if you have no home automation then go for it if not I’d do more research first. Amazon Alexa or that IFFT app or whatever pretty much combine to the systems.
reviews.title: I like the ecobee system but prices not worth.
reviews.author: Dabloesco

reviews.body:
Great addition to your Ecobee environment. Easy to install and they alert quickly when a door or window is opened. Great features packed product.

Can be easily added to your Apple HomeKit setup.

Just remember as the instructions state to make sure you know exactly where you are placing them and how they will work when opening or closing a window or door before you pull the cover off the two sided mounting tape and mount them.
reviews.title: Ecobee Door & Window Smart Sensors
reviews.author: Cayamantkid

reviews.body: These work well but are a bit pricey. I love the ease of installation. Scan the QR code, mount on door or window and done. I also bought the haven membership so I could have it turn off my hvac if the door or window stays open too long, which i do forget on nice days. I watched the sales and got the 2 door window and camera setup. I like the arm/disarm feature so i dont have to remember to do it. If they were less money i would do my entire house instead of door and windows I use for venting on nice days.
reviews.title: Easy to install and use with haven and thermostat
reviews.author: yeehaw57

reviews.body:
Have it with Apple Kit and very limited functions with apple kit. Also away function incl geofencing seems not to work properly or takes too long until it switches to away. That is not energy star, no sense keeping cooling/heating ignoring that we are away, for what. Nest seems to make this better.

Also sometimes compressor isn’t switching on (switch time) but it doesnt say why, which restriction isnt let it start. Door/windows eco fuctions switches off compressor without resoecting compressor on min time. Etc. for 5stars which i expecyed, there is still long way.

Main deception is that i cant regulate humidity like temperature. Set point eg 65% and it cools to keep this humorous regardless of which temperature. This was main reason I bought, thought it would have this function
reviews.title: Several Points
reviews.author: LuisAzimut

reviews.body: I had trouble installing it. The instructions were somewhat clear and then it didn’t show up on the ecobee app. So I had to remove it from the door and start again, by removing it some of the paint of the door fell off, so I ruined my door. Then was the time when I realized that the device I purchase does not come with its most essential function - to notify us the door is open. So essentially I realized that I didn’t buy a sensor, I bought a subscription’s device. It would’ve been nice to build the sensor to make sound so if the door or window is open and someone is close by they can hear the sound. Currently I have no use of this since I don’t want a subscription and I can’t sit around looking at the app to visually see the notification. I guess it’s my fault that I didn’t read all the info before buying it. But I totally did not expect this to be the case.
reviews.title: Requires subscription
reviews.author: Barabina

reviews.body:
Sensors & Cameras are great quality much like the thermostats but…

Your additional security items are expensive. Competitors offer similar features without the added cost. Some additional security features should be standard. If ecobee doesn’t change folks will stop buying your security sensors and cameras. Give customers better security features as a standard. Easy to use, quality equipment and great performance but poor marketing of additional security services.
reviews.title: Sensors & Cameras are great but…
reviews.author: Danny1@

reviews.body: I was leaning toward a Google Nest due to Google's bigger name and the higher rating that I saw. However, my HVAC advisor strongly recommended ecobee. I'm glad I followed his advice, and so far I'm loving my ecobee. It's very easy to use, and best of all, I am now able to control my home's temperatures remotely from my phone. I also have two ecobee sensors, one on a door and the other on a window; they are also working out well. I might get a couple more when they go on sale.
reviews.title: Very pleased with ecobee
reviews.author: ecobee user8

reviews.body: I recently installed my home security and thermostat with the Ecobee security bundle kit and smart thermostat. From start to finish I was amazed at how intuitive and simple the setup process ended up being. Not to mention the HomeKit integration is seamless and free of any technical issues. In fact, I was so impressed that I purchased two extra cameras and couldn't be happier. I recommend Ecobee products to anyone looking for high-quality and intuitive devices for your smart home setup.
reviews.title: Exceeds Every Expectation
reviews.author: TJG89

reviews.body: I bought this early December, and I love the response to Siri, I love the ability to tightly control the schedule, and I’d like the motion detection that manages efficiency. There is one change that needs to be made however. The smart home features override the schedule. It took a few weeks to figure this out, by that time my gas usage had quadrupled to what it normally is. Since I work at home in a detached studio, I walk in and out of the house all day long. I need the smart features to work, but if the schedule says that during certain times the heater is not supposed to go on… And this will be true in the summer with air conditioning as well… Then the smart home features need to use the schedule first. It’s a small tweak, but I think it’s necessary one. Other than that, I’m happy
reviews.title: Almost perfect… almost
reviews.author: beckerjim

reviews.body: The sensors were easy to install. In just a few minutes you are in business: the only gripe I have is despite what the website says my dog walking around the house while I am out will trip the senors which prevents me from setting the alarm. Support told me there is no way to change the sensor's sensitivity. Support also a future firmware update is supposed to fix the issue I am fine with that but there is no way for the consumer to know when the update has been installed.
reviews.title: Great sensor

reviews.body:
Absolutely delivers on its promise. Love how it's not only used for HVAC, but also security with its occupancy sensor. Highly recommend this product and the subscription plan. The annual plan is very affordable given how it does 2 for 1 (HVAC and security). Get it in a bundle for a better value. Trust me when I say the more sensors the better, but don't go too crazy. At least add the door sensors to your doors. Then, the windows you open the most frequently. These ecobee devices can work with many sensors simultaneously.

The install was very easy. Just make sure to clean the surface. For doors, make sure the door does not swing and hit the sensor while being close enough for the sensors to work.
reviews.title: Great addition to Ecobee system
reviews.author: pooki789

description: About the product Real-time notifications whenever a door or window is opened or closed through the ecobee app. When paired with ecobee Smart Thermostat Premium, it can play a chime when your Smart. Sensor for doors and windows is opened, for greater peace of mind. No Smart Security Subscription required to use this feature. Place Smart. Sensors near your valuables like drawers, safes, and medicines cabinets, and receive instant notifications if they are opened. Installation is quick and easy. Simply, attach a Smart. Sensor to a door, window, entryway, or other areas that contain valuable items drawers, safes, and medicine cabinets. Smart. Sensors gives you peace of mind thats powered by an easily replaceable battery designed to last up to 3 years. With an ecobee Smart Security subscription youll unlock real-time push notifications when the system is armed. It can detect motion from a range of up to a 120 arc 16 feet away, notifying you when doors or windows are opened unexpectedly, or when unexpected motion is detected in your home. Comes with an industry-leading 3-year .

name: Purifier Hot+Cool Formaldehyde (HP09)
bestFor: HEPA H13 purification, heating & cooling fan with formaldehyde destruction

name: Purifier Cool Autoreact (TP07)
bestFor: Whole room air purification and oscillating cooling fan for QLD/WA summers

specifications.name: Noise Level
specifications.value: Quietest settings (Night mode), 20% quieter than previous mode

specifications.name: Sustainability Certifications
specifications.value: Recyclable packaging (apart from plastic shrink wrap)

reviews.body: I purchase my first-ever Dyson purifier cool fan after being recommended by a family member and the reviews I read online. Very simple to use, powerful fan yet a very quiet and adjustable airflow with a swivel base. Not only it is functional but looks streamlined and does not take up too much space (or expense) like an air conditioning unit. I love the magnetic remote control "base" on top of the fan, so the likelihood of loosing the remote control is minimised!. Literally the quietest cooling fan that I have used, was not disturbed by any noise when switched on overnight. The air flow coverage from the fan in our large bedroom was sufficient and effective and with the filtration filters it meant that my allergies to dust and pollutants were being minimised. Thanks Dyson, I highly recommend this product to all consumers. Purchased directly from Dyson NZ, amazing service and prompt delivery! Thankyou!!
reviews.title: An amazing purifying cooling fan!
reviews.author: Jill

reviews.body: In the pictures the whole thing sort of looks silvery but in reality the top part is very much white, only the bottom is silver. Also in the pictures it looks like it might be made of metal but 'in the flesh' it's definitely and obviously all plastic. Remote didn't work at first, but after I left it on top of the unit for a while it started to work. Maybe that's how it charges? Was unable to get machine connected to WiFi via app. According to the display the air quality in my room was already pure which I find hard to believe, with how much I was constantly sneezing with a stuffy nose and irritated sinuses, the whole reason for this purchase. Definitely not as powerful as a traditional fan in terms of air flow/cooling even at the max setting, in fact pretty pitiful and feeble, but I suppose that's the trade off. In terms of noise, on the highest level, the only one that blows any appreciable breeze, it's even noisier than a traditional fan. As others have said, it sounds like the jet engine of an aeroplane taking off. But that doesn't bother me too much, in fact the noise of a fan going helps me sleep. The problem with traditional fans is they accumulate dust buildup which can be hard to clean off, which is why I bought this one. I'm hoping this purifier will trap and filter all the dust. The air in my room smells better, all though I am still getting spells of sinus irritation/sneezing/running nose. Basically as a fan it's pretty rubbish compared to a traditional bladed fan, so I'm keeping it just for the air purifying, though it's efficacy at even that is questionable, compared to far cheaper units; when I spray fly spray or deodorant in my room it can take days for the air quality to go back to green! If I were doing it over I would probably separately buy a cheaper but better fan (which I've already done to cope with these hot nights) and a cheaper but better air purifier. But I've got this thing now so I might as well keep it.
reviews.title: Works as an air purifier, not so good as a fan
reviews.author: Hayden

reviews.body: I bought this about a month ago. I initially bought it as an air purifier. I got a great deal on it at almost half off through dyson's website. In the month I've had it, the filter is much dirtier than I thought it would be. On the flip side, I have not had to dust my furniture or ceiling fan blades in a month. It makes me wonder what my family has been breathing in for the past twenty years. The air purifier also has a cooling effect, which my family loves! I enjoy the lack of noise the purifier has. Some days I have to check to ensure it really is on.
reviews.title: Well worth the purchase!
reviews.author: Karen

reviews.body: I purchased the Purifier Cool after debating for several months and could not be more pleased. The air flow and coverage is impressive. The auto mode helps keep the air circulating and well filtered in a large open room with 14fr ceilings. I am noticing less dust and build up already after a few weeks. The app controls are super easy to use and make it fun to monitor. The machine also looks very sleek and has been complimented by guests.
reviews.title: Excellent Purifier and Fan!
reviews.author: Phillip

reviews.body: This is our second Dyson air purifier cool. Really happy with this fan.. it’s cooling while air purifying so it’s running constantly in our living room. Great for pet odours & general air quality where we live. The fan is quiet but if you turn it up to 10 it’s a little louder, nothing to really disturb you too much. Remote control easy to use. Helps move air around a large family living area. Dyson support is great too.
reviews.title: Our second additional cooling fan

reviews.body: The product has stopped working after a month of use. We bought this product at the beginning of June and didn’t end up using until August. Fast forward to Sept 26 and it stopped working. Contacted Canadian Tire and they told me that I have to contact Dyson itself. Dyson is giving me a runaround stating that the warranty has expired because this is an old model. I have submitted proof of receipt, Canadian Tire website screenshot showing the product item that was on the receipt and we are not Nov 2nd and I am still waiting for their warranty department to confirm if they will cover the repair!
reviews.title: Stopped working after a month!
reviews.author: MLDev

reviews.body:
After receiving real life advice from long term owners of Dyson's other air purifiers we decided to go with this one and forgo the heating aspect of the other ones as it wasn't really applicable to our use case scenario or the size of the room it resides in.

We keep this in the kitchen/dining room and it provides a lovely cooling breeze while we're also eating but also helps to neutralise odors while cooking.

It has been pretty cool to watch how it works in Automatic mode as it reacts in real time once it detects lowered air quality ratings.
reviews.title: Great purifier and cooling fan combo
reviews.author: Athina

reviews.body:
I bought two Dyson TP07’s during Amazon Prime Day this summer and I’m so glad I did. Buying two was just a bit more than one when not on sale.

The sound—even at a level 10–is perfectly acceptable, especially when compared to other fans.

My biggest “complaint” is not making it clear from opening the box that so much more control is available to you than oscillation and fan level. If you haven’t already discovered it, press the icon that looks like a remote (far right) to discover how you can control how much your fan oscillates. You’ll have to play with the other controls to discover each of their uses. Older folks remember the days when we got instructions with the product and we didn’t have to figure these things out, including accessing the online manual.
I love being able to see how much filtration function is left on the filters—a nice way to know just when to reorder. And, by the way, the filtration is fantastic! So much better than other HEPA systems I’ve had. I love being able to compare outside air quality vs inside air. I’m not sure how they know outside air quality if all your windows are closed —tapping into local weather apps, perhaps? Here in Minnesota it’s been awful this summer (Canadian wildfires) so I’ve appreciated it.
I haven’t used the remote device much, preferring to use the app on my phone, but the device came in handy last night when I wanted to turn the bedroom fan down without fiddling with my phone.

I absolutely have no regrets buying these Dyson fans.

reviews.body: Great design, fair build quality, some nice features, limited in some desirable functionality and inconsistent operation between units. As background, I own three TP07’s and have experience with other purifiers (including 2 different models and 6 Blueair units). The Dyson app could use some enhancements to improve the functional capabilities of the unit. For example, the app is unable to apply the desired default operations across all models; one must program each separately (a hassle given how the app is programmed). The app (and the TP07) cannot be programmed for scheduled operations while also using the ‘auto’ function (e.g. run the purifier each day between 9a-11a and/or run the purifier for 10 min each hour, and then revert to ‘auto’ where the purifier automatically runs when it detects a higher concentration of dust, smoke, etc.). If you use ‘auto’, you cannot use scheduling. If you use scheduling, you cannot also use auto mode. If you use scheduling, the device will only run when scheduled and not revert to automatic operation. If there is a way to schedule run time operation for a block of time or for ‘x’ minutes per hours via the app (which I could not), then the app should be more intuitive so I could figure out a way to do it (I tried and failed; it doesn’t look like the app has this desired/needed capability). I also found the ‘auto’ sensing varies greatly between units. Placing all three TP07s in the same room equal distance from a diffusor with essential oils, where each machine was in ‘auto’ mode, each machine read the air quality differently, one starting immediately at a relatively high fan speed, the other starting later but at a lower fan speed, and one sometimes not automatically starting at all; each diffusor also presenting different air quality readings. While not a strictly controlled scientific experiment, I did find the diffusor each consistently operating differently from the others despite altering the variables in my in-home experiment (distance/location of the purifier from the diffusor, different levels of diffusor output, etc). Regardless of what I did, each machine operated consistently itself, but differently from the ‘auto’ sensing capability of the others. For better or worse, my household air is relatively clean (which is why the TP07 doesn’t turn off often in ‘auto’ mode). Yet, I bought the TP07 for purifying the air as well as circulating the air in my rooms (but not necessarily running all the time to circulate air). lastly, build quality. For the price, the unit feels ‘cheap’ with its lightweight plastic parts (looks fantastic though). Fix the app, fix the TP07 operation, ensure consistently in operation between the unites, beef up the build quality, and I’d give 5 stars. I’ve had 6 Blueair units running 7x24x365 for 10 plus years, the build quality of the Dyson doesn’t inspire such confidence. For me, it’s a 3 star rating today.

reviews.body:
I have had issues with watery eyes, stuffy nose, etc for years and no matter the season.

I decided to purchase this Air Purifier with cooling (fan) in hopes I’d feel better overall and not so stuffed up all the time.

Thus far, seems to be working.

I started using this in our family room and after a few days noticed my eyes were watering less and my breathing was beginning to clear up.

After nearly a week I decided to move the unit to my bedroom where I share the space with two little dogs and one big puppy. I notice I’m starting to breathe easier and cough less during the night.

The onscreen indicator which tracks VOC’s etc shows improvement in air quality.

I definitely like the unit and would recommend it to others; just wish it weren’t quite as expensive as I’d ideally like to have one in my bedroom and one on the main level where we sit and enjoy time as a family. Although the unit is light weight to move from room to room I don’t want to give up air quality in the bedroom to get better air in the family room.

Seems to be a well built product. We have three Dyson stick vacuums in the household plus a full size upright at current and have had likely two or three other Dyson vacuums over the years so I am hoping this air purifier won’t disappoint over the years.

reviews.body:
We got really tired of our tower fans squeaking and having to take apart the entire casing just to clean the fans inside. We also had a separate smaller air purifier in the bedroom. With a baby on the way, and needing free up some space, we bought this Dyson fan/air purifier. We were pretty skeptical at first because of the price point... It is markedly way more expensive than any other fan out there, but we have other Dyson products already and we decided to give it a try.

We were not disappointed. We love that the fan isn't very loud. We love the combo of the fan and function of the air purifier, which REALLY works. We also use the continuous monitoring so we can see the stats of what pollutants if any are present. It is VERY accurate. As soon as we used some cleaning products that had some type of smell or my belly butter that had natrual scent (but a scent nonetheless), it was detected by this Dyson.

So far we love this machine and wished that thae cool/hot/air purifiter/humidifer combo would come in a taller version.

reviews.body: It is nice to get what you pay for with any product, and—sadly—that rarely happens. This is NOT the case with the Dyson Purifier Cool TP07, in my opinion. This is a high-quality product. As others have stated in their review, the unit has a higher initial price than most consumers whom are looking to buy an indoor fan. Well, yes; but this is so much more than just a fan. With features such as HEPA filtration and Bluetooth connectivity via the free Dyson app, a considerable amount of information is constantly available to the consumer. One reviewer stated the unit did not seem to move enough air; that no air flow could be felt. I cannot help but wonder if that person had the unit running in reverse. Although the unit has ten speeds available, I have never found it necessary to set the fan speed higher than six in my central Florida home. The unit is very quiet, in my opinion; barely noticeable operating at the speed I usually select (five or six).

It's quite annoying and for the price I paid should not be occurring, especially so soon after I bought it. My other Dyson I bought many years ago is still running strong. Now that I have spent time with this newer machine I can tell the build quality has gone down. Additionally I reached out to support, they mentioned I would need to send in my machine and it would take 10-15 days for repairs. I told the support person the air quality in NYC has been pretty bad lately and I needed an air purifier, if they could ship me one and I'd return the "broken" machine, the support person told me this was not possible. Not customer first at all. Overall Dyson you should be disappointed in your company and your engineering. Take this product off the market until you can build something of quality that will last, so wasteful!

The Hepa filter captures 99.97% of particles 0.3 microns in size, and powerful Air Multiplier technology purifies the whole room and cools you. ² Tested per Dyson internal test standards for whole-room air projection (Tm-005021) and purification coverage (Tm-003711). ²Fan, not an air conditioning unit. reviews.body: I have several heat-pump type mobile AC units and wanted to integrate them into my fully voice-controlled house. I did manage to buy a third party stand, but the shape of the unit does not seem to accept any wall mount, unlike the heating version. The unit has capacitive control by touch, which is very hit and miss, causing significant irritation. Product has potential with firmware updates and better integration but not really ready for market yet

Wir verwenden drei dieser Geräte, um unsere Panasonic-ACs zu steuern – und es funktioniert hervorragend. Allerdings steht und fällt der Nutzen mit der verwendeten App. Die offizielle Tado-App wirkt rudimentär; mit ihr möchte man nicht zu viel Zeit verbringen, auch wenn alle Möglichkeiten offenstehen.

Das Tado-Kästchen ist auch mit Apples HomeKit kompatibel. Doch in der Home-App sind längst nicht alle Möglichkeiten der Klimaanlage vorhanden – und weit weniger, als mit der Tado-App möglich sind. Da sehe ich allerdings die Schuld bei Apple. Die beste Steuerung habe ich bis anhin mit Home Assistant erlebt. Aber eben: Einen solchen Server muss man erst einmal einrichten und mögen.

Kurz: Die Steuerung an sich ist top. Aber es kommt darauf an, über welches System sie angesprochen wird.

reviews.body:
Update 15-11-2025: Heb een 2de nieuw product besteld op deze site om een tweede taco aan te sturen en het infraroodbereik van deze is stukken beter dan de eerste uit mijn 2024 review hieronder dat 2de-hands was. 8 meter is geen probleem zolang er maar line-of-sight is. De nieuwe begint met W37 en de andere met W03, firmware is dezelfde, wellicht nieuwer model?

Daarom review aangepast. Overigens is stembediening via Siri beperkt tot aan/uit, temperatuur, koelen/verwarmen en b.v geen ventilatorsnelheid. Ook een groot nadeel is wat de vorige reviewer reeds aangeeft in de laatste zin.

OUD: Ik heb deze tado° Smart AC Control aangekocht, weliswaar via Marktplaats voor 50 Euro, om een Haier airco-unit in mijn woonkamer te kunnen aansturen via de tado° app en Apple Homekit. Een tado° kamerthermostaat en dito radiatorkranen had ik reeds in bezit en deze Smart AC Control is dus gekoppeld in mijn tado° app. Aansturing zoals aan/uit, koelen/verwarmen, temperatuurinstelling, ventilatorsnelheid, verticale/horizontale swing, tijdsschema's werkt zo goed als probleemloos in de app.

Echter! De handleiding geeft dat dat de Smart AC Control IR (=Infrarood)-zender een "line-of-sight" (zichtlijn) moet hebben met de IR-ontvanger van de airco-unit. Dat is uiteraard logisch, maar al na 4 meter onderlinge afstand houdt het op qua aansturing en kan de airco-unit niet via de app of HomeKit worden aangestuurd. Aangezien ik voornemens was om de Smart AC Control 8 meter verder te zetten aan de ander kopse kant van de woonkamer, waar de originele remote van de airco-unit nog gewoon werkt, is dit dus geen oplossing. De workaround was hier om het apparaat direct onder de airco-unit te plaatsen, maar ideaal is dit helaas niet.

Het product is met 100+ euro duur. Het is eigenlijk niet meer dan een IR-blaster met WiFi en een display.

Na twee keer proberen is het gelukt om de AC bediening werkend te krijgen in de Tado app en Apple Woning.
De bediening werkt goed, stuurt de airco (Mitsubishi) goed aan en reageert goed om Siri commando's.
Wat iets minder werkt:
- Installatie via Wifi is wat rommelig, werkt alleen via oudere 2.4 netwerken, waarbij volgens de gebruiksaanwijzing ook de iPhone op 2.4Ghz moet werken. Waarschijnlijk hangt dit af van de router/access point, maar is vaak niet voor elkaar te krijgen.
- Een Tado account aanmaken is verplicht, en hoewel deze mogelijk alleen voor installatie en updates wordt gebruikt als je integreert met Homekit of andere controller, is het jammer vanuit privacy oogpunt dat een sensor/bediening met de cloud verbonden moet worden.
- Als je de normale afstandbediening van de airco gebruikt, blijft de Tado ingesteld op de oude stand. Dus als je de airco uitzet met de oude afstandbediening, kun je de airco niet meer aanzetten met de Tado totdat je de airco nog een keer uitzet (met Tado). Niet handig dus voor bediening op afstand, je ziet dit alleen als je ernaast staat...
