reviews.body:
Das Gerät ist genial, man kann remote alles regeln. Die Klimaanlage von Daikin wurde sofort erkannt, man muss dazu aber nahe ran gehen.
Ich kühle das Dachgeschoss wegen des Wechselrichters der PV-Anlage. Wenn die Sonne scheint verbrauche ich nur den selbst erzeugten Strom.
Folgendes könnte besser sein: Der Verbindungsaufbau zum Server hat nicht gleich geklappt, ich musste es zig Mal probieren. Das Problem ist bei mir noch folgendes gewesen, dass der Zeitschlitz des Tado zur Eingabe des Passwortes des eigenen WLAN sehr kurz ist, da konnte ich teilweise gar nicht so schnell tippen ....
Und: Man kann das Gerät an der Wand nur ankleben, ist blöd bei einer Tapete, es fehlt ein Adapter mit kleinen Schrauben.
Trotzdem gebe ich 5 Sterne.
reviews.author: Masto

reviews.body:
Ich habe die Argo Ulisses Klimaanlage. Man muss 5x die Fernbedienung "erkennen" lassen, plötzlich funktioniert es. Allerdings ist die Einbindung in Homekit Automatisierungen alles andere als trivial, denn es macht nicht das, was erwartet wird. So schaltet z.B. die Kühlung immer um 22:00 Abends ein (was programmiert gewesen wäre), auf 20 Grad (was richtig ist), aber natürlich nicht, wenn es nur 19 Grad im Zimmer hat. Macht keinen Sinn. Ausserdem wird der Schlaf/Nachtmodus der Klimaanlage nicht nicht unterstützt.
Halterungen gibt es auf Thingiverse (für Leute mit 3D Drucker). Ich weiss noch nicht, wie lange ich mich damit abmühen werde (hab das Ding jetzt 3 Tage).

name: Smart Thermostat
bestFor: Minimalist designer E-Paper display heating & cooling schedule control

reviews.body:
It just works

Having researched all of the smart thermostats and valves that can connect to HomeKit it appears that Netatmo is the only system that doesn't try to charge you monthly subscriptions for "additional" features. You buy the kit, install it, and that's it. Before purchasing I sent a message to their technical team to ask a pre-scales question and received a response answering my question in full within 1 business day. Looking good. A product that gets good reviews, no extra monthly charges, technical support that seem to be on the ball. So I proceeded with a purchase of a thermostat and a single rad valve. Installation of the thermostat is a piece of cake. No more complicated than swapping a light switch. The unit itself seems well made and has a good quality feel. It looks smart, but not overly fussy and the display is clear and simple to read. A very nice touch is that you can orient the thermostat in one of two ways and the unit detects which way is up to rotate the display automatically. I like that. Good design. Setting up the hub is similarly a straightforward thing to do. Basically, just plug it in. Download the app, and you're done for a basic setup. All in all it took less than 1 hour including a basic software setup which is painless. I then installed the smart rad valve. Again, easy to do with clear instructions. It took just a few minutes to identify the correct adapter for my old thermostatic valve. Here's a tip: you'll probably find that your old valves have seeped a little and there may be some limescale or other general crud around the pin of the valve. I scratched this away with a screwdriver, brushed off the debris and then checked the pin movement. It wasn't completely stuck, but very stiff. A couple of squirts of WD40 and a bit of a gentle tap and the pin was free and moving nicely. If you don't check for this you'll find that your new smart valve might not be able to move the pin and open/close the actual valve. The whole installation of the TRV took about 15 minutes including valve cleaning. But that was my first time. Subsequent installs have speeded up - about 5 minutes per go. I've been impressed enough to go ahead and purchase another 12 valves to equip all of the radiators in my house. The system is very easy to use and setup and provides that rare thing: simplicity and yet the ability to create complex configurations if you need to. You can create multiple heating schedules, with different temperate bands for different time slots, and different temperatures for each room in a band. If you really want to. If not, let the built-in guide set it up for you and you're done. I have a 5-bedroomed house and work from home, so wanted to create a comprehensive setup, where some rooms are heated during the day, others not, all the rooms at night, but some, such as bedrooms, to lower temperatures. No problem. It can do all that. HomeKit linkage is fine - it just works. Siri can do her thing and you can remote control temperature in each room without any difficulty. The best feature in my option is the ability to have an individual radiator valve call for heat. That's something a traditional setup cannot do. For example, during the working week I can configure the rest of the house to run at a lower heat, and keep just the office at a comfortable level. When the temperate on that radiator gets low, the valve can open, call for heat through the wireless system, and have the boiler turn on. The other valves will stay shut due to their programmed temperature. The result: you heat the room you want, and not the whole house. That is the whole point of a smart system: fine grained control and accurate temperature setting. I have a smart meter and I've been comparing the gas usage from the heating system over the past few days. It's getting colder outside, but I can already see savings, and the house feels like it has a more comfortable even temperature spread. Like others have said - you need to let the system settle in. Firmware updates will need to be sent to each valve to give them all of the above features. It's fully automatic, but it can take a day or two. Most of my valves updated overnight, but some took a little longer. Be patient. All in all, for a setup with 14 valves and a thermostat it isn't cheap. But it is good quality, it works very well, and it very much does seem to save money and distribute heat much more effectively. In todays energy conscious and environmentally sensitive times, this seems like a very good investment.

reviews.body:
At this time of the purchase this is my winner in smart thermostats on the market

We purchased this thermostat about a year ago together with the weather station. Before that I read all kind of forums, opinions, discussed the with friends who own Nest thermostat how that works for them. The final decision was more positive for netatmo thermostat- for my needs. It offers real time graphs and you may scroll it back and see also the realtime history graph, timeline. This is what nest does not offer from what friends who use told me. Only some i think daily stats not any time- realtime stats. In the app, It shows how many % of gas uses the heater, how long, current set temperature and current temperature in the room. You also get monthly report with previous month for comparison via email where you can compare then reports later if you need between parts of the year. This thermostat fits us better because gives us more freedom to manage remotely, what Nest did not offer and probably still does not offer as much. It seemed to me that Nest is more for people who need more fixed heating schedule where Netatmo gives me varios options for remote app management and also people who want to change the temperature while they are directly in the house. I can set my schedule and if people inside the house change it, i can set also after how many hours their set temperature will expire /max 12 hours/. The installation of thermostat is very simple process, you can see the wizard on their website. You will receive a thermostat and another small squuare shape power adapter which acts like an agent between the router/internet/ and the actual thermostat on the wall. The thermostat has a simple menu, shows set temperature and current realtime temperature in the room. At the top you have a plus and at the bottom there is a bottom sign. Using clicks you can change the set temperature , 1 click = 0.5 degrees. With the thermostat you will receive also i think 3 colors paper stickers, I use orange and then you place it under the top plastic cover and that gives the thermostat the nice color you like. You can then attach it to the wall using 2 screws if i remember well. Thats all for the thermostat in the room. In the app you can set away mode temperature, frost guard temperature, schedules, expiration time in hours/max 12/ after the locally set temperature will change back to your temperature which you set in the app as default. You can extend this if needed, e.g if set 12 hours expiration then e.g after 9 hours you can move the 12 hour slider to extend it for that moment from the left 3 hours/ rest of the time to 12 hrs expiration/ to again 12 hours max so it will keep locally set temp to e.g another 12 hours. Hope this makes sense :) The company often sends emails with added features and you can upgrade the thermostat software remotely. In the temperatures you can create profiles with various temps and then use it in the scheduler. In the app settings there is also a settings wheel button/ top left corner/, where you may add to the app also other thermostats/locations/. Assign the thermostat a name, share the access to the thermostat with other people for remote access. After you click on the thermostat name it shows menu settings for that location, with name, location, timezone / possible to set anything u want/, strength of radio signal between the agent and thermostat, batteries level status in the thermostat, wifi signal strength of the agent, firmware version, list of users with remote access, wifi configuration menu, home profile menu/ you choose gas, electric, wood ,....type of heater, size of the place, type of the property/. There is also advanced menu which offers to choose the expiration time for locally set temp, polarity, temperature offset / very useful if you have the thermostat in the location which is always warmer/ colder than the other part of the place where is the temperature actually important for you. That means if you have it in a place with usually temp higher 1.6 degree then you set this offset and will be always showing you real temperature at the part of the room you need. You can choose your heating algorithm, minimal heating time and also it offers to use heating prediction feature. Great toy to monitor your house/condo temperature, save money, efficient, simple and full of features. I have only positive words about it. Ohh last note, when the thermostat blinks/flickers/ that means battery level is low and it will be good to replace them later when you can. That could be a little easier process, its not easy if you have it attached in the room corner with connected wires in the wall. Thank you for a great product and making our life easier! If you are wondering if this review is honest then yes it is, paid full price and at that time it was a challenge to get it with english instructions and not in french thats another recommendation for you, make sure you will get it in english if thats your preffered langauage. If you have any questions post it as a comment and ill try to help you. You may also add +1 helpful click if this has information which you needed to know.

Un thermostat connecté pratique et économique

💡 Motif de l'achat : Je cherchais une solution pour contrôler ma chaudière plus facilement et faire des économies sur ma facture de chauffage, et ce thermostat est vraiment ce qu’il me fallait ! 💡 Description et avis : ✅ Ce thermostat connecté est super pour ceux qui veulent optimiser leur chauffage. Il est très facile à installer et offre un contrôle simple à distance grâce à l’application, qui fonctionne très bien. ✅ Il est vraiment économe en énergie, ce qui permet de réduire les factures de gaz de manière notable, un véritable atout pour ceux qui cherchent à faire des économies. ✅ Le contrôle de la température est précis et pratique. L'application offre de nombreuses fonctionnalités, et la possibilité de programmer des plages horaires pour le chauffage est un vrai plus pour adapter la température à mes besoins. 💡 Petit bémol : > Dans le planning de chauffe, on ne peut régler les moments de chauffe ou de coupure que par tranche de 15 minutes. Cela peut être un inconvénient si vous souhaitez un réglage plus précis, mais cela reste un détail mineur par rapport à toutes les fonctionnalités utiles du thermostat. 💡 Conclusion : ✅ En résumé, ce thermostat connecté est un excellent choix pour ceux qui veulent un contrôle simple, une réduction des factures de gaz et un produit de qualité. Malgré un petit bémol, je suis totalement satisfait et je recommande vivement ce produit pour sa facilité d’utilisation et son efficacité.

reviews.body:
Einfach funktional

Das Themostat von Netatmo ist bereits das Dritte, welches ich benutze. Eines zu hause und zwei weitere in Ferienwohnungen. Wenn die Teile erst einmal laufen, dann gibt es absolut nichts dran auszusetzen. Die app ist sehr übersichtlich und funktional. Die Temperaturregelung funktioniert sehr zuverlässig. Auch das Web Applet für den Browser lässt keine Wünsche übrig. Die Batterien sind Standard und halten ewig. Die Einrichtung kann etwas kompliziert sein wenn die Synchronisierung des Raumthermostates mit dem Relais nicht auf Anhieb funktioniert. Das war bei zweien der drei Geräte bei mir der Fall. Ist kein Hexenwerk, aber ich kann mir vorstellen, dass der ein. oder andere da seine Schwierigkeiten mit hat. Daher einen Punkt Abzug. Fazit: Zuverlässige Smart Thermostate in wertiger Qualität.

Steuerung per Alexa funktioniert auch problemlos. Falls das Handy mal nicht zur Hand ist, kann man am Thermostat auch direkt die Temparatur einstellen.

reviews.body:
Fantástico. Fácil de usar y ahorra calefacción

Me decidí a comprar el termostato después de una muy buena experiencia con la estación meteorológica del mismo fabricante. De nuevo, estoy muy satisfecho. Se instala muy fácilmente, sustituyendo el termostato que ya tienes, y a partir de entonces se configura en dos pasos y funciona solo. En caso de duda, a través de la web te asesoran para confimar si tu caldera es compatible y el mejor método de montaje del termostato. Lo que de verdad hace especial al termostato es su app para el móvil. Sin ella no es más que un termostato corriente. Con la app, y mediante un programa de configuración muy sencillo, estableces los horarios en que estás en casa o fuera, y regula la calefacción según esa pauta. En un par de semanas de uso, aprende lo rápido que tarda en calentarse la casa y entonces se ajusta para que siempre te encuentres la casa a la temperatura deseada cuando llegues a casa. Si te vas de casa unos días, puedes dejar la calefacción al mínimo en casa para ahorrar y que se encienda automáticamente cuando vuelvas. Para usuarios avanzados, es totalmente configurable, y además a través de la web de Netatmo te da cada mes informes de cuánta calefacción has ahorrado, y compara tu programa con el de otros usuarios que vivan en tu misma ciudad o provincia, para que tengas referencias con que comparar. Si encima tienes una estación meteorológica Netatmo, se enlazan y detecta en cuanto empieza a hacer frío antes de que la casa se enfríe en exceso. En resumen, estoy muy satisfecho. La casa está siempre a la temperatura que quiero, y encima este año estoy gastando bastante menos en gas.

Dopo una attenta selezione

Non posso che unirmi al coro di chi ha recensito questo prodotto con 5 stelle. La mia storia è semplice: oltre ad essere un amante della domotica e dei servizi web, sono molto concreto anche sull'affrontare determinate spese. Il mio termostato di casa si è rotto, un BTICINO tipico con il display a cristalli nero, con le regolazioni per il riscaldamento manuale o il giornaliero con le fasce di calore..... niente di eccezionale. Dopo 18 anni mi aspettavo che ci fosse ancora in produzione, ma non che una BTICINO potesse chiedere per quel prodotto oltre 150 euro (un pezzo di plastica con una tecnologia alquanto "retrò". Visto il prezzo, ho iniziato ad informarmi: premetto che ho già parte della casa con domotica, ad esempio comando via APP anche il riscaldamento o il condizionamento dei miei DAIKIN quindi ero già pratico di dispositivi che dovessero collegarsi alla wi-fi di casa e consentirne il comando anche da remoto. Questo prodotto ha di molto superato le mie aspettative (considerando che il costo è di pochi euro superiore a quella "schifezza" della BTICINO che c'era prima. Passo alla descrizione della scatola (dovrei spendere parole positive perfino per il packaging, veramente degno di nota, quasi stile Apple). All'interno ho trovato: - cavo e relè se si vuole attaccare il comando direttamente alla caldaia - il dispositivo a muro - un coperchio se si vuole usare il dispositivo che comanda la temperatura come soprammobile - il coperchio che sta dietro la scatola per coprire i buchi del muro (non che ce ne siano da fare, ma chiaramente questo dispositivo ha una misura diversa rispetto alla scatola elettrica classica di casa) - viti fischer, se si vuole o si ha la necessità di bucare - cover per dare un colore al retro della trasparenza del dispositivo (è già bello cosi come è, Paul Stark disegna ottimi prodotti di design casalingo) - un cavo usb - adattatori elettrici vari Tutto quanto sopra può spaventare, ma vi assicuro che io non sono un elettricista e nemmeno un caldaista, ma ho montato il dispositivo in meno di 10 minuti, compresa la configurazione da app. Ho tolto il vecchio termostato, ho recuperato i due fili che poi sono quelli che danno il comando alla valvola del piano terra (dove ho installato il dispositivo Netatmo), ho collegato i due fili al nuovo e ho ricomposto la scatola, tra l'altro fissandola con due sole viti sfruttando uno spazio tra il muro e la scatola in plastica del precedente termostato. Lavoro egregio, aderente perfettamente al muro. A questo punto ho montato le tre pile alcaline (già in dotazione, le ho dimenticate nell'elenco) e con una leggera pressione ho fatto aggrappare il controller alla presa muro. A quel punto ho preso il relè, gli ho attaccato la presa in dotazione compatibile con i nostri impianti elettrici, ho scelto dove potesse stare si visibile, ma non in mezzo alle scatole visto che ci dovrà stare, in teoria, a vita. La mia scelta è stata sopra un mobile dove peraltro avevo già il router wi.fi. Ho scaricato la APP di Netatmo, con semplicità estrema la APP ha cercato il relè, mi ha guidato nella configurazione, tra l'altro prendendosi da sola le chiavi di accesso del mio wi-fi (io ho usato un iPhone 6S e un iPad Air) e tutto era fatto. Con mia graditissima sorpresa, ho scoperto che, avendo già dispositivi Apple in casa, posso comandare il Netatmo anche con i comandi vocali di SIRI, basta seguire una semplice procedura dal telefono o dal tablet (uno o l'altro è uguale, tanto poi si sincronizzano con l'icloud) e a quel punto si può chiedere al telefono (o al tablet) che temperatura rileva il termostato, che temperatura è impostata in quel momento, se voglio alzare la temperatura, abbassarla, spegnere la caldaia quindi e molto altro, chiaramente se si estendono i prodotti Netatmo (ad esempio la stazione meteo o il pluviometro) tutte le funzioni si estendono. Ho fatto quindi delle prove per verificare che accendesse e spegnesse regolarmente la caldaia in base alla temperatura impostata. Da subito sia sul tablet sia sull'iPhone si è iniziata a compilare il diagramma della curva termica (tra qualche giorno potrò anche dirgli di comportarsi in maniera intelligente, anche se già in parte lo fa). Sappiate, per chi appunto ha prodotti Apple come me, che è perfettamente compatibile con il servizio HOME KIT di Apple, lo troverete nelle impostazioni del vostro telefono o tablet e potrete sfruttarne tutte le potenzialità. Altra grandiosa scoperta, avendo in casa un Apple TV comprato diverso tempo fa, di terza generazione (quindi non l'ultimo modello) posso chiaramente comandare tutto, anche l'accensione manuale, o anche sapere come sta la casa in termini di temperatura, anche quando sono fuori casa. Insomma, se siete indecisi come lo ero io, fidatevi, è un gran prodotto e vale tutti i soldi spesi, anzi, mi vien da ridere se penso che stavo per ricomprare quella schifezza della BTICINO che avevo prima, che non ha nessuna di queste funzioni. Ora aspetto la neve...... cosi mi immagino sotto al piumino che dirò "..... Ehi Siri".... e poi "accendi il riscaldamento".... oppure "aumenta di 1 grado".... non so se rendo l'idea, OZIO PURO......

reviews.body:
This product is a very useful product. seams to be built as well as any quality electronics product. The most exciting use that I had for this product was to setup the on and off operation of my air compressor. The compressor is homed in an outbuilding, and i have airlines supplied underground to my shop and my garage which allows me to use the air compressor without the noise of the compressor. I used this product in conjunction with a Hue receptacle (plug) to turn off and on a relay. The relay, is used a switch to operate a low voltage contactor at the location of my compressor. The contactor Applies power to my compressor. This Hue product allows me to turn on and off the compressor at will from my phone and also allows me to set a timer of how long I want it on. The compressor works as normal and shuts off on it own when desired pressure is reached. However with almost all compressors they leak down and come back on when the reach lower pressure. This Hue product prevents me from having to go to the outbuilding and turn on or off the compressor. Also saves in energy cost by not allowing the compressor to come on when not being used. This is an awesome upgrade to my remote air system.
Was able to install one Hue light bulb to use, in the bedroom. It worked very well.

Although I really like the Hue products, In my honest opinion the products are very cost prohibitive to every day users. The cost of each light bulb, switches, and other accessories are very high. The cost of using the app for upgraded capabilities are very expensive. Making this system, unpractical for most people, and allows for the most extensive use to be by wealthy individuals. I have seen other comparable products that can do allot of the same things with much less expense. The Hue product appears to be a good product, but for someone such as myself with limited or should i say a fixed income, it is not what i would consider affordable.

description: Let Philips Hue enlighten you. The 60W A19 White and Color Ambiance Starter Kit Gen 2 has everything beginners need to turn a house into a smart home. Just install the Hue bulbs and sync them with the included Hue Bridge, which gives you complete control of your lamps and lighting fixtures through the Philips Hue App available for Android and Apple smart phones and tablets. Now you can dim or brigthten your lights, set the mood with cool or warm lighting, and even put your lights on a timer so they turn on as you get home from work. With 16 million colors to choose from, you are sure to find the right mood for the occasion. You can even choose colors that go with your favorite books, movies, music, and video games! Gradual dimming and brightening functions mimic sunset and sunrise so you can fall asleep and wake in natural lighting. These next-generation bulbs are 25% brighter than the previous generation. Pair the bulbs with Amazon Alexa, Apple Home Kit, or Google Assistant and you won't even need an app to control your lights, just your voice. If your home is already a "smart home", you can even pair them with an existing Nest or Smart Things system. With Philips Hue, the future looks bright. Or dim. Or however you want.

reviews.body:
My old TKB Home Zwave thermostat died after serving me well for 6 years, so I was on the look out for a replacement and came across this MCO thermostat so thought I would give it a go. I’m using it to control wet underfloor heating. I’m by no means an expert when it comes to electrics or plumbing, but it was simple enough to turn off the breaker, remove the old one and replace it with this new one. I have 3 wires and consulted with an electrician friend on how to wire it up. Live, Neutral and the 3rd wire went into the NO port. Then I had to bridge the COM to the Live.
Super impressed with the responsiveness and accuracy of the Thermostat. It looks smart with its glass front and touch capacitive buttons and most importantly it instantly paired with HomeAssistant (running Z-wave JS and Aeon Labs ZW090).
Really happy with it and will look to replace the other 4 TKB Thermostats shortly as 2 have died recently and I’m sure the other will follow.

reviews.body:
Initial setup was incredibly time consuming and "buggy". Literally took a day and a half even with continual, very quick & frequent communications with Tech Support. The firmware would not update; setup would time out; I would have to repeatedly clear out & go back to Step 1 to restart the entire update and setup process. The directions were clear; they just didn't work. Once the required updates and setup finally completed, everything worked. I use this to pair with the Kwikset SmartCode 916. The pairing was simple, quick and straightforward.
As for the Kwikset lock and the SmartThings App, I want to be able to "see" and get an alert every time the lock changes state (locked or unlocked) whether the code was used to enter or not; regardless of locking/ unlocking with code, key or manually (like the Vera setup). The Aeotec SmartThings App only triggers an alert if a code is entered.
The App also does not allow the Administrator to view a User's Code once it is created. This makes no sense yet you can work around this by including the Code itself in the User's Name. (Why would the Administrator who grants and controls access be blocked from viewing what he/ she created??)
After all that.... the Hub and App now consistently work the way they were designed.

The downfalls are:
1. No automation
2. Not enough room for all devices, so we have to get creative. You only have a certain # of locations that can be added.Would love to keep each property as a separate location vs adding several properties to one location.
3. Not all integrations work fantastically. Our ring camera always shows the battery is dead or nearly dead. So we ended up removing it and just use the Ring app

bestFor: Wall-mountable Alexa control dashboard with Matter, Thread, & Zigbee

reviews.body:
Useful hub, much easier than using phone all the time . Has Alexa voice built in. All your Alexa compatible devices displayed according to rooms you have grouped them into on the Alexa phone app. I bought a generic tablet stand to prop it on a table rather than wall mounting.
While most of the widgets can be moved to be put in the order you want them, the same is not true for routines (where one tap activates a series of actions) Maybe this will come later with a software update. I like how the Hub's IR detector opens the screen when you approach it.
Generally it sits there with a pretty background and a clock. Virtually no instructions with it, need to go to online tutorials to get the most out of it.

Purchased this last week and am extremely satisfied with the Echo Hub. I can easily see all my Ring Security cameras and can even arm/disarm my Eufy home alarm via an on-screen keypad. The screen is clear and responds quite well. Given the on-sale price, the hub presents great value for money!

name: S8 MaxV Ultra Robot Vacuum and Mop
bestFor: Ultimate hands-free cleaning on Australian timber floors and high-pile carpets
description: FlexiArm Design Side Brush automatically extends, reaching into every nook and cranny with precision and ease, whether it's under furniture or around concave corners, the FlexiArm Design Side Brush ensures that no dirt or dust is left behind. Extra edge mopping system effortlessly reaches edges and tight spaces, ensuring no dirt or grime is left behind, with margins of less than 1.68mm, it delivers unparalleled precision, leaving your floors spotless. 10,000Pa extreme suction effortlessly lifts dirt, dust, and debris from every surface of your home. Heated air drying, the S8 Maxv Ultra misses nothing, not only are your floors left immaculately clean, but your mops are also dried with gentle warmth, ready for future use, with heated air drying, your home stays fresh. Auto dust emptying takes away the hassle of dealing with dust, with this innovative feature, your vacuum takes care of emptying its dustbin all on its own, ensuring that your floors stay clean without you ever having to lift a finger. Hot water mop washing gives your cleaning routine an upgrade with hot water mop washing reaching temperatures of up to 60°C (140°F). This feature effortlessly dissolves stubborn and greasy stains from the mop while effectively disinfecting it. Intelligent dirt detection feature uses sensors to detect dirty water while mop washing, ensuring thorough cleanliness, it prompts re-washing of dirty mops and targets specific dirty areas, enhancing overall cleaning effectiveness. Auto detergent dispenser ensures your robot vacuum takes care of dispensing detergent automatically, cleaning becomes seamless and the dispenser takes the guesswork out of having to measure and choose detergents. With auto tank refilling, your robot vacuum ensures that you never have to worry about running out of water while mopping, dock self-cleaning ensures your robot vacuum's cleanliness, eliminating manual maintenance, and saving you time and effort.

name: Qrevo Master Robot Vacuum
bestFor: Dual spinning mop pads with 10,000 Pa suction and FlexiArm edge cleaning

reviews.body:
If I could marry this thing, I would. I named her Robo Ranesha, and let me tell you—worth. every. penny.

Watching this robot go from vacuum to mop (and yes, the mop pads lift up 👏), then return to the dock to clean itself, head back out to finish the job, clean itself again, empty, and recharge—all while leaving my floors spotless—is honestly mesmerizing.

Salt, snow, ice from those awful recent storms? No problem at all. What used to be an absolute nightmare is now handled better than when I do it myself.
I got this on sale, and even though they call it “budget-friendly,” let’s be real—it’s still expensive. BUTTTT it is 100% worth it. The app is fantastic—easily the simplest robot vacuum setup I’ve ever done. I love the features, the controls, and being able to see exactly where the robot is at all times.

It handles multiple levels too (even though I had to contact tech support to figure out how the mop works when the dock is on another floor). Speaking of support—they were amazing. I got live help at like 2 AM, and they were responsive and helpful.

If you’re on the fence—don’t be. Just get it. You won’t regret it. 💯🧹✨

reviews.body:
I really loved this machine for the first week. It was a total game changer. The app is a bit clunky but you get used to it. I loved how you can customise the settings for each room etc.

I did heaps of research and chose this one because of the mop pad removal option and the mop that goes out to the side (which is awesome). In general it all worked fine despite a few random issues - the robot unable to enter rooms that are within the height limit, robot not cleaning selected rooms, issues with the mop pad removal and cleaning mop pads even after only vacuuming. I also had issues with the automatic dust removal and had to manually do it on the app. However, most of these issues you can find a way to sort out through the app.

The biggest issue I had was the very expensive dust bags somehow ended up wet and falling apart inside the dock. I had to replace them twice within three weeks of having the machine. The cardboard had completely disintegrated, and the bags were smelly and wet. Somehow there was water getting inside the vacuum and the bag. I followed all instructions, and the floors were always dry before cleaning. I don’t know if I just got a lemon, but I returned it and wouldn’t say I recommend this brand. I’m hoping to get a full refund and buy a different brand.

reviews.body:
I bought this during the Boxing Day sales and I’m a little disappointed in it.

This is my second robovac, first being Ecovac. The Ecovac, when it works, is fantastic. Gives a spotless clean in a much shorter time frame. But the software was a huge issue and would constantly glitch, making it to get stuck in areas it shouldn’t be in in the first place. Hence upgrading to the Dreame.

The Dreame software seems to work really well but the clean is not great. I have pets and I’m constantly finding fur it has missed around the house and it takes more than twice as long to clean than the Ecovacs. It takes two and half hours just to vacuum the house. And it was more expensive than when I purchased the Ecovacs. And for some strange reason will only clean 1/3 of the bathroom, I have no idea how to even fix this.

It also runs the mop even though I’ve set it to vacuum only, so the mop pads are dirty. I don’t fill the water tank, because I don’t want to use the mop function, so the pads just stay dirty and it irks me. This was not an issue with the Ecovacs. If you set it to vacuum only, it doesn’t run the mop function.

I’m regretting not getting the Roborock now. I just don’t think the Dreame is worth the money at all. Their customer service wasn’t that great either, in fact getting to speak to someone was almost impossible. After a bunch of prompts it goes to voicemail and you have to leave a message and wait for someone to get around to calling you back.

reviews.body:
Performance:Superb
Portability:Great

Pros:
-A++ value robot vacuum with dock that can auto-lift mop pads during mopping on carpeted area
-Comes with auto expensing detergent.
-The dustbin is 3L
-Dock size is quite slim & sleek
-Vacuum suction 5000Pa is the best for late 2022 model (Newest would be 6000Pa but not yet released in MY as of Jan 2023)
-Vacuuming and mopping is satisfyingly clean on standard mode. It also increases su tion when it detects carpet.
-Camera equipped, so it's essentially moving cctv to check on things (no it does not store video on the robot. Only on your phone, if you set it to)

Cons :
-Mop pad cleaning isn't so clean (picture is after 2x mop), and with cleaning mop pad every 108ft of mopping
-Water tank 2.5L as opposed to competitor 4L (for my 551sqft mopping and cleaning of mop pad every 108ft, it can mop 2x before I need to refill)
-the detergent does make the floor a bit slippery when your feet is a bit wet

Final thoughts : 5/5 for a robot vacuum that vacuum and cleans my apartment on almost daily basis. To maximise the cleaning, don't leave around stuff on the floor and have a furniture that is at least 10cm tall for the robot to pass underneath. I got this for rm37XX during launching + voucher and added 1y warranty. In total it's covered with 3y warranty. Spare parts (brush, mop pad, hepa filter, detergent) is also easily obtained on Shopee. I dare to say it's my best purchase of 2023

Side note : You still need to do 5mins cleaning of the robot mop base station as there are dried dirty water, monthly/bi-weekly 15mins cleaning & maintaining of the robot brush, hepa filter, dustbin as well

reviews.body: Spent a long time researching. A good quality robovac was on the wish list for 2 years. In that time vacs got better, & with more features. Once the X40 was realised this topped the list (it was the ultimate amongst the competition) I waited a few months to see the reviews and sift through the hype. It still stood out as the best and it was time to buy. I was initially impressed with the packaging, the finish of the vacuum and base station. It was Easy to setup through the App. Lots of prompts & hints.So simple. First map took 7mins (big ground floor) Map looks exactly like the house. It even outlined the S shape of my sheer curtains. Very detailed.I then was easily able to rename the room's in the map and join some areas into one room,ie it put the butlers as a separate room, so I joined it with the kitchen in 3 clicks. I then selected to vacuum first then mop afterwards. The App showed it moving in real time and its path. It did the perimeter of each room and then it went parallel to the wall, back and forth until the room was complete. It did each room separately. The swing out brush got into all the corners. The vac didnt hit the skirts. The light went on in darker areas to help it see clearly. I have seen reviews of Ecovacs getting lost and traveling with no logical pattern, so was happy with this outcome. Mopping was great as well. The are so many fine adjustments in the App, but without being overwhelming. After day 1 of use of am so happy with Dreame X40 and have no reason to believe any other day will be any different, based on the extensive reviews and ease of getting this up and running today.
reviews.title: The best RoboVac ATM

reviews.body: The app is easy to use (however needs 2.4GHz vs 5GHz wi-fi). Areas are fairly simple to set up, but once you have, the robot cleans perfectly. It easily navigates obstacles - even those not on the original mapping - ie a pair of shoes left out. It also cleans the mop pads with hot water throughout the mopping sequence so the floors are super clean. You can choose to allow the robot to lift the mop pads whilst vacuuming, or to detach them at the doc and then return to reconnect when its time to mop. Very happy, and can't fault it so far!

It vacuums and mops all our hard floors and vacuums our carpeted areas very well. Given the full house we have, this little unit does an amazing job keeping the floors clean, with very little input from us. The only things we need to do is have it re-map every so often (I'm sure this could be fixed by firmware update), change water, and collection bag, as well as remove long hair from the ends of the brush (happens in almost all of these robo vacs). Considering this is the flagship model it should really have come standard with the tri-cut brush which is next on my list to get but is an additional $200 cost just to save less than 2min a week to remove the long hairs.

description: The Dreame X40 Ultra Robot Vacuum and Mop is an advanced home cleaning solution designed to revolutionize your cleaning routine. This state-of-the-art device seamlessly combines powerful vacuuming and intelligent mopping with next-level automation, ensuring every corner of your home is spotless. With features like Mop. Extend Robo. Swing Technology and Omni. Dirt Detection, it adapts effortlessly to different cleaning scenarios for a customized and efficient experience. The hands-free base station is the epitome of convenience, handling self-emptying and mop cleaning without user intervention. Its award-winning design includes a liftable mop and side brush system, preventing wet and dry debris from mixing and protecting your carpets. A Vormax suction system delivers an impressive 12,000. Pa of cleaning power, ensuring even the finest dust and stubborn debris are captured. Smart Mop & Washboard Cleaning technology keeps your mop pad fresh and effective during every cleaning session, while precision mopping strategies ensure thorough coverage, leaving floors streak-free and shining. From unreachable spots to delicate surfaces, the extendable and liftable side brush and mop adapt to clean with care and accuracy. The X40 Ultra doesn't just clean—it transforms your space with minimal effort required from you.

name: Deebot X2 Omni Square Robot Vacuum
bestFor: Fitting under low-profile Australian furniture and square corner cleaning

reviews.body:
Purchased it less than a year ago. Here is my experience
1- too noisy, you can't run it at night time or when you are hanging out in the lounge ...
2- can't run it when you are out of home as it usually tangles around the edge of the rug or gets stuck around the door stopper or behind the couch or under the table!
3- doesn't clean properly regardless of the size of the rubbish. it appears to have a selective paths without the full overage of the area. yes I have tried X1, X2 or double cleansing or usual cleansing...
4- if you choose anything other mop and clean at the same time, the software gets crashed and it basically doesn't mop only or vacuum only. the program finishes within a sec.
5- gave it a map and still doesn't work withing the boundaries, and yes I know how to map the space
6- poor quality or the main brush and the frame. the main brush keeps getting tangled ( I keep checking and it's not tangled , it stops working with the main brush tangled message). The brush cover is so poor that trying to put it back together it breaks easily
7- if a furniture is on it's way , it spends so much energy and time to pass around it that basically runs out of the battery before it finishes the job.
8- It shoves the rubbish under the rug ! just lift up the rug and you would know what I mean.
9- minimum of 3 hours drying cycle for the mops, which in summer heats up the whole house.

So you think you get a good quality top of the market for such an expensive robot ? think again. I would have given it back if I could.
reviews.author: NooshkaD

reviews.body:
Im going to be honest, I had thought a robot vacuum was a bit of a gimic. My wife really wanted one - I didn't. So, we compromised and got one, not too dissimilar to the time we compromised and got a cat, which now catches wild rabbits and hides them in our two year olds wardrobe for us to discover.

Anyway, she's just thrilled with it - the wife that is - I dont know how the cat feels about it as I haven't seen the thing since the Deebot arrived, so we have SUPER clean floors now.

The Deebot is very clever - I still don't feel like we're using it to its full potential. It maps your house, has an actual good mopping ability and actual good sucking power (on some of the more thorough settings), it has obstacle avoidance with lasers and cameras - very high tech - "you can even tune in to watch it on your phone", my wife was bragging to me. Made in China so that data is surely confidential. I think she said it can take a picture and send it to you if it can't reach something during a clean. I'm not sure how I feel about that feature, to be honest. I have a feeling it's just going to end up ratting on me all the time, which is points against, if true.

Speaking of rodents, I’d be lying if I said I wasn't curious to see the action replay of a chance encounter between the Deebot and Mr Meowington's next wee rabbit pal - I wonder if the AI can tell its not actually a small lumpy mat. Something to look forward to, I guess.

Anyway, suffice to say that so far everyone in our house is happy with the purchase. Everyone that matters at least.
reviews.author: JaredW48

reviews.body:
From day 1 this has been the worst purchase we have made. I insisted we bring it back to the store upon the many issues straight up, awful mapping, just generally useless (we are very tech savvy).
However, we persisted with it for over a year, trying many different things to improve the function. today was the last straw. It's going in the bin! Overpriced and useless compared to cheaper models. very disappointing, don't waste your time, money or sanity!

The vacuum often does not complete the cleaning task when not home. I will put the vacuum on and come home to it not completed at all or it is forever getting lost/stuck and requiring it to be remapped. Very unreliable if left unsupervised and even more frustrating coming home to the job not being done.

Forgets where it is and struggles at times to find the station, misses cleaning areas and has a poor battery life with going out cleaning a bit then going back to charge. Will put dirt into piles ant times if you have not cleaned it the day before and then leave the dirt and go around the piles it’s created as if it is an obstacle. I purchased my Deebot x2 robotic vacuum in January, absolutely love it. It has been a game changer for me as I have a back injury, & vacuuming in our home was a constant struggle. Now it is a dream to think about vacuuming, no more stress just set it & go.

However, imagine my extreme disappointment when I was informed that the store where I purchased my expensive machine could not supply me with vacuum bags, as quote this item wasn't listed on the store's system, however it is listed on The Good Guy site, I was informed by staff member. Have already purchased a replacement bags once & had to pay post for this item, & yes Harvey Norman still cannot supply me with these bags., 2 months later. reviews.body:
I bought this about 6 weeks ago and it’s been a game changer. My floors are so clean. I love this machine! Was considering getting a cheaper vacuum but glad I didn’t. I love how it washes and dries the mop pads and empties the dust bin. She (Debbie) cleans the main area every day and I am horrified at the colour of the dirty water.

I did have a couple of teething issues where she couldn’t get back to the docking station but the front camera was covered in dust. God knows where she finds all this dust, lol. She has been stuck under chair legs but i love how you can go into camera mode on the app and manually drive her out. She gets right into some corners but not others. Don’t buy this if you expect it to replace manual vacuuming. It’s more for maintenance cleaning, although I have only manually vacuumed once in the last 6 weeks.

Give it a few weeks to work out the app. One tip on the app, you can vacuum without mopping you just need to press the vacuum option before choosing your room. Wait for the beep on the machine before choosing the room. You don’t need to remove the mop pads for just vacuuming. Long story short, I freaking love this robot!

description: Transform your home cleaning with the powerful Ecovacs DEEBOT X2 OMNI Robotic Vacuum, engineered for a hassle-free experience. This bagged robot vacuum effortlessly sweeps floors, delivering 8000Pa of suction to lift dirt and debris with ease. Navigating intelligently through 3D Structured Light and Lidar sensor technology, it avoids obstacles and restricted areas for thorough coverage. Enjoy up to 212 minutes of autonomous cleaning time and relax knowing this robot can self-charge when power runs low. With Wi-Fi connectivity, you can use voice commands or the app to schedule cleans wherever your phone takes you. Weighing just 5kg, the compact DEEBOT glides under furniture to reach hidden dust bunnies. Mopping pads attach to gently wash floors with hot water, leaving behind gleaming hard floors. For powerful automated whole home cleaning, look no further than the Ecovacs DEEBOT X2 OMNI. The manufacturer's part number for this product is DEEBOT-X2-OMNI.

name: Deebot T30 Pro Omni Robot Vacuum
bestFor: 11,000 Pa ZeroTangle anti-tangle brush for long pet hair

specifications.name: Weight
specifications.value: Around 18 kg (combination of docking station and robot vacuum), 4.1 kg (Robot)

specifications.name: Design Highlights
specifications.value: Obstacle avoidance, Advanced mapping, Mopping Function, TrueMapping 2.0

specifications.name: Assistant Support
specifications.value: Google Assistant, Alexa, YIKO AI Voice Assistant

reviews.body:
I recently upgraded from the N10 plus to the T30 Pro Omni, and I’m so impressed. The N10 plus was a great introduction to robotic vacuums for me, but the T30 Pro Omni has stolen my heart.

The TruEdge Adaptive Edge Mopping is my favourite feature. With its retractable mop head and spinning motion, it effectively tackles even the trickiest spots on the floor. I no longer have to go back and manually clean up small bits of residue which is great.

The mapping system is another game changer. It’s very user-friendly, allowing me to easily select specific rooms for cleaning. The water tanks in the mini omni station have also been a huge convenience. The self-cleaning system means minimal maintenance on my part, and emptying the dirty water is very satisfying! See picture attached.

As someone who sheds a lot of long hair, I’ve always struggled with vacuum rollers getting tangled. Thankfully, the ZeroTangle Anti-tangle Technology has solved that issue. I no longer have to spend time cutting hair out of the brush, which has saved a lot of frustration (and a few arguments with my husband 😂).

I’m also impressed with how well it cleans along the edges of furniture—it’s noticeably more thorough. Plus, the ability to transition between rugs and hard floors without any manual adjustments is so helpful.

My final point, which is important to me (maybe less so for some) is its aesthetics. It is a pretty white and beautifully designed to fit seamlessly into my home and its decor. 10/10 for this.

All in all, the T30 Pro Omni has been an amazing upgrade, and I couldn’t be happier with it.
reviews.title: Great upgrade
reviews.author: TaraP

reviews.body: Setup was simple. Mapping the house was easier then expected, basically tell it to map your house and it goes exploring comes back and its basically done. Map needs fine tuning but easy done through the app. Vacuum quality is great, I have 2 dogs that lose hair and this left the carpets very nice. I run around on standard suction as strong suction chews the battery. Mopping quality is also great. I love the true edge, it cleans edges perfectly.Avoidance detection has been perfect also.The bot isn't loud either unless u run on the deep clean setting were the suction is at maximum.On standard you can easily watch TV while it vacuums on by. The loud part is when it gets back to the docking station and does the auto empty but that only lasts a few seconds. At this point in time I cant knock its performance but it is only early days and it is my first Robot Mop/Vacuum. I was however not too happy that not a single spare part is supplied.I would have thought at least a set of mop pads and a bottle of floor cleaner would have been supplied considering the unit has a RRP of $1799 but nope nothing at all. That aside definitely earning its keep at my home.
reviews.title: Great Robot so far
reviews.author: Rob

reviews.body: This is a cleverly designed machine that takes out the hassle of cleaning your home. It has a smart mapping system that lays out your house floorplan and enables different methods of cleaning - via zones, rooms or programs. The unit picks up all kinds of mess and I am super impressed that it collects mountains of hair and does not ever get the hair caught or tangled in the machine itself. The robo easily moves from carpets to tiles to wooden floors throughout my home. The app is easy to use and has all sorts of options available.On the downside it uses a lot of energy to vac on a strong suction and I am unable to vac and mop my house on 1 charge. So I therefore have to wait 3 hours for the battery to recharge after vacuuming before setting it on the mop function. I have also had 2 instances where the robo could not find its station I had to manually lift the robo and place in directly in front of its station as it had been "lost" for a period of time cruising around the rooms in my house trying to locate its home. I am not sure if this is a bug I will have to put up with occasionally or if it will improve over time as the ai improves.

reviews.body:
A hi-tech robot vacuum and mop on one that gets the job done quickly, efficiently and with minimal noise. I particularly like the Deebot T30 Pro Omni’s TruEdge adaptive edge mopping feature. It knows where my furniture is so it mops around them and doesn’t damage the legs. The auto-empty feature is really handy too, as I don’t have to do anything to it. Lastly, the ZeroTangle anti tangle technology is so good! I have long hair and a dog too, so the fact that it doesn’t get tangled up is super helpful. I was always cleaning my old vacuum cleaner, but this means I don’t need to worry about it.

These features and the trusted Evovacs brand make it a great choice for your mopping and vacuuming. It’s such a great feeling to be able to come home to a beautifully clean home! Note: this was gifted but is genuinely loved.

reviews.author: Krish4444

reviews.body:
I recently purchased the Ecovacs N30, and it has completely revolutionized my home cleaning routine. This little machine packs a punch with its powerful suction and intelligent navigation system, effortlessly gliding through every nook and cranny of my house. It handles pet hair, dust, and crumbs with ease, leaving my floors spotless.

It's smart mapping technology is impressive, learning the layout of my home and optimizing its cleaning path for maximum efficiency. I love that it can be scheduled to clean while I'm out, and the ability to control it via an app is a game-changer. The app allows me to start, stop, and monitor cleaning sessions from anywhere, making it incredibly convenient.

The vacuum's battery life is exceptional, lasting long enough to clean my entire house in one go. When the battery runs low, it automatically returns to its charging dock, recharges, and resumes cleaning right where it left off. This level of automation and convenience has saved me so much time and effort.

One of the standout features is the quiet operation. It works quietly in the background without disturbing my daily activities or sleep. Additionally, the sleek design and low profile allow it to fit under furniture and reach places that traditional vacuums can't.

In summary, is a top-notch robot vacuum cleaner that delivers on all fronts. It's efficient, intelligent, and user-friendly, making it a must-have for anyone looking to simplify their cleaning routine. I highly recommend it!
reviews.title: Amazing vacuum cleaner
reviews.author: Alinazi

reviews.body:
I had high hopes for the DEEBOT T30 OMNI PRO, but this vacuum has been nothing short of a disaster. For a premium price tag, I expected a reliable, high-performance robot vacuum and mop—instead, I got a malfunctioning, over-engineered gimmick that can’t even do basic tasks properly.

Major Issues:
❌ Water Tray Won’t Empty – The entire point of an automated cleaning station is defeated when the vacuum fails to empty the dirty water tray. After following every troubleshooting step recommended by Ecovacs, the issue persists. This is a design flaw, not user error.

❌ Overcomplicated Yet Inefficient – For a device that’s supposed to make life easier, it requires constant intervention. What’s the point of automation when I have to manually check, reset, and troubleshoot it every time I use it?

❌ Horrendous Customer Support – Instead of acknowledging the clear major failure, JB Hi-Fi refuses to provide a refund or replacement, insisting on a lengthy "assessment" process that delays resolution and leaves me with a broken product. This is unacceptable.

Final Verdict:
The T30 OMNI PRO is not fit for purpose—it’s a $2,000 headache that requires more maintenance than an old-school vacuum cleaner. When a premium product fails at its core function, it should be refunded or replaced immediately, but instead, JB Hi-Fi hides behind vague policies and delays.

Save yourself the frustration. If you're looking for a reliable vacuum, buy anything else—this is a shiny, overpriced, dysfunctional piece of junk.

Would give it zero stars if I could. 🚨 DO NOT BUY. 🚨 AND "THE EXTRA CARE PLAN" MEANS JACK TOO!

reviews.body:
I recently upgraded from the N10 plus to the T30 Pro Omni, and I’m so impressed. The N10 plus was a great introduction to robotic vacuums for me, but the T30 Pro Omni has stolen my heart.

The TruEdge Adaptive Edge Mopping is my favourite feature. With its retractable mop head and spinning motion, it effectively tackles even the trickiest spots on the floor. I no longer have to go back and manually clean up small bits of residue which is great.

The mapping system is another game changer. It’s very user-friendly, allowing me to easily select specific rooms for cleaning. The water tanks in the mini omni station have also been a huge convenience. The self-cleaning system means minimal maintenance on my part, and emptying the dirty water is very satisfying!

As someone who sheds a lot of long hair, I’ve always struggled with vacuum rollers getting tangled. Thankfully, the ZeroTangle Anti-tangle Technology has solved that issue. I no longer have to spend time cutting hair out of the brush, which has saved a lot of frustration (and a few arguments with my husband 😂).

I’m also impressed with how well it cleans along the edges of furniture—it’s noticeably more thorough. Plus, the ability to transition between rugs and hard floors without any manual adjustments is so helpful.

My final point, which is important to me (maybe less so for some) is its aesthetics. It is a pretty white and beautifully designed to fit seamlessly into my home and its decor. 10/10 for this.

All in all, the T30 Pro Omni has been an amazing upgrade, and I couldn’t be happier with it.

reviews.body:
This robot vacuum and mop certainly has its quirks.
The sensors can be very finicky on the water tank and vacuum bag/container.
It loves to go around chair legs 100 times.
It can sometimes register a small cat toy as an obstacle and other times try and eat them and get the rollers tangled.
But nothing that can't be sorted with a bit of patience and some creative use of the app commands, and the job it does keeping hard floors and carpets clean is pretty good.
Use regularly for best results.
The only major drawback of this unit is the outrageous cost of the replacement parts (vacuum bags, mop pads, filters, and brushes). Small bits of fabric and plastic that have to be replaced regularly and probably cost cents to make, but the manufacturer sees fit to charge enough to feed a family for.
You can buy these parts for less than 1/10th the cost on sites like temu, but those (of course) don't always work as the machine can sense some non-branded parts and refuse to work with them.
So, while it does a good job keeping the floors of a single storey home clean, and not having to spend nearly as much time on these jobs yourself is fantastic! Beware that there are ongoing costs for parts that must be replaced regularly and are unreasonably high.

I have owned several robotic vacuum cleaners, over 10+ years, this by far the worst.

Bought this to replace my old Neato robot, and boy am I disappointed.

Poor app integration, can store only one map at a time. Very limited and basic options to edit the map, if a room is missed at the time of creating the map, there is no way to add / edit the map and you need to start all over again.

Rudimentary navigation compared to cheaper robots with liDar navigation. The robot covers some areas a few time (goes around in circles), and some areas not at all.

Does not avoid obstacles, violently bangs into furniture and obstacles, makes several attempts to forcibly go through objects, damaging them. Does not have any option to set-up "no go zones" a basic feature available in almost all robots with navigation.

Moping is a joke, it is more like lightly wiping the floor with a dirty wet pad, dirt sticks to the pad and is then dragged all over the house.

Dirt collection bin is very small, requiring emptying it frequently.

Does not come with a Drip tray, though their manual, clearly states it is included.
Contacted customer support, was told to send proof of purchase, along with picture of the manual showing parts included. Sent email, no response from customer service.
Why the farce of asking me to send proof of purchase in the first place and why show it on the manual.

Very poor customer service, takes more than 40 mts to get through and after that no response or resolution.

Overpriced, nothing but hipped up brand name, there are much better options available for a lesser price.

This is my 3rd Romba, so I know what to expect.
Cleaning is fair, noise is fair, but it is not returning to the docking station.
I have a small house, the docking station is centrally located, the device spent hours mapping before for its first use and it still stops in the middle of rooms.

reviews.body: Very pleased with my Roomba Combo. I've only had it for a couple of weeks. I used the vacuum component only at this point. Looking forward to checking out the mop component. It definitely meets my expectations. I was disappointed it did not come with a manual. I had to look online for instructions on how to use it.

reviews.body: I spent the whole apartment and I couldn't read the map of the house very well, even though there was only a little furniture, I bumped into it and did it again. In short, it was much less than I expected.

reviews.body: Love the Roomba. I live in a 2 bedroom apartment and don’t need the cleaning lady anymore. Roomba paid for itself in a month and the house is always shining.

reviews.body: Good for a non-pet apartment. Pros: low cost, mop and vacuum. Cons: does not recognize carpets, Mapping accuracy and cleaning according to that map

reviews.body: A nice entry level robot vacuum/mop combo. The scheduled runs are nice to keep things clean but you will need to do a deeper clean on your own later.

reviews.body: Received order with in the days quoted. I like the ability to use my phone to set up the cleaning schedule and get alerts if there is an issue.

reviews.body: We live in a 4 bedroom house didn’t really do the job for mopping wise but the vacuum suction is good just it seems confuse an constantly goes back to one area at times

iRobot

description: Whether your mess is wet or dry, the Roomba Combo i5 robot vacuum and mop can double up on cleaning tasks with one machine. From spilled crackers to everyday shoe printsthis robot can handle it. Set it to vacuum only or vacuum & mop your hard floors by swapping in the Roomba Combo Bin. Double the clean with one machine.
