reviews.body: let's face it this is a non essential luxury item and probably not on everyone's radar. but after seeing one at a relations house I decided to treat myself. after doing plenty of research realised I didn't need to spend for the top models as the eufy was actually all I would need for my home. well it's brilliant, so easy to set up and link to your phone, it makes it's own floor plan of your house which is easy to refine and zone and off it goes, it will do the entire ground floor of my house which is hard flooring with rugs (it did have trouble with one corner of an older rug but just stuck it down with a bit of tape) it can vac/mop separately or in one sweep depending on how dirty your floor is. yes ok it misses a corner or a hard to reach place but I've found it worth it to clean while I'm out/asleep at night especially with a dog, my hard flooring is looking really good 👍. I took one star off my review as I think the dust bag could be made from better materials ie not a cardboard top and also easier to empty.
reviews.title: A luxury but well worth it item
reviews.author: Cathryn

reviews.body:
We bought the Eufy X10 Pro Omni to help keep up with the daily cat litter tracking and hair from our cats and dog. After a week of use, I can say that I LOVE it.

Set up and mapping was fairly simple. We did have to move the base station to a more open spot against a wall for it to work, instead of a spot behind some furniture.

It does a good job navigating under chair and table legs and into tight spots. We make sure to keep the floor tidy so it can reach everything. It will stop and turn when we (or the pets) walk in front of it. It does get stuck on our hide rugs, which can cause the mop pads to come off. It's a minor annoyance but still.

Pretty good suction. Not perfect, but for a little robot it's impressive. It's not crazy loud, but might be loud enough to wake light sleepers- especially when it empties the dustbin. The mop also picks up an impressive amount of dirt. For big messes or sloppy messes, I'd use a real mop though. Stairs and edges do need to be done the old fashioned way.

We have the base downstairs and we made another map for the upstairs. We carry the robot upstairs to clean and it does a good job. I do think it runs out of water halfway through but there is no alert. That would be a helpful feature.

Overall, this has made our house feel so much cleaner by running it daily. I can hit the spots that were missed once or twice a week and spot mop if needed. Love it and wish I would have taken the plunge sooner!
reviews.title: I love this robot and named it Rosie
reviews.author: Simone

reviews.body:
While the Eufy X10 Pro Omni is one of the top of the line products - they fail to mention in the advertising that it's only designed for short to medium pile carpets and will not detect long pile carpet, thus will mop your carpet making it wet. If you have luxury/deep carpet you'll need to manually set mop exclusion zones for all the carpeted areas, or just turn off mopping all together. Also, it can't lift the mops high enough to avoid dragging them along the carpet even when you've set the exclusion zones, making the carpet damp - so I don't use the mop function at all in order to keep the mops dry. One other inconvenience is that the little spinning brushes fold/bend back after just a few hours of vacuuming, so now my X10 is less able to get into corners / edges.
Aside from these major inconveniences it's a good unit and the suction seems good and surprisingly quiet. Once it learns your layout it's thorough. App UI is good and customisable. Customer service is good (AI based). You can place it in different floors and it will detect and map the floor as a new area / save to memory for next time.
I'd note that the X10 is probably overkill if you don't have pets or if you keep a tidy house as the object avoidance seems largely to be for pet related messes. I probably could have settled for a cheaper model like the C20 and still got just as good a job.
reviews.author: RoyceP1

reviews.body:
This bot cleans better than expected. I love that it sets off and vacuums and mops the kitchen floor in the middle of the night whilst I am sound asleep! It is then set to charge up during cheap electricity periods. What’s not to like? The basic set up was extremely straight forward but all further instructions are on line only and I found it difficult to get answers to programming specific tasks. In the end it was mostly trial and error which was a little frustrating.
Mapping rooms takes no time at all and I’ve been very impressed by the multimap facility. You can just pick up the bot and carry it upstairs to clean elsewhere and when finished it returns to the start spot to wait for you to return it to its charging base.
Would I buy it again? Most definitely. It keeps on top of day to day cleaning without any fuss.
reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.author: Stephirey

reviews.body:
We have had 2 basic robo vacs in recent years. The last one only lasting 6 months, so after lots of research and questioning spending so much money on the Eufy X10 Pro we bit took the plunge.

I’m sitting here on day 2 writing this review as we are pleasantly surprised as to how good this robo vac is. It doesn’t drag dirt and reposition it somewhere else on the kitchen floor, it actually cleans up, empties itself, cleans the mop pads and waits for its next request.

Carpets are cleaned very well and I thought we vacuumed our floors well, this little vacuum got into all corners and under furniture so the whole place is clean as can be.

Yes we will need to get out the big vacuum and mop the floor but not every day, once a week will do.

The app is so much better than previous ones used and it actually works.
reviews.title: An essential piece of cleaning kit
reviews.author: Lellieb

reviews.body: We've not had it for a month yet but we got it in a Black Friday deal for just £449+£6 for delivery. I've just noticed the TopCashBack hadn't registered so have submitted a claim for that ££! It hoovers and mops well and finds it way around the kitchen furniture. It's quite quick and with both of us having the app on our phone either of us can take it to a room and set it off as and when. I think the place will get cleaned more often than having to lug a hoover about and do it ourselves. We can set it off while we're on other tasks, like virtual meetings! It's pretty quiet but I wouldn't do a meeting with it on in the room. It finds its way back to base for recharging and emptying of the dust and dirty water. Luckily the dog just ignores it too.

Game changer! This little gem was simple to set up and once plugged in and the tank filled just meandered round the house finding its way round and plotting each room. It is unobtrusive and takes itself back to the station to change water, wash mops and empty dust into the onboard dust bags. My floors are gleaming! We have a labrador and I was worried how it would cope with the shedding. No problem for this machine! I was ashamed the first time I emptied the dirty water tank. It had picked up so much dirt, despite me regularly mopping before. Absolutely recommended!!!

this thing does an ok job vacuuming - it's too tall to get under cabinet ledges and couches, which is a huge design flaw. it only has one spinning brush on one side, so it will miss stuff on occasion. The mop is a 4 out of 10. even at the max settings it only does a fair job, and even with using the OEM cleaning solution from Eufy, it's streaky. I got this unit at basically 50% off, so I'm not that disappointed considering what I paid, but if I'd paid full price I would have returned it. Once nice thing is that you don't actually need 2 feet clearance around it - I've got it tucked in right next to stuff and it finds it's way home no problem
reviews.title: moderately decent but needs improvement
reviews.author: Jaxon

reviews.body:
What a great piece of tech! So easy to set up & use.
Starts off by mapping the house (upstairs and downstairs). Clever enough to not fall down the stairs too!
There are options to set scheduled cleans or regular cleans which can be initiated at the click of a button. Also adjust the type of clean you need - wet mop, dry mop, hoover only etc
Moving things off the floor & opening doors is all you need to worry about. Works well at night with its own light but I would recommend scheduling some lamps to turn on whilst it does the work as this seems to be quicker.
Fascinating to watch it do its stuff.
reviews.title: Great investment & time saver
reviews.author: Dave83

reviews.body: I had wondered about buying a robot to help me keep my floors clean, but thought that it might be unlikely that they live up to the hype. My kitchen floor has been constantly mucky since the arrival of our spaniel puppy a year ago. Not any more! My kitchen is now mopped and vacuumed each night and hasn't ever looked so good! The vacuum works well on carpets too and even though the cat treats it with distain it has made my home appear clean and tidy. My carpets have stripes that would challenge the best of lawns. It does sound like a jet engine when its emptying the dust. But its reduced my stress, and I would recommend!

Absolutely love this vacuum. He’s been named Philippe and at this point he’s basically part of the family. I run him twice a day and the house stays consistently spotless with zero effort from me. It’s genuinely such a clever bit of kit, maps well, gets everywhere it needs to, and just quietly gets on with the job. The only slightly louder moment is when it empties itself, but it’s over quickly and then he’s back to being unobtrusive. Would 100% recommend. Honestly can’t imagine not having one now.

I’ve had a few different robot vacuums over the years. So an upgrade was inevitable so this one is a game changer. With having pets that malt all year round it’s made life easier to cope with the constant cleaning and mopping. It’s quiter then my other vacuum when going around the house but a little noisier when emptying the vacuum. It was easy to set up and I like the added features on the app. My only negative was it didn’t come with any cleaning fluid. So had to just use water as you can’t put any random cleaning products in the water tank. ( warranty will be affected) so you have to buy their cleaning fluid they recommend which is quite expensive. Also you only get one dust bag. And they are expensive as well. But I guess if you was paying for a cleaner it’s probably cheaper in the long run.. I do like the eufy brand though. I’ve had my other eufy for 4 years and I’ve only change the battery so that’s lasted longer then some normal upright vacuums.
reviews.title: Quieter then expected
reviews.author: Alicat

reviews.body:
After thinking robot vacuum cleaners were a bit naff for years, we finally decided to take the plunge on the x10 omni.

So impressed with ease of set up and use, from one touch mapping of our house (which I followed it round not quite believing it...) to easy scheduling of nightly kitchen cleans it's been great.

It doesn't quite get fully into some edges we're either carpets dip into walls or under our oven - and the mop is good without being great, but we're still really impressed with it. Our old vacuum hasn't been touched since!
reviews.title: Review of EUFY X10 Pro Omni Robot Vacuum & Mop with All-in-One Station
reviews.author: Reviewed by Currys customer

reviews.body: After a few weeks of using, I am more than very satisfied. Cleans very good, I like that I can choose the different suction power. Since we have pets, different types of floors, carpets as well, and pet shed is a normalcy for our household. The robot does the job perfectly. There’s an option for cleaning close to the edges and works very well. AI and camera helps with avoiding obstacles (pet toys, slippers, bowls). Basically I do other stuff while the robot does the vacuum and mopping and we have a clean house. Since we use mopping option daily, sometimes more than ones, due to wet weather, we have to empty dirty and refill fresh water approximately every 4 - 5 days. But as long as the house is clean and I don’t have to do the floors and carpets, I’m very happy with this purchase. I just wish I’ve done it sooner, but my research for the best robot, our needs and reasonable cost, lasted a while
reviews.title: Eufy X10 Pro Omni Robot Vac Vacuum Cleaner and Mop Ultimate Bundle - White | T2351221
reviews.author: Vesna

reviews.body:
Ok, so I'm only 2 days in, but wow, what a great product!
It copes with dog hair, ground in mud, tassels on rugs and the threshold ( quite high) between the dining room and conservatory floors. It also has to cope with the dog following it around!
The app takes a bit of getting used to. Don't make my mistake and set it off on a clean when you first get it. Open all the doors, move any obstacles you can and get it to map ( found in the settings icon , top right of the app).
John Lewis price matched prime day, so we purchased from JL ( a no brainier because of the warranty).
reviews.title: Wow! What a great product
reviews.author: Mrs C

reviews.body: We looked at a lot of robovacs and this one had the best combination of features for our needs. We have used it for about a month. It has some amazing capabilities that we can customize to do a variety of different jobs for various needs and conditions in our house. We have different customized jobs scheduled through the week and can check the status, stop, start, reschedule remotely if needed. Three things that could be better...the App is good but a little clunky to use. The Eufy can mop close to wall edges but not against edges. The Eufy is too tall to go under most of our furniture but on the other hand, if it had a lower profile, there are several other capabilities it would not have and those are more important to us than cleaning under all furniture. Overall, we are very satisfied with our Eufy and have absolutely no regrets.
reviews.title: We Love our Eufy
reviews.author: John

reviews.body: We spent ages brushing and mopping a large hard floor area and gave a thick carpet that took an age to hover. This clever bit of kit (X10 Pro) came up with its own floor plan and cleans while we’re out dog walking. The floor’s are looking brighter, the daily dog debris is cleared up and the carpet has stripes! It hasn’t got stuck yet despite small tables, stools and dining room chairs all getting in the way and if we move them it realises there’s a gap and gets those spaces too. Only negative is it empties so frequently and spends an age drying the mop but guess it knows what it’s doing. This has freed up so much time already for other jobs we rarely found time for. Very happy with this impressive bit of tech.
reviews.title: This is clever kit and saves so much time
reviews.author: Jeeves

reviews.body:
Had this about a month now and very pleased with it. Easy to set up and use via the app, and it does a great job in our busy house.
I think there were a couple of comments about the noise. It isn't noisy when it's running but it does make a loud noise when it's emptying back at the doc, but I think the noise is reasonable and relatively short lived.
For the mopping we have purchased the official solution seperately and that has helped leave a really nice finish on the titles.
reviews.title: Great hoover mop
reviews.author: Hannah

reviews.body: Love this product and it is the first of this type that we have bought. Easy to setup. Mops and hoovers really well and we have only used it on standard (not high power) settings. Must have access to the base station (which we keep in our kitchen) to mop. We lift the hoover bit onto second and third floors to hoover. it is noisy when it returns to the base station to empty otherwise relatively quiet. Easy to start and monitor with the app.
reviews.title: Great innovation
reviews.author: Graeme

reviews.body: Have dog and birds. Fur is a headache and we have little time to clean. Been using this for about 1.5 weeks and running it daily. Really impressed at how it keeps the house clean!!! Quite automated and effective. Hair and fur not getting tangled either. It has never been stuck so far and can handle door thresholds and carpets (it tries and tries until it conquers, if needed). App is good. Worth the investment. Hoping it lasts a long time too, appears well built.
reviews.title: Cleans!
reviews.author: Ginny

reviews.body: Love this product. I have problems with my back and dreaded mopping and vacuuming forever as I often wound up in pain after these chores. Well, problem solved! Easy to use app, excellent vacuuming and mopping . Self emptying vacuum container empties into regular vacuum bag that fills like a regular vacuum. Self cleaning mop heads. Does a great job. Zone cleaning, room cleaning whatever you want!
reviews.title: Best thing to happen to my back!! Best vacuum ever!
reviews.author: buetf-75

reviews.body:
This is a product that does not do what it says on the box. Or if so it does it pretty badly.

The most significant issues worth knowing about is that the edge hugging feature is useless. It will take twice as long and use more than twice the battery per room, and it only cleans about 50% of the edge in a wave pattern anyhow.

The claim of 150sqm to no 2-3 times is nonsense. It feels me it does my 40sqm home and it will do it 3 times maybe before it's out of water. And lots of spaces i have are carpet! Eufy tell me it might be that i need to adjust the water settings.... but it claims to do this with AI... So that's also poor. Anyhow, it's mop washing that uses all the water. And I've set it to the heat frequent wash cycle and it still goes through it quickly.

It's claim of mopping 'like you do' is only true if you really really suck at mopping. And it seems to leave circular streaks.

Sometimes, even in the most thorough cleaning setting, it even misses a strip of floor whilst mopping between each row, evident as the dry lines on the photo.

Furthermore, it sometimes does weird stuff and seems to get itself all confused, or miss a patch of floor or veer off on a diagonal to a wall etc.

It's also really noisy. For hours and hours after mopping. Don't place it in a living space you expect to occupy.

I've not been impressed at all.
reviews.title: Underwhelming
reviews.author: Greg

reviews.body: Setup was quick and simple and started cleaning within minutes. The vacuuming performance is impressive: powerful suction with adjustable settings and efficient navigation. The self-emptying feature is great, though it's quite loud for a few seconds. I haven't tested the mopping function yet, but as a vacuum, it performs exceptionally well.
reviews.title: Quick Setup & Powerful Vacuuming (Haven't Tried Mopping Yet)
reviews.author: JJ

reviews.body: Fantastic! A replacement for the small Eufy that basically wore out! This is easy to set up, works like a dream and I have my floors mopped and vacuumed daily! I couldn’t believe the colour of the water in the dirty water tank!! My wooden floors must have been filthy and I didn’t know!! It navigates the rug I have and raises the mop heads and just vacs it! It’s the best £418 I’ve spent in ages! Cheapest price could find it too!
reviews.title: Fantastic Machine
reviews.author: Lorraine56

reviews.body: I love this machine - it is effective and easy to use. It requires next to no input when setting up and mapping the room - couldn’t be easier. I love using the app to see what it has done and where it has been, and setting it off when I am out so the house can be clean by the time I get home. It is very cheap to charge - less than 3p, and the battery charges relatively quickly and can mop and vacuum out large downstairs rooms on one charge no problem. It is noisier than I anticipated - I can have it on only for a short task if I’m in the room at the same time, and it is too noisy to run in the middle of the night on another floor.

We love this machine. It’s easy to clean, refill with water and change out mop pads. It does a very good job going around legs and maneuvering out of dead ends. I’ve attached a video showing you how it figures out and completes vacuuming and mopping around chair legs. It likes to do the perimeter firsts and then systematically go back and forth in the center. We are very happy and glad that we chose this one.
reviews.title: Great little cleaner
reviews.author: Annja

reviews.body: I have been looking at this vacuum/mop for a long time and eventually decided to purchase on the Black Friday deal. It’s best thing I have bought and so pleased with the cleaning performance. Love it. I have a mix of wooden floors/carpets and tiles downstairs and it does an amazing clean throughout. Easy to set up through the app and it’s programmed to do a daily clean. Do not hesitate to buy. It’s life changing!
reviews.title: Best cleaning product
reviews.author: Mrs Mop

reviews.body: I have hard floors and I'm very happy with the performance of it as both a vacuum cleaner and a mop. Does it miss some spot occasionally? Sure, but that's pretty common for Robo vacuums. This is my third and I can't fault its performance or the app. My only issue is the dust bag. I watched some reviews and it wasn't super clear how awkward that was to empty - pull everything out thru a small hole. It's definitely a step back in time to the old disposable ones. Not a great system. But I love everything else, so much so I got my mum one and she loves it too.
reviews.title: Great vac and mop bot
reviews.author: Veronica F

reviews.body:
So I’ve gone from the X8 hybrid with mop, and I was a bit sceptical with the pricetag of this new model, but I’m having it for a few days I found the features are really really handy,

The mop feature works really really well, and lifts up the carpet so your carpet doesn’t get wet. The auto AI mapping is leaps and bounds ahead of the X8 hybrid. I was very shocked so far it’s been a really simple set up really simple process really, would recommend people taking the plunge and buying the only issue I found is that it is a lot more noisy than the eight hybrid, especially when it changes the water and empties The dust compartment.

The only other issue is the height of it is quite tall compared to the previous models that don’t obviously have the water tank or the dust collector, but it’s a small sacrifice for the ability to just literally set it off and let it do its own thing and then empty itself ready fresh for the next go out.

Very happy purchase if it lasts as long as I last a eufy Hoover I will definitely buy a second one and hopefully the good times continue
reviews.title: An upgrade that really is an upgrade
reviews.author: DaveRus

reviews.body:
This little machine is seriously impressive. The suction is next-level — it picks up everything — and the AI mapping is so smart, it just gets on with the job without crashing into furniture. The Mop Master 2.0 actually cleans properly too, not just wipes the floor.

The best part? The Omni Station does it all — empties the dust, washes and dries the mop pads — so I barely have to touch it. The detangling roller brush is genius too, no more pulling hair out of the roller.

Honestly, it’s made my life so much easier. Floors have never been cleaner and I haven’t had to think about vacuuming in weeks! 🙌
reviews.author: SarahG23

description: The X10 Pro Omni is designed to keep your floors sparkling clean with minimal effort. Its mop pads are washed with clean water and dried with heated air to prevent odors and bacteria. The large dust bag only needs to be replaced every two months, and the clean water tank holds enough water for multiple cleaning sessions in a large home. X10 Pro effortlessly removes hidden debris, including pet hair, from carpets and hard floors in a single pass. Its powerful dual mop pads effectively eradicate stains and leave your floors shining. The mops automatically lift when a carpet is detected to prevent it from getting wet. With advanced obstacle avoidance, the X10 Pro Omni can identify and navigate around over 100 different objects, even in low light conditions. You can also use the app to customize cleaning scenarios to fit your specific needs. The Pro-Detangle Comb and reverse rotating roller brush work together to prevent hair from getting tangled, saving you time and hassle.

name: Freo X Ultra Robot Vacuum & Mop
bestFor: Zero-tangling floating brush with DirtSense intelligent re-mopping

reviews.body: I was super excited to receive this robotic vacuum because we really don't have time to clean and mop all the time with the kids being so messy and in such a large house. The box that arrived was HUGE because the base stand and the robot are quite large. The base's footprint is about 41x37cm (43cm height) and the robot vacuum is about 35cm in diameter (10cm height). It's quite large so if you have a tiny apartment or low furniture, this is totally not for you.The base has handles on the sides so it was quite easy to remove from the packaging. The initial setup required a lot of steps such as removing some parts wrapped in plastic, and removing warning stickers and protection foams etc. They claim you need to give at least 1m of spacing in front of the base, so I installed it in a corner where the robot had sufficient space to dock itself. The instructions for everything are very clear and in many different languages (including English and Japanese), but the first annoyance I ran into is there's quite a few steps missing in the 2nd Chapter "Setup". In fact it starts at 2.2, what about 2.0 and 2.1? Well even the online PDF doesn't have those steps and there's clearly some instructions missing, but it doesn't take a rocket scientist to figure it out so it wasn't such a big deal. There's a bottle of "cleaning detergent" hidden inside the "dirty water" bucket, which you need to remove the seal (but not the cap) and then place upside-down inside the machine. The bottle is of unknown providence, I have no idea who makes it or what it contains, and there's no instructions on obtaining a refill. That was my second annoyance with this product. They claim you MUST use their specific Narwal Freo cleaning detergent "or risk breaking the device" but I ended up finding it listed here on Amazon for 3180yen. Are you kidding me?So after I setup everything I was dumbfounded as to "how" to get it to work... well, there's a touch panel that sometimes reacts to my touches, sometimes doesn't. It's a dark display with no physical buttons that lights up and animates. Some soft "buttons" appear but they are just icons and I have no idea what they mean without looking at the instruction manual. What is the obsession with using icons without words? Well if you look in the manual, each icon has about 20 different functions, and sometimes you have to hold two of them at the same time for 2 seconds while touching your nose with the other hand and standing on one foot. It's probably one of the worst robot vacuum UIs i've ever encountered. How hard was it to put an actual scrollable MENU with words and simple up/down/select buttons? These kind of buttons are crazy annoying but I know why, it's because they expect you to use the APP.Well now we get to my last and most major annoyance with this robot vacuum. The app is a privacy nightmare. It is hands-down the app that asks for the MOST permissions ever - of all the other apps I have installed. It wants access to my photos, location, bluetooth, wifi, cellular, personal phone identifier. It also *requires* an internet connection to use the app because you MUST create an account on their cloud service to even get into the app. Then once logged-in (I used a free junk email address), you have to again be connected to the internet to add your robot, but it will not allow you to add it without providing Location access and it also wants to connect to my WiFi so it can get online or something... Why? Oh wait, I skipped a step. When you create your account and try to add your robot, you must agree to an EULA and also agree to their "IoT" Privacy Policy where you specifically allow them to collect any and all data for any and all purposes (probably to resell your data). Hey you, we're still talking about a vacuum, right?I went through this process on my iPhone (iOS) and on an old Android phone (LineageOS) and it was the same privacy crapfest on both devices. There's no escaping it.In the end, I delete the app on both devices because I absolutely refuse to accept their EULA and ANTI-PRIVACY POLICY. It seems others might be totally fine with just clicking "agree agree agree" but this is ridiculous and borderline abusive in my opinion. The worst part about all this, is MOST of the robot vacuum functions are unavailable and can not be configured or set without the app. For example, to set the "default" cleaning mode to "vacuum only" - must be done through the app. You also can't change the very loud volume or language of the robot without the app. You can't set any timers or auto-cleaning modes without the app. So basically I find myself with a "dumb" robot vacuum that is only able to work when I manually press a button on the base or the robot itself. All the best features are effectively locked behind a seriously flawed privacy invading online cloud-connected data sharing mobile app, for a vacuum, and in 2024 I'm just not having it.As for cleaning, well yeah that works as expected.
reviews.author: 購入者さん

reviews.body: I was super excited about this newly released product and placed the order right away especially after reading all the 4/5 star reviews. However, it is quite disappointing to the point that I have to write a review which I never do. First of all, one day after I placed the order during the new product campaign, Amazon already lowered the price by 15000 Yen. Once the product was received, setting up and getting it all connected was not easy and straightforward with the app. Then, the vacuum can not go back to the base station after many attempts. It still doesn’t and I have to manually give it a push. In addition, the map edit function in the app is not easy to use at all. For example, I still haven’t figured out how to add a carpet to the map so the robot can avoid mopping the carpet. As for cleaning and mopping, it does the job, but it’s expected to do so at this price tag. For the mopping, it leaves marks on the floor and I found out mopping multiple times help. Stay tuned for the follow-up reviews on how/if I can resolve these issues…

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.author: Ben8

reviews.body: Super

初めて買ったロボット掃除機でした。
ペットがいるのでずっと床の汚れが気になっており、水拭きも出来るしセールで安くなっていたので購入しました。本体めちゃくちゃ重くてビックリ。

数週間使用してみた不満点
仕方ないとは思いますがやはり隅っこの掃除はイマイチ、カーテンも障害物判定なので掃除してくれないエリアが結構あり、毎朝カーテンを上げるところからスタート。
厚手の絨毯に引っかかりモップが外れてエラーになる事数回、コンセントなどのコードに引っかかりエラーになる事数回、コードなどの引っかかりやすいポイントは除去する必要があると思います。絨毯はどうにもできないので引っかかった時だけ介護しています、絨毯無いのが理想ですね。
ペットサークルなどの柵は認識できないようでガシャガシャ軽く当たりながらも避けてくれています、もう少し頭がいいといいんですが…。水拭きを毎日してもらうと結構すぐ水が切れるので補充する手間を感じる。

使ってみて良かった点
大まかには綺麗になるので、床面積が広く動物の毛などがよく落ちる我が家は掃除の手間が軽減されてとても助かっています。一番最初にスイッチを入れた日は何度も水拭きしてくれていました、汚かったみたい…。実際、水を変えると汚かったです。
ペットのトイレエリアは入って欲しくないので進入禁止エリアの設定が出来て良かったです。
我が家のWi-Fiが対応してなくて設定に手間取りましたが、そこをクリアしたら簡単に使用開始できました。本体の清掃も簡単で扱いやすいので良かったです。

壊れず長持ちしてくれるなら値段に見合っていると思いますが、すぐ壊れるなら微妙かもしれません。
reviews.author: Ryo

reviews.body: Parto con l'estetica, il narwal non ha eguali per eleganza della base con le sue linee tondeggianti e pulizia visiva (robot che entra tutto nella base, nessun contenitore acqua a vista) per cui è già bello solo a vederlo. Entrando nel dettaglio trovo molto intuitiva l'applicazione che consente di rinominare le varie stanze, scegliere quantità di acqua da usare, livello di aspirazione, quale stanza evitare etc. a livello di rumorosità è silenziosissimo nella modalità meno potente (che in realtà riesce ad aspirare bene) che mi consente di utilizzarlo la notte o mentre lavoro, poco meno silenzioso nella modalità super potente ma ci sta, è comunque sopportabile. Pulisce bene ma per questo dovrò fare altre prove. Ho notato che ha una precisione millimetrica Nel passare ma non sbatte quasi mai. Nel complesso lo adoro. Grazie narwal. Sarà il mio alleato nelle feste e nella quotidianità. Ho aspettato un po' di tempo per averlo ma Narwal mi ha gentilmente inviato un omaggio per l'attesa, servizio clienti per email molto veloce nelle risposte.
reviews.title: Eccezionale
reviews.author: V.

reviews.body: Dopo 6 anni di onorato servizio, il mio robottino lavapavimenti è deceduto. In 6 anni molto è cambiato, così ho deciso di investire sul narwal freo x ultra per constatare che molto è cambiato in questi anni. A parte una iniziale difficoltà nel configurarlo, date le scarne istruzioni in tutte le lingue a me note, dopo aver effettuato il pairing di robot con base (passaggio essenziale per aggiornamento ma anche per le opzioni di lavaggio) è andato a meraviglia. Lo possiedo da 2 settimane e si è lamentato molto per lo stato in cui ha trovato il pavimento apparentemente sporco ma non in modo esagerato... Ancora da constatare la durata dei pezzi interni,per ora mi ritengo comunque soddisfatta. Se potesse volare saremmo a 10 stelle, poiché trasportarlo (solo robot) da un piano all'altro è un po' pesante (per il solo spazzola mento probabilmente non ne vale la pena, se avete già alternative e metrature modeste). Per lavare infatti necessita dea base, questa sì pesante a prescindere dallo spostarla coi serbatoi vuoti.
reviews.title: Un salto di qualità
reviews.author: C.V.

reviews.body:
なんといってもデザインが良いです。
本体のタッチ液晶の操作パネルも使いやすいです。
モップが回転するタイプで、ブラシが両サイドにあり、モップを自動乾燥までしてくれる物を探しているならこれが最もコスパ良いです。
スマホアプリの操作もやりやすく、マップが崩れる事がありません。
2cmの厚さのプレイマットも普通に上がれます。何も不具合有りません。
動作音も静かで、ドックに帰った後の洗浄もうるさくありません。
商品選定時に気づきにくいのが、ゴミは本体のダストボックスに溜まり、ドックに吸われない事です。でもゴミが圧縮されるようで、60日間は溜めれる容量だということです。
隅っこモードをしても完璧に隅々にはモップはかかりませんが、あまり気にしてません。むしろ隅っこモードは時間が少し余分にかかるので最初以外使ってません。
モップ掛け用の洗剤が一本付属します。
今まで他のロボット掃除機ではブラシに髪の毛が必ず絡まっていたのですが、1週間使っても一本も髪の毛が絡まっていません。

物は避けますが、コードは絡まります。
Googleアシスタントも対応していますが、コマンドは「掃除して」では伝わりません。「掃除を始めて」なら伝わります。
このような小さな欠点はありますが、デザイン性、髪の毛が絡まらないことに重きを置く人には一番のオススメとなります。
reviews.author: タツ

reviews.body:
自宅は2階建てなので10年くらい前より各階にロボット掃除機を設置。以前はルンバを使っていましたが、今年の3月に2階用をAnker Eufy X9Proに買い替え、水拭き性能の高さに驚きました。高齢の母親のいる1階用にもモップ自動洗浄付きモデルが欲しくなり、評判の良いNarwal FreoXを購入。
【良いところ】
・ステーション側に操作ボタンがあるため、1回スマホで登録を完了すれば高齢の母親でも簡単に使えます。
過去にルンバi3でにスマホアプリを入れましたが、高齢の母親には使いこなせませんでした。
他の機種とも悩みましたが、スマホ操作が不要を条件として探すとコレ1択になりました。
・フローリンングの床が本当にきれいになります。洗剤の効果もあると思いますが、Anker X9Proより確実にきれいになります。
・ゴミが圧縮される点は良いと思います。とはいえAnker X9Proでも掃除の都度、ゴミを捨てていましたので個人的には自動収集は不要だと思っています。
【悪いところ】
・スマホアプリの使いやすさはAnkerの方が良いです。Ankerでは各部屋・廊下など細かく部屋を設定できましたが、Narwal のアプリでは上手くできませんでした。(評価マイナス1点)
・洗剤がチョット高い。定価の3千円は高いのでは?
【総評】
全体的に満足度は高いと思います。バッテリーの持ちもよく、動作させれば1階の床を全てきれいにしてくれます。
ジャパネットたかたと組んで、訪問設置・初期設定を行うサービスがあれば、高齢者に売れると思います。
reviews.author: Nob3

reviews.body:
Abbiamo deciso di acquistare un robot per farci aiutare con la pulizia dei pavimenti di casa, in quanto con due bambini e un cane c'è necessità di fare una pulizia giornaliera, cosa che a volte risulta complicata vista la grande quantità di impegni.
Finora lo abbiamo testato per tre giorni, e siamo molto contenti.
Avevamo passato il pavimento con l'aspirapolvere e lo straccio per bene prima di sguinzagliare il robot in modo da agevolargli il lavoro ma con gran sorpresa abbiamo visto che grazie alla tecnologia dirtsense ha ripassato lo stesso più volte anche dove eravamo convinti di aver già pulito a sufficienza.
Risultato?
Acqua nel cassetto dell'acqua sporca nera!
Pavimento super pulito e gran soddisfazione.
Sicuramente un acquisto che ci permetterà di avere una casa più pulita e più tempo da dedicare a noi.
reviews.title: Impressionato
reviews.author: D.R.

reviews.body:
Lo utilizzo da poco piu' di un mese e devo dire che sta andando molto bene, facile l'utilizzo dell'app che permette di attivarlo in qualsiasi momento e da qualsiasi luogo, nessun problema rilevato nell'installazione.
Fa egregiamente il suo lavoro sia nell'aspirazione che nel lavaggio, cosa quest'ultima che mi interessava particolarmente.
Bellissimo il design, si integra bene con l'arredamento.
Un solo problema nella mappatura perché ha mappato insieme cucina soggiorno e cameretta ma basta selezionare dall' app la pulizia a zone per fargli pulire solo una parte se non si vuole pulire tutta casa.
Al momento direi che è stato un ottimo acquisto!
reviews.title: NARWAL FREO X ULTRA
reviews.author: S.

reviews.body: 椅子で畳が傷つかないように、御座を重ねて敷いている環境ですが、想像以上に掃除することができました。痛んだ御座の継ぎ目部分も乗り越えて掃除することができます。まず商品が届いたときに、その箱の大きさに驚きましたが、ベースステーションやロボットの大きさは邪魔にならないサイズ感でした。ベースステーションは空気清浄機くらいの大きさで、奥行きが空気清浄機1.5個分くらいです。ロボットもそれに収まるサイズなので、4畳半部屋に置いても大きくは感じませんでした。箱はミドルタワーのパソコンケースの外装箱より大きいので、フルタワーパソコンのケースの箱くらいあります。床が畳や御座だったり、カーペットのある部屋だと、隙間に引っ掛かって、ロボットが動かないという事をよく耳にしますが、御座を重ねている床がデコボコな部屋でも掃除ができました。乗り越えられる段差の高さは、2㎝までなので、それくらいの段差であれば問題なく走行できます。しかし御座がめくれあがっている場合は、サイドブラシやモップが隙間に入ってしまい、引っ掛かることもありましたが、自分でバックして軌道修正していました。ファームウェアーのアップデートに、新しい床材で畳なども追加されていたので、そのおかげで掃除できたのかもしれません。絨毯やカーペットを敷いている場合は、設定でカーペットモードをオンにしたり、エリアを指定することで、その部分だけ強力吸引することができます。カーペットなどでも重ねて敷いている場合は、めくれあがっている隙間にサイドブラシが入り込んで、引っ掛かると思うので、掃除の前になるべく平らにしておくとスムーズに走行できます。ロボットが走行できる範囲なら、思ったよりもしっかり掃除機をかけてくれたので、毎日の軽い掃除はこのロボットに任せて大丈夫そうです。デスクワーク中の消しゴムのカスを、このロボットに掃除してもらおうと思って注文しましたが、その用途であればしっかり目的を果たしてくれます。ちゃんと掃除をするときは、掃除機でやった方が良いので、用途と目的別に使い分けた方が良いです。木製の廊下も掃除機とモップ掛けをしてもらいましたが、しっかりモップ掛けできていました。モップが回転しながら洗剤でゴシゴシ拭いてくれるので、汚れが綺麗に落ちます。ただしあまりに狭い廊下だと、すべて掃除してくれず、途中で戻ってきてしまったので、ある程度の広さが必要です。廊下の幅がロボットとほぼ同じくらいの大きさだと、途中で停止して戻ってしまいます。具体的な清掃エリアの広さは、最低でも0.3坪必要なので、指定エリアの幅と奥行きが99.5cm必要になります。廊下に置いてあったストーブなどをどかしたら、幅がロボット2台分くらいになったので、99.5㎝以下ですが掃除してくれました。新品のモップの状態と、水拭き直後のモップの状態、モップの自動洗浄後の状態を画像に載せておきましたが、1回のモップ洗浄で汚れがほぼ落ちていました。モップの乾燥はかなり時間がかかるので、4~5時間は見ておいた方がいいです。と言っても自動で洗浄から乾燥までやってくれるので、放置しているだけで勝手に乾かしてくれます。モップの洗浄時の音は、窓用エアコンの稼働時より低くいですが、水で洗っているような音がします。乾燥時の音は強力乾燥モードに設定しても、窓用エアコンの送風や、パソコンのファンの音より静かです。静音モードにすると、耳をベースステーションにあてても分からないくらい静かになります。モップを洗浄した時に使った汚れた水は、白いダーティーボックスに溜まるので、水漏れなど心配はありません。音声認識はSiriとAlexaに対応しているので、アプリをインストールし、ショートカット音声を録音するだけで使えます。アプリはアカウントを作成する必要がありますが、フリーのメールアドレスでも登録可能で、要求される情報はメールアドレスと住んでいる国だけなのですぐに使えました。音声操作は良好で、一つの部屋だけで使う場合は、音声操作のみで完結できます。部屋を移動して使う場合は、マップの切り替えをする必要があるので、アプリから操作する必要がありました。また音声のショートカットを作るときは、デフォルトだと英語認識になっているので、マイクマークの横の「EN」を「あ」に変える必要があります。ロボットの操作は、ロボット本体のボタンや、ベースステーションのボタンでもできますが、組み合わせを覚えるのが大変なのと、掃除エリアのマップを作製するときにアプリが必須なので、どのみちアプリのインストールが必要になります。アプリからの操作のほうが、ボタンの動作がテキストで書かれているので操作しやすいです。また作成したマップは、2Dでも3Dでも表示することができ、掃除中はロボットの現在位置がリアルタイムでマップに表示されます。説明書やロボットの音声は完全に日本語対応しているので、「ステーションに戻っています」などの現在の状態を、Siriの声で話してくれます。ロボットの音声のボリュームはアプリから調節可能なので、デフォルトの75%くらいの音量が大きすぎると感じる場合は、小さくすることもできます。付属品に予備の使い捨てダストバッグが2個と、洗って再利用できるダストボックスが1個付属していたので、画像を掲載しておきました。ロボット本体にもあらかじめ使い捨てダストバッグが1個装着されているので、合計で3個付いています。使い捨てダストバッグやダストボックスは現在(2024年5月19日現在)販売を確認できませんでしたが、2024年5月24日ごろに順次販売されるようなので、とりあえず付属品だけで大丈夫そうです。再利用できるダストボックスは、HEPAフィルター部分だけ定期交換が必要なので、1~3か月くらいの交換が推奨されていました。メインブラシやモップ、サイドブラシなどの各消耗部品は、1~3か月での交換が推奨されていて、交換時期はアプリから確認できます。交換時期は使用時間によってカウントされているので、例えばメインブラシなら300時間、モップなら150時間、サイドブラシなら150時間、使い捨てダストボックスは32時間という感じです。使用頻度が少なかったり、モップ掛けをしない場合は、もっと交換時期が延びたり、モップの交換カウントダウンが進まないということもあります。部品ごとにカウントされているので、よく使う部品と、使用頻度によって変わり、ランニングコストは人によって違ってきます。将来的なロボットのバッテリー交換費用を、Narwalのサポートセンターに問い合わせてみたところ、2024年5月20日現在の日本国内価格は11,085円とのことなので、維持費が安価で良いと思いました。為替相場や市場の動向で将来的に多少変動するかもしれませんが、現在はこの価格でバッテリー交換ができるとのことです。保証期間内であれば無償でバッテリー交換できるとのことですが、1年保証のうちにバッテリーがヘタることはないと思うので、保証が切れたあとのランニングコストの参考として記載しておきます。お手入れやメンテナンスは簡単で、ベースステーションの新しい水と、汚れた水を取り替えるだけです。使用後はベースステーションをコンセントから抜き、ロボットの電源をオフにすることが推奨されています。ベースステーションをコンセントに差しっぱなしにすると過充電となり、ロボットのバッテリー劣化につながるようなので、使わないときはコンセントを抜き、ロボットの電源も切っておいた方が良いようです。ベースステーションのコンセントを入れると、自動でロボットの電源も入るので起動は楽です。ロボットの電源を切らずに待機状態にしていたら、翌日バッテリーが10%くらい消耗していたので、ロボットの電源は毎回切ってからベースステーションに収納したほうが良いです。ロボットの電源を切るには、ロボット本体の電源ボタンを長押しするしかないので、アプリからもロボットの電源をオフにできるよにアップデートしてもらえれば、電源を切るのも楽になると思いました。付属品は簡潔にまとめられており、ロボットの組み立てはサイドブラシの装着だけなので、セットアップが楽でした。このロボット掃除機だけでは、本格的な掃除はできませんが、毎日の軽い掃除は任せられるので、それだけでかなり楽になります。自分で掃除機をかける頻度が減るので、そこにメリットを感じるのであれば満足度が高くなるはずです。毎日軽い掃除をする時間がなかったり、自宅で仕事をしているときに掃除の手間を省きたいのであれば、とても役に立ってくれます。
reviews.author: Tororo

reviews.body: Ho acquistato questo robot, l’unica critica degna di nota è che, avendo un cotto scuro, vede spesso tappeti che non esistono, rallentando spesso l’ispirazione perché aggira la zona. La critica si estende all’applicazione che non permette in tempo reale la modifica della mappa, ma solamente a programma concluso. Inoltre la manutenzione, contrariamente a quanto pubblicizzato va effettuata spesso in presenza di animali domestici e pavimenti ruvidi che attirano maggiormente lo sporco. Smontare la zona del lavaggio dei mop nei primi giorgi di utilizzo vi farà rendere l’idea di quanto è spesso dovrete pulire la zona della base.
reviews.title: Bene ma vede tappeti dappertutto
reviews.author: S.C.

reviews.body:
Fantastico alleato nelle pulizie quotidiane. È stato un po’ complicato all’inizio mappare la casa perché non riconosceva specchi e parti cromate o trasparenti come gambe delle sedie e dei tavoli. Anche avviando la pulizia bisogna fare attenzione a predisporre bene la casa per evitare che si incastri.
Per il resto è perfetto, rapido e silenzioso e aspira e lava molto bene lasciando solamente gli aloni di sporco meno recente che magari vanno puliti a mano.
Comodo il controllo da remoto per avviare le pulizie quando si è fuori casa

reviews.author: カミィ

reviews.body: 中国の新鋭メーカーNarwalによる完全自動掃除機です。わたしの知る限り、この価格帯で8200Paの吸引力は断トツです。音も静かでかなり優秀だと思います。【設置】ベースステーションは丸みを帯びたデザインのため予想以上に大きく感じられましたが、重量は見た目ほどではありません。移動の度にマッピングし直す必要はありますが、持ち手も付いているため室内での移動は問題ありません。左右30cm、前方1mの確保が必要なため、まずは設置場所の選択が課題となるかと思います。【セットアップ】洗浄液の詳細についてはマニュアルに記載がないため、詳しいことはわかりません。もう少し詳しく情報収集してみたいと思います。ハードウェアの準備については良いとして、使用方法に関するインストラクションがほぼありません。このあたりは国産メーカーでは考えられませんが、触れながら操作方法をつかむ必要があります。基本的にアプリ操作が必須となりますので、スタンドアローンのほうが良い場合は本機はおすすめしません。ベースステーションのスイッチのアイコンもわかりにくいので、当面はガイドの厚紙を置いておきたいと思います。トラブルシューティングも用意されていないので、中断してもいいのかどうかなどわからないことは多々あります。【性能】・絡まらないブラシは優秀です。まだ運用を開始して数日しか経っていませんが、ブラシの状態は良好です。・8,200Paの吸引力は期待してよいと思います。モップ掛けした後の床面はさらさらで気持ちいいです。床面の素材の合わせてモップ圧力が変わるので、床にも安心です。ちなみにモップが上がる高さは12mmなので、毛足の長いカーペットには向きません。格子状に移動するので、やり残しが少ない点も優秀だと思います。おにぎり型モップで、隅っこも期待以上にきれいにしてくれます。・吸い取ったごみは自動的に圧縮されるので、ダストボックスが小さく設計されています。本当に7か月メンテナンスが不要であるかというと、当たり前ですがごみの量次第だと思います。個人的にはこまめに捨てようと考えています。・障害物センサーは普通に機能しています。クリアできる段差は2cmまでです。・モップだけではくダストボックスも乾燥できるので、衛生面での安心感があります。【気になる点】・やはり、使用方法に関するチュートリアルが必要だと思います。せっかく買ったはいいものの、使い方が今ひとつよくわからないというケースもあるかと思います。・メンテナンスに関する情報も必要だと思います。消耗品については、公式ウェブサイトの「アクセサリー」というところに、洗浄液、ブラシ、モップ、フィルターの紹介が上がっていました。総じて、高い吸引力と高い洗浄力が売りで、細かいことを気にすることなく掃除機に任せておけばいいと考えることができる方には最高の製品。国産メーカーの製品を使い慣れた方からすると不親切極まりなく、不安要素も多い。全自動掃除機に求める機能は一通り網羅しており(自動ゴミ捨て機能がないが、ゴミつまりを避けるためとのこと)、性能の割に価格はリーズナブル。しっかり働いてくれます。

reviews.body: Inizialmente il prodotto sembrava validissimo. reviews.title: Narwal NAR6972075732565 Aspiradora Robot Freo X Ultra con Estación de Acoplamiento Todo en Uno y Potencia de 8200 PA
reviews.author: Pablo L

reviews.body:
Questo modello rappresenta l'ultima evoluzione della famiglia Narwal e presenta molte novità interessanti. Sebbene abbia ancora alcuni problemi di navigazione, soprattutto quando si passa vicino mentre è in funzione, ho notato un netto miglioramento con l'ultimo aggiornamento del software.

Il Narwal Freo X Ultra è dotato di una spazzola centrale "Zero Grovigli" altamente efficace, progettata per rimuovere fili, peli e capelli da pavimenti e tappeti. La docking station è un vero e proprio centro di pulizia automatico, in grado di lavare e asciugare il mop, erogare il detergente, pulirsi e sterilizzare il serbatoio di raccolta polvere del robot.

All'interno della confezione ho trovato il Narwal Freo X Ultra, la docking station tutto-in-uno e tutti gli accessori necessari per il lavaggio e l'asciugatura del mop.

Il Narwal Freo X Ultra ha dimensioni compatte che gli consentono di muoversi facilmente in spazi ristretti e sotto i mobili. È leggermente più grande rispetto ai modelli precedenti, ma rimane comunque abbastanza maneggevole.

**Pro:**
- Spazzola centrale "Zero Grovigli" altamente efficace
- Docking station tutto-in-uno per il lavaggio e l'asciugatura automatica del mop
- Aggiornamenti software regolari per migliorare le prestazioni
- Design compatto e maneggevole

**Contro:**
- Problemi di navigazione occasionali
- Non adatto a tappeti molto spessi e morbidi

Ho utilizzato il Narwal Freo X Ultra principalmente per la pulizia dei pavimenti in casa mia e sono rimasto molto soddisfatto dei risultati. Nonostante alcuni piccoli inconvenienti iniziali, il robot si è dimostrato affidabile e efficiente nel rimuovere sporco e detriti da pavimenti e tappeti. La docking station automatica è stata particolarmente utile, rendendo il processo di pulizia completamente senza problemi. Sono fiducioso che, con ulteriori aggiornamenti software, questo robot diventerà ancora più performante e renderà la pulizia domestica ancora più semplice e conveniente.
reviews.title: Docking station tutto-in-uno
reviews.author: A.

reviews.body:
Confesso che non è la mia prima esperienza con dei robot aspirapolvere con base di ricarica, in famiglia ne abbiamo diversi ed anche di diversi marchi, posso dirvi che questo in particolare mi ha davvero stupito, cercherò di essere il più esaustivo possibile anche perché i pregi di questo robot sono davvero molti.

Dopo averlo provato, penso che questo Narwhal Frio X Ultra sia più di un semplice aspirapolvere robotizzato, posso affermare che è una piattaforma completa per la pulizia domestica che unisce funzionalità avanzate, design innovativo e tecnologia all'avanguardia corredati da una pulizia davvero ottimale.

Inizio con una panoramica delle funzionalità di base del Narwhal Frio X Ultra:

Questo dispositivo è progettato per offrire una pulizia completa e accurata in tutta la casa. È in grado di lavare, aspirare o eseguire entrambe le operazioni contemporaneamente, fornendo una pulizia efficace su tutte le superfici di casa vostra. E' davvero un robot versatile e di ultima generazione.

Una delle caratteristiche che distingue questo robot da tutti i concorrenti è la sua stazione tutto-in-uno, questa stazione infatti non solo funge da base di ricarica per il dispositivo, ma svolge anche altre funzioni davvero importanti. È dotata di un pannello touch capacitivo retroilluminato che consente di eseguire comandi manuali in modo intuitivo solo con il solo tocco di un tasto, al suo interno ospita serbatoi separati per l'acqua sporca e pulita, oltre a una bottiglia di detersivo per ottimizzare il processo di pulizia, vi assicura una pulizia costante di casa senza interruzioni e senza dovervi preoccupare troppo della sostituzione dell'acqua, ha un sistema di asciugatura dei panni, nel retro inoltre monta anche due attacchi per l'acqua e per lo scarco, quindi volendo è possibile anche collegarla all'impianto di casa e non preoccuparsi più di riempire il contenitore dell'acqua pulita e di sviotare il contenitore dell'acqua sporca.

Un'altra delle caratteristiche più innovative del Narwhal Frio X Ultra è il sistema DirtSense, questo sistema utilizza sensori avanzati per valutare il livello di pulizia del vostro pavimento. Se rileva particelle di sporco o contaminanti, il dispositivo continua a pulire fino a quando la superfice non sarà pulita al 100%. Questa funzione garantisce una pulizia completa e approfondita di ogni superficie, assicurando un igiene massima.

Per quanto riguarda la navigazione e la mappatura degli ambienti, utilizza un avanzato sistema di mappatura computazionale SLAM 4.0, questo sistema utilizza tecnologia LiDAR (tecnologia di rilevamento di distanza in tempo reale con sensori laser) e sensori laterali per navigare in modo preciso e efficace attraverso gli ambienti domestici, evitando ostacoli e rilevando le variazioni come muri, sedie, oggetti ed ostacoli degli ambienti. Questo assicura una pulizia completa e accurata in ogni stanza, senza alcun rischio di danni, graffi o incidenti.

La pulizia dei detriti è resa efficiente dal potente motore di aspirazione da 8.200 Pascal. Questo motore garantisce una rimozione completa dello sporco da ogni superficie, assicurando una pulizia precisa e potente; inoltre, il robot è dotato di una spazzola progettata appositamente per evitare l'ingarbugliamento dei capelli, garantendo una pulizia senza intoppi anche nelle case tipo la mia con animali domestici che perdono tanto pelo.

Le testine rotanti lavapavimento sono dotate di motori che sollevano e abbassano i panni di forma triangolare a seconda del tipo di superficie. Questo assicura una pulizia efficace su pavimenti e soprattutto tappeti, senza lasciare macchie umide o residui di sporco. Inoltre, la funzione Smart Edge Swing consente al dispositivo di avvicinarsi ai bordi e agli angoli per una pulizia completa e accurata lungo il perimetro delle stanze.

Oltre alle sue potenti capacità di pulizia, il Narwhal Frio X Ultra offre anche un'esperienza utente intuitiva e personalizzabile grazie alla sua applicazione dedicata consente di pianificare e monitorare le attività di pulizia da remoto, offrendo una vasta serie di opzioni di personalizzazione e funzionalità per adattare il dispositivo alle proprie esigenze.

Per concludere questo Robot aspirapolvere è davvero ideale per chi desidera avere una casa pulita senza doversi preoccupare troppo, di ultima generazione non ha nulla da invidiare ad altri concorrenti più famosi, anzi, li supera come innovazione in tutto e per tutto.

Consigliato.
reviews.title: Formidabile
reviews.author: A.

reviews.body:
**Introduzione:**

Finalmente ho avuto modo di provare a fondo il nuovo robot aspirapolvere con lavaggio e stazione di lavaggio, e sono rimasto davvero entusiasta. In questa recensione, condividerò i dettagli della mia esperienza, evidenziando i pro e i contro di questo prodotto innovativo.

**Funzionalità e caratteristiche:**

* **Doppia azione:** aspira e lava contemporaneamente (ma si può scegliere anche di farlo separatamente o in due passaggi diversi) grazie a due spazzole rotanti che convogliano lo sporco verso la potente aspirazione centrale e due panni rotanti sul retro.
* **Stazione di lavaggio automatica:** un vero tocco di classe! La stazione lava e asciuga i panni dopo ogni tot di area lavata e dopo ogni stanza, garantendo un lavoro impeccabile e una manutenzione minima.
* **Sensore di sporcizia intelligente:** il robot è in grado di rilevare la quantità di sporco sul pavimento e adattare di conseguenza la frequenza del lavaggio panni, per un'efficienza ottimale.
* **Applicazione avanzata:** l'app per smartphone permette di gestire le pulizie in modo preciso e completo. È possibile creare mappe virtuali della casa, impostare programmi di pulizia personalizzati, regolare la potenza di aspirazione e del flusso d'acqua, e monitorare l'attività del robot in tempo reale.
* **Modalità di pulizia avanzate:** oltre alla modalità di pulizia standard, il robot offre diverse modalità per adattarsi alle diverse esigenze:
* **Modalità 2D:** visualizza la mappa della casa in tempo reale, mostrando i percorsi seguiti dal robot.
* **Modalità 3D:** una vera chicca tecnologica! La mappa della casa viene visualizzata in 3D, per un'esperienza ancora più intuitiva e immersiva.
* **Pulizia mirata:** è possibile selezionare aree specifiche della casa da pulire, oppure creare zone virtuali da escludere dalla pulizia.
* **Accessori in dotazione:** il robot viene fornito con una serie di accessori utili, tra cui:
* Due panni rotanti in microfibra
* Due spazzole di ricambio
* Stazione di ricarica e lavaggio
* Serbatoio per l'acqua pulita
* Serbatoio per l'acqua sporca
* Detersivo per pavimenti
* Sacchetti usa e getta per il contenitore polvere

**Esperienza d'uso:**

Dopo aver configurato l'app e mappato la casa, ho subito messo alla prova il robot. La prima pulizia ha richiesto circa mezz'ora, ma il risultato è stato eccellente. I pavimenti erano perfettamente puliti e senza segni di spazzolate. La funzione di lavaggio è stata particolarmente apprezzata, in quanto ha permesso di rimuovere anche lo sporco più ostinato.

**Punti di forza:**

* **Pulizia impeccabile:** il robot aspira e lava con grande efficienza, lasciando i pavimenti impeccabili.
* **Stazione di lavaggio automatica:** un grande vantaggio che rende il robot davvero autonomo e pratico da usare.
* **Applicazione intelligente:** completa e intuitiva, permette di gestire le pulizie in modo preciso e personalizzato.
* **Modalità di pulizia avanzate:** la possibilità di scegliere tra diverse modalità rende il robot adatto a qualsiasi esigenza.
* **Accessori in dotazione:** il kit completo include tutto il necessario per iniziare a utilizzare il robot fin da subito.

**Punti di debolezza:**

* **Tempo di pulizia:** la prima pulizia completa del piano (60mq reali) ha richiesto circa 3 ore.
* **Capacità dei contenitori:** i serbatoi per l'acqua pulita e sporca sono da circa 5m4 litri, ma potrebbero richiedere di essere svuotati e riempiti più volte per pulire case grandi.
* **Costo:** il prezzo è elevato, ma a mio parere giustificato dall'alto livello di tecnologia e dalla qualità del prodotto.

**Conclusioni:**

In definitiva, questo robot aspirapolvere con lavaggio e stazione di lavaggio è un prodotto eccellente che consiglio vivamente a chi cerca un dispositivo di fascia alta per la pulizia domestica. Le sue funzionalità avanzate, la sua efficienza e la sua praticità d'uso lo rendono un investimento che vale la pena fare.

**Valutazione:** 4,8 stelle su 5

**Consigliato:** sì, per chi desidera il meglio in termini di pulizia automatica e domotica.

reviews.body:
Vacuum works well, and vacuums and mops as expected on normally clean tile and wood floors we have in most of the house.

I did get it to clean garage epoxy floor (never mopped, winter grime and road salt from car in piles) and it worked great on out of the box settings. With optimization of settings to wash mop after 5m2 would probably have been streak free after 2 goes.

Compared with our old Robovac the navigation and mapping and ability to set cleaning on different areas is better. However it lacks some things we really need:

1. 4 floors map storage. Really annoying, almost a send back issue as we need 4 or 5 due to split levels. This should be a simple app modification. Let’s see if we can work around it.
2. Ability to spot clean. May exist in app, but I’ve not found it. You can of course split up rooms to do this, but unnecessary.
3. Need to move base if you want to mop another floor. A hassle.
3. App designed around having Xiaomi full home automation. Would be much better if they had a “just show me the Hoover and forget the rest” setting.
reviews.title: Good vacuum plus mop, but some limitations

reviews.body: So far I am impressed with this robot. I had a robo vacuum before, old generation, and I’m impressed how much the technology advanced. This one scans the room when you set it uo and then uses the stored map to optimise cleaning. I recommend to use the vacuum before mopping setting because it protects the vacuum system from the humidity. One downside is that you cant put cleaning solution in the tank. So it cleans with just water. But you can set it so it rinses the mops every 5,8,10m. I find that by the end of the 8m the mop is already dry so I keep it on 5m setting. We have two floors so I tested taking it upstairs. And it works. You have to change the map in the app for it when you do that. It detects the stairs so it doesn’t fall. And it vacuum cleans the whole upstairs area in one go. With the mopping upstairs, given that it doesn’t have the base there, what I do is that I change the settings so it doesn’t return back to clean mops, and I rinse them and spray them with the cleaning solution by hand every 6-7 sqm it cleans.
reviews.title: Great vacuum robot

reviews.body:
Honestly this thing changed my life . I have a 80m2 fitness/relax room that is very annoying to clean and I installed the robot there. The first 2 times it cleaned the floor the water came out satisfyingly brown, proof that it was doing its job absolutely great. I now run it several times per week on a schedule and the room is always spotless. The fact that it goes back to the base to clean the mop every 8m2 (you can change that setting) ensures that the floor is actually being cleaned, contrary to simpler models that are just wetting it.

Battery is largely sufficient to cover the whole space in 1 run. The map generation function is amazing, especially compared to my 5 yo Roomba i7+. Honestly the only downside I found so far is that you can’t add detergent. The base is relatively big, not an issue per se but something you should be aware of before buying.

I’m so satisfied that I bought a second one for another floor of the house. And honestly, the price is absolutely incredible.

I have a few concerns in terms of data privacy, but at the end I don’t mind if a map of my house is being regularly sent to China. I did connect it to a separate guest WiFi network however, just in case…

name: Core 400S Air Purifier
description: Elevate your home's air quality with the Levoit Core 400S Smart WiFi Air Purifier in a sleek white design. This smart air purifier is a must-have for any modern home, seamlessly blending advanced filtration technology with convenient smart features. The Core 400S is more than just an air purifier; it's a smart home integration that allows you to control and monitor your air quality from anywhere. The purifier's exterior is a clean white color, designed to blend with any decor. It features a streamlined design, with a simple control panel on top for easy operation. The air intake is located around the base of the unit, while the purified air is released from the top. The device uses a three-stage filtration system designed to capture dust, pollen, pet dander, smoke, and odors. The pre-filter captures larger particles like dust and hair, extending the life of the other filters. The H13 True HEPA filter removes 99.97% of airborne particles as small as 0.3 microns, including allergens and pollutants. Finally, the activated carbon filter absorbs odors, smoke, and VOCs. With the Core 400S, you can create a healthier living environment for you and your family. The smart features allow you to monitor air quality in real-time via a companion app, adjust fan speeds, set timers, and receive filter replacement notifications. Compatible with voice assistants like Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant, controlling your air purifier is easier than ever. Experience the difference of cleaner, fresher air with the Levoit Core 400S Smart WiFi Air Purifier.

Equipped with motion, temperature, humidity, and ambient light sensors, the thermostat adapts to your environment for smarter performance. It also provides energy monitoring insights to help you track and improve efficiency over time. The device features a clear 2.4-inch LCD display for easy viewing and control, along with Bluetooth and dual-band Wi-Fi for stable connectivity and quick setup. It supports simple scheduling, allowing you to adjust temperature routines at any time, and is compatible with most 24V HVAC systems, including multi-stage setups.
